highlights.summary:
The Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai (ICT) is a public university founded in 1933 as the University of Chemical Technology, an affiliate of the University of Bombay. It received a "deemed to be university" status from the Ministry of Human Resources. It has been accredited grade ‘A++' by NAAC and recognised by the UGC. The courses are also approved by NBA.
ICT Mumbai has many departments offering UG, PG and doctorate programmes in fields of Engineering, Technology, Pharmaceuticals, Mathematics and Allied Sciences. The institution made collaboration with IIT Kharagpur and offers 2 year MTech program during internship. The highest package offered during the ICT Mumbai placements 2023 was INR 9 LPA and the average package offered was INR 6 LPA.

college_info_program.intro:
ICT Mumbai offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes across multiple streams such as Engineering, Technology, Pharmaceutical Science, Allied Sciences, and Mathematics. BTech and MPharma are the flagship programmes at ICT Mumbai. These programmes are provided in full-time mode in several specialisations. Some of the popular BTech specialisations are Chemical Engineering, Dystuff Technology, Fibres and Textile Processing Technology and Food Engineering and Technology. ICT Mumbai MPharma programme is accredited by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). Candidates seeking admission to these courses at the Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai, must meet the eligibility criteria. reviews.review_title: ICT: The best college for chemical engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: ICT Mumbai has a record of offering 100% placement to students in the bachelor of chemical engineering courses. The highest package offered this year (2024) was 20 LPA by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL). The average package is in the range of 13-14 LPA for the B. Chem. engineering course. Top recruiting companies are BPCL, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Sun Pharma, Pidilite Industries, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are excellent as far as academics are concerned. There are well-equipped labs for research. College Wi-Fi is made available after registration. Hostel facilities are available if the student lives more than 70km away from campus. The mess is available along with the Hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified. The passing percentage is 40% for each subject. The curriculum is pretty easy if you attend all the lectures and practice well. The practical labs give you hands-on experience with the theoretical knowledge you get in class.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology
reviews.review_title: A Very Underrated Government College.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are average, not up to expectations. The highest package for Textile 2024 was 16 LPA, and 2-3 people got it. Top recruiters are Trident, Arvind, and more. Almost all 3rd and 4th year students get internships. This is the textile processing branch; they teach textile chemistry here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good for the textile department. Labs for the textile department are good, not very good. Hostel facilities are good, mess food is okay, also cheap. Fees are only 36,000 for the year. There's a snooker table at the hostel and a turf to play cricket, and also basketball and volleyball courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is very good, teachers are very qualified and knowledgeable, though some are bad, they just read slides. The course in textiles is quite industry-ready, as much as I heard from seniors. This is textile processing engineering; it is more chemistry-oriented. We process the textile after the manufacturing is done.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Fibres and Textile Processing Technology
reviews.review_title: Review on Institute of Chemical Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: 50% students get placed, and the rest go for higher studies. The highest is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Trident, Bitra, Archroma, Aditya Birla, Reliance, BSaf, Siyaram, Vardhman, etc. Roles offered can range from marketing to shop floor work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms have air-conditioning and projectors. The library is well-equipped with books and journals. The food quality at the hostel is bad. Sports and games facilities are available. Hostel rooms are affordable, although they are quite small in size. The canteen food menu is limited, and the food is oily.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and experienced. The course curriculum needs to be updated. Several seminars and programs are conducted, making students ready to work in the industry and grow there. Semester exams are easy to pass. The pass percentage is 90%.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is best. There are multiple clubs, suiting all different kinds of personalities. Scholarships are available for students.

reviews.review_title: Good for aspirants who are willing to do research or opt for higher studies.

detailed_review.Placements: The eligibility for placement is that you have to clear all subjects, and in the 7th semester, companies hire students based on performance in mock group discussions and interviews. The average placement offer is between 3-5 LPA. Companies like Glatt and Sun Pharma hire B Pharma students based on their requirements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, and Wi-Fi is accessible once you get admission to ICT. The labs are top-notch; you will get different sections of labs in the pharma department, such as general labs, pharmacology labs, and pharmacetics labs. In the ICT campus, there are four hostels. UG students are admitted in hostel number 5, which is the best hostel among others based on facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified, but the teaching quality isn't that good. You will get the opportunity to do research on any topic of your preference under any professor, which gives you hands-on practice and exposure to research work and publications. The pass percentage is 40 percent.
detailed_review.Other: On campus, you will not get bored; it’s in the heart of Mumbai. In the university, every year there are many fests like Vortex, Asia's largest chem fest, and Manzar sports saga, where you can get the opportunity to participate and gain exposure to different things and exchange cultures.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering (Lipid Engineering)
reviews.review_title: The college for fortunate students.

detailed_review.Placements: In the last batch, I saw that 38 out of 55 students were placed, and 8 students received the opportunity to pursue a PhD in chemical engineering through government fellowships in different countries. The highest package was about 12 LPA, and the lowest was 4.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very poor because the actual campus of ICT Jalna college is under construction, so, at the moment, the college infrastructure is not that good and is rental. Although it's good if you're more focused on education instead of infrastructure. Regarding labs and classrooms, they are very good; all labs are equipped, and all the instruments are new and good. Classrooms are also good, with ACs and digital classroom logistics.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are well-educated and well-qualified, and they are all supportive. This is the best benefit of an autonomous college: you can directly meet any teacher by visiting their office. They have no problem helping and encouraging you. This course is very relevant to the industry and actually prepares a chemical engineer to be industry-ready. The implant training program is very helpful for gaining experience. The implant training (IPT) is actually an internship provided by the college for 12 months during your 5-year integrated M.Tech degree, which is sufficient and very helpful.
detailed_review.Other: There is not much crowd; it's a silent and peaceful area. It is strongly recommended for students who do not believe in night outs and enjoy life but believe in studying and planning for the future. For those looking for further education, like PhD candidates, taking admission here will yield the best results.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Polymer Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: Best college for chemical engineering fields.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 90-95 % of students are placed with an average package of 7 LPA and the companies that visited the campus were Exxon, BASF, Balmer Lawrie UAE, Cosmo Films etc. The placement percentage is low because many students don't accept the offer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Quality of the food in the mess is quite good as compared to other college's mess, and the canteen is even better and also not too expensive. For sports, basketball, volleyball, Badminton court is there and also turf is there for football. As such medical facilities are not there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, professors are very helpful and very talented as they have very good industrial experience. While talking about curriculum, it is quite good as they also teach you entrepreneurship, management and finance-related subjects so that if, in future, you decide to do something then you can figure it out by yourself.
detailed_review.Other: Firstly I wanted chemical engineering but I didn't get that branch as my marks were quite low, and polymer was second second-best branch in ICT as per the placement record. Talking about fests, there are many os them so don't worry you will enjoy it.

reviews.review_title: Best college for Masters in pharma.

detailed_review.Placements: ICT has only a few colleges across India and our college is the best chemical college in India. We have 100% placements rate every year with Astrazenca, Pfizer, Johnson&Johnson and many top Pharma companies visiting to hire a lot of students. For getting good packages, you need to perform well in the interviews. The highest package can go upto 40LPA. Internships are a part of the syllabus. Everyone needs to do at least one internship in every semester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college  infrastructure and campus is really cool. We have many labs in the college along with a new incubation centre which was developed this year. 24 hours Wi-Fi service is available in the college. They also provide a digital library which can be accessed from any location. College hostel has limited seats providing triple sharing rooms having separate beds, tables, fans, and water filter facilities. Mess food was decent in quality but the canteen’s food is really good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers of our college have completed their Masters from the university itself. They are really great with the practical experiments. They provide notes of every subject. Syllabus of our course includes many subjects and the industrial training makes us industry ready. Our batch’s passing percentage is 80%.
detailed_review.Other: College has students coming from different States of India. The surroundings have many shops and company offices are located nearby.

reviews.review_title: I am fully satisfied with this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 90 percent students get placed with top recruiters such as HPCL, and MACLEODS. The highest package offered for this course was18lakh/annum and the lowest package was 7lakh/annum. Almost all the students got internships with core industries. Some students were selected for DAAD, MITACS, TAIWAN internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are of top level with 24 hrs electricity and Wi-Fi availability. The classrooms, library, and the labs are fully air conditioned Hostels provides room with 4 students sharing each room having attach washrooms. Washing machines are provided for washing clothes. Food quality is also good in the mess. Our college is tied up with KIIMS for medical facilities. There are issues with outdoor games like cricket and basketball as we are currently in a temporary campus and do not have access to a bigger ground.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified with Ph.D. and M.Tech degrees and have approximately 10 years of teaching experience. This college has trimester based pattern with 3 trimesters each year having 2 trimesters for theoretical classes and 1 trimester for internship in the industries. Trimester exams are not that tough if you prepare well.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because it provides theoretical knowledge along with practical as after each trimester you go for internships in the industries where you can apply your theoretical knowledge learned in the classes. There are 2 fests which are organized each year i.e., PARVAAZ for final year students and UDGAM for Freshers.

reviews.review_title: Good placements and great college.

detailed_review.Placements: ICT placement needs a 6.0 CGPA in every semester. We have internships every year and need to do at least a 3-month internship. Emcure Pharma hires many students as trainee interns. Cipla, Lupin, and Dr. Reddy's are the recruiters. The packages depended on the interview, but it was always more than 7-8 lacs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Life on campus is lively, with a good social life and many clubs to join. The infrastructure was really good, with a well-stocked library and big classrooms. We have an annual fest called Vortex. Many enjoyable moments and events are held here. The hostel needs to be good; the accommodation is average and the food is also not good. Management needs to take care of these things.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have many teachers separate for practical. In practicals, we have great labs and teachers always help us understand and perform practicals. We have a very well-designed course in which equal importance is given to every subject. Exams are always hard in summer and winter; they are conducted each semester for 4-5 months.
detailed_review.Other: There is no need to improve; we just need to pay attention to the hostel and mess food.

reviews.review_title: About My Masters from ICT Mumbai.

detailed_review.Placements: Our institute is the top chemical institute in India. We have top-class placements. 100% of the students in every batch got placements. FSSAI, Haldirams Group, Lay's, Balaji Group, and many top companies in the industry are coming to campus. The package range is 4 to 20 lakhs per annum. We have internships in the curriculum; all students have done a 9-month internship with a stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus and classes were clean and green, but the campus area was small. For many events, management is done by seniors; every month we have at least one event. Wi-Fi facilities are provided, and a library is present in the college. We can bring any book from there. The hostel is big, but getting admission is challenging, given the merit list. As a South Indian here, food is different, but I have no other option.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty are Ph.D.-qualified seniors and also help us in our studies. Most teachers are 40+, but their teaching is really good because they have lots of experience. This course and institute are top in India; the demand in the industry is good, so there is no need to worry about placements. Semesters have combined passing and separate passing for practical and theoretical exams.
detailed_review.Other: I do not find anything that needs improvement, but only mess food needs to be in many varieties.

reviews.review_title: Review of Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai (ICT).

detailed_review.Placements: This institute has a wide range when it comes to the chemical industry. There are plenty of placement opportunities in both core and non-core industries. Every year, almost 90–95% of the chemical department is placed. Students get intern role at premier chemical companies like Unilever, Asian paints, Lupin, etc. I am a research intern with a stipend of 25,000 rupees.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus houses numerous clubs and societies. Several events are conducted throughout the year that benefit students in terms of sports. The ICT campus has badminton, cricket, and football courts. The hostel rooms are very clean and properly equipped with two, three, or four beds. Mess food is good in quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: For Course I appear for the entrance test, and most questions have tough calculations. Following that, the INR 1,000 application fee was paid. In this course, we have a one-year-long research project. Our professors are highly educated and always ready to help us. Semesters have practical and written exams, both of which need to be cleared for passing.
detailed_review.Other: The college fees is approximately INR 57,000 per month.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: Best college for research in Chemical Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch consisted of 20 students in my branch. Overall, the placements for my batch were good, with the highest package of 14 LPA offered by AB In Bev (a brewing company) and the average package being around 6 LPA. Nearly 80% of students sat for placements, while six people went for masters abroad. The main roles offered are in research and development, quality assurance and food production.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent when it comes to classrooms, but other facilities like labs, libraries, and research centers are excellent. It has a huge library where students can also access the books online through their portals. If you are genuinely interested in research in the chemical domain, this is heaven for you. Also recently, the M Mokashi incubation center was inaugurated, where you can work on your startup ideas. The sports and games facility, mess and canteen are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are highly qualified Ph.D. holders in their field, but not every professor is helpful and not every professor's teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is periodically updated to meet industry standards so that students become industry-ready. Also, the difficulty of the exams depends on the professor for that subject. Some make it really easy for you, while with others, you will have a hard time.
detailed_review.Other: It is located in Matunga, which is in central Mumbai, so connectivity is not an issue. Also, the campus is lush green and its surroundings are also beautiful. Also, at any time, one or other event is going on on campus. There are numerous fests, like Vortex (the Technical Fest), Manzar (the Cultural Fest), Sportsaga (the Sports Fest), and also departmental fests and events for freshers.

reviews.review_title: I have done my masters in chemistry. I am fully satisfied with my college, which includes facilities

40% of students were placed, and others went for higher studies.
INR 3 LPA was the lowest, INR 8 LPA was the highest, and the average package was around INR 4-5 LPA.

reviews.review_title: This is the best college in Maharashtra.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 40% of students go for higher studies at top universities across the world. All those who opt for placements get placed with decent salary packages. For chemical engineering, the average salary package is about 10 LPA, and the highest is around 21 LPA by BPCL. Companies that hire students from this campus include Reliance, Aarti Industries, BPCL, Exonn Mobile, SRF, etc. Internships are offered at the end of the third year. The implant training cell takes care that everyone gets an internship in companies like Reliance, Aarti Industries, Laxness, Biocon, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has the best infrastructure compared to other government colleges in Maharashtra. Classrooms are equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. It has a dedicated IPC lab for computer-related courses. The chemical lab is the heart of this college. We get to perform many experiments during our course. The machinery and equipment in the labs are too costly. Some of them cost more than Rs. 50000000. We can enjoy the lab sessions and perform out-of-the-box experiments.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly knowledgeable. They have industrial experience. Many of them got awards, like Padmbhushan and Padmvibhushan, from the government. Many faculty members are directors in big chemical companies. This improves our chances of getting placed in good companies through their contacts. Semester exams are tough, but you will surely enjoy studying one night before and getting passed.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Food Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: It is the best college for M. Tech in Mumbai.

detailed_review.Placements: Before students were about to give their final exams, there were placement interviews held over one or two months. The institute placement wing listed the dates for the placement interviews. As there were appropriate chances of jobs, students were able to pass the interview and the written aptitude tests due to their academic knowledge.

Almost every student gets a desk, bed, and locker. If a student wanted to rent one of them, it would be very expensive because the college was in New Mumbai. The meal quality in college was very good. The menu had not yet been decided. They provided non-vegetarian food twice a week in sufficient quantities. If a student wants an extra meal, such as an egg or a banana for breakfast, they must pay.
detailed_review.Faculty: There was a ratio of approximately 1:35, which states that there was one teacher available for 35 students, which was quite good. Our teachers were highly qualified and their behavior was also excellent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because it is the best for this type of course. Anyone could choose this college to do this course. Our class had 35 students and our course fee was Rs. 85,250 per year.

reviews.review_title: Overall good college but there is no campus life as its own campus is not ready yet.

detailed_review.Placements: There is no placement till now as our college 1st batch will pass out in july 2023. So there is no idea of placement till now. But internships are very good here. From 1st year u will get internship in iocl and other companies in research fields.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classroom and library are good. Wi-Fi is also available in college premises. Hostel rooms are very spacious with accommodation of 3 students in each room. Quality of food is good in mess. Medical facilities is also there. But there is no canteen in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite decent here well qualified for teaching. Some teachers have qualified GATE also and some are Ph.D. holders. Course curriculum are well designed. Semester exams are not very tough but u need to study hard. If u fail in semester exam then u can sit for re-exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with this institute.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college, almost 100% of students are placed every year. This year, the highest salary package offered is 12 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 5 LPA. reviews.review_title: Wonderful faculty members and campus life .

As of 2021, Average package of my branch was 7 lac per annum. Many well known companies like Reliance, Tata chemicals, BASF, BPCL HPCL, ONGC, Dr. Reddy's laboratories, Asian paints, Ambuja cement, etc. Recruited students. In India only this institute has 3-6 months of internship in 3rd semester as a part of its curriculum which gives good professional experience.

reviews.review_title: It's a nice college if you want to pursue chemical engineering it is the best college in India .

They have amazing teacher faculty members many types of equipment are available for every field. The course curriculum is very relevant and they are very cooperative .

reviews.review_title: It is a great college that provides a journey towards well-being.

admission.title: ICT Mumbai Admission Overview
admission.overview_text:
ICT Mumbai admission is ongoing. Admission to the BTech course is based on a score in MHT CET or JEE Main exam. Check the Institute of Chemical Technology course admission, followed by course-wise eligibility, selection criteria, fee, seat intake and others.

The following steps must be followed for ICT Mumbai admissions:

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for the MBA programme at ICT Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Students must complete graduation with a 50% aggregate to enrol for MBA admission at ICT Mumbai. Students also have to pay the course fee if they get selected. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply for this course.

faqs.question: What is the minimum cutoff of ICT Mumbai for BTech in 2024?
faqs.answer: ICT Mumbai offers admission to BTech specialisations on the basis of JEE Main ranks. The cutoff for the above BTech specialisations varied between 25192 and 46061 , for the General AI category candidates. Therefore, to attain a seat at ICT Mumbai, candidate must have a rank of 25192 or above in the JEE Main.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the fees for four years BPharma in ICT Mumbai?
faqs.answer: ICT Mumbai BPharma tuition fee is INR 4.9 lakh . Other than this, the hostel fee is INR 99,00 (for boys) . Moreover, candidates who are willing to know the complete fee structure can visit the official website of the university. Note: However, it is subject to change. Hence it is indicative. The aforementioned fee has been sourced from official sources.

faqs.question: What is the expected JEE Main cutoff 2024?
faqs.answer: NIT Manipur JEE Main cutoff 2024 has been released for admission to the BTech courses. During the Round 1 cutoff, the closing rank for CSE was 25886 for the General category students under the AII India Quota. Among OBC candidates, the closing rank for B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering stood at 8750 . sections.heading: Introduction
text: The Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai campus has state-of-the-art infrastructure. It has modern classrooms, laboratories and a high-end library with 70,000+ books and bound volumes. The Information Processing Centre (IPC) has 150 PCs, 2 laptops, and 1 LCD projector. The university has on-campus accommodation for around 850+ students of all courses in its 5 hostels.

ICT campus also has a gymnasium, playgrounds, and indoor & outdoor sports facilities. ICT Mumbai has four centres with high-end technology and modern learning facilities. The main campus of the university is in Mumbai, and off-campus locations are Bhubaneswar (Odisha) and Marathwada (Jalna). See the video below to know more about ICT Mumbai infrastructure.

sections.heading: ICT Mumbai Campus Highlights
text: The ICT Mumbai campus is spread across 16 acres with all the modern facilities required by students. It has a huge auditorium, which can accommodate a large group of students for college-level events. The research centres have well-equipped labs with all the modern equipment for students' academic needs. There are arrangements for both indoor and outdoor sports to encourage students to participate in physical activities. It also has Animal House facilities. The animal house has an area of about 1500 ft² , which has highly ventilated air conditioning system (HVAC) to provide proper air and lights. The house has small animals, like mice, rats, guinea pigs, rabbits, etc. Some of the key campus highlights are below:

tables.ICT Mumbai Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

sections.heading: ICT Mumbai Hostel Facilities
text: The campus has 4 hostel blocks for both boys and girls. The total accommodating capacity is close to 900 , including students from all courses and years. Hostel rooms are properly ventilated and have the basic furniture, such as a study table and chair, a bed, a cupboard, etc. All the hostels are under 24/7 CCTV surveillance for the safety and security of the students. ICT Mumbai hostels have 3 Messes , which are run internally by the Mess committees headed by the Warden. Allocation of the hostels is completely merit-based, and preference will be given to students who come from outside Mumbai.

For the hostels, guest rooms are also available for the parents who wish to come and visit their wards. For medical emergencies, on-call doctors are also available for the students. Senior doctors are also available in the health centre of the hostel. The hostel of ICT Mumbai also consists of a gymnasium and playgrounds with sports facilities for indoor & outdoor sports activities. Some other hostel facilities of ICT Mumbai are as follows:

sections.heading: ICT Mumbai Library
text: Prof. M M Sharma Library is the central library. It functions as a dual library, catering to both the academic and research needs of students. The ICT Mumbai library is housed in a separate ground-floor area, along with a two-storey building. Inside the library, there is a dedicated reading space accommodating 200 students at once. The library remains open throughout the year, except on four days: Independence Day, Republic Day, Ganesh Chaturthi, and Dussehra. Some of the library’s collections are as follows:

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the ICT MumbaiCampus
text: Within a short distance from the Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai campus, students can explore lots of places, like the South Indian Temple, Don Bosco Church, B N Maheshwari Udyan, Sion Garden Park , and others. The local Matunga market also provides a vibrant experience. Matunga is a popular location among students for its South Indian delicacies. A few popular eateries are Arya Bhavan, Ram Ashraya, Udupi, Sharda Bhavan, and Cafe Madras, etc. Watch the video for more information:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: Institute of Chemical Technology's library has a collection of 77102 books, bound volumes and reports, 4848 theses, 125 journals (printed) and 5 databases. It performs a dual role of an academic library as well as a research library. It is housed in a separate ground plus two-storied building and follows a completely open-access concept. The library is fully computerized using the library management software called Libsys. It can be termed as a hybrid library with the best collection of printed and digital documents. The library is also a member of E-ShodhSindhu Consortium. The library has a facility of circulation service, reference and referral service, current awareness service, bibliographic service, photocopying service, user orientation programs, e-resources training programs and book bank service.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: ICT has five hostel blocks on the campus including 3 boys and 2 girls hostels. The total number of hostel accommodation seats available for the students at the ICT is nearly 855 (for all courses and years) including 210 lady students.

highlights.summary:
Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur (MNIT) which was formerly known as Malaviya Regional Engineering College (MREC) Jaipur was named after Madan Mohan Malaviya. It is a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Rajasthan. The institute is recognised by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and has been accredited by the NBA.
Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur was ranked 42nd in the 'Engineering' category by NIRF 2025 Ranking. MNIT has signed MoUs with several international universities such as the University of Greenwich London, Stevens Institute of Technology, North Dakota University, University of Saskatchewan, Deakin University, Florida International University, University of Dundee, and Medine Education Mauritius, among others.
It was established in 1963 as a public technical university in Jaipur, India. MNIT offers a wide variety of studies in Engineering, Sciences, Management, Design, and Humanities. Eight four-year undergraduate courses of study led to the Bachelor of Technology degree, and a five-year undergraduate course led to the Bachelor of Architecture degree, with a total of over 5,000 students. Postgraduate degrees award Master of Technology (MTech), Master of Science (MSc), Master of Business Administration (MBA) and Master of Urban Planning. There are also doctoral programmes with over 300 students. Popular courses at Malaviya National Institute of Technology include BE/ BTech and MTech. MNIT admission to BTech is done through the JEE Mains entrance examination. It is followed by JoSSA counselling.
According to the MNIT placements 2024, the highest package stood at INR 64 LPA. The MNIT Jaipur average package and median package offered to UG students stood at INR 11.06 LPA and INR 8 LPA, respectively. The institute also has a dedicated training and placement cell that conducts different training and skill-development programmes for students. The institute facilitates its students with a library, auditorium, seminar or conference halls, guest houses, internet & wifi, hostels, and canteen, among others. detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85–90 percent of students from this Mechanical Engineering batch got placed, the highest package offered is 24 LPA, the median and average package is around 10 LPA, the minimum package is 5–6 LPA, students who get on-campus internships are very few, almost 18–20 percent, and the top recruiters are BPCL, HPCL, JPMC, BNY, and Amazon.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available are quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, electricity, classrooms, and libraries, but for hostels the mess is the worst part as the food is of very low standard and we have to manage by taking food from the canteen sometimes, although some government hostels are good in terms of food quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are mostly highly qualified and knowledgeable, but they lack in teaching quality as either they are not interested in teaching or don’t take it seriously, the courses are relevant as per the demand of industry and companies, the level of semester exams is not difficult, and it is quite easy to maintain a 7 CGPA.

reviews.review_title: Highly impressed by the faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 96 students are placed out of 108 students enrolled last time. The highest package offered is by JPMC, which offered a package of 27 LPA, while the average stood at 13 LPA with the lowest at 4.6 LPA. Top recruiters include JPMC, L&T, Honda, Tata, etc., and other PSUs like BPCL, HPCL, BEL, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We had a nice infrastructure as this institute is an institute of national interest. The most famous building includes Vivekananda Lecture Theatre Complex (VLTC), which is also Asia's biggest lecture theatre. All labs are advanced in my department with certain labs for conventional manufacturing too. You will find a 24*7 Wi-Fi facility in the whole campus. Hostel forms another joy of life. We had a lot of fun in the hostel. Food in hostel is around average, but friendship is a must to order food from outside.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty here are Ph.D. in their respective fields. They have immense knowledge. You can approach them anytime by mail and physically in their office during academic time. I had good relations with certain professors who guided me not only in academics but in personal problems too. The course curriculum is completely industry-oriented. Like as a mechanical engineer, we also learnt machine learning and IoT.

reviews.review_title: It is useless here.

detailed_review.Placements: They are good enough. Many companies come and placement records of MNIT regarding chemical engineering are literally good. There is also a placement cell for different branches that will guide you on your way. Hope you will get a good placement. Coding culture is the worst here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is too bad for this college. Water quality is very poor in lecture hall complex, sports ground, and even in hostel. You have to walk miles to fetch good water. The course is very chill.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our branch has good faculty members. But you cannot study with them. You have to take the help of YouTube for sure. It does not make the students ready for industry. Semester exams are too easy to pass. Teachers are very good and supportive, you will enjoy it.
detailed_review.Other: Definitely not something I will recommend. Fests are overhyped and they are just yuck. Department days are also the worst.

reviews.review_title: MNIT Jaipur is the best NIT in North India.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80% of students get placed in our college. The highest package is 1 crore, the lowest package is 12 LPA, and the average package is 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Flipkart, Qualcomm, and others. Almost 40% of students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our hostels are old but look okay. The infrastructure is very good. There are many classrooms and one big library that contains a lot of books related to subjects and others. There are almost 17 hostels for both boys and girls.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant to the course. Semester exams are more difficult than expected. The pass percentage is 65%. It does not make the students industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am very interested in Organic Chemistry.

reviews.review_title: Decent campus life and solid infrastructure, but faculty needs improvement – MNIT Jaipur experience.

detailed_review.Placements: I am doing B.Tech. In chemical engineering from MNIT Jaipur, 2028 batch. There is AIR 2 from chemical department, GATE 2024 from MNIT Jaipur. The 2024 batch placements details for chemical engineering- around 62% of students are placed with maximum, median, and average CTC of 27 LPA, 9.5 LPA, and 11 LPA, respectively. Top recruiting companies are Reliance Industries and Tata Chemicals.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is top-notch. Hostel is also very good but the only problem is with mess food which I think is in the majority of colleges. Talking about the chemical department facilities, there are labs, Wi-Fi (24x7), library with AC installed, and classrooms. There is also central canteen and night canteen in college. There is a dispensary for medical facilities. All major sports facilities and other facilities are available at the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very well qualified, knowledgeable, and helpful also. But I think they lags in teaching quality. They are not able to build interactions throughout the class. The curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are not so difficult, and majority of the students pass with only just above the passing marks. But there is absolute grading system in the chemical branch of MNIT, unlike relative grading system that is in other branches.

reviews.review_title: Fantastic college life at MNIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in my college are less than average. The maximum package in my branch is 27 LPA, and the medium package is also provided. Higher studies outside India are chosen by most of the students. The placement percentage is low, which is around 63%. Tata Motors, Hero, and MotoCorp are the top recruiting companies for our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is excellent. The hostel is new, well-maintained, and synchronized. The mess has hygienic and delicious food with a special dinner every month. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The lab facilities are old and in need of new equipment. Wi-Fi facility is available in the academic block of the college only.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum and courses do seem a bit old, but even the premier institutes such as IITs have the same kind of curriculum. Professors are highly qualified. All the teachers and professors have completed their master's and Ph.D. from premier institutes in the country and the world.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd is superb. It is full of intelligent and talented individuals. The campus life is also wonderful. We can keep ourselves truly occupied if we want to in non-stop fests, club events, and competitions.

reviews.review_title: Nice experience at MNIT Jaipur.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements provided are decent and feasible. The package deal is 62.75 LPA. The median deal is around 15 LPA. Placement ratio is good too, around 70%. The best hiring companies here at MNIT in electrical engineering department are Deloitte, BHEL, and Airtel.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is excellent. Hostel facility is extremely well-maintained and newly built. Labs are well-maintained and marvelous. Lab sessions are so planned that these sessions are engaging and happening. Wi-Fi is not provided in all areas of the campus, specifically in the hostel block. In hostel, internet is available through LAN cables. The quality of food here at MNIT is not up to the mark and it is sometimes not hygienic too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The semester is roughly 4 months. There is a lag of 2 months between mid-semester exams and end-semester exams. Course curriculum is decent. Quality of teaching is average. Semester exams are not very tough. Majority of students clear exams. Pass percentage is 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for college over a branch in my order of preference. Additionally, the research lab here in my department is excellent and according to my interests. The lab equipment is upgradable. There are two main fests in my college, Sphinx and Blitz. Scholarships are being provided to deserving students. The campus is located in a VVIP location in Jaipur, which offers safe and peaceful environment.

reviews.review_title: Realistic opinion about MNIT Jaipur.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are satisfactory. Many companies visit the college and the placement figures of MNIT for chemical engineering are literally satisfactory. There is also a placement cell for other branches that will lead us on the right path. I hope we will have good placements. The coding culture here is the worst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not good in this college. The quality of water is poor in the lecture hall complex, sports grounds, and even hostels. We get a good water. Moreover, the infirmary remains closed on Sunday. Sports facilities will also be closed on Saturday and Sunday.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful for exams, and they give more information. There is a sufficient number of teachers. In every semester, there is a medium-level exam paper. There is a mid-term paper for 30 marks and an end-term paper for 50 marks, with 20 marks for internal assessment. Courses are good. The course curriculum is quite relaxed.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this branch because I wanted to study in a large and beautiful college. The two biggest events in college are Sphinx the biggest tech fest in Rajasthan, and Blitz the biggest culture fest in Rajasthan. Several other events also keep happening all around the year.

admission.title: MNIT Jaipur Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: Malaviya National Institute of Technology Jaipur admission 2025 is primarily entrance-based. MNIT Jaipur offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes in Engineering , Architecture & Planning, Management, and Applied Sciences. Some of the popular courses offered by the technology institute are BTech, MTech, MBA, PhD, and MSc. As per the admission process, the mode of application for all the courses offered at MNIT Jaipur is online. The institute accepts scores of national-level examinations such as JEE Main , GATE , and IIT JAM. The seat allotment is carried out through JoSAA, CCMT, and CCMN counselling for BTech, MTech, and MSc, respectively. Read more to know about MNIT Jaipur admission 2025 in the following article:

faqs.question: How do I get admission to MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Admission to MNIT Jaipur is completely entrance-based. Candidates who are willing to get admission to any of the UG & PG courses at MNIT Jaipur must qualify for national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, IIT JAM, CAT, etc., for the respective courses. Candidates who pass the selection process have to register and appear for the counselling process conducted by specific counselling bodies. Find below the selection criteria for the popular courses:

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: No, admission to all the courses of MNIT is through entrance examinations. For example, admission to UG courses (BTech and BArch) is only through Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB) after JEE exam. In addition, for PhD, admission is granted based on merit in the in-house entrance test. No other means of admission is accepted by the institute.

faqs.question: What is the cost of studying MBA at MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: As per the unofficial sources, MNIT Jaipur MBA  fee for MBA course is INR 2 lakh. This is tuition fee is calculated as per the first-year fee and the amount can vary. The hostel charges are up to INR 1.43 lakh and a one-time fee of INR 18,300 is also added to the total fee. Candidates have to pay a certain amount of fee at the time of admission. However, if students call off admission till the last date of cancellation of admission, their first-semester fee will be refunded after the applicable deducting processing charges. Further, the given fee is as per unofficial sources. Candidates can visit the institute's website for more details around MNIT Jaipur MBA fee.

faqs.question: Is there MBA in MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Jaipur offers a two-year XAT / MBA course. Admission to the Management course is entrance-based. The aspirants are admitted based on scores in CAT / XAT / CMAT / MAT followed by group discussion and personal interview rounds. Moreover, the total tuition fee is INR 2 Lacs and there are 79 seats available for the course.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MNIT Jaipur for MBA?
faqs.answer: The selection criteria for MBA admission at MNIT Jaipur includes the score of the national-level entrance exam. Canddiates seeking for admission to MNIT Jaipur MBA course must appear for either CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ GMAT. Candidates are further shortlisted based on exam scores and then required to take part in the group discussion and personal interview rounds. Based on performance in all the selection rounds, the seat allotment will be carried out. Check out the CAT 2024 preparation strategy to ace the exam.

faqs.question: What is the fees of M.Tech in MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Total course fee includes multiple components such as tuition fee, admission fee, hostel fee, caution deposit, etc. Moreover, the total tuition fee for the MNIT MTech courses ranges from INR 1.4 Lacs to INR 2.1 lakh. This given fee is as per the data taken from unofficial sources and thus is subject to changes. Aspirants can visit the MNIT website (mnit.ac.in) for more details on the fee structure.

faqs.question: Is GATE compulsory for admission at MNIT Jaipur in MTech?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to M.Tech programmes is only through GATE. The institute does not accept any other entrance test scores. Moreover, aspirants with valid GATE scores also need to take part in CCMT counselling for the seat allocation procedure. Candidates have to pass graduation with BTech in order to be eligible to apply for the course.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in M.Tech in MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Admission to the M.Tech programme at MNIT Jaipur is done basis of GATE score and CCMT Counselling. The seat allotment is carried out during the counselling. BTech/BE or MSc with a minimum of 60% aggregate is the basic eligibility for M.Tech offered at MNIT Jaipur. Eligible candidates can apply for the GATE website by visiting the official website (gate.iitk.ac.in).

faqs.question: Which M.Tech courses are offered by MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The technology institute offers MTech courses in over 20 specialisations. Some of the popular M.Tech specialisations offered are Structural Engineering, VLSI Design, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Water Resource Engineering, and Steel Technology. The institute also offers MTech courses in part-time mode. The total seat intake for all MTech specialisations is 612 collectively.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for MSc offered at MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: MNIT Jaipur offers MSc admission based on the scores obtained by the candidates in the IIT JAM score. Based on the cutoff marks, selected candidates further need to take part in CCMN counselling ( steps to apply ). Candidates who meet the eligibility requirements can apply to take the IIT JAM exam online by visiting the official website (iitr.ac.in). To be eligible to apply for this course, candidates have to pass UG dehree in BSc from a recognised boad.

faqs.question: What is the mode of application for MSc at MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to MSc at NIT Jaipur need to apply for IIT-JAM ,  followed by CCMN for admission. The application process for IIT JAM is carried out in online mode (jam.iitg.ac.in). In order to submit the application successfully, aspirants shall pay the application fee, which is INR 1,800 for all the candidates and INR 900 for females (all categories)/ SC/ ST/ PwD for one test paper.

faqs.question: What MSc courses are offered by MNIT Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The PG-level course is offered in three specialisations. The course is available in the disciplines of Applied Chemistry, Applied Mathematics, and Applied Physics. The admission procedure is the same for all these programmes. There are a further 41 seats available for each of the MSc courses. Read more about the admission process here .

faqs.answer: The mode of application at MNIT Jaipur is online. Aspirants can visit MNIT's official website (mnit.ac.in) to fill out the application. highlights.summary:
UPES was established in 2003 under the UPES Act, 2003. It is one of the renowned universities in Dehradun to offer quality education to students. It is a private university and has several schools, functioning under it like School of Computer Science, School of Design, School of Law, School of Business, etc. UPES Dehradun is globally famous and has been ranked in the band of 901-950 by the QS World University Rankings 2026 in the World University category. It has also ranked 45, 43, and 36 in the categories like University, Engineering, and Management, respectively by NIRF 2025.
University of Petroleum in Dehradun is recognised by the UGC and has around 1,500 faculty members who are experienced in providing quality education to students. The university has more than 14,000 students who trust the education system and curriculum of the university. It has also been accredited by the NAAC with an A grade. Further, the Petroleum University Dehradun has also been accredited by NBA and is a member of AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business). UPES Dehradun admission is conducted on the basis of both merit and entrance exam scores. Some of the popular entrance exams accepted by the university are JEE Main, CUET UG, UPESEAT, SAT India, CAT, etc.
UPES Kandoli campus courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The university offers various courses like BTech, BBA, BCA, BPharm, MBA, etc., mainly in the fields of Engineering, Business Management, Computer Applications, Pharmacy, Science, and others. reviews.course: B.Tech. in  Applied Petroleum Engineering (Intelligent Petroleum Systems)
reviews.review_title: Absolutely I am satisfied because of good culture, faculty, and good placement in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: About 95 percent of students are placed in the year 2025, the highest package is about 35 LPA, the average is about 11 LPA, and the top recruiters for our branch are Cairn Oil & Gas, Vedanta Ltd, ONGC, Adani Gas, HP, Oil India Limited, GAIL, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good, we have a common library, the campus is divided into blocks in which classes are conducted, sports facilities are also good, the college hostel has a limited number of seats so I would prefer an off-campus hostel, but the food in the campus is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and experienced, they are always helpful and supportive, semester examinations are not very difficult if you pay attention to lectures, and you can score a good CGPA with minimal effort, as the course curriculum is related to industry requirements.

reviews.review_title: Knowledgeable faculty and support.

detailed_review.Placements: 99% are placed. 6 LPA is the lowest package, and 33 LPA is the highest, but placement records are good, and everyone is getting placements somewhere else, and students are also supportive. Zepto, blinkit, EY, KPMG ITC, Indigo, Aadani Airpot, ONGC and all are recruiting. 100% got internships. Manager and Consulting roles are offered. placements are also good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything has Wi-Fi, a good connection, good college life and a view. Hostel life is amazing and has to be seen, and the night view and jamming sessions are the point of attraction.
detailed_review.Faculty:
All the teachers are highly qualified, and they are great and supportive. 
3 years for Bachelor's and 2 years minimum for Master's degree. For a 3-year Bachelor's degree, there are 6 semesters, and for a 2-year master's course, 4 semesters. You will love the campus life. The faculty is also knowledgeable and supportive.
detailed_review.Other: One university offering an MBA.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Digital Forensics)
reviews.review_title: The college can improve on the placement records.

detailed_review.Placements: A smaller number of student placement records have been shown this year, and I heard about the fact that Microsoft banned this college from entering for placements due to an internal issue. The placements average at  7 to 10LPA, that too if you are qualified with a good amount of knowledge in the field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are fair, sports facilities can be improved, and there are frequent Wi-Fi problems. I went inside the on campus hostel and noticed the rooms are smaller but ventilated well with a good mess. There needs to be more events based on communities outside the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers who are on the younger side are helpful but can be rude at certain times. The curriculum can be better focused on newer generation technology in the coding part. The semester exams can be passed with a fair amount of practice and knowledge of what happens in the classes.
detailed_review.Other: Events and everything are fair and good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization Technology)
reviews.review_title: Career prospects are strong, though classrooms can feel average.

detailed_review.Placements: UPES has excellent placement opportunities, especially in CSE. Around 90-95% students are placed with the highest package going above 50 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. Opportunities are there, but for top performers. Core roles are limited, and many companies offer mass recruitment profiles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: UPES has one of the best infrastructures among private universities in India, but classrooms should have AC. Hostel and cafeteria are decent, the view from hostel is epic. Wi-Fi-enabled labs are advanced, well-stocked libraries. Sometimes you feel crowded in hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive. The curriculum is industry-oriented, updated regularly and includes emerging areas, AIML, data science and cloud computing. UPES also encourage projects and certification. Exams are manageable if you keep up with lectures.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd in UPES is diverse, with students from all over India. You get good exposure to various cultures, and most students are friendly and energetic. Overall, you will easily find your group.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Graphics and Gaming)
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, overcrowded for B.Tech students, and placement is average.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in second year so no one is placed in my batch. But the senior gets package which is well and good. The highest package is around 60 LPA in my course, and average is 12 LPA. Some top recruiting companies are TCS, Microsoft, Amazon, and others. Internship is mandatory in our course so everyone gets an internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has all the facilities like Wi-Fi, computers, and labs. I live off campus so I don't have an idea of the hostel on campus. In sports, we have basketball, football, volleyball, badminton, cricket, and many others. We also have tournaments and all to encourage students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful but some are not so good and helpful. Teachers are knowledgeable but sometimes they lack somewhere either in the course or to understand the students. The course curriculum is good like they don't have unnecessary subjects and topics. Semester exams are not so difficult to pass but a little bit of hard work is required.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Applied Petroleum Engineering (Energy Systems and Storage)
reviews.review_title: So basically, if you are willing to have good placements and be successful.

detailed_review.Placements: So basically, in my course, the strength of the students is not that much, which means the competition criteria is not very high, resulting in good placements. I'm currently in batch 1, and the total batches in my passing stream are 3. The eligibility criteria to sit for placements is 8+ CGPA, which every student should have for their own benefit. The highest package in my college is recorded as 50 LPA, which is recently offered in 2024, whereas the average top package is 17 LPA, which I think is good for a beginner.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: So TBH, I am not living in the campus hostel as the campus hostel serves non-veg food, and I have been a vegan from birth. So I avoid living inside the college campus. But I have seen some facilities and also heard more from my friends, like good infrastructure with good-speed Wi-Fi, properly furnished rooms with no smelly gallery, separate balconies, and many more. Medical facilities and other curricular activities are also available on campus in different places with different rules.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really working hard to help us understand concepts by being strict, which I really appreciate now as a mature student. Many extracurricular activities are also there, for example, I am an applied petroleum student, so I participated in course-related clubs that include quizzes directly connected to my course and help me with my academics. However, the semester exams are not that tough to pass, if you study well and keep up with the teacher, then there’s no reason to be stressed about them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science (Global Pathway Program)
reviews.review_title: Industry-focused curriculum with great campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at UPES are pretty solid. Around 90% of students get placed each year. The top package has gone up to 50 LPA, and the average is about 7 to 8 LPA, and companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Deloitte, PwC, and ONGC hire from here, with roles ranging from engineers and developers to business analysts and legal associates. Placements are a strong point, though internships could be improved.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College offers modern infrastructure with Wi-Fi, labs, smart classrooms, and a rich library. Hostels are safe with decent food, medical care is available 24/7, and the campus has strong sports and fitness facilities for an overall balanced student life.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at UPES are really helpful and knowledgeable. The courses are industry-focused, so you feel prepared for real jobs. Exams are not too tough if you study regularly, and most students (90%+) pass without much stress. Faculty at UPES are generally seen as helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable.
detailed_review.Other: I picked this course mainly because it’s industry-focused and has good placement opportunities. The best part is the practical learning and supportive teachers. On the flip side, fees are a bit high, and internships could be more. Campus life is fun with lots of fests, events, and clubs. The crowd is lively, the surroundings are beautiful, and there are scholarships for deserving students, so overall it’s a good mix of study and fun.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Cloud Computing and Virtualization Technology)
reviews.review_title: UPES 2025 updated information, all about infrastructure, placements, facilities, hostel, etc.

detailed_review.Placements: Usually, in UPES, students get placed with a decent package of around 8 LPA. When it comes to the highest package, it goes above 30 LPA, and average is 8-10 LPA. Many companies come to the college and take students with a good package, but it totally depends on the student whether they will be able to clear it or not.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty good, and UPES has its own Wi-Fi named UPESNET. It has a good high internet speed, and also the labs and classrooms are not the same as those at CU, GUE, and other private universities. It has far better infrastructure with a good environment, but when it comes to campus hostel, you are charged a lot higher fees, i.e., Rs. 1,94,000 for a triple sharing room, and the food in the mess is not of that good level. As a student who lived on campus for a year, it was very tough to eat that food.
detailed_review.Faculty: UPES has a highly qualified faculty. Faculty have a great knowledge of the subjects, and they actually guide everything and are always available for help. UPES has one of the most advanced curricula compared to most universities. Semester exams are tough to clear as they have a moderate level, but students generally pass.

reviews.course: B.Des. in Graphics and Communication Design
reviews.review_title: Great campus, creative vibe.

detailed_review.Placements: I've just completed my second year in BDes in UPES, so I'm not completely aware of the placements yet. However, according to what I've heard, around 80% get placed, and the remaining ones are given a minimum salary just so that the college can claim 100% placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many facilities, classrooms with projectors, design labs, a library, a sports ground, a hostel, a gym, WiFi, an infirmary, a multipurpose hall, cafeterias, and a lot of scenic and creative spaces. I haven't lived in the in-campus hostels, but I've heard they're okay, just overpriced.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and experienced, and the teaching quality is good with a practical focus. The course is industry relevant and updated. Exams are moderate in difficulty, and most students pass with consistent efforts. Specifically for design, we don't have written exams, rather interaction-based ones, called the jury.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for its creative focus and industry exposure. The best part is the hands-on projects. I wish there was more interdepartmental collaboration. The campus vibe, events, crowd, and the surroundings are lively and inspiring.

reviews.course: B.Des. in Mobility and Vehicle Design
reviews.review_title: Well-built campus providing you the best experience of what college life means.

detailed_review.Placements: If students choose transportation and mobility design at UPES, about 70 to 85% get placed almost every year. The highest ever package recorded is about 10 LPA, with the average being 4-5 LPA and the lowest being 2.5-3 LPA. Top companies like Maruti Suzuki, Mahindra, and Tata recruit students from UPES. Nearly 100% of students got internships related to Automation in companies like Tata Elxsi, OLA Electric, and such. Top roles offered are transportation designer, mobility solutions designer, UX in automotive designer, 3D visualization, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our hostels are provided with good spacious rooms, electricity, water supply, and water geysers. Food and canteen services are also neat and provided promptly. Medical services are also available when needed. UPES also provides Wi-Fi, has good labs, and tidy classrooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified and from various top institutions like NID, NIFT, and many more. Around 10-20 faculty members are from the design field in this college. They are open to doubts and clarifications and provide personal mentorship if needed. Students are well-trained to fit industrial standards. Exams are of average difficulty if studied properly, and the pass percentage is 60-65%.

reviews.review_title: Creative campus with supportive faculty and growing opportunities in animation.

detailed_review.Placements: I’m doing a B.Des. in Animation and VFX at UPES. Around 88–90% of students in our course secure placements. The highest package is 10 LPA, the average is 6.5 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. Companies like Dell, TCS, and MPL hire from our course. Approximately 80% of students secure internships, often at companies like Dell and Accenture. Most roles are 2D/3D animator, VFX artist, storyboard artist, or concept artist. Placements depend a lot on how good your portfolio is. If you work hard and build skills, you get good opportunities. UPES does help, but you have to try too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our Animation and VFX course has good labs with drawing tables, powerful PCs, Wi-Fi, and projectors. The library has useful books and is peaceful. Classrooms are clean and have AC. The hostel rooms are decent, Wi-Fi is pretty bad, not going to lie, and the washrooms are clean if maintained. Food in the mess is average, but the canteen has better options. Medical help is available 24/7 on campus. There is a sports ground, a basketball court, and indoor games too. Overall, if you stay involved and take care of things, it is a good place to learn and stay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable, especially in animation and design subjects. Some teach well, while a few are just okay. The curriculum is mostly good and covers both basic and advanced topics, including industry software. It could be updated a bit more for real-world trends, but it helps make you job-ready if you put in effort. Semester exams are not too hard if you attend classes and complete assignments. The pass percentage is high, around 90% or more. If you work regularly, it is easy to manage.
detailed_review.Other: The best part is learning cool stuff like 2D/3D animation, VFX, and working on real projects. Teachers support creativity. I wish the software access and class schedules were better managed. The campus is beautiful and has lots of greenery. There are fun events like Uurja and Ignite, and the crowd is chill and creative. There is Wi-Fi, sports, clubs, and decent scholarships. It is peaceful here, but far from the main city, so travel takes time.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: A good college for a person seeking a nice social life with good studies.

detailed_review.Placements: Here at UPES, in my course B.Tech CSE, almost 90% of students are placed. But package is not that much for the majority, like average salary package is almost about 4-5 LPA, not more than that. Highest salary package I heard was about 55 LPA (not sure if it was off or on campus ). Top recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, etc. All students get an internship from UPES since it is a part of course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure here at UPES is very nice, all blocks are well furnished with peaceful white theme classes. In campus hostels are good. Since I live outside the campus hostel, I heard that the mess food there is not that good. Hostel has a lot of indoor games. There are many grounds dedicated to every sport. Regular contests and competitions occur for sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and helpful. Of course, some teachers are there just to give marks and complete their semester classes. Curriculum is very structured and organized in comparison to other colleges. I personally feel the semester exams are easy and manageable.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course here at UPES because I found this college better than any other private colleges in northern India in terms of all things. For improvements in course, I would suggest college to increase coding culture since that is the key to placements. College has a very good social life. One could see events on a regular basis. College has various clubs so one can connect with other students easily and unite in a club.

reviews.review_title: Everything is good about this college; what life teaches you.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost every student gets a placement offer if he/she wants to appear for an interview. The highest and average package is around 8 lacs per annum and the lowest is around 4 lacs per annum. Various companies visit the campus. Everyone gets an internship in 1st two years as this is compulsory for the curriculum or the credit to be completed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 1Absolutely, the facilities and infrastructure we are getting are very good. I believe there is nothing left that our college does not cover. There are various types of hostels, such as 3 sharing common washrooms, and non- AC which costs - 83, 1,83,000. Sharing common washrooms with AC which costs Rs. 1,93,000. Sharing attached bathrooms with AC which costs Rs. 2,45,000. The hostels are quite expensive; normal-class people can't afford them. Everything else is good. Also, the mess food is good; they change the menu every 15 days.
detailed_review.Faculty: Experienced faculty members are very good, but new faculty still need to understand how to teach college students. The course curriculum is good; it helps us understand concepts very well and prepares us for cooperative life. They have open-book examinations in the mid-semester, which include theoretical questions, and close-book exams at the end of the semester, where questions can be asked from anywhere. It is a bit challenging.
detailed_review.Other: I want to gain experience in my cooperative life, so the course topics are the best. They should not admit too many students, as it could affect the college's reputation. Everything is very good.

reviews.review_title: My college was overall very good.

detailed_review.Placements: 30% of students were placed in my batch of B.Com out of the whole batch. The package was average. The highest package was 4-5 LPA and the lowest package was 2-3 LPA but it was the time just after COVID so the placement record was average. Most of the offers were from sales in B.Com.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are fully furnished and the seating arrangement is good in the classrooms. We had full access to the smart boards and everything in the ventilation system was good. The library was fully furnished, and quiet and comfortable seats were there for 9 hr access every day. The library was centralized. Facilities were good in the hostel. Rooms were fully furnished and connected washrooms were available. Some rooms had air conditioning. The food in the mess was good. There was a convenience store in the hostel from which you could get your daily needs stuff and a salon was there inside the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members were very cooperative, helpful, understanding, and very qualified staff. We learned good things from them. The course and curriculum are relevant practical knowledge was also provided by the college. Exams were not so difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Com because I wanted to do my family business. Fest was very good and entertaining in our college they used to invite influencers, singers, writers, etc.

reviews.review_title: Great college for law aspirants with excellent infrastructure and industry exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: A significant percentage of students from my batch were placed, especially those who actively participated in internships and extracurricular activities. Top recruiters included Dentons Link Legal, JSW, Tata, Hero, etc. The highest package offered was around 11 LPA, the average ranging between 4 to 5 LPA. Internship opportunities were available from the end of 1st year itself. Students are well guided through the placement cell and workshops.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: UPES has an impressive infrastructure with well-equipped classrooms, a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, smart boards, digital libraries, moot court halls, and modern labs. The hostel facilities are excellent, with clean rooms, regular housekeeping, and round-the-clock security. The food in the mess is hygienic with multiple cuisine options, and there is a cafeteria and food court for variety. Medical facilities, sports grounds, a gym, and recreational space make hostel life very comfortable and enjoyable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at UPES are well qualified and experienced, many of whom hold PhDs or have substantial industry exposure. They are approachable, supportive, and encourage active student participation through case studies, moot courts, and debates. The curriculum is updated regularly to stay aligned with current industry trends and includes relevant electives like Criminal Law, IPR, Taxation, Institutional, etc. Semester exams are moderate in difficulty but require consistent learning. The pass percentage is high provided that students put in the required effort. Continuous assessment ensures that students stay engaged throughout the semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose BBA LL.B. at UPES because of its unique specialisation options and strong reputation in legal education. The best part of the course is its practical orientation through internships, moot court sessions, and guest lectures by industry experts. The college regularly hosts national-level events, seminars, and fests like UURJA, adding vibrant energy to the campus. I wish there were more inter-university exchange programs or international collaboration, but otherwise, it's a fantastic learning environment. The campus is beautiful, located amidst hills, with great weather and modern facilities.

admission.title: UPES Dehradun Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
UPES Dehradun admission 2026 is both merit and entrance-based. The university provides more than twenty programmes at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. These are offered in fields, such as Engineering, Management, Science, Business, Design, Law, Computer Applications, Commerce, and Arts. The modes of study can be full-time or online, depending on the course. UPES Dehradun conducts its entrance exams, such as UPESMET UG, UPESEAT , etc., for admission to some specific courses including BTech, MBA, BBA, etc.

The university also accepts JEE Main , CAT, CUET UG & PG , etc as an alternative. The admission mode differs by course with details in the eligibility table given below. Interested students can read this article to get all the details on UPES admissions .

faqs.question: Are admissions open at UPES?
faqs.answer: Yes, UPES Dehradun admissions 2026 are open now. Interested students can apply at the university's site. The admission and application forms has to be submitted duly filled in. Students can visit the UPES website for regular updates.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in UPES?
faqs.answer: To get admission in UPES Dehradun, students have to complete the admission process. This requires students to check the eligibility and meet the same. Eligible students then have to either appear for the university-level exams or submit valid scores other exams. Once the selection rounds including personal interview (if applicable) are done, pay the fees. Seats are offered after verification of documents.

faqs.question: What is the fees for BBA in UPES University Dehradun?
faqs.answer: Total tuition fee for BBA ranges between INR 1.5 Lacs and INR 14 Lacs as per unofficial source. The fee excludes other fee components like caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Aspirants are required to pay course fee after completion of all selection rounds to confirm their seats. Selection to BBA course will be based on national and university level entrance exams like UPESMET UG, UGAT or CUET UG followed by a personal interview round. For admission to Global BBA, candidates need to qualify PI round and submit Statement of Purpose. If a student is unable to pay fee within given time, his or her admission will be cancelled. Students also need to pay registration fee through online mode to apply for admission. The application fee for UPESMET UG is INR 1,350.

faqs.question: Does UPES accept CAT scores?
faqs.answer: Yes, UPES Dehradun does accept CAT scores for MBA admissions. Students with a valid CAT score of 50 percentile or above are eligible to apply for the course. Eligible students have to appear for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview rounds for final selection.

faqs.question: What are the exams accepted by UPES for admission to its courses?
faqs.answer: UPES accepts several entrance tests for admission to its courses. These are excluding the university-level exams (UPESMET, UPESEAT, UPESMET UG). See the table below to know about all the exams accepted by the university: CAT / CUET PG JEE Main / CUET UG / SAT India CUET UG / UGAT CUET NEET / JEE Main/ CUET CUET/ NEET (depending on specialisation) CUET

faqs.question: What is the fees of UPES MBA?
faqs.answer: UPES MBA fee is between INR 1.5 lakh and INR 15.7 lakh as per an unofficial source. The fee is calculated based on tuition fee and does not includes other components. Students are required to pay course fee after completion of all selection rounds to confirm their seats. The selection to MBA course will be based on national and university level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, UPESMET, etc., followed by group discussion and personal interview round. In case a candidate is unable to pay fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. Aspirants will also need to pay a registration fee to apply for admission. The application fee for MBA course is INR 1,350. They can pay the registration fee via any of online payment mode.
