faqs.question: Can I apply for UPES Dehradun BTech course after Class 12?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates who have passed Class 10 and Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate and a minimum of 50% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, Maths/ Biology, and English in Class 12 can apply for BTech/ BTech (Hons) course with JEE Main or CUET score. Aspirants meeting the eligibility requirements can apply for any of the BCA specialisation. Candidates can choose the specialisation of their choice in the second year of the course. BCA is available in three specialisations, namely Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security and Internet of Things. Additionally, candidates will be shortlisted for BCA based on CUET UG score. Aspirants who have not appeared for the entrance exam can come for personal interview round. After completion of the selection rounds, aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university. The total tuition fee for BCA ranges between INR 3.42 Lacs and INR 4.82 Lacs as per an unofficial source.

Besides, candidates who have passed Class 10 and Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate along with Mathematics / Computer Science / Information Technology as one of the major subjects in Class 12 can apply for the BCA course. After completion of the selection rounds, aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university. There are a total of 60 seats in the BCA course. sections.heading: Introduction
text: The UPES Dehradun provides modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. The campus is spread across 44 acre of land with domain-specific labs, hostels, and facilities for curricular and extra-curricular activities. Some of the highlights of the infrastructure of UPES are as follows:
For more information about UPES infrastructure check out the below video:
list: Library:UPES library has a seating capacity of more than 400 students and contains over 73,327 volumes of publications including books, standards, reports, proceedings, and more than 150 national and international journals. It also has a rich collection of online resources in terms of CDs, access to specialised portals on oil and gas and power-related information

Hotels:UPES has a separate hostel for boys and girls with a capacity of more than 2000 students at the Bidholi and Kandoli campuses. All the hostels have a Wi-Fi facility for learning. A common room has been provided in each hostel for relaxation and a 24*7 power backup and solar power water heaters facility is available

Cafeteria:The university has a multi-storied food court within the campus, has a number of food courts and cafeterias with a modern ambiance to provide nutritious and balanced meals, snacks, and beverages to students of both campuses
Sports Complex: UPES has a multipurpose playground for playing hockey, cricket, football, and other sports with world-class sports facilities and equipment

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: UPES’s library has a seating capacity of more than 400 students and contains over 73,327 volumes of publications including books, standards, reports, proceedings and more than 150 National and International journals in the fields of petroleum exploration, power, infrastructure, chemical, computer, electrical, electronic and mechanical engineering, information technology and management, etc. It also has a rich collection of online resources in terms of CDs, access to specialized portals on oil and gas and power related information. UPES has also acquired institutional memberships of the British Council Library, the American Centre Library, the AIMA Library, the Central Secretariat library and DELNET, IIP, WIHG Dehradun. As a part of collaboration IFP,France has gifted a large no. of books and Shell, a global oil major has also gifted a large number of technical books to the library.

VNIT Nagpur, established in 1960, is one of the oldest NITs in the country. All the programmes offered at VNIT Nagpur are approved by the UGC. VNIT Nagpur offers UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes in the fields of Engineering, Architecture, Science and Technology. Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology course admission is based on entrance exams, such as JEE Main, GATE, DASA UG, IIT JAM and NATA.
Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology, Nagpur is one of the prestigious Engineering institutes in India. As per the latest NIRF 2025 rankings, VNIT Nagpur ranks #44 under the category 'Engineering' category. Additionally, NIT Nagpur is ranked by several international organisations as well.

VNIT Nagpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: It's a good college for a mechanical engineer, like myself.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, 50% of my batch is placed. The lowest is 7 LPA and the highest is 18.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies were ZS and ABG. Many students got internships from our batch in companies like Bajaj, Tata, etc. As a quality inspector for a manufacturing unit. Overall, for campus placement, the college is good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Typical government hostel, gets cleaned every day. LAN connection is available for all the students. The mess food is average, like you can survive on the food, except on Sunday night. A health centre is available on campus itself, and an ambulance is also available. Good enthusiasm for sports also.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are mostly Ph.Ds in their own domain. They have vast knowledge in their respective field. Teaching is good and understandable. The course book is provided early, and the course content taught is already informed to students. College exams are set by professors only, so they are mostly based on the syllabus.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in mechanical engineering, particularly in the automobile section, like car manufacturing and research & development. Professors are already qualified, and they mostly share their respective industrial reviews for students, which is nice. Events are held every 2 months or so. The campus crowd is normal, and the campus location is in the middle of the city.

reviews.review_title: Overall a decent experience with good opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements here are somewhat decent. I would not say they are that great as compared to the circuit L branches but they are good. Around 75-80 percent of people get placed. Average package is around 10 LPA. The lowest being offered is like 5 LPA - 6 LPA, depending on the year you are seeing. Top recruiting companies include Vedanta, etc. For us, 3 vocational training is compulsory which is provided by the college itself its very helpful for you to get placed in the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities provided here are good. For example, you get a Wi-Fi-enabled classroom with the projectors and everything. Hostel facilities are also good. You get a 3 people-sharing room in the first year. The mess food is good and hygienic. You can definitely eat it. There is also a health center that gives you all the required medicine when necessary. The colleges' focus on sports and games is too good like for first year. They have a thing called intramurals in which we compete against each other, and participation in it is compulsory. Grounds are decent for each sport.
detailed_review.Faculty: Even though it's an NIT, I won't say all the professors are that good. Some are really knowledgeable and think about the students. They will guide you, but there are teachers who don't give a damn about what you do. They just come into the class and try to explain, even though no one gets them, what they are trying to say about the mid-term exams. So, they are actually not that hard, don't rely on the teachers, study on your own. The passing percentage is around 80 percent. The college follows the new education policy.
detailed_review.Other: The reason I chose this course was not because of any interest, it was the rank that determined your course. It is a pretty decent course. About the college connectivity, like it's in the middle of the city, Nagpur, with a lush green campus. You will get easy access to railways and airports. The fests here are decent as of now which I have experienced. The main fests of the college are about to happen so I will update after seeing those fests. There are scholarships too for academic excellence only as per my knowledge.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: VNIT Nagpur- the man, the myth, the legend.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed is overall 86%, while in our branch it is 93%. The highest package is 64 LPA offered by Oracle to 9 students. The lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 17 LPA. The top companies recruiting are Oracle, Google, DE Shaw, and JP Morgan. About 60% of students receive internships. The top roles offered are SDE and data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here is quite decent. There are old buildings dating back to 1980, and also newer buildings. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, except at hostels, where we have a LAN with good speed. There is a well-equipped international-level library. We have three messes. The food is above expectations, but is repetitive. It has one of the best sports facilities among all NITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here are well qualified, usually Ph.D. holders and Ph.D. scholars. They are highly qualified and good. The curriculum, like other NITs and IITs, is outdated and not relevant in this era. The exams are mid, mildly difficult except for some exams such as EE and M1.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: You had to qualify JEE to get into this.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements were good for circuit branches like CSE, ECE, EEE, and Mechanical as well. For other departments, placements were decent. Typically, students in the 5th and 6th semesters had opportunities to apply for on-campus internships, while those in the 7th and 8th semesters applied for placements. Companies like Google, Oracle, Goldman Sachs, Hilti, Wells Fargo, DE Shaw, NatWest, ZS Associates, John Deere, UBS, Reliance, Samsung, and others visited the campus. The highest package offered was 36 LPA. The average was 11 LPA. More than 80% of students were placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms were very good. Facilities included a fan, two closets, a table, and a bed with a chair. The mess food was not up to the mark, and we had to adjust to it. A mess form had to be submitted. Rooms were allotted based on a lucky dip. Many books were available in the library, so there was no need to buy books from outside. Classrooms had ACs, LCDs, projector screens, and many other facilities. There was a very large ground with different sports facilities. We also had the Institute Gathering (IG), which lasted for 10 days, where all departments competed in different sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were really experienced and talented. But most failed to deliver the same knowledge to students. Most teachers had a vast knowledge bank, but were not the best at teaching. There were two exams, namely midterms and end-of-term terms, carrying 30 and 50 marks respectively. The course was slightly old in terms of content, but updates were being made that were branch-specific, such as more detailed electronics in the electrical lab, including diodes and other relevant experiments.

reviews.review_title: Solid mechanical engineering experience at VNIT Nagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: The batch 2024 mechanical batch. Ni vnit, placements are strong,  90% placed. The package is 31LPA, the average package offered is 9LPA, and the lowest package offered is 5LPA. Top recruiters include HPCL, Maruti Suzuki, BPCL, Aditya Birla, and John Deere. Roles are mainly GET, design, projects, and quality engineer. Internships are too good, especially for 7+ CGPA students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: VNIT has solid labs, a huge digital library, and a good sports infrastructure. Classrooms are basic, no AC, and hostels improve as you go from shared to single rooms with LAN connections. Mess food is average, Sports /Medical are excellent, and campus life is vibrant.
detailed_review.Faculty: Mechanical depth at the VNI solid faculty is qualified, and some are from there, though teaching quality varies. The curriculum is strong, with labs, projects, and industry visits making you job ready in core fields. Exams are moderate, regular study is enough to clear overall good fundamentals, but you need self effort for extra skills like coding.
detailed_review.Other: I am from the mechanical engineering branch, with 115 students per batch. The course is four years, covering all core areas like thermodynamics, design, and manufacturing, with solid lab exposure. Placements are strong if you have maintained a 7.5 CGPA. Chances of getting placed are almost certain, the highest packages go to top performers, and even average is decent for a core branch. I chose mechanical because I like machines and wanted a balanced theory and practical, and Vnit offers exactly that. Still, the syllabus feels a bit outdated. Classroom and Wi-fi could improve, and the mess food is just average.

reviews.review_title: The view of VNIT college from the eyes of a sophomore.

detailed_review.Placements: For mechanical engineering branch in the year 2024-2025, a placement percentage of 95+ was achieved, with the highest package being given by BPCL. The average and median were about 11.6 LPA and 10.8 LPA, respectively. The college has a reputation for having a higher placement percentage for mechanical students, even when compared to CSE from the last 2 years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is very good infrastructure in the college for most of the programs, specifically for mechanical, there is a Siemens centre of excellence in which VNIT students can take part in certification courses in labs like product design and validation, test and optimization, reverse engineering, and many more. The mechanical engineering department has one smart classroom and many other classes. The only thing to complain about in the hostels is the food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers from the department of Mechanical Engineering are very senior and very qualified. Everyone has a huge pool of knowledge that they are ready to share with the students. The course is evolving and becoming more industry-ready with each integration, like the involvement of CADM as a course to give opportunities to those who wish to get into design-related fields. The exams are not really difficult, but they are not graded leniently.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Visvesvaraya NIT College review.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80% of students managed to get placed. The highest salary package on the table is around 13 LPA, while the lowest sits at about 5 LPA. Most of the recruitment action comes from companies like ZS, JSW, Jindal Steel, Birla, and Varroc. Unfortunately, only a handful of students snagged internships at our college. Most have to venture out and search for opportunities elsewhere. The top job roles being offered usually include positions like consultant and view engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is practical, with good facilities both for sports and academics. You can always use a LAN port for an unlimited public Ethernet connection.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very well-qualified and are of a lot of help. The teaching method is of very high quality. The training program is very relevant and it definitely prepares students for the industry. Semester exams are at a medium level of difficulty. However, the pass percentage is dependent on the average score of the class, which is 50%.

reviews.review_title: This was the best college for the M.Sc. in Chemistry course.

detailed_review.Placements: In our institution, 77% of students secured placements in our programme. The leading recruiting firms included HOCL, IOCL, ONGC, and several other top companies that visited our college. The top package from our research was approximately 25 LPA, while the average package stood at 12 LPA. Approximately 70% of students received internship offers. The advanced positions available included Analytical Chemist, Research Scientist, and others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There were good labs, great sports facilities, and a playground. Very big tournaments were organized every year, and coaches were provided for games. There was a hotel office. The hotel was awesome in every way, very clean and lush with lots of trees. The mess food was pretty good. There were large rooms for students. There was a small hotel fee of 750/year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers had extensive education, with the majority holding PhDs in their respective specialties. Their teaching abilities were exceptional. Honestly, the curriculum had no bearing on technical objectives. The semester questions were well-organized and extremely hard.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great quality of life. Have to compromise a bit on placement.

detailed_review.Placements: In the 2025 batch, approximately 80% of students are placed in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering. The highest package is 14 LPA, the lowest 4.5 LPA, and the median 8 LPA. The average package of ECE, EEE, and MME was almost the same. MME comes just after Circuital in hierarchy in VNIT, above Mechanical and Chemical. Top recruiters are mainly from core industries (Jindal, JSW, etc.), and non-core recruiters are generally mass recruiters. Many students go for research internships. Top roles in core are entry-level, but in core, the stability of the job is unmatched. Whereas non-core shows big monetary gain early on in life.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and hostels are some of the best in NITs. 1st year students mainly get double-seater rooms, and if you report late, you will get triple-seater rooms. From the 2nd year, you have the option to choose either double or single-seater rooms. 3rd and 4th years are fully single-seater. 4th-year students get the newest apartment-class hostels. The mess is manageable, and medical and sports facilities are top class compared to any other NITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers hold Ph.D. degrees from IITs, IISERs, or abroad and are well qualified. Teacher quality varies, but in general, the faculty is all okay. From the 2nd year onwards, the departmental faculty handles everything. Semester exams are quite easy. Mostly everyone passes except for the BEE and Maths-II courses.
detailed_review.Other: I chose MME out of interest in the materials side of prospects and scope. The rising need for different materials in semiconductors is also a big upcoming area. Fests are not as grand as IIT Bombay's Mood Indigo or Tech Fest, but it is what it is. You will get pretty bored attending the same fests all 4 years, so enjoy 1st year as much as you can.

reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with the opportunities the college gives to students.

detailed_review.Placements: As of March 2025, 72% of students are placed in the Mechanical Engineering (B.Tech) department. The top recruiting companies are HPCL, Jindal Stainless, Maruti Suzuki, BPCL, and Aditya Birla Group. Students got PPOs from Accenture, Neterwala Group, ITC Limited, and John Deere.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A continuous LAN network is available in hostel rooms. The library is well-equipped with many books. Hostels are cleaned daily and hygiene is maintained. The food quality in the mess is decent. Medical services provided are very good and free of cost. Sports complex is also robust with so many sports equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers here are PhD graduates and helpful. Teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is updated and relevant. We have lab sessions for every theory course. Semester exams are very hard here and require continuous study. Exams can't be passed by studying one night before. The overall passing rate is almost 98.6%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of VNIT Nagpur  Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package of our college is around 8–9 LPA. The highest CTC offer in CSE is 64 LPA, and the lowest CTC is 4 LPA. The placement percentage is more than 70%. In CSE, the average package is 15 LPA, and in Metallurgy, it is around 7–8 LPA, which is decent enough. The placement statistics are not that fancy, but the average and median packages are decent. Circuital branches like CSE, ECE, and EEE have great packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a classroom complex with six floors where classes for most departments take place. Each classroom has a smart board and AC. Wi-Fi facility is available in every classroom, and there are more than eight lifts for easy movement. Each department has its own building where practicals are conducted, and the practical infrastructure is excellent. For example, in Metallurgy, there are instruments and machines that cost crores. Overall, the infrastructure is good. In the hostel, students are allotted different hostels each year, some rooms are dual occupancy, but most are single occupancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, professors are extremely qualified and knowledgeable in their domains, with about 8–10 years of teaching experience. Some professors are approachable and teach well, while others are very strict and do not teach effectively. The worst part about this college is the semester exams. They are extremely hard compared to other colleges, and professors do not give good grades, making it really difficult to score a high CGPA like 8+. You need to study hard to pass exams.

reviews.review_title: The college is placement-focused. Hence, there is more focus on academics.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements were very good. The training and placement cell was very active and alert in providing the best opportunities to aspiring students. The percentage of students getting placed was nearly 93% for the top 3 branches and nearly 85% for the overall college. I aspired to join a semiconductor-based company mainly hiring for the Analog or Digital Design Engineer role.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good and approachable toward students, with obvious exceptions, which I felt could be found anywhere. In spite of the growing software-oriented culture, professors encouraged students to take up core engineering as their future in advanced fields of work. Many professors were open to research work with students who showed interest in spite of the poor research and experiential setup. I was from the Electrical Engineering Department, and as per my experience, the professors in my department were highly skilled and highly supportive.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd at VNIT Nagpur was fantastic. Seniors were really supportive in every aspect possible. We also had student mentors as part of the student mentorship program. There were various clubs. I was a part of the debating club. Octaves was the music club, Velocity was the car club, IV Labs was all about robotics and coding, and a few notable clubs. There were many events such as Axis Techfest, Aarohi Cultural Fest, Consortium Annual Event of E-cell, Institute Gathering, Department Gathering, Mech Days, Ganesh Chaturthi, etc. My personal experience was really great with the institute.

reviews.review_title: Norms and strictness are at their peak in 2026.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement and the cutoff for companies here are so lenient and as per my batch analysis, the placement goes 100% for the students or grades with a CGPA of 7.5 and above. The basic pay is the lowest package is 7 LPA for the nontechnical and core departments.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department of mechanical engineering is at the benchmarked cracking score out of all the departments as it was the first department of the college and the hostel facilities are typical of the South Indian style. Sports facilities are surplus in hostel facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very strict. Sometimes not coordinative enough if you have grudges or harsh talks. They solely have the power to either pass or fail the exam and the curriculum is flexible as we can opt for many OCs and HMs to complete the credit.
detailed_review.Other: The crowded surroundings of the campus give you immersion in the overall ambiance from every corner of the country.

reviews.review_title: Review of VNIT Nagpur, chemical engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Only around 30% to 40% of students are placed and sometimes even toppers are left unplaced. The highest package is 14 LPA and the lowest is 7 LPA. Internships are very difficult to get. Only 3 or 4 students get internships from campus rest everyone has to go for the alumni network.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College facilities are good and department is huge. Labs have broken instruments and you learn nothing. Some hostels are good while old hostels maybe difficult to live in. Mess is average sometimes you might find insects in it but if they are alive then don't worry if they are dead then it's a problem (not said by me but by the mess head). Sports grounds are great and facilities are very nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are like dictators, none of them follow a single set of rules each of them have their own set of rules. Course is good for research and not for placements, for placements you have to study on your own. Some subjects are easy but some subjects are there only to fail you. These professors teach to fail students, it's like a joke to them.

reviews.review_title: The truth behind B.Arch in VNIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Less than 5% of students are placed in the course. The highest package is 5 LPA. The lowest is 2 LPA. The average package was 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Consulting Engineers Ltd, Galactic Group, Alliant Group, and Neilsoft. 99% of students got internship in many companies all over India. Roles offered are JR. architect, fresher architect, and site engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The best facilities and infrastructure are available on campus, well-equipped with technology, and a library with a wide range of books related to all departments. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, but sometimes times signal won't be available in hostels, no co-living is allowed on the campus, fewer space rooms and high security on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers and all profs are very helpful in the campus with good teaching skills and knowledge. The course is highly relevant to the industry. It makes students ready for the industry, not so difficult in examinations, one day reading is enough for passing.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course with passion. It is a very good course. We get to explore the design very well. The one thing that can be improved is more practical knowledge needed to be taught to students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: A cute and short story about a struggling engineer.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage of our seniors is 63% and not sure about a further increase in it until the last semester of our seniors ends. Our super senior batch had a better placement ratio comparatively. It was 70% at that time. Placements and packages depend on the respective branch. A higher package is obviously offered to the CSE branch and decreases like that till the mining branch. A maximum of 19 LPA is offered till now. More than 14 LPA for circuital branches are offered only by government companies such as HPCL - 18 LPA, BPCL - 18 LPA, and GHEL have come recently.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library and classrooms are pretty neat and clean but the department seems old but still it's clean. Our college is actually small. Roads and maintenance are great. Facilities regarding studies are ultimate (pros, library, seniors, Ph.D. students). The hostel is a 10 from 2nd year. 1st year hostel is separate due to ragging problems which is good and safe for freshers. 1st year hostel is old and big which is given to 2 girls per room which looks like a home. Coming to the senior's block so called apartments are allowed for a single person per room which has a great ambiance.
detailed_review.Faculty: Senior pros are excellent but pros as freshers are a bit tough to reach student mindset. Everyone has expertise and knowledge in their core subject. The teaching quality is perfect. The updated course curriculum is good. The average passing is 35-40 out of 100 for every course opted. The course curriculum is somewhat vast but somehow manageable. It can be decreased by 2-3 courses. 8th sem has allowed students for a 6-month internship which gives industry experience for a fresher joining placements. This helps to increase placements in our college.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as I got it in the JoSAA location in the beginning but later realized this was the best course for getting lifetime settlement in government jobs. This is the only course where multiple options are available such as coding, it sector, private jobs in the score, government jobs, M.Teach, foreign studies, and what else. Traveling from the girl's hostel to my department is so far by cycle. No expectations regarding scholarships here from my side. Events are forever in this college. Axis, cell, aarohi, literature fest, and many more fests are conducted but organizing this fest requires money.

reviews.review_title: The sports facility here is excellent. I would say one of the best among all NITs.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college, students have to appear in the first semester and third semester to become eligible for campus placements. There are many companies who visit our college for campus placements like TCS, telecom companies, and other IT companies by theory and practical. In this course, you can understand about the origin of electricity.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Aarohi is a cultural fest and is held for 3 days in October. VNITs annual technical fest is AXIS. Consortium is organised by an e-cell of VNIT in February. There are about 1.3 lacks printed books and 8,000 E-books in the VNIT library. Each classroom has a green board, tv, and two projectors. The overall review is sports here are excellent. Fests here are okay. The curriculum is also okay. There are various clubs such as Octaves for music, hallabol, acting, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty member and student ratio is 50:2. Many faculty members are also available in our college. The faculty I like is Proof Aayushi Soni mam who is an English teacher. My class coordinator treats students like a friend in computer science engineering, so I decided to join this college.

reviews.review_title: The first and best thing I love here is my lush green campus.

detailed_review.Placements: From the 6th semester, students were eligible for placement. In my campus, 100% of students got placed. Last year, the highest package offered was 12.25 LPA to Kriti in IBM, and the average package was 4 LPA. My degree was completed, and I was placed in Justdial. Over 100 companies, like Google, Amazon, HCL, and many more, visited my campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I thought our campus was better than any other college when it came to greenery. The infrastructure was also very nice and attractive. There were many clubs, for example, Hallabll for acting, Octaves for singing, Iridescene for artwork, 911 for hip-hop, Bollywood dance club, Technical Club IV Labs, Velocity, Ashlesha Astronomy Club, and many more. I was in the Iridescent Art Club and tried for IV Labs and Ashlesha Astronomy Club, which I was eligible for the next year. Joining the clubs improved our self-confidence, communication skills, and personality.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio was 1:20, and the relationship bonding was very good, creating a positive environment on campus between students and faculty. Math Sir Arun Dubey and English teacher Rich Man were very nice on my campus. Most of the students who attended the college passed every semester. Two internal and two external exams were held each year.

reviews.review_title: Campus life in VNIT, Nagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: Less than 10% of students are placed, with the highest package being 5.5 LPA, the lowest 3.5 LPA, and the average 4.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Galactic Group, Tata Consulting Engineers Pvt. Ltd., Alliant Group, and Aarvee Associate Architects Engineers & Consultants Pvt. Ltd. 90% of students get internships in the 5th year, 9th semester. The roles offered are fresher architect, junior architect, and consulting engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, with a well-planned campus filled with lush green trees and plants. It has a good range of Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, AC classrooms, old studios, and good hostel facilities, such as hot water, CCTV, and high security. The Intime for girls is 10:30 pm.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are helpful throughout the course and provide us with good knowledge and doubt clarifications and extra classes. The course is relevant and makes students industry-ready. The passing marks are 50% in core subjects and 35% in non-core subjects. The difficulty level of the question paper is moderate.
detailed_review.Other: Choosing the course is based on passion and many extra activities that help students learn faster and better. Many events take place on campus, such as Axis, E-Summit, consortium, and cultural events like Onam, Sankranti, and Ugadi festivals are celebrated.

reviews.review_title: My college makes my life.

detailed_review.Placements: In my batch, there are 100 batchmates, with 25 girls and 75 boys. The placement percentage from my branch is 65%. There are four students change their branch from Civil to Computer, Electronics, Mechanical, etc. Some students left the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My college provides facilities like singing, gymnastics, and an auditorium. There is a classroom complex with 40 rooms, each having AC facilities. The fest I like is Keyan, which is held in every classroom, and the ventilation system in classes. There are more than 5,000 students in my college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The first-year exams are so hard. Teachers are helpful, and there is no chance of cheating during examinations. Teachers are very mindful and educated. Almost all teachers have a Ph.D. degree. The most difficult subjects I face are Chemistry and Physics because they are absolute in marking.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am passionate about building, and my goal is to become a builder. There are many clubs in my college, such as Hallabol Cell, Samwad, etc. There are two fests celebrated in our college Axis, a technical fest, and Aarohi, a cultural fest.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for VNIT Nagpur?
faqs.answer: VNIT Nagpur admission process is entirely entrance-based. Candidates are required to qualify for national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, IIT JAM, CAT, etc., for the respective courses. Candidates who obtain a valid score as per the course's requirements in the respective entrance exam will have to register and appear for the counselling process conducted by specific counselling bodies. sections.heading: Introduction
text: VNIT Nagpur campus is spread across 215 acres (approx.). It offers all the modern amenities to its students, such as modern classrooms, library, hostels, and cafeterias, etc. Few more facilities offered at this institute are as follows:
To learn more about the VNIT Nagpur infrastructure, check out the video below:
list: Hostel:Talking about the hostel, it has 11 hostels that are divided between boys and girls. The total capacity to accommodate is 3,500 students. There are seven boys' hostels and four girls' hostels. Each hostel has a telephone, TV, sports items, water coolers, water heaters, and well-equipped mess facilities. The institute also has excellent residential facilities to cater to the needs of more than a thousand students.
Library:VNIT Library has a well-stocked library book and journal collections that have been built up over time in a systematic manner.

Sports:The institute offers both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. Some of the sports offered on campus are cricket, football, basketball, kabaddi, lawn tennis, and badminton. There is one hall for yoga and one hall for cardio fitness.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: Institute has 11 hostel building for boys and girls with a total capacity of 3500 students. Institute has excellent residential facilities to cater the need of more than a thousand students. There are seven boys hostels and four girls hostels. Each hostel is having a telephone, T.V., sports Items, water coolers, water heaters and well-equipped mess facilities. It is mandatory for hostel inmates to join the mess in his/ her hostel, managed by the committee of students' representatives. All hostels are having the independent mess where vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals are available. All residents have to bear the wages of the mess cooks, servants, helpers and cleaners.

paragraphs: VNIT Nagpur scholarships are offered to meritorious students. Some of the popular VNIT Nagpur scholarships schemes available for BTech students are National Level Scholarships, Maharashtra State Scholarships and other State and Private Scholarships. Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students (10 Students of Institute as per merit)

highlights.summary:
Established in 2005, Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences is a private college which is situated in Chennai. It is famous all over the country for offering quality education in a variety of departments such as Medicine, Allied Medical education, Engineering, Dentistry, Law, Management, Physiotherapy, Pharmacy, Nursing, Physical Education and Architecture. Saveetha Institute has been awarded grade A by NAAC. The medical college holds the 25th rank among all medical institutes in the country. All the courses are recognised by the Medical Council of India and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
The institute offers UG, PG and super speciality courses in the fields of surgery and medicine. Saveetha Dental College is considered as one of the best colleges in the world. The institute provides a comprehensive environment for education by its high-end labs, classrooms and libraries.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Saveetha Medical College?
faqs.answer: S IMATS Chennai admission process is based on both entrance test and merit list set by the university. To apply for UG courses, candidates must have atleast passed Class 12 or equivalent exam from a recognised board with 50% aggregate. For admission to UG courses, candidates must appear NEET-UG exam conducted by NTA. Admission to MBBS, BTech, MBA, M.Tech courses is done on the basis of NEET-UG, TNEA, TANCET, GATE exams respectively.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences admission?
faqs.answer: Here are the last dates for applying to SIMATS into various courses:

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences for admission MBA?
faqs.answer: The main details regarding entrance exam scores that Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS) accepts for MBA admission are as follows: SIMATS grants admission to MBA programs based on the results of standardized management entrance tests such as CAT, MAT, XAT, ATMA, and CMAT. The necessary percentile scores at a minimum are: 50 percentile of the CAT 60 percentile in MAT 60 percentile in XAT ATMA - 60% of the sample CMAT - 60% of the sample Those who pass any of these admission tests with a valid score can apply to SIMATS' MBA program. A bachelor's degree from an accredited university with a minimum of 50% overall grades is required of applicants in addition to their entrance exam results. Depending on the volume of applications, the exact deadlines for receiving an admission offer may change every year.

faqs.question: How many students can do B.Tech at Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences?
faqs.answer: Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences (SIMATS) has established intake capacities for each of its engineering branches, which determines how many students can enroll in the B.Tech program. The following specializations for the B.Tech programs that SIMATS provides, Electrical and computer Science (CSE) Communication and Electronics Engineering (ECE) Technical Mechanical Engineering (ME) Environmental Engineering (EE) Biomedical Engineering (BME) Science and technology (BT) Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence (CS & AI) A total of 1260- 1300 seats are available for B.Tech programs at SIMATS.

faqs.question: What should I do to get a direct admission in Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: SIMATS does not offer a direct admission to B.Tech. An entrance exam is required. The admission process for B.Tech is as follows:

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech at Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences?
faqs.answer: The entire cost of the four-year B.Tech degree is about Rs. 5 lakh. This covers the costs of tuition, room and board, deposits, mess fees, and other expenses for eight semesters. The whole cost of tuition fees for four years comes to about Rs 3.5 lakhs. The tuition for the first year is approximately Rs 75,000 every semester. Every year, it rises by 10% to 15%. The annual cost of the mess and hostel is approximately Rs 50,000. Extra deposits are not included. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering

detailed_review.Placements: Placement at our college is pretty good, as reputed companies visit our campus and hire students. They generally take our basic written or MCQ tests before interview rounds and generally there are 3-4 interview rounds (depends). More than 85% (approximately) students are placed every year and the other 15% would choose higher education or choose to opt for his/her own startup. The institution perfectly trains 3-4 months prior to the placement season.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are very well furnished and it has 3 sharing rooms. In the case of nearby PGs, the rent (which ranges between 6,000 and 10,000 per month) is slightly lower than hostel fees. Every room has big cupboards, a bed, chair, table, dustbin, nightlight, book shelf, shoe stand and all other basic requirements for every student. Every hostel has a high-speed wifi, tv, table-tennis on the ground floor, kettle, iron and few more things. The infrastructure of our college, Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune, was advanced. All the labs consists of latest machines and computers with high computing processor. The labs were quite good for Artificial Intelligence. Sports facilities were also good. It includes football with turf, Volleyball, Kho Kho, etc. Sports includes volleyball, turf for football and cricket, kho kho, basketball and other games that can be played on hill top ground.

Everyone of them holds a master's degree and almost 30–40 of the lecturers hold a PhD in the particular subjects they teach us. They are more than helpful to us and we can approach them anytime we wish to. There's usually a core curriculum that is compulsory for 1st and 2nd year but from 3rd year you get specialization and elective courses within your CSE branch. Project-based learning is promoted on a high scale for developing hands-on experience to solve practical problems. I personally feel there should be a stronger partnership with relevant companies to provide internships. I know technical skills are crucial, but incorporating soft skills like communication, personality development, and teamwork needs to be in areas of improvement. Talking about the frequency of exams, SIT follows the semester pattern strictly; exams are held every 5 months, i.e., twice a year and 1 month leave after 2 semesters of completion for internships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good University for B.Tech.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements for CS-IT are great. Companies like Microsoft, Google and Amazon also come to the campus for hiring. For electronics, the placement is okay and for mech and civil, it is not good at all. So I would suggest you go for CS-IT/E&TC only. A lot of good companies visited for CS/IT and Electronics students. Microsoft hired for Consultant role, Google hired for IT support role and Amazon hired for a non-technical roles (Product Compliance Associate). We had many private product-based firms such as Continuum, Persistent Systems, Book My Show and IBM who hired Software Engineers. We also had a Japanese company hire for a developer’s role. I got placed in Continuum Managed Solutions. The entire process was simple and straightforward. The placements head shared the emails for the company hiring and we shared our consents and resume. The students then underwent the hiring process at the college which differed from company to company. The placements record for CS/IT was good with almost 80% of the students getting placed. The placements record for the other branches was average. The college prepared us for the placements drive through the 3-days workshop.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The gender ratio is balanced though there are fewer females in Civil and Mechanical branches. Most of the students are friendly and there is no discrimination on the basis of anything. Everyone gets along with each other well. I have not currently opted for a hostel but I did live in the hostel in the 1st and 2nd year of my degree. The hostel life is good. We have triple sharing rooms available for the students. The accommodation for the students is on first come first serve basis. The number of rooms available is less than the number of students. Boys don't get to enjoy hostel life beyond 2nd years due to the shortage of rooms and so the boys from 3rd and 4th year live in rented flats in Sus-Pashan and Baner. New hostel rooms are being built and they may provide more accommodations in the future. We have an annual cultural fest called Reverb and technical fest called Techfest. Each branch holds it owns Techfest events like CS/IT has Techela. Both these festivals go on for 2 days. The fests are enjoyable and provide great opportunities for the students to showcase their talents. We have an annual sports event called Prota, it encourages the sports enthusiasts to participate and sweat it out in the stadium.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are well educated and they have a good repo with the students. Few of them are really helpful towards the weak students. We get remedial classes too. The sessions are always interactive between the students and the teachers. All the faculty members have PhD and MTech backgrounds having expertise in the field of Research and development. The ratio is actually small and I personally feel it is beneficial due to more individual attention being provided which results in more personalized feedback, increased interaction and potential adaptation to their teaching style. Professors allow the students to contact them via email for academic clarifications. You can even visit them in the staff room for one on one discussion. One of the best thing is that the professors are friendly and easily approachable. You can usually talk to them beyond the class hours and during office meetings to get guidance. There's a core curriculum which is compulsory for 1st and 2nd year students, but from 3rd year onwards, you get specialization and elective courses within your CSE branch. Project based learning is promoted on high scale for developing hands on experience to solve practical problems. I personally feel there should be a stronger partnership with relevant companies to provide internships. I know technical skills are crucial but incorporating soft skills like communication, personality development, and teamwork need to be the areas of improvement. Talking about the frequency of exams, SIT follows the semester pattern strictly, exams are held after every 5 months i.e., twice a year and we get a month’s leave after 2 semesters for internship.

college_info.college_name: SIT Pune Admissions 2026: Dates, Eligibility, Seats, Application Process, Fee

admission.title: SIT Pune Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: SIT Pune admission 2026 is based on entrance exam scores of the candidates. Symbiosis International (Deemed University) conducts SITEEE for admission to Engineering courses at SIT. The institute also accepts national or state-level Engineering entrance exams such as JEE Main and GATE for UG and PG admissions. SIT Pune offers BTech and MTech courses at UG and PG levels in multiple specialisations. Apart from this, it also offers a PhD programme under the Faculty of Engineering of Symbiosis International University. Candidates can apply for SIT Pune admissions via online mode.

faqs.question: How to take admission in SIT Pune?
faqs.answer: SIT Pune offers admission to UG, PG and PhD courses based on entrance-exam. To get admission to any of the course of SIT Pune, candidates need to follow all the steps of the admission process.

faqs.question: Are admissions open at SIT Pune?
faqs.answer: Symbiosis Institute of Technology or SIT Pune admissions are currently open for 2025 session. The applications are open for first year BTech through JEE/ ASGEEE/ MHT-CET 2025, direct entry to BTech second year and M.Tech programme. Candidates can register on the official website of the institute for the preferred course. Admission to SIT Pune courses is entrance-based.

faqs.question: Does SIT Pune accept JEE Main score for BTech admissions?
faqs.answer: Yes, SIT Pune accepts the JEE Main scores for admission to its BTech programme. The institute also accepts other state-level government engineering exams for BTech admissions. SITEEE is also conducted by the institute to grant BTech admissions to students. Interested candidates must apply for various courses offered at the institute at its official website. Symbiosis MTech admissions are based on GATE scores.

faqs.question: Who can apply for SIT Pune BTech?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to meet the eligibility criteria to apply for the BTech course. Candidates need to pass Class 12 examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of Chemistry / Computer Science/ Electronics/ Information Technology/ Informatics Practices/ Technical Vocational subject/ Engineering Graphics with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) to apply for SIT Pune BTech programme. Aspirants who have passed the DVoc stream in the same or allied sector can also apply.

faqs.question: I have just given MHTCET, will I get admission to SIT Pune through MHTCET?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can take admission in SIT Pune BTech programme with MHT CET score. However, aspirants without the score need to provide the scorecard at the end of the admission process during document verification. SIT Pune releases a merit list based on entrance examination scores, branch preferences, and availability of seats. Emails are then sent to merit-listed candidates with links to download the offer letter and pay the first installment of academic fees within 5 days of receiving the offer letter email.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for Ph.D at SIT Pune?
faqs.answer: Candidates must pass one year or two-semester master's degree programme after a four year/ eight semester bachelor's degree or two-year/ four semesters master's degree course after three-year bachelor's degree with a minimum of 55% aggregate can apply for PhD course. There is a 5% relaxation in the aggregate for SC/ST/ Differently-Abled candidates.
