reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is value for money to get a good education.

detailed_review.Placements: If students are aiming for CSE or IT courses, then SSN gives very good placement opportunities, with a high probability of campus placement and the possibility of high-paying offers. If students are in ECE or other core branches, then they still get decent placement chances, especially in core, engineering, R&D, and software-core fields. But students should be ready to compete and perhaps work on additional skills to stand out. SSN placement cell, industry connections, and a diverse recruiter base all contribute to making it a relatively safe bet among private engineering colleges in India.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SSN is built on a sprawling 230-250-acre campus along the old Mahabalipuram road (the cyber corridors of Chennai). There are many dedicated blocks, separate ones for workshops, the central library, computer centre, science and humanities, etc. Classrooms are spacious, digitally enabled (projectors, audiovisual aids), and often air-conditioned, facilitating interactive and modern teaching. For all departments (CSE, EEE, ECE, mechanical, civil, chemical, biomedical, etc.), there are well-equipped labs. SSN supports advanced labs.
detailed_review.Faculty: If students choose a branch like CSE, IT, or other research-oriented streams, then they will likely benefit from experienced faculty members. There are many PhD holders. It has a good faculty-student ratio and exposure to research for modern topics. They provide good potential for mentorship, project guidance, and research orientation. Faculty members are actively involved in publishing. Students may get a balanced mix of theoretical teaching, practical, and project-based learning if they engage proactively (since experience can vary across faculty/subjects). As with any institution, actual benefit depends on which department/branch we pick, and our own initiative (attending classes, interacting with faculty, using resources, and seeking guidance).

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: If your aim is to get a package of 30 or 40LPA or above SSSN is the best choice.

detailed_review.Placements: 95 percent of students are placed every year. For Software related roles in the following year the highest package is around 65LPA and more than 3 to 4 offers are more than 1 CPA. Top MNC like Google Microsoft, Amazon TCS etc are hiring.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SSN is one of the modern and premier institutions in India with a world class infrastructure which is known to all. In case of a hostel it is separate for both genders with unlimited Wi-Fi and Ethernet. Many games are also present with coaches who have served in IPL.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers have 10 years of experience. All have completed their degrees in IIT and NIT and Anna University. Semesters are going to be very hard because they have included open book tests for certain subjects. The evaluation is going to be like a grading.
detailed_review.Other: I am very interested in studying AI in this modern world, I chose SSSN.

reviews.review_title: Helpful faculty, strong research, good facilities, placements, and higher studies opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: I believe 90 percent of students are placed. The lowest, average, and highest packages are 3 LPA, 6 LPA, and 15 LPA. Companies include Hyundai, TCS, Ashok Leyland, and others. A high number of students manage to get internships in Caterpillar and similar companies. Top roles are usually in automotive, design, and industrial/production engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has Wi-Fi, both traditional boards and e-boards to demonstrate concepts and videos. The library is filled with books and is exhaustive in quantity. The tables and rooms are refurbished frequently and are comfortable. Windows are open, letting in fresh breeze. The canteen and mess serve top-quality food with high variety. A first aid kit is kept ready in case of emergencies, and the hostel is really nice with AC and single-room options.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors are masters of their subjects and have a strong research focus. You can see the amount of research they produce if you walk down the hallway of my department. The course is extremely relevant and has ample electives to branch out as you see fit. Semester exams are entirely based on the syllabus, and if the concepts are clear, you do not need to worry. In my section of 64 people, I think everyone has passed.
detailed_review.Other: I study Mechanical Engineering, and I personally feel the course is wonderfully designed. We have ample elective choices, and the department has professors who are extremely helpful. It is an extremely engaging course, and you are introduced to new topics every semester. Do not be fooled by the core tag. My favorite subjects are Additive Manufacturing and Operations Research, which are really interesting. Events and fests are plenty, sports facilities are amazing, and the football field is one of the best in the state. There are many clubs, so do not miss the opportunity.

reviews.course: M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: In Tamil Nadu, SSN College is number one for placements. Highest package is about 1.2 crores, and lowest package is 3 LPA. So many top companies have come to our college. Tamil Nadu's one of the best colleges is SSN. So many MNC companies came to our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have best infrastructure and labs. We have best AC classrooms. We have a well-stocked library with central AC. We have best hostel rooms, and washrooms are very clean. We have a medical facility available for both hostelers and day boarders. We also have sports available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified, well educated, and they are well knowledgeable. Their teaching is very super. While teaching, they are very friendly to students. This course is a relevant civil type. This is not relevant to industries. Semester exams are not tough, it is moderate.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with all aspects such as placements, campus life, and education.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% placements were provided. Top companies like Amazon, Zoho, and Oracle participated in the placements and startups also took part. The highest package offered is 50 LPA. A diverse number of companies attended the placements and all hired with a lot of benefits.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel was very spacious and comfortable. The hostel food was very average and they should improve on that.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty were all experienced and very good at their job. Concepts were taught with utmost skill and understanding. Semesters were quite difficult and challenging. The questions were very twisted and tricky and was quite tough to attend without a heavy preparation. My course and syllabus was architected very well with important base knowledge about computer science and coding-related concepts were also taught to us.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life was pretty good as the college is very scenic and beautiful surrounded by stress all over.

reviews.course: M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with the infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in our course are around 80%, which is a good record. The quality of placements is also really good. The highest package offered is 48 LPA. The average package ranges from 6-7 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Accenture, IBM, Capgemini, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are like international colleges, which are extremely good. The library is available. Wi-Fi is present. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is also good. Sports facilities are present in limited editions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective fields of study. The teaching quality of our faculty members is extremely great. The course curriculum is relevant. Students have mandatory internships in the course and research work so they get real industry exposure.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a top 1 college for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: The top roles offered are from premium companies, including data scientist, development engineer, frontend, backend development, machine learning engineer, etc. Even non-technical roles are offered such as sales, marketing, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The quality of mess food is average but the infrastructure is just too awesome. There is a basketball court, cricket ground, canteen, library, canteen and two other food shops which provide hygienic food. There are AC hostels as well as non-AC one can choose according to their needs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers have excellent knowledge. The teaching methods are amazing and interesting, which keeps students attached to subjects and interests. The pass percentage in college is 45% out of 100. The difficulty level depends on the paper but it is more easy to pass if we prepare the important questions.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in the computer science course. This course offers all subjects related to computer science and gives a wide range of subject knowledge which helps us to get high package jobs. Everything is perfect about this course and maybe sticking to one language like Python alone is not enough, which I feel personally. There are a lot of events happening like cultural fest, hackathons, paper presentations, etc., where students can actively participate. Many hackathons and cultural events are there too for students to participate in.

reviews.review_title: I got a new family in my college.

detailed_review.Placements: In many departments particularly in mechanical the placement percentage exceeds 90%. The highest package is around 1.17 core per annum and the lowest package falls in the range of 8 to 10 lacs per annum for companies like Range, Caterpillar, etc are hiring our college for placements since I am a second-year student we are not compelled to go for placement we had done lots of projects regarding our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in our college for the mechanical department are very good. The college offers Wi-Fi facilities in classrooms libraries and labs also. They provide labs with essential machines and equipment and safety facilities in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable then we think the faculty obtained their Ph.D. and IITs only. The method of teaching is such a way that all the students can understand the topic. The lab technician makes students more skillful in using machines and equipment so we are the students of industry-ready

reviews.review_title: I am fully satisfied with the college and its facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: SSN College of Engineering has a 94% placements in Mechanical Engineering and an overall placement of 69%. The college provides placements in many good companies like Caterpillar, TCS, and several core companies such as Elite Woods.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of SSN College of Engineering is so good, with a campus area of 230 acres. The food in the college canteen and hostel mess tastes really good, and the hostel rooms are neatly maintained. The security is very strict.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at SSN College of Engineering are very friendly and helpful to students. They want their students to achieve top-tier jobs, and the exam question papers are set at a difficult level so that students can tackle and handle all sorts of interview questions.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechanical Engineering at SSN College of Engineering because of placements and infrastructure of this college.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life - Great balance of academics and enjoyment.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly ECE students take up IT jobs in on-campus placements. Recruiters like Barclays, Fidelity, and many other Fintech companies recruit from here. In the core side, embedded systems are mostly in demand. Students who are very passionate about core take up higher education.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Library has many resources and books. Wi-Fi facility is also present. There are total 18 ECE labs out of which some are curricular labs and many are research labs. Hostel and mess are also better than many other colleges. Medical clinic is also available on the campus. Sports complex and gym are also available for interested students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors teach really well. Just following their notes and attending their classes regularly is enough to get good marks on the exam. The curriculum is updated in every regulation and in the latest regulation (R2024) many soft skills development courses are also added.
detailed_review.Other: There are 2 big annual fests - Invente (tech fest) and Instincts (non-tech fest).

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Journey in SSN College of Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a final-year student and I am studying in the electrical and electronic domain. My college got the best placement compared to all the other colleges, especially for Computer Science Engineering. They are offering extremely high package jobs. They are calling lots of reputed companies, and one of my friends got placed in Google and Amazon and lots of other top companies. For core jobs like electrical and mechanical, students are also placed with 12 LPA, and the least placements were 3 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SSN has the most beautiful campus and their infrastructure is so beautiful. It’s full of greenery, and no college maintains such infrastructure like SSN. I love the campus, and it is very clean and hygienic. They have huge labs which help the students to learn more practically than theoretically. The hostel facilities are also good. The rooms are so clean and are cleaned every day. The washrooms are also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college has good faculty members. They have 50 faculty per department, so the faculty-to-student ratio is pretty good. They help a lot in making the students understand the concepts very easily. They provide us with study materials which are totally enough to clear the exams and understand the concepts very strongly. They also have demonstration classes.
detailed_review.Other: I got into the electrical and electronic domain, but I wanted to study Computer Science because I hated electrical in my school days. But once I started learning the concepts, it looked very simple for me to understand. I would say my faculty is very good at making the concepts simpler. We also get an opportunity to take seminars which help us to search for the topic and understand how deep we should go to study and learn a topic.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: SSN College of Engineering - The best College in Tamil Nadu.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements for CSE and IT in SSN College of Engineering is very nice. The average package is around 10 Lacs. The highest salary is Rs 1.12 crores per annum, by MotorQ company. The lowest salary is 3 lakhs per annum. Usually, most of the students get placed in the company they intern with.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available in SSN College of Engineering are great. We can access the library daily. The library is very good. The infrastructure of the college is very good. The campus has good Wi-Fi facilities. The lab is good. Classrooms are very nice. Mess food is average, but Rishabs and canteen food is very good. Best food ever tasted. Value for money. Sports facilities are very nice. We also have a good GYM.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers here are so friendly till now. The curriculum is good and updated. It makes industry-ready engineers. Semester exams are good. Two assessment exams called CAT 1, 2 are held once in a semester. All the teachers here are Ph.D. holders from IIT Madras and Anna University.
detailed_review.Other: The B.E. CSE curriculum is good here. The highest placement here is Rs 1.12 crore, which is also from the CSE department. Invente is a technical event, and Instincts is a cultural non-technical event conducted once in a year in our college. Campus crowd is very limited when compared to other colleges. Many scholarships are given by the college. Campus life is very good.

reviews.review_title: Perks of SSN College of Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all the students from our department who got placed remaining are doing their higher education. Five of our students got placed in a major core company called Caterpillar, and a few of them made wood. The highest package offered by the core company is 12 LPA, and other companies also recruit from our department, including MotorQ and Amazon. Most of the students try getting internships on their own, and our college CDC makes sure everyone is doing their internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a good infrastructure in terms of hostels. We have 9 hostels with different kinds of rooms, and all the hostels are provided with Wi-Fi. There is a hospital inside the campus, and all the hosts can access it without any hesitation. When it comes to mess, we have two kinds of mess. One is called Premium Mess, which serves variety food items, and the other is called Normal Mess; this is the one most of the students are enrolled in. The food dishes served here are minimal, but they almost cover all the required vitamins and minerals. All the mess includes breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner. Monthly once we get to have fest.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the faculty members here are just awesome. Every staff member is highly qualified, and most are likely to be involved in publishing papers, and some have their own patent. They often do projects by having their students in their team. Since it's an autonomous college, we have a syllabus that strengthens our base. We have an atmosphere that encourages students to do projects based on their interests. When it comes to semester, it's pretty hard, and it challenges your basic understanding and problem-solving skills. Pass percentages vary based on subjects, and the pass percentage is always way higher than the fail percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical engineering because of my interest in machines, and later it turned towards aeronautical. Mechanical in SSN is good, and staffs are good. The only thing that matters is your interest. We have various events happening around the academic year, and the main is the cultural event called Instincts, which happens for 3 days.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A college you don't want to miss.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students were placed, except for those who had standing arrears or a history of arrears. The top recruiting companies were Fidelity and Citibank. The highest package was from Motorq at 1.2 crores, and the lowest was around 6.5 LPA. The average salary was around 9 lakhs per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SSN College of Engineering has pretty good college Wi-Fi, but it has lots of restrictions. The teachers are very knowledgeable and can help you with projects. The library is a pleasant place to study and relax. The mess is below average, but the canteens are good. The college has top-class infrastructure for sports like football, cricket, badminton, and basketball.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum at SSN College of Engineering covers all the fundamentals that we need to survive in the industry. However, it's up to us to make good use of the resources and learn the material thoroughly. The semester exams are not easy and not predictable, but if we study hard for the internals, we can pass them.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of SSN College of Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: About 100% of the students get placed in my course. The highest package offered to my super seniors was 18 LPA, with an average of 7 LPA and the lowest of 3.5 LPA. For internships, about 5-10% of the students get placed. Top roles offered are SD roles. The companies that come for placements are Deshaw. Co., Fidelity, and City Bank.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available in my department is great, with complete Wi-Fi available to do our college work. They have great labs and many research labs where students can accompany faculty members in those projects. SSN is one of the colleges where 5G labs are present.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members who teach here are Ph.D. holders and have in-depth knowledge of what they teach. They have a clear idea about where this topic in the curriculum will be used in a real-world scenario. The course curriculum relevance is based on the Anna University syllabus.
detailed_review.Other: If a student wants to pursue a pure technical role in their placements, then they must go with the IT or CSE department. As they will study in detail about programming languages when compared to other departments.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Faculty is good approachable hostel food is bad even for premium mess food cost high.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement here is good compared to other competing self-financing private institutions. MotorQ offers a 1.1 CPA, which is the highest in the college. HCL is also one of the leading companies. The average placement is from 6-8 LPA. About 60-70% of students get their internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SSN is one of the popular colleges known for its infrastructure. However, as an SSNite, I can give you a clear review. The hostel for 1st-year students is well-maintained, but for 2nd-year students, the story is different. They convert 3-sharing rooms to 4-sharing due to a shortage of hostel space caused by the introduction of SNU Law.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty here are very good and approachable. As for CSE depth, my teachers are better than those in other colleges. I think my course outcomes are very good. The semester exams are a little tough, but CAT is okay. However, teachers don’t always give good marks; they seem to grade based on their mood.
detailed_review.Other: I am passionate about CSE, so I chose it. The only thing I think could be improved is arranging better bus facilities for hostel students. Although it’s available, they charge for it. If hostelers could use the day scholar bus without extra charges, it would be better. The Wi-Fi is good here.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good college with high infrastructure, with well-qualified and experienced faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are really good, and students are encouraged throughout their entire journey in college life. Companies that visit the college offer excellent opportunities to the students. Also, the package for each job is really competitive and worthwhile. If you have knowledge and are ready to gain new skills, the college will really support you in landing your dream job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Talking about the infrastructure—the labs, classrooms, library, and even common areas like the canteen and walking paths—everything is maintained regularly. Each lab is equipped with features corresponding to its name. Additionally, the entire campus has a very good Wi-Fi connection.
detailed_review.Faculty: About the faculty, they are really very kind, knowledgeable, and experienced in their field. They genuinely want the students to have a bright future. Each student will have a separate mentor to whom they can turn for solutions to their problems. Additionally, the mentors motivate the students and assist them in every aspect of their journey.

reviews.review_title: Your highway to heaven !

detailed_review.Placements: Whoever appears for placements gets placed. Several companies come to recruit our students. Right from IT companies to a lot of core companies, and recently, our seniors from the mechanical department got placed at Caterpillar in associate designers and other roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am a day scholar, but according to my hosteller friends, the hostel rooms are good, but the food from the mess is okay at best. They do provide Wi-Fi, and the students are allowed to use mobile phones in class unless a teacher specifically tells them not to.
detailed_review.Faculty: I can assure you that all the professors are really qualified, as the institutions only hire Ph.D. scholars and seasoned professors who got their degrees from NITs or IITs. Now it is changed to just IITs. Most of the professors are really friendly, especially in the mechanical department.

reviews.review_title: Curriculum and life at SSN.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of students will be placed with a good package. The average salary offered is INR 7 LPA. We had around 200 companies in the last academic year. Companies like TCS, CTS, Infosys, Comcast, Wood, Amadeus, Amazon, Genpact, and British Telecom visit and pick a bunch of candidates.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at this college is the best in Tamil Nadu. It won't feel like Chennai at all. Campus life here is tremendous. The campus has Wi-Fi everywhere. It is a very beautiful campus. One of the best you can ever find. It's eco-friendly, has a lot of trees, and has a park, which is a hangout spot and a favorite for anyone.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here are friendly and helpful; they let you study your way and guide you not only in the curriculum but also in extracurriculars and others. They always look after you and treat you very well. And they always motivate students to gain knowledge of the latest technology and stuff. They never fail to encourage students to participate in extracurricular activities. Semester exams are moderate. It has a pass percentage of 93.5%.

reviews.review_title: Our college is a good place to study but it does not provide good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: In mechanical engineering, most students opted for higher studies. Many students are placed. The highest salary package offered was 16 LPA and the lowest salary package offered was 12 LPA. The college provides the contact of companies for internships, and students can get internships based on their interests and contacts.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides excellent infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available. It is unlimited, with some restraints on a few websites. Classrooms are provided with adequate fans and digital projectors. Hostels are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are Ph.D. holders. They are knowledgeable and are ready to teach students whenever requested. Our teachers follow the classic teaching methodology, but they show their presentations to students through projectors. The course curriculum is planned by the teacher considering current industrial needs. Semester exams are average.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical because of my interest in making machines and the basic engineering around them. Mechanical engineering is considered one of the courses that can be passed easily, but it is false. Without effort, most students fail the test. Events and competitions could have been more intense. You are given complete freedom to do what you do after class, and you can make the most of it with clubs, projects, sports, etc.

sections.heading: SSN College of Engineering Academic and Research Facilities
text: SSN College of Engineering (SSNCE) offers a state-of-the-art academic and research environment that fosters excellence in engineering education and innovation. The campus is equipped with spacious, digitally enabled classrooms, seminar halls, and smart learning spaces that support interactive pedagogy and collaborative learning. Each department houses specialised, fully equipped laboratories aligned with current industry and research standards—such as the IoT Lab, High Performance Computing Lab, and VLSI Design Lab. SSN also emphasises interdisciplinary research through its dedicated Centre for Research , which supports funded projects, publications, and patents in areas like Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Renewable Energy, and Biomedical Engineering.

Faculty and students have access to cutting-edge infrastructure, including GPU clusters, simulation software, testing equipment, and fabrication units. The college maintains strong industry and institutional collaborations—both nationally and internationally- and is a recognised research centre under Anna University. SSN’s academic ecosystem encourages innovation through incubation support, technical clubs, and regular conferences and workshops, ensuring students graduate with both deep technical expertise and practical research exposure.

sections.heading: SSN College of Engineering Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: SSN College of Engineering offers residential facilities. The institute has separate hostels for boys and girls. The hostels have their own kitchen, dining hall, library, TV room, internet, and telephone facilities. There is 24*7 surveillance as there are CCTV cameras. Apart from these, there are shared study and recreational spaces, laundry, medical support, and a well-equipped gym.

facilities.description: SSN library has 84000 volumes and 20000 titles and an online journal database with a link to IEL (IEEE & IEE), ACM, Science Direct, SpringerLink.com and EBSCO. The library stocks 206 national and 114 international journals and magazines to keep students abreast of the latest findings and research. And the resources are constantly being expanded, with around 1,200 books added each semester. SSN also has institutional membership in the libraries of IIT-Madras, Anna University, British Council, MALIBNET (Madras Library Network, Chennai) and DELNET (Developing Library Network, New Delhi).

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering (Full Stack Software Development) in tie up with GeeksforGeeks
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements in 2022, and really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80 percent of the students are placed in this course. The highest package is around 56 LPA. Average package varies every year, and the recent graduated batch average package is around 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Amazon, Microsoft, and Apple visit the campus to hire students. At last of the course, all students received an internship offer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the university is in top-notch condition. This is the biggest university in India. All labs and library are well-equipped with air conditioning. Classrooms are well-maintained. Food is ok for South people, but it looks like somewhat difficult to survive on this food. They provide 24X7 medical facility.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty at this university are well-educated and knowledgeable. Many professors are very friendly to the students. Teaching quality is also good. Every student is happy with the curriculum provided by the college. In point of difficult level of exams, I think sometimes we feel it's difficult and some other times it is not like that.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing I observed in this course is the curriculum. There is nothing to improve in this course. We have top-notch events and good connectivity. Scholarships are there to help students who can't pay their fees.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Reviewing facts about Lovely Professional University.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the batch of 2023-2027 pursuing B.Tech in CSE, and like 80% of students are getting placed. The highest package varies from 20-30 LPA, the lowest package is 4 LPA, and the average is 7-8 LPA. Many companies visit here, like TCS, Wipro, and Capgemini. Almost 70% students get internships through the college in companies like TCS, Visa, and companies come here for roles like Web developer, Data scientist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For my course, the facilities are quite good. The university is providing computer labs, Wi-Fi and big classrooms. The library is also there, which is very huge and consists of a wide range of books. The hostel is also decent, and the rooms are always clean. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available at any time.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in my course are good and very talented. Most of them are qualified PhD teachers. The curriculum is also very relevant to the industry, and it is up to date. Coming to the exams, the difficulty level is medium and mostly like 80% of students get good marks every time.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I like to do something big in the CSE department, and I wish there were better, more advanced labs and more industry visits. About the campus life, it is really nice. We are having fests and events every day. I really like the campus life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good infrastructure and facilities. Good placements, campus life, and facilities are excellent.

detailed_review.Placements: It depends on the performance of the student whether he/she can get placed, as the competition is very high. The highest package is around 45 to 50 LPA, the lowest is 5 to 6 LPA, and the average is 10 to 11 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities of the classes are very good. Labs are also very good, and library facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi is good, but sometimes, due to the large number of students, the network goes down. Hostel facilities are very good. Mess food and canteen are also very good. Medical support is available 24x7. For sports, we have an auditorium where you can play games and sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and knowledgeable in their respective fields. Whenever we cannot understand, we can ask anything in their cabins when available. Teaching quality is excellent. The course curriculum is relevant and very good to make students ready for industry. Semester exams are moderate, though if your basics are clear, then you will be able to clear, otherwise not.
detailed_review.Other: On campus, almost 5 to 6 events and fests are organized where you can participate in Hackathons, Singing, and many more. If you have good marks in JEE or Class 12, then you can get around 40 to 45 percent scholarship. In addition, there is LPU NEST, which is LPU’s own entrance exam. If you get above 280 marks, then you will be able to get 35 to 45 percent scholarship in tuition fees.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best infrastructure this college has, alongwith very good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 605 students placed in our batch so far. The highest package is 53 LPA from Microsoft, the lowest is 5 LPA from Capgemini, and the average is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, GoDaddy, GoComet, Firecompass, Broadridge, etc. 40 percent of students are placed at internships from our batch from the 2nd year itself from LPU. They got internships from other companies like QuickHeal Academy. Security analyst, Penetration tester, Malware analyst, etc., are the top roles offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: On our campus, all facilities are very good. But sometimes we have Wi-Fi speed issues in some blocks, not in labs. The library is open from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classrooms are digital for every class, we need a laptop mainly for CSE. Faculty are good. In the hostel, most of the facilities are very good, but a few times we have issues with the electricity bill at the end of the year. The gym is present inside the hostels, which is also free. The mess food is good in taste and unlimited. But the mess fee and hostel fee are paid separately.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers for our batch were industry mentors. So, they are very calm, patient, well-trained with practical knowledge, and treated us kindly. Exams are conducted very frequently here. But qualified faculty helped us to pass those exams very easily. In teaching, they provide us with industry materials, labs, study guides, PPTs, projects, etc. Teachers are always online, so doubts are cleared easily. The course is very relevant for us for the fee we paid. Placements became easy due to the industry tie-up curriculum only. The pass percentage is 40 percent in exams. The exam level is moderate to difficult. We can pass by studying easily.
detailed_review.Other: I personally chose this course because of my interest in cybersecurity, and was not very interested in coding like DSA. The best thing about our course is the CompTIA certification. Grade mapping for our subjects is available if these certifications are passed. So, we became good at fundamentals and scored well in 4 years because of certification. I wish the semester could be extended by some more days. The semester here is of a very short duration, with only 4 months per semester. Frequent events always take place on campus. So, the campus is always joyful, with crowds, talents, and student efforts. For events and fests, this campus is the best.

reviews.review_title: The college has beautiful infrastructure, good facilities, and strong placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students who opted for this course was 30%. The students of this course received the highest package of 15 LPA and the lowest package of 9 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Agri-Associate, Kincannon & Reed, AG HeadHunters, and Keller Executive Search. Around 70% of students received internships in these companies. The top roles offered ranged from research and development to practical farm management and even business-oriented positions.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college had number one facilities and beautiful infrastructure. The classrooms for my course were hygienic and clean. Every block contained a library, and free Wi-Fi was available 24/7. The quality of food was not ideal for South Indian students. But overall, it was very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were highly helpful. Every student had a personal mentor. They prepared us with hands-on experience for every aspect of the course related to the industry. The pass percentage was 99%. The semester exams were above average. I liked it very much.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a very good college with excellent infrastructure and strong placement support.

detailed_review.Placements: For recent B.Tech passing-out batches, approximately 85–95% of eligible students get placed. The placement rate is particularly strong for CSE, IT, AI, and Data Science. The core engineering branches also receive consistent placement support. It depends on students’ skills and academic performance.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: B.Tech, BBA, MBA, BCA, and MCA courses are offered. Labs are available, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostel and college. The library is very good, with seven floors. Each floor can seat 100–120 students. Food is very good, and three types of food are available. South Indian, North Indian, and combined. Non-veg food is not allowed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers teach in English, but some teach in Hindi, and students can understand. In our college, there is a CAS exam first, then a mid exam, and finally the semester exam. For the semester exam, students have four attempts to pass. If a student does not pass after four attempts, it is considered a backlog. To clear the backlog, the student must pay 10% of the full college fee.
detailed_review.Other: Events happen in the college every week, with 3–4 events. Event fees range from Rs. 100 to Rs. 500. Scholarships are available up to 60–70%. Non-veg food is not allowed. If anyone brings non-veg into the college, their scholarship is revoked.

reviews.review_title: You get placed according to your capacity and capabilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is given to deserving students who have the capabilities. They are placed by high paying companies, but if you are not that capable then you will have to find your own placement. Every student is not assured of placement. Its according to your capacity.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, smart classes, libraries, and even a hospital inside the campus. The campus is even bigger and has its own many areas and food courts. It has many facilities, like an indoor stadium, a pool, many grounds, and even a helipad for helicopter landing.
detailed_review.Faculty: Good faculty members, learning material, and even a good syllabus and half an hour of sleep in the world is a great day of school and I am not going to the campus. I do not know if it has any questions about your house, and even if I do not, I do not have to worry about getting a free ride.
detailed_review.Other: Everything except non veg is available inside the campus.

reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Actually moderate and below moderate companies with the below package of 3.75 LPA picked up for placements. Various companies invited but companies below 4 LPA only hire candidates from the Diploma courses. The highest package offered would be 3.9 LPA by companies like HCL, IBM, and Mindtree.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amazed with the college infrastructure as they were offering a number of courses in various sections. For all the sections, 80 percent of seats were enrolled directly and the rest of the enrollment was through management. Fees should vary between direct admission and management quota students. Sports and games were played by us regularly as they were part of our schedule.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our professors were intellectual with the best industrial experiences, and guided us step by step. Professors were very diplomatic in their behaviour and in their answers. Exams for our courses were liberal and easier to score the minimum marks by observing the everyday class without doing any self preparations.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of LPU  Lovely Professional University.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement charges and the training were properly planned and conducted for all the batch students from their first day of college. Dell, HP, Amazon, Cognizant, Ninja were a few of the on campus visitors at the first phase of placement, followed by companies like MultiCore, Hexaware, Concentrix, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Visiting the hostel rooms seriously made me feel comfortable and much more peaceful in the day to day routine. The perfect environment allowed us to have meaningful college days without any distractions. The fee fixed for all the services was not affordable to all.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were the biggest supporters every time. Their timeless efforts and priceless help throughout the course, which in the end bring the constantly greater grades. Faculty members might also be good at coding and the best error resolvers. If the model exam score was reduced than the prior immediate meeting arranged with our parents.

reviews.review_title: Enjoyed campus life, agriculture practicals are good, but the schedule is tight.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch, almost 70-75% of students got placed from the course. Placement is honestly above average in LPU if you are consistent. The highest package in my course went around 10-12 LPA, the lowest was around 3 LPA, and the average stayed somewhere near 4-5 LPA. Many companies like Infosys, Tech Mahindra, ICICI, HDFC, and a few agriculture-based companies also visited, depending on the branch. Internships were also offered to almost 40-50% of students, with a bare minimum stipend between 15k and 20k.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Seriously, writing about the infrastructure, which is one of the starting blocks of the university, is that it has very excellent infrastructure compared to our block, which is at the last. The experience of the library is very good, and the Wi-Fi can be said to be average. I have not taken the hostel because I stay in a PG.
detailed_review.Faculty: Everything is good and best. The atmosphere is very competitive during exams. The curriculum is also good, but the students who fail in the exam have to write a review and appear for an exam that costs 500 rupees. Overall, it’s a positive response from my side.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen B.Sc. Agriculture, because I always wanted to work in the agriculture field, and LPU was offering a good setup with labs, fields, and practical exposure. The best thing about the course is that we get proper field visits, crop production practicals, and teachers are also helpful most of the time. Events like Krishi Mela, agri-exhibitions, and different departmental activities also provide good exposure.

reviews.review_title: Review of LPU - Lovely Professional University.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85 percent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course was 24 LPA. The average package was around 5-6 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Axis Bank, ICICI Prudential, Infosys, etc. The top roles were executive and manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were good. Wi-Fi facility, modern classroom. Hostel quality was very good, like 5 5-star hotel. Shopping malls were present on the campus. Mess and canteen food were also good. A sports complex was present.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective subjects. The teaching quality of our faculty members was good. The course curriculum was relevant. Students become industry-ready. The semester examination was at a moderate level. Around 95 percent were passed.

reviews.review_title: Lovely Professional University Review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements in our course were decent. The highest package offered in our course was 12 LPA. The average package was between 3–4 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Lupin, Sun Pharma, Mankind, etc. Around 80 percent of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. All the required instruments were available for practicals. The campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Mess and canteen food were good. Medical facility was present. Multiple sports complexes were present.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our faculty members was good. The course curriculum was relevant. The college provided the lab to gain practical experience; it depends on the student. Semester examinations were moderate.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the faculty but the environment is good.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in my 2nd year right now, as I see there are students getting placed, but more companies prefer CSE students, and also the students in BCA get placed in sales more than in coding line, though if you study hard, you can get placed in coding jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are good because the Wi-Fi is good in hostels, though the same cannot be said about food, as the food may be good for some and not for others. The medical facilities are good, as is a hospital on campus. The Wi-Fi facilities are also good. 1 person gets 40 GB for a week, and online games cannot be played on this Wi-Fi.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching faculty cannot be said to be good as there are good faculty, but they are fewer in number. The faculty members all just see their own rating in class, and if someone repeatedly asks doubts, they just lash out at the student, so the faculty are not good.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are happening daily.

reviews.course: B.Tech. Electronics and Communication Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) in tie up with True Chip and Futurewiz
reviews.review_title: All are welcome. It is an awesome campus.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package is reported as 3 crore per annum. The top companies recruiting include Amazon, Google, Apple, Nvidia, Intel, Bosch, and many others. Packages are offered to 6000+ students, and the 2025 batch has 1700+ students. It is an awesome college, and placements are among the top compared to other colleges.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are luxurious, affordable, well-cleaned, and secure for students. Rooms are available in different types, with AC or without AC, and for 4-person, 2-person, or single occupancy. There is 24-hour security. You can buy anything inside the campus as we have everything. It includes malls and markets.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-trained and professional. Many of them hold doctorates in India. If any problems arise, they help us. All exam questions are of standard level. Exams are conducted with good security and discipline, including M.A. exams, CA, midterms, etc.
detailed_review.Other: We have many opportunities, such as hackathons, technorathons, and fests for students, including Sunburn and car shows.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Every opportunity available, but you should be serious.

detailed_review.Placements: To be very frank, colleges do not provide the actual data of placement internships, etc. The reason behind it is that there are too many admissions this year, more than Rs. 30,000. Although, the highest placement is of 2.5 crore per annum, it is fake. Last year, it was 54 LPA, and the average package is about 6 LPA to 8 LPA because they make students ineligible for the placement, so this is the average of only eligible students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is really awesome and well-maintained. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. The library and the hospital are available. Mess food is ok-ok, canteen food is good overall hostel and infrastructure-wise, LPU is holding its position well. Sometimes, like very few times in the whole year, there is an electricity issue, but it is acceptable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, they are mostly IITian and NITian qualified and knowledgeable. Some of them do not deliver well, but most of them are good. Course curriculum is also relevant, and regular practical field experience is given to students in other branches, such as civil. And academically, it's also not that tough, except for some professors. Last semester, 91 percent of students passed, which means no back, and this is the general trend.
detailed_review.Other: College life here is full of fun, and lots of activities are going on. I chose this course since it is the time of AI, CS is the best branch for it. I also did a specialization in AI. I should be serious about academics from the first semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Placements are not good, huge number of students (completion more), and infrastructure is good.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently pursuing my B.Tech (CSE) from LPU, Punjab. I am in 2nd year currently, so if you are coming LPU for the placement opportunities, the first thing you should keep in mind is that you are competing with 10,000 to 15,000 students in CSE, so for the placements you have to study according to that. Teachers are good over here. According to my experience, some of my friends who are in different sections have told me that they are having bad teachers, so it's your luck.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and libraries are very spacious, ventilation is good, in summers AC is turned on the whole day, so the rooms are cold in summers. I am not living in hostel, but my friends who are living in the hostels told me that the hostels are good, but they are costly. In 2nd year most of my friends shifted to law GATE or green valley, which are the places near our college. The food of our mess is also okay, not so good not so bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful and also qualified enough to teach us. If we ask doubt to them, they clear it very nicely. Teachers also depend on your luck, as I told some of my friends who had bad experiences. The semester exams in our colleges are not tough. If you pay attention in class, you can get good CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because I have no other option left for me. My last option is LPU, which is like a mini town. Everything you need will be in the college, and also the population of LPU is much more than Jalandhar, it seems to be, but no doubt if you are coming to LPU for the enjoyment. You will feel like you are in heaven, but if you want to be placed in a company, I think LPU is not for you.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: If you are going to utilize the LPU facilities, its gonna be a good journey for you.

detailed_review.Placements: There are a lot of students pursuing B.Tech CSE in LPU, the competition is a little high. The highest package in LPU is in 2018, of 3cr. The average package offered is 8LPA. Top companies like Google, Microsoft, and Flipkart come to pick students from LPU. The placement is very good compared to. The students get placed based on their CGPA. Students should maintain a good CGPA for better placements. 90% of students who are doing engineering are getting placed from LPU.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of LPU is the best thing. LPU is 600 acres with modern infrastructure. Students can utilize all these facilities. There is everything in the campus itself, malls, a hospital, and everything for arts, sports, and industrial skill developing facilities, libraries, a lot of canteens, etc. The hostel facility is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly skilled and qualified, very helpful and friendly. The teachers are highly skilled in teaching and industrial teaching too. They are not only teaching the students, but also they are preparing them to become industry ready, as they develop their soft skills in communication and for interviews. The exams are of two types, MCQs and objective, based on subjects. When we score overall weightage of 40 out of 100, we will pass for the new semester.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because of my passion for teaching and coding. The best thing about this course at LPU is that we can have a lot of fun studying this course, as they provide many sorts of events, clubs, etc. Sometimes there will be events happening for students to take a break from studying and chill. When we talk about a crowd, College is filled with many students and is very crowded, with students from different parts of India and even from outside of India. The college surroundings are very well maintained. The college is providing scholarships for students with an exam called LPU NEST.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: LPU is good but expensive as compared to opportunity or knowledge.

detailed_review.Placements: LPU placement services are good, as there are many big companies that come and give placement opportunities, such as Capgemini, TCS, Cognizant, etc. Talking about the highest package, it is above 50 LPA. 85% of students get their offer letter before the last semester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of LPU is phenomenal, there is everything that a student needs for their education, starting from a great library to good quality of practical labs in each field. They have great professors who give you guidance whenever you need. LPU also has a great campus where you can get many opportunities to learn and grow.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers have good knowledge of their field. They provide guidance in their respective field, but sometimes when they are not in the mood, they don't give any attention. Some teachers are not even good in their respective field, have an ego, and on. The curriculum is relevant, like they teach you everything to make you industry-ready, but you have to work on your own. Semester exams are sometimes very tough, and sometimes medium, but never easy.
detailed_review.Other: Other information, like they have a great sports coach for different fields, like every field. If you like sports, they provide a cultural event. They organised various tech events like gaming, hackathons, coding competitions, and many more.

reviews.review_title: Average college with good marketing.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, the average package is around 3 LPA. Some of the Top Recruiting companies are HighRadius with a package of 6-8 LPA. This year, around 50% students got placed. Whereas in the previous year, around 80-90 % students got placed. Maybe due to AI and market changes. The highest package was around 10 LPA in Increff, and the lowest is around 2.5 LPA in root analysis. Some of the Top Roles offered in my course (B.Tech Biotechnology) are Business Analyst and Data Analyst. Some students get selected for sales roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our facilities are average. Wi-Fi is available for Computer lab work and works fine. Labs are okay with average equipment and facilities, don't expect big equipment and materials for higher-level research. Classrooms are also okay with not-so-good benches and other facilities. There is a high scope of improvement. The library is great with great facilities and a number of books. Hostels are okay as well. Food is also average, like what you can expect from a mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is okay, not very good. Some teachers are knowledgeable and some are not. But no teacher is great at teaching students, except 1 or 2 if you are lucky to get one. The course curriculum is relevant, at least better than that of other private universities. Semester exams are difficult and not very easy to pass. The passing percentage is 40% overall.  Most of the work has to be done by students if they want to get a good CGPA or gain knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: Events on the campus happen often, but are not worth the time, and most of us don't get time to attend or enjoy the events. The campus crowd is very much. Students get good scholarships, which is why many students join this university. There are some extracurricular activities like dance, music, etc, that the university provides, but students have to join and make time for that besides their studies.

reviews.review_title: For agriculture, it is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Students become eligible for placements from the 7th semester. For agriculture course, Tata Rallis, ITC, Nath biogenesis, Syngenta, Wipro, etc., were recruiting companies. Some of them were hired for internships, some for jobs, and some companies offered jobs after internships to some students. I wanted to pursue a masters's in agriculture entomology but currently doing a job. It also offered internships at Syngenta. I cannot exactly recall the stipend but it was less than Rs 15,000 per month. Students had analyzed the effect of weedicides on weeds. ITC hired students for content making and procurement.

There were 2 libraries in each department, and one central library for all campus students. In classroom, there was a projector, whiteboards, and in few classes, there were window and AC. Wi-Fi was all over the campus. In hostel, I share a room with three other students. Room was good and large. We had fans and study tables for everyone. Air-coolers were also available in the room, and hot water facility was also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were really nice at the university. They were very helpful and very informative. They provided all the help that was needed, providing materials, recommending books, and solving your problems anytime. Exams occur per semester, with one mid-term every semester. Mid-terms were MCQ-based while finals were both MCQ and long-answer type. B.Sc. agriculture contained 8 semesters with approximately 12 subjects per semester, while the last two semesters were all about practical and project works.

admission.title: LPU Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
LPU admission 2026 is mainly entrance-based and a multi-step process starting with application followed by selection rounds, and result declaration. The Lovely Professional University (LPU) offers more than 300 degree and diploma courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels along with several distance learning courses via the LPU Centre for Distance & Online Education . The application process for the university can be completed online.

LPU conducts LPUNEST as the in-house entrance and scholarship exam for its courses in fileds of Engineering, Agriculture, Management, Law, Design, Pharmacy, Architecture & Planning, and more. While LPUNEST is widely accepted by the university, if students have valid scores of other national-level entrance exams, such JEE Main Part 2 , NATA , CAT , MAT , XAT , etc, they are exempted from appearing for LPUNEST for selective courses. Those who want to improve their scholarships can apply for the LPUNEST exam as well.

faqs.question: Is it expensive to study MBA at Lovely Professional University?

faqs.question: Will I get a direct admission in LPU with 65 % marks in Class 12?
faqs.answer: LPU does not offer direct admission. However, admission to few courses is merit-based.  Aspirants scoring a 65% aggregate have a good chance of getting admission in LPU. Candidates seeking admission must visit the official website of the university to apply online. To apply for LPU, aspirants need to register for LPUNEST for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate courses. LPU admission to most of the courses is based on LPUNEST score. However, national-level entrance exam scores are also accepted for admission to BA LLB (Hons), MBA, BTech, etc. Candidates must complete Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. The selection rounds are followed by counselling and document verification.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST 2025 exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST 2025 must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: What would be the fees if you take a direct admission in the LPU?
faqs.answer: The fee is same for regular and direct admission. LPU fees changes for every course. The top LPU courses along with fee details are mentioned below: Note: This information is gathered from official website and is subject to change.

faqs.question: Is LPUNEST required for LPU MCA admission?
faqs.answer: LPU accepts LPUNEST score for admission to MCA and MCA Hons courses. LPUNEST exam is conducted online every year for admission to MCA and other courses. The test is as an Entrance Test and Scholarship Test. Scholarship amount is determined by the marks and rank obtained by students in the exam. The exam duration is 2.5 hours. The test comprises 125 questions of 500 marks. Students also need to complete graduation to get admission to MCA.

faqs.question: What is LPU fees for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total fee for BTech is INR 4.5 lakh -INR 16 lakh. The fee is calculated based on the semester fee.  Admission to BTech course is based on LPUNEST or CUET UG score. After completion of the selection rounds, shortlisted aspirants need to pay the course fee to confirm their admission. Candidates are first required to register with an application fee for LPUNEST. The exam fee for LPUNEST is INR 1,000 for males and INR 500 for females.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in LPU for BTech without taking JEE Mains?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates seeking admission to LPU BTech course can also apply via LPUNEST. Apart from accepting a valid JEE Main entrance test score, LPU also conducts the Lovely Professional University National Entrance and Scholarship Test (LPUNEST) for BTech admission. The score of candidates must be equal or above precribed percentage in JEE for exemption from LPUNEST. For scores below the prescribed percentage, candidates will be required to appear for LPUNEST. Only after qualifying LPUNEST, candidates can get admission to the BTech course.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in LPU for BTech?
faqs.answer: LPU offers admission to BTech based on LPUNEST . Candidates apply for BTech CSE Software Product Engineering need to pass KQ test followed by a PI round. Additionally, candidates need to pass Class 12 in relevant subjects to apply for BTech course. After completion of the selection rounds, candidates need to pay a fee to confirm their seat.

faqs.question: Does LPU offer lateral entry to BTech course?
faqs.answer: LPU offers lateral entry to BTech course. faqs.answer:
Hi,In order to take admission in MBA the eligibility criteria needs to be met in LPU.The eligibility is 55% + LPUNEST/CAT/MAT/XAT/NMAT/CMAT+ Interview or Completed Company Secretary (CS) from Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) or Completed  Chartered Accountancy (CA) from Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) or Completed Cost & Management Accountancy (CMA) from Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICAI).Let me share with you interview competencies that are tested as part of MBA interviews in LPU.
The various parameters includes Fluency, Grammatical errors, elaboration of the concept, Clarity in thought process, Confidence, General Awareness, and leadership quality. 
In LPU when you sit for an MBA interview there are 2 panelists one from the core domain and the other from soft skills to assess you on speaking skills. Both the panelists will be rating you on the competency and a score will be generated. On the basis of the cut-off score only you will be considered as qualified or not.
Hence, whatever is the specialization that you are wishing to opt for the faculty of the core domain will be checking you on that and keeping in mind the above competencies stated. And Yes, you will be checked about the General Awareness so you need to keep yourself up to date. You will be asked questions related to your graduation degree and what made you go for MBA as well. So, kindly prepare the justification for that.
So, all the best. Stay confident and answer the questions logically keeping the above-stated factors in mind. As what questions will come your way depend upon the panelists but the factors on which you are going to be tested remain the same.

highlights.summary:
NIT Durgapur is a premium BTech institute which was recognised by the Act of Parliament and was thus, constructed in 1960. It has also been accredited by the NBA. The 14 departments of the institute award undergraduate, postgraduate and doctorate degrees in courses like BTech, MCA, MSc, MBA, MTech and PhD. The entrance-based admissions for NIT Durgapur are applicable for both undergraduate and postgraduate courses. The institute offers admission through national-level entrance exams and counselling only. According to the NIRF 2025, NIT Durgapur achieved 49th place for the Engineering category. In the 2023 NIT Durgapur placements, the average BTech package was 13.62 LPA and the highest was 70 LPA.
In addition, NIT Durgapur offers scholarships to deserving students as well. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life with strong extracurricular activities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 82 percent of students in my course got placed. The highest package reached 80 LPA, the average is around 12.6 LPA, and the lowest is near 3.6 LPA. Top recruiters include Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Deloitte, NVIDIA, PayPal, Infosys, Accenture, and Adani. About 60-70 percent of students secured internships, mainly in companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, and Wells Fargo. The most common roles offered are software development engineer (SDE), analyst, consultant, and core engineering roles, depending on the branch. Overall, placements are strong, with CSE and ECE achieving the best packages, and other branches steadily improving their placement records.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Durgapur offers modern infrastructure with smart classrooms. Wi-Fi-enabled labs, a central computer center, and a library with print and digital resources. The campus is 187 acres with advanced research facilities like Utkarsh Bhawan. Hostels provide basic furniture, LAN/Wi-Fi, and common areas. Newer hostels are better maintained, while older ones need renovation. Mess food is average, but canteens provide variety. Medical facilities include a 24/7 health unit with doctors, an ambulance, and a pharmacy. Sports facilities are very good. Along with fields for cricket, football, basketball, tennis, gyms, and indoor stadium access. They ensure academic, recreational, and healthcare needs are well supported.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at NIT Durgapur are well-qualified. Many holding PhDs and research experience. They are generally helpful and approachable. Teaching quality is considered good, blending theory with practical exposure, though some students feel pedagogy could be more industry-oriented. The curriculum is regularly updated, aligned with AICTE guidelines, and includes electives, labs, and projects that help build industry-relevant skills. Semester exams are moderately difficult, testing conceptual clarity rather than rote learning. With consistent preparation, most students perform well. The pass percentage remains high, often above 90 percent. It ensures that the majority of students successfully clear their courses and move towards placements.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in technology and its strong career prospects. The best things are the well-structured curriculum, hands-on labs, coding culture, and excellent placement opportunities. However, more industry-like projects, updated lab equipment, and increased research exposure would improve it further. NIT Durgapur has a vibrant campus life with fests like Aarohan Tech, Recstacy, cultural, and sports events. The campus crowd is diverse and energetic, with strong club and extracurricular activity participation. The institute offers good scholarships. It has decent connectivity to major cities, and a green, spacious campus that balances academics with recreation and overall growth.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Durgapur - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT has the best placements ever. So many students joined the B.Tech in mechanical course. The highest package is 1.6 crore per annum, and the lowest package is 42 LPA. Many top MNCs came to our college. So many students got internships at the start of the 3rd year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everyone knows that NIT college has the best infrastructure and placements. That is real, we have the best classrooms with AC. All labs are available. Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. We have a well-stocked library. We have so many canteens and a hospital.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-educated and knowledgeable. They are from NITs and IITs colleges. The mechanical engineering course curriculum is somewhat relevant to industry management. Semester exams are tough, so we have to study more than that.

reviews.review_title: Very satisfied with the college faculty, and there are good placements. Nice to be here.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am studying in 1st year, I haven't talked with our super seniors completely, but I asked once, and they told me that placements in our college in the last year were terrible compared to other years. The highest is 32 LPA, the lowest is 7 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. Top recruiters of our college are TCS, Wipro, Capgemini, Cognizant, and Axiom. Roles like software engineer, full-stack developer, data scientist, and AI engineer are offered in our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have no Wi-Fi, in addition, we have jammers to block the network. Labs are well-designed and maintained properly. Classrooms are good with projectors included, a clean board, and a nice air flow through windows. Very comfortable. The library is also good with books. They got more books than any college after Githam.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful to us, and they have nice qualifications and are very friendly when teaching us, and they also help us in lab practicals very well. Our course curriculum is fully relevant, and it does help in keeping students industry-ready. Semester exams are tough, but you could pass if you study well. I don't know about the pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course out of pure passion for being a chip designer, and the best thing about our course is the course itself. If the faculty of the 1st year goes easy on us in labs, then it would be a great help for us to improve. Events are indeed well-maintained, and I love the annual day.

reviews.review_title: Don't take civil in NIT DGP.

detailed_review.Placements: They provide very few placements for civil engineering. Accenture, Black Buck, and ZS are the only companies that come for SDE roles, and all are very small with fewer packages. Many companies only open to circuit branches like EE, ECE, and CSE, so if package does matter, you can choose this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is good, but no washing machines and no AC, that's it. Good water facility. There will be 3 MEM per room in the girls' hostel. I don't know about the boys' hostel. In classrooms, there will be AC and all, and the Wi-Fi is also very good; no need to worry about it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are now okay, but some professors are not good. There is some partiality towards locals, but still, some professors are really good and have good knowledge. Exams are also quite okay because there will be no stress due to the gap between exams and less syllabus.
detailed_review.Other: Don't join the civil. You can join circuit branches here.

clips.title: NIT Durgapur Infrastructure

sections.heading: Introduction
text: NIT Durgapur is a fully-funded premier Technological Institution of the Government of India and is administered by an autonomous Board of Governors.  The Institute is located about 160 km north-west of Kolkata on the Howrah-Delhi main railway route and overlooking the National Highway No. 2(the Great Grand Trunk Road). It offers excellent infrastructure facilities, including an academic block, a library, hostels, and much more. The Institute spreads over an area of 187 acres of land. It is fully residential and co-educational.

sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Campus Highlights
text: NIT Durgapur is one of the top-tier institutes in the country for engineering and other courses. The institute offers modern and well-maintained infrastructure to provide a healthy atmosphere to students. There are hostels for boys and girls, a well-stocked library, high-speed internet access, medical facilities and much more. Read further to get detailed information on the infrastructure facilities provided by the institute:
Campus Building:

tables.NIT Durgapur Campus Highlights: Smart Classrooms, Auditorium, Library, Sports Facilities, Internet Access, Medical Facilities, residential facilities and more

sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Academic and Research Facilities
text: NIT Durgapur provides excellent academic and research facilities to promote academic excellence. The classrooms are well-equipped with the latest technology to promote the easy flow of information. The institute has a Computer Centre that provides central computing facilities to the students, faculty members, and scholars. The centre has the necessary infrastructure, including a sufficient number of Computer Hardware, software, air-conditioned labs, and a stabilised, uninterrupted power supply. All these infrastructures are maintained from time to time. The institute also has a number of laboratories and smart classes . There is a large auditorium for holding events.

sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: NIT Durgapur offers hostel facilities for boys and girls. There are seven boys' hostels and two girls' hostels at the institute. About 2500 boys and 500 girls reside in these hostels at present. The names of these hostels are:

Students are offered shared rooms till the third year, and the single rooms are allocated in the final year. A single cot, a study table and a cupboard are provided to every student. There is access to clean water, electricity, LAN connectivity, laundry, medical facilities, library, gym, etc . There is a dining hall where meals are served. The food is usually prepared in the mess , which offers vegetarian as well as non-vegetarian options. The hostels have common rooms with recreational facilities such as television, indoor games, reading materials, etc. CCTV surveillance and security personnel are present, which offer round-the-clock security .

Along with hostel facilities, there is a guest house standing beside the Director's Bungalow. The guest house offers hospitality to the Official and Non-official guests of the Institute. It is a double-storied building with modern living facilities. The guests of faculty members and students are also accommodated there with an advance booking, subject to availability.
