sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Library
text: The library of NIT Durgapur was established in 1960. It acts as a central facility in supporting the study, teaching, research and development programmes of the institute. There is a separate building for the library with three floors on a plinth area of 1000 sq. metres . It has a collection of 1.7 lakh volumes of print books, including:
Along with this huge collection, the library has also subscribed to:

The library operations have been automated with the help of an integrated library software package, LIBSYS-10 . The database of books can be accessed through OPAC (Online Public Access Catalogue) . Circulation services are being carried out with the help of the Barcode System (Scanning) . The digital library has a good collection of electronic resources. To facilitate the free flow of information among users, the library has a Wi-Fi Internet facility inside it.

It is also an institutional One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) member, which offers 30 leading publishers' e-resources . As a member of e-Shodh Sindhu: Consortium for Higher Educational Electronics, it offers an Online e-Resource Requisition System . Moreover, it is also an institutional member of Shodhganga: a reservoir of Indian Theses @ INFLIBNET. Furthermore, it is a member of the National Digital Library of India (NDLI), which provides access to content from some leading publishers’ books to its members.

The library has a collection of several thousand E-Books on Computer Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Biochemistry, Genetics and Molecular Biology, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, etc., published by leading publishers.

sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Sports Facilities
text: NIT Durgapur offers sports facilities to promote holistic development and fitness among students. The institute organises various sporting events throughout the year, be it Intra NIT or the Inter NIT and the Inter University tournaments. There are excellent sports facilities as well as a gym for boys and girls with separate timings. There is a ‘Lords' Football stadium, the central Sports ground ‘Oval', where Volleyball courts with flood light facilities, a concrete cricket practice pitch, a concrete Basketball Court with flood light facilities, a concrete tennis court with flood light facilities, and concrete badminton courts with flood light facilities are built. Most of the halls of residence are equipped with Volleyball and concrete badminton courts, including Table Tennis and Carom board facilities. The games available at the institute include:

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around NIT Durgapur
text: NIT Durgapur is situated around many interesting places which can be visited by students during their free time. For instance, the Durgapur Barrage which is a major landmark offering scenic views and a place for recreation. Troika Park can be visited for boating and other water sports. Kumaramangalam Park is one of the largest parks in the area, featuring musical fountains and boating. For spiritual visits, students can explore Ram Mandir and Shiva Shakti Dham .

reviews.review_title: It offers good education and facilities. Placements are better for non-core roles.

detailed_review.Placements: 50-60 percent of students got placements in the civil course. The highest package offered last year was 19.90 LPA, and the lowest package was 4 LPA. The average package offered ranges from 6-7 LPA. The top recruiting companies in our course are L&T Construction, Tata Projects, NCC Limited, etc. 70-80 percent of students got internship opportunities. Top roles offered in our course are site engineer, design engineer, quality control engineer, planning engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. There is a civil lab in the department building and many classrooms. There is a central library which is open from 10 AM to 8 PM. The quality of facilities in our hostel is average, as there are few indoor games and an old building. The quality of the mess is not good in our hostel. The canteen facilities are good. Medical facilities in college are good as they provide the necessary medicine when needed. There are two grounds and many courts that cover almost all sports, and sports facilities are good with respect to other aspects.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Their teaching style is old school type. They come to class and give lectures for their respective time period and go. They do not cover doubt and carry all students. The course curriculum is relevant, and it prepares us for industrial material, and in labs, we will experience it. Semester exams are not as tough as the entrance paper. Almost all papers come from notes, so it will be easy to prepare. The minimum pass percentage is 33 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the civil engineering course because it allows me to create infrastructure that directly impacts people's lives. The best thing about this course is that we deal with real-life problems, such as how the building will be constructed, how the bridge will be constructed, and it will be very enjoyable. One thing I wish could be better about my course is to change people's perspectives about this course. They think that in this course, there is more hard work and less income, but this is not true. Many activities and many fests are organised on our campus every year.

reviews.review_title: My review about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: There is a placement cell which invites a lot of companies and firms for job opportunities. There are also opportunities for those who are willing to be an entrepreneur because students and the college also organize many times of hands-on workshops, research projects, and internships, as well as eminent scientists and professors talk to encourage students. So many companies come to recruit people. Internship fairs are organized by the placement cell of our college, and they recruit students from all courses. Packages vary from company to company, maximum being 12 LPA, and minimum 4 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure is different for different hostels. There are 9 hostels for boys in this college and 3 hostels for girls. Mess and canteens are present in every college and have a quite amount of seats, so every student can sit here at one time and eat. Bathrooms are present in sufficient amount. You don't need to take tension for infrastructure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly educated and experienced as well. There are a lot of senior faculty members. Junior faculty members have also joined in recent times. We like the teaching of some and don't like the teaching of some others, just like any other college. They are always there to clear any type of your doubt. They also motivate every student to do well. They are also carrying out their research work. Many have bagged prestigious awards for their research works. Exams are semester based, two semesters per year. Examination fees are also to be submitted online. The exams were taught also. The course curriculum is good in this college. We study different subjects every semester. We almost cover every part of Physics in the whole course. Practicals are the part we are even more serious about. We love that.

reviews.review_title: Fees are lower compared to other NITs.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement of our college is really amazing as compared to all the NITs in India. As this year is 2025, the highest placement stood at 96 LPA from the mechanical engineering department, which is really a great thing. Also, the average placement of our college is 13 LPA, which is really good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I really loved the playgrounds, as these are huge, and also the inter-branch competition, which is held every year, is very exciting. The hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is average but adjustable. There is 24/7 internet, no issue with that. The bathroom is well furnished, and housekeeping is really good. They come every morning and clean the staff. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open for 24 hours. There are many grounds for different sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very cooperative. Professors can speak fluent English, so there are no language barriers among students and faculty. They are well educated and well disciplined. The course curriculum is one of the best in the world, as there are many things that other colleges don't implement, but our college does. The world-class course curriculum is the reason for the success of many students who have studied here.

reviews.review_title: The college and the surroundings are also very good.

detailed_review.Placements: In the B.Tech Mechanical Engineering course, around 75–80 percent of students get placed in the latest placement drive. The highest package offered is around 18 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is nearly 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Tata Motors, Mahindra, L&T, JSW, Cummins, Vedanta, Infosys, Wipro, and TCS. Nearly 60 percent of students receive internships, with companies like Tata Steel, JSW, IOCL, HPCL, and L&T offering good opportunities. Top roles offered are Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET), Design Engineer, and Production Engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is beautiful, surrounded by greenery and lakes. This gives a calm and refreshing vibe even during stressful exam weeks. The infrastructure is pretty good. It includes well maintained hostels, labs, and sports facilities. The Wi-Fi sometimes tests your patience, but that is part of the fun here.
detailed_review.Faculty: In Mechanical Engineering, there are five teachers from the top 2% of the world who joined two months ago. The course curriculum is relevant, and we do labs that help us adapt to the industry. The exams for Mechanical Engineering students are very tough. We have to be able to handle complex computations on our own. Academically, the college provides a decent environment for learning. Some professors are truly inspiring and supportive. While others might make you question your life choices during lectures. Still, the overall academic culture encourages teamwork, innovation, and curiosity.
detailed_review.Other: Our batch is a mix of tech enthusiasts, gamers, and night owls. They somehow manage to finish assignments right before the deadline. We are balancing chain breaks with project submissions. It creates memories that last longer than our sleep schedules. NIT Silchar provides one of the most vibrant college experiences.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the placement record in the last 3 years.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am from the CSE batch, my college has a good placement record overall and a better one in the CSE branch. In my course, nearly 70 per cent were placed, and the highest package was 55 LPA in 2025 and an average package of over 15 LPA in CSE. Oracle, Tata, and Atlantis are top recruiters. Some students also got placed at Amazon and Microsoft. Over 40-50 per cent of students have internship opportunities. Data scientists and data engineers are the top roles offered during placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Silchar was built on a total of 625 acres. A nature-rich campus with more than 20 lakes and 2-3 gardens. Classrooms are digitalised. The infrastructure for the CSE course is good, labs are well managed, and a LAN (Ethernet) is provided to every hostel room. Hostel maintenance is above average, and there are 9 boys' hostels and 4 girls' hostels. Food quality is good, and our college has a good sports management team. We have a dispensary clinic in the college itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teacher is well qualified. They have good knowledge about the subject. They were helpful for exam purposes. Their notes were very valuable. NIT curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. Curriculum is improved according to upcoming technology changes. The semester exams' difficulty level is medium to hard. The pass percentage is 85-90 every semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had an interest from the beginning, and this college is good, especially in CSE. I wish there could be more change in the curriculum of 1st year students. Campus fests and events are good. We have a technical fest in the odd sem and a cultural fest in the even sem.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with staff members.

detailed_review.Placements: About 20% of students have been placed in this course. The highest package is 15 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are consulting firms like Deloitte, Accenture, and KPMG, as well as Google, Apple, and Microsoft. All the students got internships. Top roles offered are market analysis and financial advisory.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The university covers an area of 15 acres. The building is well-designed and maintained. The classrooms are designed with 4.0 teaching technology and also provide Wi-Fi facilities in every class and hall. The hostel also provides good facilities like fresh food, gym, Wi-Fi, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are supportive and qualified. The teaching quality is also good. The course curriculum is also relevant and makes the students ready to work in companies and industries. The semester exams are easy to pass, and the pass percentage is 40% in each subject.
detailed_review.Other: I opt for this course because I want to enhance my skills in marketing and chart analysis. The campus also organizes fests and extracurricular activities. The campus is crowded enough, and the surrounding is also a learning environment.

reviews.review_title: Good college as a NIT and good placement +.

detailed_review.Placements: In EE at NIT Silchar, around 87% of students got placed. The highest package this year is 44 LPA, offered by Amazon. While core placements are moderate, many students secured good roles in tech and software companies. EE graduates from NIT Silchar secure roles in power systems, embedded systems, automation, software development, data analysis, IT services, consulting, electronics design, and core electrical companies like L&T and Schneider.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Silchar EE department has decent labs and LAN access, but classrooms lack modern facilities, and teaching quality varies. However, hostel life is vibrant and enjoyable with good mess food, clean rooms, friendly environment, and making campus life memorable.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Silchar follows a semester system with continuous assessment through quizzes, mid and end-term exams. EE curriculum includes theory, labs, and projects. Teachers are knowledgeable but teaching quality varies across subjects. Relatively grading at NIT Silchar does exist, but its impact is limited some students report that although the institute uses relatively grading, the presence of high-performing peers (toppers) often makes the system functional similar to absolute grading. Here's how CGPA matters, to be eligible for branch change (if it's allowed), you generally need around 8.0+ CGPA, for popular branches like CSE/ECE, top students often score 8.8-9.1+.
detailed_review.Other: I chose EE at NIT Silchar for its core value, career scope, and NIT tag. Campus life is peaceful, and hostel life is enjoyable with LAN and friendly peers. Though academics can be tough and classrooms average. Overall, experience is enriching.

reviews.review_title: My review about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement opportunities at NIT Silchar are one of the best among the colleges in North East India. Though other NITs provide excellent placement and job opportunities, NIT Silchar lags behind because of its geographical constraints. The companies visiting the college also provide internship opportunities. Companies like Lupin and Ranbaxy come for recruitment with an average package of around 5 LPA to 6 LPA, and the highest package is 65 LPA. After M.Sc. in Chemistry, you are eligible for a job in any pharmaceutical industry. Just send them your resume, pass the interview, and job done.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College faculty is very good and interested in learning. The chemistry lab is also in campus, which is very clean, and there are many chemical products that help in learning more about it. Exams are also held on campus and are subjected to classes. There are 9 hostels for boys in this college and 3 hostels for girls. The hostel infrastructure is good. Mess facilities, TV room, sports room, and good spacious rooms are there. And it is also very cheap. There are single rooms, double rooms, and triple rooms. There are 10 hostels on our campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty of the college consists of Professors, Associate Professors, and Assistant Professors, with a minimum qualification of Ph.D. They are recruited after grounds of interview and are among the best in their field. The faculty of NIT Silchar is highly experienced, engaged in some good research work, and are student-friendly. They understand us. They always want to remain connected to students. Exams are held in semester system. Each semester is of six months. Exams are held twice in a year, and a project is given in the first three semesters to each student, which is guided by their faculty members.

reviews.review_title: My review about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: In terms of placement and job opportunities, we are ascending every year. Each year, we call around 150-200 companies to visit our campus. By the first half of the placement season, we managed to get around 60% of eligible candidates placed. Every year, we have some new companies added to our list of recruiters with some exciting offers, apart from our past recruiters. Some big companies like Brain and Company, Deloitte, KPMG, and Embibe have hired students from our college with an average package of 6 LPA to 8 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Course is pretty good and has a lot of focus on practical learning. Every semester, there are 2-3 laboratories of 2 credits each. The institute has taken many research initiatives and has a separate research and innovation cell for these activities. I have opted for and been allotted a hostel since the first year. I got a hostel room which was initially for PG students, so the rooms are great. I got a double room in the 1st year. The rooms and facilities are excellent. Mess food is compensable. The water supply is also perfect, and bathrooms and toilets are cleaned daily.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is very much qualified, 90% of professors, assistant professors, and associate professors are Ph.D. holders and have completed many research papers. They are well aware of the courses, and the course design is also very good. Every time I got study material easily. They are also very interactive; you can contact them anytime, anywhere. Overall, the teaching standard is good now. Faculty is helpful for every student in the issue of learning and they make us improve ourselves. The course duration is 2 years. Exams are conducted two times in a semester, and between those exams, there will be two minor class tests, mid-semister, class test, and end-semester exams.

reviews.review_title: My review of this college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement scenario is decent. More than 90% of students participating in the placement process get a job. It is specifically good for CSE students who landed multiple jobs with good packages. Major recruiters are Goldman Sachs, Medlife, Microsoft, Mu Sigma, Deloitte, John Dheere, Maruti Suzuki, Tata Motors, ABB, LNT, and various PSUs. The TNP cell of the college provides summer internships for 1-2 month duration. Mostly, internships are in PSUs and some companies like Tata. Stipend internships are given only to CSE students. But we can apply ourselves for internships with a stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I have opted for a hostel which is compulsory in our college. I share my hostel room with a fellow colleague of mine. Rooms are quiet with a 24-hour electricity supply. There is a bed, a table, a chair, a wardrobe, and a balcony in the room. The lighting condition is also quite good. The hostel rent is Rs. 15,000 per semester.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and helpful. They are very knowledgeable and everyone did their PhD in their respective fields. They explain our doubts clearly. They explain everything and we can ask them any question without any fear. They are very friendly. There are two major exams in a semester. One is mid-semester carrying 30 marks and one end-semester carrying 50 marks. The rest 20 marks are internal out of which 10 are given on a class test and the rest 10 on assignments and attendance. Exam pressure is really not a lot. The course curriculum is good as it gives us a chance to know our interests if we have not known them yet. The first-year course contains all subjects like civil, mechanical, CS electrical, and electronics.

reviews.review_title: Placement and college life of NIT Silchar.

detailed_review.Placements: The top 20 students in civil engineering are selected for placement at L&T; however, due to Covid, only about 4 to 5 have been placed. Most students from all engineering branches secure positions in their respective fields, but only a few reputable IT companies participate in the placement process and recruit candidates.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Silchar has the largest library in Asia, and the classrooms and labs are being modernized. The Wi-Fi speed is quite good in all academic areas, although it only works in the hostel lanes. The classrooms are in a very peaceful location where students enjoy studying and exploring.
detailed_review.Faculty: Civil Engineering has the top facilities in terms of knowledge and experience in theoretical and practical as well. I just enjoyed the whole classes of civil engineering. Practice like surveying and soil-related are very knowledgeable and helpful in higher studies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Silchar is good in placements and campus life. City life is poor, that's all.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, in which about 90% of students are getting placed with an average package of 15 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. The highest package is 60 LPA, and the lowest package is 7 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities of the hostel and the infrastructure of the Electronics and Instrumentation branch are very good, even EI is known as the coolest branch of NIT Silchar. The food quality of the hostel is above average.  Canteen is good but a little bit cheaper, and vegetarians may face problems.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at the National Institute of Technology are good. They are highly qualified and knowledgeable, few faculties are among the top 2% of scientists. The course curriculum is fantastic, but the semesters are a little bit tougher than other colleges, but overall good.
detailed_review.Other: NIT Silchar is heaven on earth.

reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 55-65, students got placed in civil engineering. The highest package was around 15 LPA in civil engineering the lowest was around 5-6 LPA and the average was 7-8 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Flipkart and Amazon for supply chain management. Around 30-40% of students got internships either on-campus and off -campus. The top roles offered were the site engineer and the management job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The quality is not top-notch but the basic facilities like clean drinking water clean washrooms and a bathroom are available, the food qualities are not too bad it can fill your stomach for the 3 times of the day and the snacks are available the canteen foods are good. For the medical facilities. We have a dispensary where basic medicine is available and for the sports. We have football and cricket grounds for the outdoor games and for the indoor games, we have a sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable but some are a little rude. The teaching qualities varies teacher to teacher but overall it a good. Yes, the course curriculum is relevant and helpful in the student industry. The semester exams are not that tough, a student can pass by studying one night before the exam. The pass percentage is around 85%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am interested in learning more and more about the buildings. How they are built. The best thing is we can put it in our day-to-day life. I would suggest that more technical instruments should be available in the college for better learning. The events, fest, and campus crowd all are so supportive and good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: Decent placement ratio in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: 60+ out of 84 students from my branch are in the 2025 passing batch. The highest package this year was 44 LPA for the 2021-2025 batch. The average package is above 13 LPA, which is average. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Swiggy, and Microsoft. The ratio of placement for mechanical engineering students has increased, and the scene has gotten better.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All classes are digital classrooms. Labs are decent. My department is very good, with enough instruments available for experiments. The Wi-Fi provided by the library is good. However, we have LAN in the hostel, and we don't have a Wi-Fi connection. The mess food is average. There is a medical dispensary right next to the girls' hostel. The sports facilities are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and very knowledgeable. It is good to be in contact with them for greater insight into career options. The teaching quality is above average. Some teachers are surely not good. They just don't put effort into teaching, but the rest are excellent. My course prepares students for both teaching and core placements as it provides opportunities for both. Semester exams are not too tough to pass, but they need a good amount of preparation to pass the subject. The pass percentage is more than 90% for my branch.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it provides me with core and teaching opportunities. It is easy, and I can explore a lot here because it is still growing. It would be better if the course could be a little updated. Events and fests keep taking place all year round. But this year, our annual fest was not good. Connectivity is not that good. It is an open campus.

reviews.review_title: This is my short review of my campus, NIT Silchar.

detailed_review.Placements: Good placements are given for all the branches with increasing average LPA every year. You need to maintain a minimum of 7 GPA to sit for placements and even to do an internship. The world’s top companies come to recruit students. Mechanical students get an average package of 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: They provide excellent Wi-Fi, lab, and classroom facilities along with good freedom, but hostels are a bit average. Hostels are built like those from the 80s and 90s, which makes your room feel old. Until the fourth year, you don’t get any privacy in your room as only triple-sharing rooms are allotted.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and kind and give their best in teaching. Semester exams are a bit moderate, but you have very little time to study. They give very less time for exams to complete, which affects people who have studied but haven’t revised multiple times.
detailed_review.Other: Try to enjoy on campus. Be enthusiastic and participate in all the events.

reviews.review_title: Not my dream IIT but my reality - My NIT Silchar.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the mechanical branch, and my course will be completed in 2027. This year (2025), around 92% mechanical students got placed in NIT Silchar. The lowest package is around 5 LPA, and the highest package is 56 LPA. The average package offered is around 11 LPA. Many core companies are top recruiters. Top roles offered are in the research field as well as management.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are generally basic in the old gallery in which upto 2 years your classes will occur after which 3rd year onwards, your classes will occur in new gallery. There are cool classes compared to old gallery. Wi-Fi is not available everywhere but LAN services are quite good. Labs are also well-maintained. Not too big but we have Asia's biggest digital library but to be frank, it is just like an ordinary library. Hostel facilities are quite good. Food is also good enough. But it will vary according to different hostels. We have facilities for almost all sports and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are more than qualified in my college. Many of them come with a vast understanding of the subject they are teaching. But on the contrary, when you are in college, it doesn't matter how good teacher is, you are going to study from YouTube only. But still, the curriculum of our college is one of the toughest, and it has a big practical development also. I don't say you can become industrial-ready just by that. But it can become a stepping stone. Exams are very difficult, to be honest.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical because of my big brother who is already a mechanical engineer from IIT and is currently working at Walmart. I wish there were less language barriers in my college because of 50% home quota. Many students seek Assamese which to be fair, is a very beautiful language, but I have no understanding of it. Events and fests are few things to look for in my college as they are generally great. Many international artists also came to perform in it.

reviews.review_title: NIT Silchar campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are quite good in this college as many companies like Google, Wipro, Microsoft, Tata, Amazon, Deloitte, etc. Companies are offering placements with good packages with an average package of 10 lacs for the students trying for campus placements in the campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is not so good as the rooms are maintained by ourselves. The building is very old which is from the 1960s the playground, classrooms, and library are good. Especially the library which is 2nd the largest library in Asia and ethernet is provided which is helpful.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is so good on our campus. Many clubs are there like for cultural activities and education purposes technical clubs. We can be part of any clubs and the teachers are good but not so great as some of them teach well and some don't do those.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are quite good here like technical fests and cultural fests.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is good. Connectivity to the city is not so good. All other things are good.

detailed_review.Placements: Electronics and instrumentation branch is a very chill branch. Professors are good and seniors are very helpful and active in this branch. Famous recruiters are Oracle, Flipkart, and Atlassian. 90% of students got placed. The median salary is 14 LPA. The average salary is 23 LPA. The highest salary is around 53 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is not as good as I expected. But the college is full of greenery. We get the best hostel for the first year separately. Cleanliness is good, but hostel food is the worst. For pure veggies, it is not easy to survive, mostly paneer is given at dinner.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Silchar is a very active college. All sports activities are here. You will definitely get the extra edge in other curriculum.
detailed_review.Other: College fests are best. Many popular artists visit here like Monali Thakur. Since it is located in North East, you will get to know about North East culture. But during Holi and Diwali, you will just get 1 day of holiday for Diwali. There are also so many clubs, you can join like Obettivo for photography, Sympho for arts and literature, Needs for robotics, ML club, and so many.

reviews.review_title: The college kid who is okay.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are pretty average. The highest package is upto 60 LPA. The average salary ranges from 15 LPA - 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Indian Oil and tech companies from Bangalore. Most of the students get their internships in their 3rd year of B.Tech.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have Asia's biggest digital library which offers pretty much exposure to the course. Classrooms and hostel are average, you can say. All of the classrooms are not fully equipped or the maintenance is very poor. The food in the hostel is replaceable, if everyone votes if they do not like it then it can be changed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are very well-educated and have many degrees. But only 50% of them know how to teach properly. Otherwise, we find YouTube helpful in that case. The semester exams are up to the mark. All the students start sitting at their tables 1-2 weeks before the exams.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is amazing. We have a lush green campus that is full of life. The student community makes sure that there is an event every week so that no one gets bored of the daily routine of our life. The college fests are the most enjoyable days. There is one fest in every semester. In the odd semester, there is a fest called Techno and in even semester there is a fest called Incandescence.

reviews.review_title: My college experience as a student.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate at the National Institute of Technology Silchar in 2024 is around 77.5%. The highest package is 52.89 LPA, and the average package is around 13.34 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Dalmia Cement, PSUs, etc. The minimum salary range at NIT Silchar is 5–6.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is equipped with well-equipped laboratories, a central library, and LAN facilities in hostels. A healthcare centre is also available on campus. Most hostels have their own canteens. Our college has a football ground, a cricket ground, and many spaces for playing different games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of NIT Silchar are highly qualified. The curriculum includes lectures, tutorials, practicals, assignments, and project work. Exams such as class tests, minors, mid-sems, and end-sems are conducted. The semester exams are very tough, and most of questions come from faculty’s notes.

faqs.question: How to get a seat at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: As NIT Silchar admission is entrance-based. Admission to its flagship programme i.e. BTech is based on JEE Main scores of the candidates. Further, aspirants are allotted seats via JoSAA Counselling. For admission to MTech and MBA programmes, candidates must have a valid score in GATE and MAT/ GMAT/ CAT/ CMAT, respectively. The selection for MSc programme is based on IIT JAM scores of the candidates.

faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: IIIT Allahabad accpets JEE Main score for admission to the BTech courses. As per the IIIT Allahabad cutoff 2023, the Last Round closing rank for BTech ranged between 5924 and 9558 , among which Information Technology was the most competitive specialisation. The Round 1 closing rank for BTech ranged between 4817 and 8428 for BTech. So, considering the previous year Round 1 and the Last Round closing ranks, candidates seeking admission to IIIT Allahabad must secure a rank over and above 4800 and 9600 for the General ALL India category candidates. faqs.question: What are the important dates for MBA admission at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for MBA admission at NIT Silchar typicall falls in March. In 2024, the last date to apply for admission was March 31,  2024. The online application started in December 2023. The last date to submit the registration fee for selected candidates was May 5,  2024. Applicants must also keep in mind the deadlines for CAT/MAT/CMAT application.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the fees for B.Tech course at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: The fees for BTech course at NIT Silchar is INR 5 lakh . The duration of the course is for 2 years. The eligibility for NIT Silchar BTech admissions is that candidates need to fulfil 75% aggregate in Class 12. The entrance exams accepted include JEE Main Entrance Exam.

faqs.question: Is BTech admission at NIT Silchar entrance-based?
faqs.answer: Yes, admissions to the BTech programme offered at National Institute of Technology, (NIT) Silchar is entrance-based. Students seeking admission to the programme are required to clear the national-level entrance tests such as JEE Main and subsequently participate in DASA UG counselling for seat allotment. Students who have cleared Class 12 or its equivalent from a recognised board with a minimum aggregate of 75% can apply for BTech at NIT Silchar . However, the selection and admission will be done on entrance basis only .

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to M.Tech at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to be graduated with minimum 60% aggregate with BE/BTech from a recognised University to apply for MTech at NIT Silchar. The university from which the candidate obtained their UG degree must be recognised by the government or an appropriate regulatory body.

faqs.question: How much GATE score is required for NIT Silchar M.Tech admission?
faqs.answer: GATE CCMT R1 has been released for admission to the M.Tech courses. Candidates seeking admission to the NIT Silchar M.Tech course must secure a rank between 353 and 438 under the first cutoff list for the General category students. Specialisation-wise Round 1 cutoffs are given below for NIT Silchar:

faqs.question: How to get admission in an MBA programme at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: Those looking to get MBA admission at NIT Silchar need to fulfil the basic eligibility criteria of passing Graduation with a minimum aggregate of 60% from a recognised board. Eligible students need to appear for entrance tests such as CAT, CMAT, etc. Those who have scored a valid score in the entrance-test can visit the official website of NIT Silchar to apply for the programme by filling out the application form and paying the application fee. The institute will shortlist the candidates, who in turn will have to pay the course fee to secure the admission.

faqs.question: What are the entrance exams accepted by NIT Silchar for an MBA programme?
faqs.answer: NIT Silchar accepts various national-level entrance exams for admission to the MBA programme. The institute accepts valid score obtained by the students in exams such as CAT, CMAT, and MAT. Students who have cleared the cut-off released by the institute for the course can visit the official website of National Institute of Technology (NIT) Silchar to apply for the course online. Know more about preparation tips for CAT.

faqs.question: Does NIT Silchar provide MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, the National Institute of Technology (NIT), Silchar offers a Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme. The MBA programme at NIT Silchar is a two-year full-time course and the total tuition fee for the programme is INR 1.60 lakh. To be considered for admission to the MBA programme at NIT Silchar the candidates have to qualify for MAT , CAT or CMAT .

faqs.answer: In order to get admission to BTech course at NIT Silchar, students need to first appear for the JEE main exam and then fill out an online application form on the institute's official website. The final selection is done basis on the JoSAA Counselling.

faqs.question: How do I apply for NIT Silchar admissions?
faqs.answer: Admission to all NIT Silchar courses (UG, PG, integrated, Diploma and others) is entirely entrance-based. For NIT Silchar admission, students need valid scores in the respective entrance exams. Visit the official website of NIT Silchar and fill out the application form, upload the required documents and pay the application fees. For admission to courses such as BTech, MTech, and MSc. Aspirants need to complete the application procedure of the accepted national-level exam. Find below some details on the exams application procedure:

faqs.question: How to register for CCMT Counselling?
faqs.answer: CCMT Counselling registration process is conducted in an online mode. Candidates have to register for the counselling process by filling their name and GATE related details such as year of exam, registration ID, exam paper and score to generate the login details. Check below detailed step to apply for CCMT Counselling process: Category Registration Fee General or Open Category (OC) Rs 3,000 Other Backward Class (OBC) Rs 3,000 SC/ST/PwD Rs 2,500 Step 6 - Choice Filling and Locking: Candidates have to select their choice of colleges and courses during the allotted time. Change, re-order and deletion of choices could be done within the choice-filling period. Candidates must fill the choice in the order of their preference. Editing of selected choices cannot be done after locking. A printout of the filled choices must be taken for future reference.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: NIT Silchar MBA fee is INR 1.6 Lacs for two years. Additionally, candidates must pay a one-time fee at the time of admission. The amount of the one-time fee is INR 6,000. Students seeking hostel facility at the campus have to pay a hostel fee ranging from INR 52,520 to INR 1 Lakh. The mentioned fees have been sourced from the official website of the institute/sanctioning body. They are still subject to change and hence, are indicative.

faqs.question: How to apply for BTech at NIT Silchar?
faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology Silchar application process begins with an online application. The collection in the library includes 96683 books, 114 Print Journals, 5468 Bound Volumes, 4297 CD-ROMs, 17 Databases, 909 Videos, 8627 ISI Code (Printed), 9235 Book Bank (General), 8180 Book Bank (SC/ST), 152 IRC Codes, 92 Thesis, 425 Dissertation. It also has the facility of Web OPAC (Search Library Catalogue) and has digital Library. NIT Silchar library has signed MoU with the University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign, USA.

highlights.summary:
BIT Mesra was established in 1955, and is a deemed university located in Ranchi. It is recognised by UGC, approved by AICTE, and is NIRF-ranked. In 2024 NIRF-ranking, it was ranked 82nd under the University category, 20th under the Architecture and Planning category, and 48th under the Engineering category. Birla Institute of Technology Mesra is accredited with A Grade by NAAC. Through various departments, the University offers UG, PG, PhD, and other courses to students. These courses are provided across Architecture, Engineering, and various other streams.
Birla Institute of Technology Ranchi students also get placement assistance. Some of the top companies that visited the University during the placement drive are Tech Mahindra, Tata Motors, Tata Power, TCE, TCS, and others. BIT Mesra Ranchi has a state-of-the-art infrastructure and provides various facilities for students, such as hostels, computer labs, smart classrooms and many more. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied and value for money.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage in our college is about 60–70 percent, with the highest package of 35 LPA, average package of 11 LPA, median package of 12 LPA, top recruiters are Infosys, Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, Nvidia, TCS, Mahendra, etc., and the top roles offered in our college are mostly tech-oriented and core-based.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities provided are as follows: 5G Wi-Fi available 24/7, classroom projectors with centralized air conditioning, a very large library with all types of books available, hostel mess food above average, and night canteen available in each hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very helpful and deliver quality education, most of them are Ph.D. qualified, the course curriculum feels quite old, and in our college three types of exams are conducted, mid-semester, end-semester, and quiz, with a pass percentage above 5 CGPA.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Strong academics with qualified faculty and industry relevant curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: This time, only 40 percent of students placed but placement is still going. In the previous year the highest package offered is 1.45 cr, I heard only 33LPA, average package this time is 8 to 9LPA. The lowest package offered is  3 to 4 LPA for CSE at Deloitte, Microsoft, and TCS. 30 to 35 internships overall across campuses.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in hostel, in the classroom campus, and there is a weak network in library. Classrooms are well. Hostel rooms are small for two people, food quality is 7/10, and a night canteen is available. Medical, there is a dispensary but for minimal treatment, sports and games are not so good but not bad, basically all things are present.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are well qualified, helpful in nature. Except for the CSE, other branches students are not industry ready but they can level up their skills by working with professionals. Not that much pressure in 1 st year but be ready for 2nd year and 3 rd year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life is so cool. It's better than low-level IIITs and NITs.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college branch, Electronics and Communication Engineering, offered 24 LPA as the maximum package to a student. 2–3 students are chosen for internships in the companies. Our TNP cell is responsible for the issue of placements. They have given everything on their website.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A total of 13 hostels are there (2 for girls, 4 for freshers, 2 for 2nd year, 2 for 3rd year, 2 for 4th year, 1 for 5th year). I'm talking about my hostel (H4), it is the best hostel out of 4. Its food is so delightful that students from other hostels come here to eat, even seniors. Each hostel has 143–150 rooms, accommodating 2 students in each room. There are 8 wings and 8 washrooms (every washroom has 4 bathrooms, 3 English seats, 2 Hindi seats, and 4 toilet ports). Each room has Wi-Fi, so connectivity is good. Our hostel warden is the best.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified, most of them are from IITs, and knowledgeable too. In our teachers, one is from MIT (not Manipal Institute, he is from MIT USA). New teachers are very good, friendly, and lovely in nature. The Physics department contains the most difficult ones. Overall, they make our exams end in 5 days only. It's very good, we don't have to wait for weeks for exams to end.
detailed_review.Other: You can come to the college, just look at your pockets for money. My pockets are not allowing me to go for this highly paid institute, but my father is somehow managing, not that much. I have to focus to make it value for the money.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Campus life is good here if you have friends.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a fresher, so I do not know much about placements, but if you work hard and focus on what you really want, you surely will get a good placement. I think the average for ECE this year is around 16 to 17 LPA, and the highest package is 60 LPA something.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are clean, but the rooms are small for two people. The mess food is okay, not so good, not so bad. The vibes in the hostel are so good, you are really gonna love it. Washrooms are clean but not in that good condition. Geysers work in all the washrooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful if you maintain discipline in class. They also help you with attendance. Some professors are kind of strict, so be aware of them. They are experienced and focused in class, and you do not have to study at the last minute. Lab professors are not that good here.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because I have interest in core and BIT. The core is good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life at BIT Mesra, BIT Hub.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement for this batch is going well, just as good as it goes for the previous batch. Renowned companies visit the campus for both circuital and non-circuital placements, including De Shaw, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, NatWest, Flipkart, ZS, Cisco, Visa, UKG, Razorpay, Warner Bros, Paytm, Uber, Walmart, Oracle, etc. Students get commendable placements and internships based on their hard work and resumes. Some students also crack off-campus placements. In the previous batch, the highest package received is 1.45 crore at Rubrik with an average of 11 LPA. Over 200 recruiters make 1080 offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is huge and spacious with a comfortable arena comprising cafes, shops, and food trucks. The campus has 13 hostels, 2 for girls and the rest for boys. The quality of the mess food varies, from delicious on some days to average on others. The sports complex is well-constructed, large, and includes various sports grounds, including a cricket oval. Gyms are also provided. The campus has an in-built dispensary with 24/7 medical assistance and ambulance facilities. Campus Wi-Fi is available 24/7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is quite supportive and friendly. The professors are knowledgeable, approachable, informative, and provide vast professional opportunities. Seniors are helpful too, guiding us throughout. There are different machines, labs, and research and development buildings. We have mid-semester exams of 25 marks and end-of-semester exams of 25 marks. The rest is evaluated based on quizzes of 10 marks each and assignments. Lab marks are evaluated based on lab performance, lab viva, and lab quizzes. The overall pass percentage is around 40. Maintaining 75 percent attendance is mandatory.
detailed_review.Other: Maybe the overall maintenance of the infrastructure could be improved, but our college does regular work on it. We have a cultural fest, BITOTSAV, and a tech fest, Pantheon. BITOTSAV is a four-day event with heritage night, cultural evening, cool mornings, and fantastic afternoons, and it ends with an amazing and electrifying concert. The tech fest combines cultural evenings, performances, events, and hackathons with DJ nights. Scholarships are also provided based on CG.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college is very good. You will enjoy the college. It has very good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: College has very good placements. Almost every student gets placed. In my course, everyone gets placed at the end. The top company, Microsoft, also come. Job profiles are mostly in tech jobs, with very few jobs in the core sector. Internship is gained by almost 10 percent, which is very low.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has very good infrastructure. All facilities like Wi-Fi, classrooms with digital electronics and computers, and well-equipped labs are available. The classrooms are spacious with proper seating. The college has a very big library for studying. There are multiple mess facilities and canteens on the campus. Hospital is also available within the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful. Infact, they all are holding masters and are Ph.D. qualified. The quality of teaching is good, but not at top level. The course curriculum is relevant and it makes students industry-ready. Most students get pass in the semester exams

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Mediocre college, but expensive.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentages are being regraded at my college. The average package is around 13 LPA. The highest package in my branch is 58 LPA. Around 60 percent of students are placed. College do provide good internship opportunities, but there is heavy competition in that. Most students go for off-campus internships. Core companies like NXP provide FTE. A lot of students go for tech roles too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Some labs are modernized, while some are not. Classrooms have ACs, though there may be power cuts. The library is decent. Hostel rooms are tiny for double sharing. The hostel floor is just bearable. A dispensary is available, which gives us free medical care. A huge sports complex with almost all sports equipment is present.
detailed_review.Faculty: Curriculum is regularly revised. Most faculty members are good in terms of behavior and knowledge. Semester exams have no gap, therefore making it a hectic week. Two quizzes take place between mid-semester and end-semester because of the grading, things are now bearable.
detailed_review.Other: Our main event is Bitotsav. Other than that, we have a tech event Pantheon.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: BIT, Mesra, unbiased review.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent, comparable to tier 2 NIT. Overall, the college is able to get good companies on campus, and the coding culture is good, so you would be able to get a good placement if you work hard. Placement of CSE, ECE, and AIML is best among all branches. There are lots of clubs that help in improving personality. The max package was around 1.2 crores, and the average is 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite decent, like hostels are okay, not like something fancy modern build, but decent enough to live in, and the weather here is the best. Ranchi, as a city, would never disappoint you. You have one bed, a table, and LAN facilities only in the hostel. Mess food is best compared to any college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Overall, the teacher is qualified, and the best part is that you will get plenty of time during summer and winter break to do whatever you want to improve your skills. Semester exams are decently difficult, not that easy, not that hard. Getting 7 is easier than NITs.
detailed_review.Other: If you are getting CSE, ECE, or AIML, then go for it and for the rest of the branch, if you are from an above-average middle-class family, you can consider.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Mathematics and Computing
reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied with some faculty, average placement in 2024.

detailed_review.Placements: Average, but IMSC students' placement is not described in their brochure properly, so I can't say anything about it, although you can do well if you work hard. The rest of the course is good, including both the technical skills and mathematics in depth, and a little bit of Physics and Chemistry for the first 2 years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Average, like it's decent in the 1st year, but with the upcoming years, you have to change hostels every year, and it'll get worse one by one. Rooms are very small, and for 2 students, there's only 1 table and chair. Wi-Fi doesn't work properly and many sites are banned.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some are good, but some are the worst case, some are too irritating, like they have no common sense and don't understand students' feeling. They don't support students, as their only motive for them is attendance and attendance only. One of the female teachers of the MnC department is very strict with students who lick her feet.
detailed_review.Other: It's a good course, the only drawback is that it's not a B.Tech course.

reviews.review_title: The college has good placements but high fees. If you can afford it, you can go for this.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements were quite good in 2024. The mechanical engineering program got a placement rate of 85 percent with an average package of 10 LPA. There is also good scope in the non-core field. Many students got placed in the non-core field. Seniors are helpful. You can definitely ask them for guidance.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is decent. We got a double-sharing room, but the room is a little small. The college has a table tennis room, a TV room, and an area where we can play badminton/volleyball. There are many food stalls on campus. The classroom is decent. There is a sports complex where you can play most of the games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable for sure, but some of them are not quite helpful, but some really are. Exams are strict. The course curriculum is quite similar to that of other colleges. In the first year, all branches have a common syllabus. Labs are strict, and there is a 75 percent criterion.

reviews.review_title: It's okay because course is good. College is well reputed but since fee is high it can be better.

detailed_review.Placements: For MNC median package is about 8 LPA - 9 LPA (excluding off-campus). This year average is around 14 LPA. The median package for off-campus would be around 11 LPA. Some of the companies do discriminate M.Sc.  students (about 40%) but at the end it's all about the skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is full Wi-Fi facility on campus. You will get high-speed Wi-Fi in whole campus. You can't access games and pirated websites through this. Labs are also fully equipped. We have lots of space since batch strength is only 65 to 70. Classrooms are also good, with full air conditioning. The central library is the basic place for any student of BIT. This contains 2 floors which the ground floor meant for reading magazines of different kinds, newspapers, and old books. Books can be borrowed here using library card.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are helpful. All have done their Ph.D. and are knowledgeable. About their teacher, you cannot solely depend on the lectures of teachers, you have to study by yourself. I think 1 semester course is not that much relevant since it teaches chemistry and some other stuff. Semester exams here are not so tough. You can pass by study one night before. Pass percentage is around 80 percent.
detailed_review.Other: If you are interested in math then only take this branch because this branch contains so much mathematics. College life is decent to be honest. It has big and green campus (gets better the more you explore it). Everyday some or other events are happening so you will not get bored here. Fest is cool. My first fest experience was hampered by rain but what I could experience was dope night. It was fun college life so I would give an award.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the course and the university.

detailed_review.Placements: 75% of students got placed with the highest package of 15 LPA, and the lowest 5 LPA. The company that paid the highest package is IDBI Bank, offering 60% internships on campus to the students. The roles offered are analyst, consumer relationship, and management trainee, with around 64 to 80 companies visiting the campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good faculty members, food, and hostels are very good with good Wi-Fi, 24/7 electricity, and have good student interaction and various faculty members like spots complex and many inter-college interactions happen, overall good environment to grow.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good, supportive, and well-qualified to guide with a relevant curriculum and have industry visits. The pass percentage is 50%. Exams are not that tough if you are attentive in class, everything is being covered, and professors are very helpful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Infrastructure is great except for the hostel and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly all get placed at the end. The highest package is 52 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. Top recruiters are Oracle and Microsoft. You will also get an internship. Many got placed at Google as a Software Engineer, many got placed at Amazon, and those are the topmost. The alumni network is also good, so in the end, everyone got placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has great infrastructure except for the hostel. Great campus life with 780 AC and all sports facilities except swimming, and all rooms have Wi-Fi facilities. The food quality is good. There is also a night canteen, and you can buy anything on campus. There is also Domino's on the campus, where you can order online.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are qualified and very good. They also solve all doubts. You can issue any book from the library. It's very easy. If you study well in the last week before the exam, you will pass. The curriculum of this college is very good. The college itself changes its curriculum every 5 years.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a very good college if you are not getting into NIT.

detailed_review.Placements: In my branch, ECE, most of the companies allow students to sit. The maximum percentage of the class is placed in the IT sector. Suppose there are 100 students, then 80 students go to the IT sector. On campus, the placement percentage is around 60 to 70%. In the end, everybody gets placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are small in size. In college, labs and classes are very good. Classes have AC and good infrastructure. Labs are well-equipped. There is also a facility for every sport like cricket, badminton, and table tennis; there’s also a gym. All the rooms have Wi-Fi facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: ECE is the second toughest branch in the B.Tech, so it is tough. If you contact seniors, it will be very easy since they provide notes. You have to study for at least 2 to 3 days before the examination, and you should contact those students who prepare proper notes; then it is very easy to score.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college with excellent faculty and an average placement rate.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in BIT Mesra are very non-consistent. Top branches like computer science, electronics, and communication engineering experience 60-80% placements. Low branches like civil, mechanical, and chemical have less than 30% placement rate. The top package offered is 83 LPA, and the lowest package ranges from 3-4 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel could be better as a lot of things can be improved, like room conditions, internet facilities, food, and mess services. But overall, hostels are on par with other government and semi-private institutions. As far as extracurricular activities are concerned, our college has a very good sports complex which provides competent equipment for high-level sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. A majority of them hold integrated or separate master's, bachelor's, and doctoral degrees. They are super helpful, and they are willing to help students beyond classrooms to teach them real industry-related concepts. Exams are very easy to clear and proceed as Bit Mesra offers 2 quizzes (10 marks each), 1 mid-semester exam (25 marks), and 1 end-semester examination (50 marks) for each subject.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because BIT Mesra is one of the most premier engineering institutions in India, offering highly acclaimed theory and practical teaching. Regular fests and events are organised to teach students responsibilities about real-life scenarios. It has excellent campus life to help students bring out the best in themselves.

reviews.review_title: Our university has cafeterias, shopping complex, sports complex, and diversity of students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college committee uses most of the money in their pockets. Full corruption is going on.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement states are good for the circuital branch and mechanical branch but other non-circuital branch suffers. In 2024, the highest package offered on campus is approximately 62 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has a good hostel and a nice infrastructure. It maintains hygiene and everything is managed and checked by students. It has a nice environment to study. Wi-Fi is available. It has nice labs and large air-conditioning classrooms. It has a large sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is not relevant at all and they don't focus on modern technology. The old-school methodology is still being followed here. BIT cannot give us placements, and it can only provide us with contacts. Semester exams are very difficult. The relative grading helps to get the bare minimum marks for passing. Faculty members are supportive. It has a huge number of staff members.

admission.title: BIT Mesra Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: BIT Mesra admission 2025 is ongoing. The institute accepts scores in JEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, CAT, NEET-UG, etc. BIT Mesra offers a list of courses at the UG, PG and doctoral levels. Some of the popular courses of the institute are BTech, MBA, MCA, MSc, etc. Candidates can apply online for the preferred course.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at BIT Mesra in a MSc course without IIT JAM/CUET score?
faqs.answer: Yes, the institute may admit candidates without a valid IIT JAM/CUET score directly. However, this is subject to the availability of seats. faqs.question: Is CAT required for admission at BIT Mesra?
faqs.answer: Birla Institute of Technology Mesra considers CAT score for admission to MBA programme. However, it is not compulsory for the aspirants to have a valid CAT score. Aspirants can also get admission through MAT, XAT or CMAT scores. Selected candidates have to further pass the group discussion and personal interview round for final selection.

faqs.question: What are the top courses offered at BIT Mesra?
faqs.answer: BIT Mesra offers nearly 12 courses at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. The offered courses are BTech, BArch, B.Pharmacy and BHMCT at the undergraduate level and MTech, MPharm, MBA, MCA and MSc courses at the postgraduate level. Apart from this, it also offers PhD courses at the doctoral level. Additionally, the courses are offered in the streams of Engineering, Architecture & Planning, Banking, Finance & Insurance, etc. All the courses are offered in a full-time mode. Eligible candidates can visit the institute’s official website (bitmesra.ac.in) to apply. Admission to BIT Mesra M.Tech is based on merit in the GATE exam and academic performance. For the final selection, 80% weightage is given to the GATE score and 20% weightage to Academic Performance. Aspirants without a GATE score can also apply. For non-GATE qualified candidates, the selection is based on Interview and Academic Performance.

faqs.question: What is the fee for M.Tech at BIT Mesra?
faqs.answer: There are several fee components such as tuition fee, hostel fee, admission fee, and caution deposit (refundable) that sumps up to the total course fee for BIT Mesra MTech courses. Candidates can check out the below table for fee components along with the amount: Fee Component Amount (two-year) Tuition fee INR 4.5 lakh Hostel fee INR 66,000 - INR 84,000 One-time payment INR 27,500 - INR 30,000 NOTE : This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

faqs.question: Which documents are required for filling CAT application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates need the following documents while filling the CAT application form: A recent passport size photo (color against white background) Scanned signature with black pen on white paper Any photo ID card like PAN card, Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport Class 10 marksheet Class 12 marksheet Graduation marksheet Permanent address proof Work experience documents Reserved category students need to upload Category Certificate along with the CAT application form. The Certificate is available on the CAT website. Candidates can download, fill it, get it attested by competent authority and upload it as PDF with the CAT application form. The PwD category students also have to fill the PwD form and Scribe affidavit along with the exam application form. This is necessary for getting scribe facility and PwD facility at the test centre. The CAT application form is same for students from all categories. Those belonging to a particular category (SC/ST/PwD) will be required to mention it in the relevant field of the CAT form. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: Can we join BITS Mesra MBA without CAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can join BITS Mesra MBA course without a valid CAT score. The institute accept university entrance exam scores as well for the PG programme. Aspirants with a valid score of MAT/XAT/CMAT can also apply. The candidates shortlisted based on exam scores have to participate in the selection rounds. faqs.question: Can I apply for BTech at BIT Mesra without JEE Main score?
faqs.answer: The technology institute admits candidates to BTech courses based on merit in the JEE Main exam . There is no other provision for admission. Candidates shortlisted based on exam scores must also participate in the JoSAA counselling round for seat allotment. In case the seats are left vacant after JoSAA counselling , then those are filled through CSAB counselling. This is the only criteria for admission. Candidates can contact the BIT Mesra admission office to check for direct admissions. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra is completely residential with eleven hostels for boys and three separate ones for girls. All student lodging houses are spacious and beautifully laid out amidst a lot greenery. Each male-student is provided with well-furnished single-accommodation while girls share their accommodation in spacious and adequately furnished rooms. Individual rooms are constructed in a row with a wide veranda for common use running along the length of passage. Common facilities at the hostel include dining halls and common rooms with provision for several indoor games. The reading room in each hostel subscribes to a large number of magazines, periodicals and newspapers. The entertainment hall in each hostel has a color television set. Each hostel has an independent mess, completely run and managed by the students themselves. The hostels are a hub of leisure activities. Students are encouraged to pursue a wide range of extra curricular activities and hobbies in their free time and events both entertaining and competitive are arranged quite frequently. Inter-hostel tournaments of indoor and outdoor games, quizzes, competitions and adventure trips are very popular at BIT Mesra. The 'Hostel Night' organized by resident students is a memorable yearly event where students interact with the faculty members amidst cultural programmes and a lot of fun in a shared mood of festivity.

highlights.summary:
Graphic Era University is a private university and was established in 1996. It is located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand and is also known as GEU. The university is recognised by the UGC and has been accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade. It is approved by AICTE, Indian Medical Association, and Nursing Council of India. GEU Dehradun is one of the leading universities in the state to offer quality education to students in Engineering and Management fields.
It has ranked 48 in the University category by NIRF 2025, Ministry of Education, Government of India. The university has also been ranked 52 in the Engineering and Management categories by NIRF 2025. It is the first & only university in top 30 universities of India to be awarded Platinum (Engineering) & Diamond (Management) ratings by QS- I. GAUGE 360 perspective award. Graphic Era University courses are offered to students at UG, PG, and certificate levels. Some of the popular courses offered at the university are BTech, BCA, BCom, MBA, MCA, MSc, etc.
These courses are offered to students in various streams such as Engineering, Management, Science, Paramedical, MBBS, Law, Design, etc. Graphic Era Dehradun courses are AICTE-approved and accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA). The university has collaborated with more than 40 international universities of over 28 countries to offer study abroad programmes, internships, student exchange, etc. Some of the universities are University at Buffalo, University of Sannio, Yeshiva University, Atlantis University, University of Plymouth, and more. In addition, GEU Dehradun has a huge campus in Dehradun with facilities like smart classrooms, theatres, libraries, auditorium, etc.

reviews.review_title: No doubt my college is much better than any other in terms of areas.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities that students got from the Graphic Era Deemed to be University are much better and match our expectations, as we expected them to be the same. The mess serves quite good quality of food.

ICU nurse and nurse manager are the top roles offered there.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent. The librarian and the library are also very large. Wi-Fi facilities are also available in the library. Classrooms could be more furnished, but they are good. The mess and canteen are also decent. There are medical facilities. Hostels are a little bit expensive.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are below average. I have difficulties understanding topics. Faculty members should be more familiar with studies. Semester exams are not that difficult because I learnt everything with the help of YouTube, etc. The course curriculum is also relevant.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because I need fun in my college life. The college organises fests, multiple events, and extracurricular activities. The teaching quality should be improved. I would rate 10 out of 10 for both events and fests.

reviews.course: BCA in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Data Science (DS)
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty, infrastructure, etc, but not satisfied with placement opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Here at Graphic Era Deemed to be University, Dehradun, on-campus placement is decent, not very good for BCA students, but amazing for B.Tech students. However, if you have good skills, you can get placed in a good company after college. In my batch, there are 10 sections, with 75 students in each section. The highest package for BCA is 8 LPA, and the average package is 4 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Infosys, etc. Very few students get internships through college, but can apply off-campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Classes are amazing, and every class has a smart board installed in it. There are many labs inside the campus, which provide better exposure to the practical aspects of the course. There are also many libraries available. The hostel is good, the food is also good and hygienic, and the hostels are disciplined and have high security.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful during the course. They even solve doubts after work hours on call or WhatsApp and support students with research. The course curriculum is relevant to modern technology. After completing the course, students are job-ready. The semester exams are of mid-level difficulty not too tough, not too easy with an 80-90% passing percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I want to explore the teaching field more. The best thing about the course is that they teach coding, which is very demanding in today's generation. One thing that can be improved is placement opportunities. The crowd here is also decent. There are not many unwanted events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Graphic Era University review.

detailed_review.Placements: Infosys placed 708 students in total in the 2026 passing batch. There is a very high rate of placement, especially in CSE. The highest package was for 61.99 LPA, and the average was for 24.19 LPA last year. Other than CSE, different branches like electrical have come up with packages of 18-20 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every required facility is available, good food and infrastructure of hostels. We enjoy the services provided in our hostel, and along with that, we have great transportation facilities supported by the hostel and the college. It is a great place to get exposure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really qualified and provide everyone with good-quality notes in classrooms as well as on a virtual platform. We are taught everything spectacularly, and moreover, the faculty helped us after hours as well, no matter the doubts, they are very helpful.
