reviews.review_title: Comprehensive review of my B.Tech ECE program.

detailed_review.Placements: In the 2024 placement session, more than 250 recruiters visited the campus. The highest packages vary depending on the branch, and one source mentions a high package of 84.88 LPA, but that appears more for branches like CSE in 2023. Top companies for our course include big names like Google, Amazon, Adobe, IBM, Wipro, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: GU central library reportedly holds over 1,74,700 technical books, many periodicals, and journals. It also has a digital library with more than 1,200 general reading rooms with 300-seat capacity, a book bank, and reference or leading facilities. The campus is described as fully Wi-Fi enabled, as wired and wireless internet access is reported to be available 24x7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are M.Tech qualified or PhD holders. Many teachers are helpful and supportive, especially in CSE, ECE, and core engineering labs. Some teachers are very good. The teaching quality is mixed as a few teachers are average, and some just follow PPTs. The overall teaching is good, but not exceptional, depending on the teacher.

reviews.review_title: Excellent, really good college.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately all the students were placed, and all got jobs in good companies. A minimum of 95% of students were placed every year in our college, and the college provides us with top recruiting companies for our course. The highest package is 61 Lacs per annum, and the lowest is a minimum of 8 Lacs per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Excellent, Graphic Era infrastructure, of course. The hostel was so excellent, and our course and department were so good. Labs, classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games, etc., are all very excellent. Also, the mess of every hostel is so good, and the college provides us with Wi-Fi.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty and exams of our course are also very excellent, and the faculty are the best for the students. They provide us with full information about how exams are conducted and how students manage the balancing of all subjects. Our college pass percentage is 40%, and not many exams are difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course because Graphic Era is known for its placements and fests, good natural surroundings, best environment, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average college life at Graphic Era Deemed to be University. The crowd is lazy and distracted.

detailed_review.Placements: A huge percentage of students are not eligible for placements due to unfair exam practices by the university in terms of attendance and backlog. The highest was 60 LPA and the lowest 1.8 LPA, with the average around 4-5 LPA. Mostly Wipro, TCS, and other mass recruiters hire. Almost all internships are filled by students themselves. No significant support is provided by the college. Mostly SDE or SWE roles are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Most classrooms are outdated, like they were built 10-20 years ago. Wi-Fi is poor. First-year labs are bad. The library is cramped up in the break, and it's difficult to study as there are no power ports available. The quality of hostels is average, and so is the food. Medical facilities are average. Sports events and games are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful and equally qualified. Teaching quality may vary depending on the teacher, but most are good. I think it's fairly relevant to this date as they're working on both our hard and soft skills. The difficulty would be 5/10, and the pass percentage isn't disclosed, but it's around 70%.
detailed_review.Other: Events are frequent, but the management is not good. Scholarships are offered, but they are a scam as they set the criteria high.

reviews.review_title: Comprehensive and industry-oriented B.Tech aerospace at GEU.

detailed_review.Placements: Over 90% of students got placed. The average package is 5.38 LPA, the median package is 7.25 LPA, and the highest is 54.80 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ISRO, Indian Air Force, Tata Advanced Systems, Airbus, DRDO, MRO, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is designed to provide a solid foundation in aerospace engineering principles, including aerodynamics and propulsion with both core courses and electives allowing students to specialize in areas like aircraft design and computational fluid dynamics. The faculty at GEU's Aerospace Engineering department is generally well-qualified and committed to student development. They employ diverse teaching methods, including PowerPoint presentations and pictorial aids to enhance understanding. While some students have not mentioned that faculty members are helpful, others have mentioned that the teaching quality varies across different professors.
detailed_review.Other: The programme includes core courses, electives, laboratory, work projects, and seminars often conducted by industry experts from organisations like NASA, ISRO, and HAL.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied but could do better.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with my college.

If we give rate out of 5 that would be 4.5. The highest package of my course is 12 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA.

It makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams in this college are moderate, and the pass percentage is 20 out of 50.

The placement record here is consistently good and students from different academic backgrounds get the chance to sit for interviews with reputed organizations. What makes it more encouraging is that the placement process is not limited to only the top ranking students. detailed_review.Other: If you can do hard work, you can easily get a job.

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is a nice place to get our abilities into focus.

Labs are fully accustomed to systems that work efficiently. Overall, there is a friendly environment.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placement, and infrastructure could be improved.

The course curriculum makes students industry-ready even providing few vocational subjects. The first and second semesters are not that hard, mostly students get a CGPA above 6 or 7.

reviews.review_title: All over it's a great college.

The highest package is 1 crore, the lowest I would say is Rs. 50,000, and the average goes to 12 LPA. Top companies like Hyatt and Radisson visit our college. Around 60% of students got internships. The top role offered is hotel manager.

The library has so much material and great infrastructure, too. All other facilities, like medical and sports, are also great. So many things are available. The food quality is quite good, too.

Exams, I would say, are difficult initially. After that, they're easy, and in the final semester, it's a little difficult. Overall, I would say it’s average.

reviews.review_title: Pretty good in terms of study, but in terms of receiving guidance and services, they lack.

Hostel rooms are well designed and equipped; however, the Wi-Fi facilities are weak, and the bathrooms are not clean. The food is usually not good enough for me.

They often shout and sometimes just cut the call whenever asked something they don't know or want to answer. Exams are great; everything is being taught in class, and we are also provided with notes during our class.
detailed_review.Other: Psychology is a great course if studied well; I think more focus on the research field would be great, though. Campus life is great; we have a diversity of clubs, and they have a really great fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Decoding graphic era's standards.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: The class size of my batch is 75 Students (Computer Science engineering ), and the batch size is approximately 1,200 students. University provides us with good infrastructure as well as the food quality is also good. They do provide Wi-Fi in the whole campus, but the usage is limited per student in the hostel premises. We have a well-maintained lab where, on a regular basis, classes take place.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and also qualified as per our curriculum. Faculty use different methods to teach us. Sometimes they use PowerPoint presentations, and very often it is pictorial. I am pursuing Computer Science engineering, so it is relevant in the current scenario. With the advent of Artificial Intelligence, the course would be in demand.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had a keen interest in coding and learning more about computer Science. Best thing about my course is that it makes us market-ready. Every 2 months, the fest takes place. Campus crowd is too good, a lot of students are local only.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: The campus placements in our course were not numerous. The placement percentage was around 40-50%. The highest package offered in our course was 8 LPA, and the average package was around 3-4 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Nestle, ITC, Harvest, etc. Around 20% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Proper labs with well-equipped equipment and chemicals were available. The library was present with well-stocked books. The hostel of our college was also good. A sports ground was also present. The campus was very beautiful.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our faculty members is good. They taught us with real-life examples and uses. The course curriculum is relevant but doesn’t have many opportunities in India. The semester examinations are moderate.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Graphic Era Deemed to be University infrastructure has state-of the amenities, including modern classrooms and lecture theatres, advanced labs, modern libraries and computer centres, as well as a grand and spacious auditorium.

Students also have access to a dynamic and lively activity center, with mutilple large cafeterias, and extensive sports grounds. There are also recreational zones for indoor and outdoor games. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled with internet bandwidth of 1Gbps , 155 mbps . The University has also tried to make the campus accessible by building ramps, lifts, and other inclusive facilities for all.

The campus life at Graphics Era University is extremely lively, with massive fests being organised for the students, called GRAFEST . Students can also enrol themselves in the clubs, like the NSS and others. The infrastructure also includes a conference hall and a convention centre. The campus premises also feature a moot court and a Vidhan Sabha. Other facilities are listed below:

Library : The univeristy has a library called Santosh Anand Library , covering an area of 842 sqmt located at the main campus, with 12048 titles and 85924 volumes. The Univeristy has subscribed to 127 Journals/periodicals and 5242+ E-Journals. The library has access to DELNET and OPAC software, and supports the NPTEL platform. Students also get access to online journals and tools like Scopus and Anti-Plagiarism software Turnitin.
Besides the main Central library, the institute also has Departmental Libraries, like
1. The Department of Management, spread over 159 sqm, with 1679 titles and 12215 volumes.
2. Department of Cs, and IT library, which covers an area of 225 sqm, with 2378 titles, and 26755 volumes.

Other services include: ICT enabled access to library resources, Portal Camera and Zoom Scanner for visually challenged students, Reprographic facility, CCTV surveillance, Video Conferencing, Multi-Media Lab, etc.

highlights.summary:
National Institute of Technology Patna (NIT Patna) is an esteemed Engineering institute in the country. The institute has secured ranks from different national and international bodies. NIT Patna is the 6th oldest engineering institute in India and ranked 53 position in NIRF 2025. Also, the institute is ranked by several international ranking bodies. NIT Patna Architecture is ranked 23rd in India by IIRF.
Some of the courses offered by NIT Patna include BTech, BArch, MTech, MSc, etc. For the students' exchange programme, NIT Patna signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Handong Global University, Pohang, South Korea.
The institute's B.Tech in the CSE branch and BArch degrees are its two most popular course offerings. JEE Main exam scores and NATA scores, respectively, are used to determine admission to these programmes. During ongoing NIT Patna Placements 2023, the highest package stood at INR 52 LPA, whereas the average package stood at INR 14 LPA. reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Patna - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: From the end of the 3rd year, students start doing internships in different companies, and from the start of the 4th year, they start getting placed in different firms or companies. The average package offered depends on the student's capability and how hardworking they are. The average package offered to the EE students ranges from 12-13 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Rooms in the hostel are good and easy to live in. The compound of the hostel is very good. Cleanliness is there. The meal provided is of very good quality and also tasty. Different types of dishes are provided on different days. The registration process starts before the start of every semester for the hostel, and almost all students get a room. If anyone does not get a room or wants to live off campus, they can take PG or a room near campus. There is too much availability near NIT Patna.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio is good. Faculty members are approachable, but they are not understandable. They do not give practical help. Proof. Abhishek Raj sir, taught us the elements of electrical engineering in the second semester. He taught us very well and is approachable. Proof. Rishi Kumar Jha sir taught us differential equations in the second semester, and he is super with his knowledge and understanding experience. There are 2 written exams in a semester. One is a mid-semester exam, and the other is an end-semester exam.

reviews.review_title: New college. New life. A journey to enjoy.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement Salem for the training and placement cell Latin it Patna is very active and helping towards the graduation students of NIT Patna and also help those who have just recently graduated but not yet placed. The highest package in the branch of electrical engineering is about 17 to 18 LPA, the average package is about 11 to 12, and the minimum package is about 5 to 6 LPA. The top recruiting in our are Bharat Heavy Electrical Limited, NTPC. Also, companies of the tech domain take questions from our branch like Cognizant, Mahindra, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Google, Amazon, Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The medical facility at NIT Patna is well and very good; even it is available during nights and holidays. If the situation of a student worsens, then it directly shifts to the nearest medical hospital, which is PMCH in Patna. Even it has great contacts with AIIMS Patna and other medical hospitals. Wi-Fi facilities are present in the overall college, even at our hostel, classes, library, and everywhere. The library at our college contains Lacs of books of interests and domains. The fooding facility at our hostel is quite hygienic and healthy. Even the hostels are well infrastructure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty, Jeevan the professors of our college, were very guiding, helpful, and respective, and they help us very much in the course curriculum. Even while teaching and beside classes, they also guide us like their children, and they also help us to get prepared for the placements. Even they guide so much before exams. They are really helpful and respectful. The course curriculum is quite relevant but needs to be changed in some of the parts; our version is quite old, from the 90s, so there should be improvement. The semester exams are mainly two: mid and end semester examinations.
detailed_review.Other: The campus surrounding is not very large, but it is quite good; it is about 45 acres, and the new United Bihita campus area is about 120 acres, quite large than the old campus. The scholarship facility is also present at our college to help those students who are not able to pay their own semester fees. The extracurricular activities are arranged each even, and they are completed with the students of various reputed colleges in our country. I chose this course because I had much interest in this domain.

reviews.review_title: Amazing institute of India.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements of this year are going well. If we consider the placement season of last year, 2023 to 24. The highest package offered is 64 LPA, similar to the season of 2022 to 23, meaning no decrement in the highest CTC. Top recruiters are Google, Amazon, Atlassian, Oracle, Adobe, Samsung, and Goldman Sachs, followed by JPMC. The placement for the CSE branch is above 90 percent, with the overall rate being 78 to 83 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are three boys hostels and one girls hostel. The net capacity is around 1,400 students. Some hostels have poor basic facilities and the Wi-Fi is very slow due to the large number of users. The library is well equipped but the classrooms are a bit old. Mess food is unacceptable and there is a single big ground for sports like football and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at my college are very knowledgeable and qualified. The exams are not too difficult and the pass percentage is good, even for the toughest branch, which is EE. If we leave some of the faculty members out I think the others are good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is an amazing institute in Bihar.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements this year are going well. In the placement season of 2023–24, the highest package offered is 64 LPA, similar to the 2022–23 season, showing no decrease in the highest CTC. Top recruiters include Google, Amazon, Atlassian, Oracle, Adobe, Samsung, and Goldman Sachs, followed by JPMC. The placement rate for the CSE branch is above 90%, while the overall placement rate is 78–83%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are three boys’ hostels and one girls’ hostel, with a total capacity of around 1,400 students. Some hostels have poor basic facilities. The Wi-Fi is very slow due to high usage. The library is well-equipped, but the classrooms are somewhat old. Mess food is unsatisfactory, and there is a single large ground for sports like football and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at the college are very knowledgeable and qualified. The exams are not too difficult. The pass percentage is good, even for the toughest branch, EE. While a few faculty members may not be as strong, most are good.

reviews.review_title: Overall, the campus life at NIT Patna is really good.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package of my branch is about 18LPA. The lowest package is about 5 to 6LPA. 80 to 90 percent of the people in our course are placed in companies like HSBC, BPCL, SBPDCL, NTPC and others. These are the top recruiting companies for our course. Even many students in our branch go for higher studies after completing their graduation like GATE. Many of them have even been placed in companies like the Public Sector Unit, which are called PSUs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Live in the hostel named Brahmapur Hostel of the National Institute of Technology, Patna. This is one of the largest hostels for boys in NIT Patna. The mess structure of NIT Patna is delicious, and yesterday it had a special dinner. There are three boys hostels and one girls hostel. The net capacity is around 1,400 students. Some hostels have poor basic facilities. The Wi-Fi is very slow due to the large number of users. The library is well equipped, but the classrooms are a bit old. Mess food is unacceptable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors of our college are really helpful. They are highly qualified.  Many of the professors have completed their education from IITs and other reputed institutions, and their teaching quality is the best. As we know, each professor has different experiences of teaching in various domains, and their teaching style are also different, but the way they interact with the students is really helpful for us, and the course is truly relevant.

reviews.review_title: My honest review of the best college in bihar.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75 percent of the students were placed, with the highest package of 84 LPA and the median package of 12 LPA, in reputed MNCs like NVIDIA, Microsoft, etc. The college placement cell is nice, and internships are offered in the 5th semester, but they are really tough to crack for on-campus internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities available for my course are good. Classrooms are big and spacious and have all the necessities like good Wi-Fi, smartboards, projectors, etc. Labs consist of many pieces of equipment, and the library contains a wide range of books, from literature to humanities. Since the college has both management and arts students, the library also offers books on subjects like history, politics, economics, etc. There are also many newsletters, magazines, and journals in the reading section. The quality and variety of food available in the canteen and mess are great. The sports complex has many facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are like school teachers, helpful with doubts and in labs. Some are very strict but helpful for studies. The curriculum is good, as it produces students who are ready for industrial life. Semester exams are easy, but the answer sheet checking process is a little more complex.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with infrastructure and facilities provided by the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 70 percent of the students are placed in this course but in different categories, the highest package is noted to be around 42 LPA and average is 8 LPA, top recruiting companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, and SAP visited our campus to hire the students, and at last of this course 80 percent of the students receive internship offers, may provide stipend or may not.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Recently we are shifted to new NIT Patna, it is very beautiful and bigger than the old NIT, old NIT was around 50 acres where the new one is around 120 acres, they provide Wi-Fi facility 24/7 and all labs and library are running with air conditioning, food quality was good but somewhat difficult for south students, but we can manage.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum in college is good, professors are very knowledgeable and highly educated, they are very helpful to implement our ideas in any type of project, difficulty of exams vary with year and faculty, grades are running followed by relative grading, and if we want good grade, we have to be top in our class.
detailed_review.Other: It is not a normal college that we can get an easy admission in, it is not top NIT or least NIT, it is in the middle, but inside of the college all are good, and for those belonging to SC, ST, and lower-income students they get full scholarship for their tuition fees, they only pay for living in the college.

reviews.review_title: I assume that other students take admission in NIT Patna

detailed_review.Placements: This year, only about 40 percent of students are placed in our branch. The highest package is around 18 LPA, and the lowest is 3.6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are L&T, Infosys, TCS, and other software companies, as there are no jobs in the core field. Almost only 20 percent of students get internships. The top roles offered are software engineer, structural engineer, site engineer, and environment engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I live in the hostel named Brahmapur Hostel of the National Institute of Technology, Patna. This is one of the largest boys’ hostels in NIT Patna, and yesterday there is a special dinner. There are three boys’ hostels and one girls’ hostel. The total capacity is around 1,400 students. Some hostels have poor basic facilities. The Wi-Fi is very slow due to the large number of users. The library is well-equipped, but the classrooms are a bit old. The mess food is unacceptable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in the department are invaluable to students, but teachers from other departments, like the Physics department, do not seem well-qualified. Students have to prepare on their own. The course curriculum is very relevant and focuses only on courses that help with placements. There are two mid-term exams and one end-semester exam in each semester.
detailed_review.Other: This is the best college I have ever seen. I assume that other students take admission in NIT Patna.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Electrical Engineering (Power System Engineering)
reviews.review_title: College is good in academics, but it lacks facilities, such as a dedicated football ground.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest UG placement is 40-41 LPA. Approximately 80 percent of students get placed according to the professors. The average package is 10 LPA. The minimum is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are L&T, Bosch, Samsung, Accenture, and others. Internship-to-job conversion is not guaranteed at this college. To get a better job, students maintain a good CGPA and develop their skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are poor and old. The Wi-Fi is good but limited for social media and other apps. Washrooms and hostels are decent. Mess food is good. Medical facilities are poor, and students have to buy medicines from outside. The sports ground and gym are small. The canteen is good. The library is good, but still requires manual work. Labs, especially the CS lab, are excellent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. Most teachers have Ph.D. degrees from IITs and top colleges. They are knowledgeable and supportive. Teaching quality is 5/5. The course makes students industry-ready. Placement staff also helps students. Mid-semester exams are okay, but end-semester exams are difficult. The minimum pass percentage is around 35.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course through JOSSA counselling because no other options were available. The best thing about this course is the placements and skill training. I aim to improve my communication skills and become industry-ready throughout the five-year course. Events are few, and clubs are limited, so students may get bored. Scholarship staff are helpful. Extracurricular activities are decent.

reviews.review_title: Great infrastructure and good college environment.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of students were placed in my course last year. The highest package in my course is 18 LPA, the lowest package is 6.5 LPA, and the average package is unknown to me. Top recruiting companies in my course are TCS, Mahindra, Wipro, Infosys, HSBC, NTPC, and BHEL, but this will improve day by day. At present, students are less interested in placement, and companies come more for the mechanical department. Placement was good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I live in the hostel named Ganga Hostel of the NIT, Patna. The mess structure of NIT Patna is delicious, and yesterday it was a special dinner. There are three boys' hostels and one girls' hostel. The net capacity is around 600 students. Some hostels have poor basic facilities, and the Wi-Fi is very slow due to the large number of users. The library is well-equipped, but the classrooms are a bit old. The medical facilities of NIT Patna are well organised and good. Doctors are available at any time. Also, take care of students' health.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and well-qualified. You will find all types of professors, including supportive, kind, and funny ones, as well as bad ones. The curriculum set is quite good. It includes electrical engineering subjects and core energy courses. Semester exams are of a moderate level, not too easy and not too difficult, unless you do not study.
detailed_review.Other: I think in terms of value for money, as we know that NIIT Patna's new campus is already formed. When I joined the college, it was still in progress. In the first semester upon joining this college, the college charges 54,000, while in the previous year, they charged only 36,000 from our seniors who joined in their first year at NIT Patna. But yes, we're happy our new campus is ready. The crowd and campus life of NIT Patna are quite good. There are festivals at NIT Patna, including Parakram, Corona, and Milanje, eccentrica.

reviews.review_title: Our college is very good and has good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch, 75–80 percent of students get placed through the campus recruitment process. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA, the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average package is nearly 4–5 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, L&T, Cognizant, and Capgemini. Nearly 60% of students also secure internships in reputed companies, mainly in IT, Manufacturing, and Core Engineering sectors. The major job roles offered are Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET), Software Developer, Site Engineer, Design Engineer, and Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college provides good infrastructure facilities. Wi-Fi connectivity is reliable. The departments have well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, project and seminar halls, and a central library with digital access. The campus environment is clean and supportive for academic learning. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with 24/7 water and electricity backup. The mess food quality is average but hygienic. Medical facilities are available on campus. Hostel security is good. The college also promotes physical development with sports grounds, a gym, and indoor games facilities.

admission.title: NIT Patna Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: NIT Patna admission to most of the courses is entrance-based. The final seat allotment for for course admission is through counselling such as CCMT, JoSAA, etc. for some of the courses. Candidates seeking admission must visit the institute's official website to apply online. National Institute of Technology (NIT) Patna offers over 15 courses at undergraduate and postgraduate courses across different specialisations. The programmes are offered in a full-time mode.

faqs.question: How can we get admission in NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: NIT Patna admission procedure vary from one course to another. Some of the basic rounds included for all the courses are online registration, selection rounds, release of cutoff/merit list, followed by counselling and seat allotment. In the below section, details about stages of the admission process are explained: Step 1: Candidates seeking admission have to apply for the respective accepted exam through the conducting body official website. The application process is online for all the programmes. For some courses like PhD, aspirants need to visit NIT Patna official website to apply. Step 2: NIT Patna accept national-level exam such as JEE Main, GATE, IIT JAM for admission to BTech, MTech, and MSc, respectively. Step 3: Candidates shortlisted based on exam score further have to participate in the respective counselling process such as JoSAA for BTech, CCMT for MTech, and CCMN for MSc. Step 4: The selected candidates have to further pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: Can I get NIT Patna with 95 percentile?
faqs.answer: Getting into the flagship programme of NIT Patna i.e. BTech requires passing JEE Main. The cutoffs are usually competitive due to large number of applicants and less no. seat availability. It may be challenging for General category candidates to get into popular branches such as CSE with a 95 percentile. However, aspirants belonging to reserved category or female candidates can get admission with a 95 percentile.

faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: IIIT Allahabad accpets JEE Main score for admission to the BTech courses. As per the IIIT Allahabad cutoff 2023, the Last Round closing rank for BTech ranged between 5924 and 9558 , among which Information Technology was the most competitive specialisation. The Round 1 closing rank for BTech ranged between 4817 and 8428 for BTech. So, considering the previous year Round 1 and the Last Round closing ranks, candidates seeking admission to IIIT Allahabad must secure a rank over and above 4800 and 9600 for the General ALL India category candidates. Candidates can refer to the table given below to check out the 2023 Last Round closing ranks for IIIT Allahabad to get an idea of the ranks required for all the BTech courses offered at this institute:

faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted for admission in BArch at NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: For admission in BArch, aspirants need to have a valid score in JEE Main paper-II. Candidates shortlisted based on exam score are further required to take part in JoSAA counselling. Moreover, the institute may accept NATA scores. Apart from this, it is also crucial that the course aspirants fulfil the minmum eligibility requirements for admission in BArch course.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BTech course admission at NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: The National Institute of Technology Patna offers a four-year full-time BTech course, covering several specialisations. To apply for the NIT Patna BTech course, candidates must have valid JEE Main scores. Apart from the entrance test score, students also need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria set by the exam conducting body - NTA. NIT Patna BTech eligibility is a Class 12 pass with a minimum aggregate of 75%. Aspirants must also hold the relevant documents as a proof of eligibility.

faqs.question: Can I take NIT Patna M.Tech admission without GATE?
faqs.answer: No, NIT admission process Patna for M.Tech admission is not possible without valid GATE scores. NIT Patna M.Tech admission is based on candidates' performance in the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE).

faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: To get admission to NIT Patna, you must attain the rank as per the cutoff list for the category you belong to. NIT Patna JEE Main cutoff 2025 has been released for the third round. The cutoff was released for All India as well as Home State category candidates. Among the General AI category candidates, the cutoff ranks varied between 1070 and 45208 .Therefore, candidate must attain a rank below 45208, if there is no choice of specialisation. Among the General Home State quota, the ranks closed between 4169 and 54616 . Therefore, candidate must obtain a rank below 54616. To check all the details for NIT Patna cutoff, such as category-wise, round-wise and year-wise data, click here .

faqs.question: Can I get NIT Patna with 40000 rank in JEE Main?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is possible to get admission to NIT Patna with 40000 rank in JEE Main. The closing ranks for NIT Patna JEE Main cutoff 2025 was between the range of 1070 and 45208 , among the General AI category candidates. Looking at the cutoff range, we can say that getting admission with a rank of 40,000 is possible. However, the choice of specialisations at this rank would be vey limited. Similary, the closing ranks among the OBC AI category candidates also, admission at 40000 rank is possible. For the OBC AI category, the closing ranks varied between 613 and 14809 . For more information on category-wise, quota-wise, round-wise and year-wise cutoff data, check out this page .

faqs.question: Is there direct admission in NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: Candidates who want NIT Patna admissions have to clear entrance exam and also need to fulfill the eligibility criteria. There is no provision for direct admission. So candidates need valid scores of national-level entrance tests. There are in all 10 departments that offer 40+ courses. The flagship course of NIT Patna is BTech which admits students on the basis of JEE Main scores . Hence, candidates cannot get direct admission at NIT Patna. Candidates need to visit the official website of the national-level entrance exams and apply online. Selected candidates can proceed further for counselling, and PI.

faqs.question: How much rank is required for NIT Patna CSE?
faqs.answer: As per NIT Patna cutoff 2024, the Last Round closing rank for Integrated M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) has decreased compared to the previous year. The Last Round closing rank for General AI category students for Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) was 19527 , while for the General Home State category students, the Last Round closing rank was 23853 . For BTech CSE, the cutoff was 16697 which decreased to 18206 in 2024 .

faqs.question: What is the percentile required for admission in NIT Patna?
faqs.answer: For each of the NIT Patna course admissions , aspirants have to meet the set eligibility requirements. The eligibility criteria define the minimum qualification required for selection along with the aggregate. In the below table, the course-wise required percentile is mentioned: Course Eligibility Criteria BTech Class 12 with a minimum 75% aggregate BArch Minimum 60% aggregate in Class 12 with Maths & Physics as compulsory subjects MTech BE/BTech in relevant subject with a minimum 60% aggregate Integrated MSc (BSc + MSc) Class 12 with a minimum 75% aggregate PhD Graduation with a minimum aggregate of 60%

IIEST Shibpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Old college yet excels at modern engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students got placed from our course. Among them, 15-20 students got more than 20 LPA, and around 50 students got 7 LPA-18 LPA, and the rest got less than 7 LPA. The highest package is 58 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. The recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Texas, Wells Fargo, Synopsis, etc. 40 percent of students got on-campus internships, and overall, 80 percent of students got an internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Overall, the department is okay, but it needs more space. Labs and libraries are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Hostel infrastructure is bad, and the mess is also not good since this college is very old, the building and toilets have been used for many years without renovation, so it's a bit disappointing, but now they are constructing a new 10-storey 1000-seater boys hostel with a modern look. I hope they increase the quality of the food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Academically, teachers are very good and friendly. They are very supportive of research and projects. I feel the curriculum is a bit outdated, it'll be better if they include more practical subjects and hopefully remove some useless subjects. Semester exams are relatively easy. Mostly, 95 percent of students pass with a CGPA above 7.
detailed_review.Other: I am very interested in the hardware side, so I chose this course. I feel like I made a very good decision after coming to this campus, as our branch is comparatively better than all branches except CSE. There is a very good culture among students on our campus. There is no ragging, and seniors are very friendly. Since our campus is in the city, everything is very easily available to us, so it's very easy to go outside the campus. The fests are a big thing here and are conducted with great planning, and are enjoyable.

reviews.review_title: Being an IIESTian – through my journey.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement statistics of my department (Mechanical Engineering) UG 2025 at IIEST Shibpur. The percentage of students placed is 88.7%. The highest package is 20.00 LPA, the lowest package is 3.3 LPA, and the average package is 7.19 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, PWC, Tata Hitachi, Linde, and Aditya Birla Group. The top roles offered are in the automotive, manufacturing, and consultancy sectors.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In my department, there is no Wi-Fi in classrooms. However, it is available in the library. As IIEST Shibpur is the second oldest engineering college in India, the infrastructure is old but good. Classrooms are very clean and neat, with a good number of fans and lights available. To be frank, the quality of food and water in the hostel is poor. Medical facilities are limited to minor issues, but a health card is provided. All sports and games facilities are available with a good number of opportunities.
detailed_review.Faculty: I strongly say that teachers here are really helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is the best. The course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. The difficulty of semester exams is average to difficult, and the pass percentage is around 90–93%.
detailed_review.Other: If you are interested in mechanical research studies, then this is the best option for you because IIEST Shibpur is excellent for research and has a strong alumni network. The old infrastructure needs to be replaced with new infrastructure. Regarding events and fests, many events and competitions take place, attracting a huge crowd. I do not know about scholarships as my annual income is high. Many extracurricular activities are also available, such as NCC.

reviews.review_title: The glory of IIEST Shibpur, Kolkata.

detailed_review.Placements: For the 2025 batch, the average package for IT was 14.12 LPA, with a median of 11.4 LPA. 80% of the total IT students are placed, with top recruiters like Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Deutsche Bank, and Wells Fargo. Some students got internships in their third year itself and cracked a PPO.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good, with a new, state-of-the-art 1000-seater hostel. The departments, their labs, and other classrooms are well-maintained. The Central Library, along with the computer center, has a lot of books and resources and air-conditioned study places for students to use.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-experienced, knowledgeable, and masters in their field. The curriculum is not that relevant compared to the current job market scenario, but this is also the case with other national institutes. Semester exams are not that difficult, a reasonable amount of study helps in cracking them easily.

reviews.review_title: College gives you all the things regarding academic as well as college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 70% of students of the department of civil engineering got placed in prestigious firms as PWC, some PSUs like BHEL, BPCL, and GAIL. The highest package is about 22 LPA, lowest is 6 LPA, and average is 9 LPA - 10 LPA. Top recruiters are PWC, JSW, BPCL, TCS, and many more. About 90% of students got internships, whether paid or non-paid.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good in the department. We have seminar hall, Wi-Fi, labs, and well-equipped classroom. There is also a library. Quality of food offered in hostel is much good. Canteen is available at affordable cost. Medical facilities are also provided by the institute. Sports club and gymnasium are also well-equipped.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and highly qualified from top institutes in the country. Teaching style is flexible. Mode of teaching is English. Course material is relevant and makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are there. Two exams are there per semester equipped with several class tests and assignments. Pass percentage is good.
detailed_review.Other: Civil engineering is one of the oldest courses offered by the institute with good placement records. Highly qualified teachers are there to guide. Several events and seminars are organised by the department. Department fest is also there. Scholarships are also provided for meritorious students.

reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Campus placements are excellent 100% placements. Summer placements 2019-20 1.31 LPA (2 months) were offered. In final placements 2018-20 18.76 LPA were offered. Aspirants can go through the placement report of the college for further information. Every student has to go through a summer internship program for 2 months (April-May). The college offers on-campus internship opportunities and many renowned companies visit the campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: So far we have not come to the electives stage that will be given to me in the second year but in the first year, I have to study all three subjects that are physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry. I will opt for physical chemistry as my elective in 2nd year. I am staying in PG and I pay Rs. 6000 per month and the facilities are not very much good but they are just fine to stay. Food is not quality food but it does the job and is better than eating fast food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is just more than my expectation. I am being taught by scientists and researchers some of them have done their research and some have written books on NCERT and other boards. Most of the faculty here have either done their Ph.D. or postdocs from abroad. They have worked with many Nobel Prize winners in chemistry. We have only 12 classes and 3 labs per week and are awarded Saturday off along with Sunday. So we had enough time to have fun and spend time on other activities.

reviews.review_title: Really good college, like if you make good friends who hustle and are fun at the same time.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students got placed in the department of mining engineering. The top recruiting company is Coal India. The highest package is given by Coal India of 40 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. The roles offered are mining engineer, mine planning engineer, drill and blasting engineer, mine surveyor, etc. Almost 30% of the students got internship, in which some got individual internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are pretty old and dirty, but are being maintained every year. All the hostels have Wi-Fi with a speed of up to 300 Mbps, and in the curfew hours, like around 10 pm, the speed goes to 30 to 40 Mbps. The campus is clean, but roads are very poorly maintained however, work is underway and will probably be finished in 5 to 6 months. The library is one of the best places with AC and sofas for reading journals and computer desks for studying, and a computer center which will open soon for all the students. Canteens are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very helpful and well qualified, which will help with their greater insight for a better future in the particular branch. The teaching quality is very good with smart boards and comfortable seats. The curriculum has recently been changed and has become more relevant for the upcoming students. Exams are very decent, not too hard, not too simple, but you can get help from the professor if you are active in class. The passing marks are 40% and above. All this pretty much makes us ready for the industries.
detailed_review.Other: This course is given by the Jossa counselling. I did not think it is that special, but after I joined the college, I realized that this is a pretty good course if you are interested in it. Almost the course is very good, but they should have kept the branch change option in the first and second year on the basis of marks. Events and fest are very healthy and very energetic, which do not interrupt the studies and help us to make very good memories. Campus crowd is very small, and scholarships are being given to many students.

reviews.review_title: My honest review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: It is awesome. Some of the best companies of international standards visited our campus for campus placements and offered a very attractive compensation package. Infosys, Wipro, Intel, L&T, IBM, Tech Mahindra, Iflex Solutions, CMC Ltd., HP, Dell, ONGC, IOCL, etc., are some of the reputed Indian companies to mention and there are many more remain to be mentioned.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no hostel facility in the college as the college is located at a prime location of Jabalpur where a lot of coaching classes. Hotels and PGs are available at a very economical rate which we will not find anywhere else. It is small. The hostel facility is the most attractive thing in this institution and I can definitely suggest one who needs the hostel facility to choose this college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course is designed based on CSIR, NET, and JRF (for PhD and UPSC CGE through which we can get a job in GSI or CGWB. Faculty members are highly qualified. They are PhD holders from prestigious foreign universities. Teacher interaction is very good in the classroom and they are helpful outside the classroom also. Exams are semester and mid-semester basis. Weekly class tests are also conducted for the assessment of the internal assessment. The course curriculum is perfect for today's needs, and it includes both theoretical as well as practical knowledge. As geology is a field science, it includes field trips to different parts of India. The course is designed keeping in mind the demand of industries as well as to fulfill the knowledge of research-oriented students.

reviews.review_title: IIEST Shibpur is worth it or not.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a student from the department of mechanical engineering (currently in 1st year). Placement statistics for the 2025 passing-out batch. Placement percentage of students is 70.93%. The highest package offered is 21.64 LPA, the lowest package is 3.3 LPA, and the average package is 7.84 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Tata Steel, and Vedant. Top roles offered are automotive, steel, and analytics.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In first-year classrooms good number of fans and lights are there. They are also very clean and neat but there is no Wi-Fi connection. Labs are also nice. Our hostel buildings are too old, infrastructure is not that good at hostel. Wi-Fi connection is there with good speed. Mess food is decent. Three canteens are there on our campus. Medical facilities are not available (except for everyday and small problems) but they provide health cards. All sports and games facilities are available and good.
detailed_review.Faculty: In this college teachers are knowledgeable and helpful. Their teaching quality is nice. In first year all students have to study basics of all departments so I don't know that much about course curriculum but as per my knowledge our college curriculum is good. Semester exams difficult level is moderate to difficult, and pass percentage is around 80%-85%.
detailed_review.Other: After JEE selection is the main task, I have done so much research on many NITs and IITs but for my rank, this college and department is the best option. College fees are less. Department with a good curriculum. College with the best NIRF rank. It is near the city, of Kolkata. All facilities are available inside the campus or just near campus like ATM, banks, railway stations, airports, and hospitals. In our college, technical fest is Instruo and the annual cultural fest is Rebeca. Rebeca is an event of 4days with a full crowd on the campus full of light. A scholarship is there for college students called GAABESU which is provided to alumni.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: About IIEST SHIBPUR formally known as BE college.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90% of students got placed every year. The highest package is 82 LPA and the lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is 8 LPA. Recruiting companies are Accenture, Jp Morgan Case, TCS, PW, Microsoft, Google, and many more. About 30% to 50% of students got internships. On-campus, selection is much more than off-campus. Students are also very helpful here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Library is open every day from 10:00 AM to 12:00 AM except Saturday and Sunday, closing time for Saturday and Sunday is 6:00 PM. Wi-Fi is available in library, a quiet place for study. There are separate hostels for girls and boys, and at least 3 days of non-vegetarian food are given to students. Biryani is given 2 times a month. Infrastructure is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, mentors are assigned to each student who guides them and also resolve their academic plus personal problems also. They make students industry-ready. The difficulty of exam is moderate, with 2 exams conducted in each semester, mid-sem of 30 marks, end-sem of 50 marks, and 20 marks based on assessment and attendance.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there are lots of opportunities in this course and also we can get high-paying jobs in this sector. Even the semester, each weekend fest is organized here, and each club, each society, and each hostel organized their fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It was the best period of my life to spend such a memorable time there.

detailed_review.Placements: 65% of students get placed in my batch. The highest package is 37 LPA Texas Instruments, the lowest is 5 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. The top recruiting company is Texas Instruments. 20% get internships, mostly in IITs, some in foreign universities, and a few in the industry. The top role offered is Analog Engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are good. The library has a high-speed Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are very comfortable, with soundproof walls. The food in the hostel is below average in the first year but gradually improves. Table tennis is available in the hostel. For cricket and football, there are Oval and Lord's grounds.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality is average, but professors are well-qualified. The course curriculum is relevant and makes me industry-ready. The semester exam is chill for me, mostly, previous year's questions repeat in the exam. The passing grade for the semester exam is 4 SGPA.

reviews.review_title: It is an absolutely amazing college, and I love everything about it.

detailed_review.Placements: Most students get PPOs. Most students are hired by Tata Steel, Rashmi Group, Aditya Birla Group, PENLM, and Goldman Sachs. The highest package is 14 LPA and the lowest is 5 LPA. Tata Steel and Rashmi Group are the top recruiters. Most students get internships, mainly with Rashmi Group and Tata Steel. The role is Junior Engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are really good. Classrooms are air-conditioned, Wi-Fi is available, and the library has a wide range of books. The quality of food in the hostel is okay-ish but eatable. There is a hospital and three canteens inside the campus, and a lot of sports events are happening.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, and everyone gets an 8+ CGPA. Semesters are okay, and the curriculum makes students industry-ready. Students are great, and teachers as well. They help a lot. They are great. Everything is amazing. Great department and has great students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest. There are fests happening almost every weekend, the social life is placed here. There is a music room, gym, and many clubs to join, like music, literature, chess, art, and dance.

reviews.review_title: It is the 2nd oldest engineering college and the only IIEST in India.

detailed_review.Placements: The batch strength is about 90-95. The placement percentage is above 90%. The highest salary package offered is 32 LPA by Texas Instruments. The lowest salary package offered is around 4 LPA - 5 LPA by TCS. For electrical, CESC, Tata Steel, Texas Instruments, Jindal Steel, etc., visit the college. In core, Google, Microsoft, TCS, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan, BNy Mellon etc., visit here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good but quite old. It is being constantly renovated. There are around 20 hostels with a 1,000 seater and a 10 storeyed. It already completed its construction. The girls' hostels are particularly large with good food. Boys' hostels are average with average food. The exception is on an occasional basis.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are easy to pass if we are willing to put in effort, either one night before or throughout the whole semester. Teachers are approachable and quite frankly. They want us to excel no matter what we do in life. The curriculum I would say is a bit outdated though newer technologies are being taught in higher semesters.
detailed_review.Other: I am in electrical engineering. It is the hardest engineering branch. If we can excel, we can get a certificate to excel anything. It holds plenty of quizzes, fests like technical and non-technical, and other events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgy and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIEST Shibpur: One of the oldest colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: The college placement is good here, with about 80 percent of the students getting placed. The Department of Computer Science and Technology got the highest package of around 53 LPA last year, and apart from that department, all got decent placements and good results.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All courses in the college are good. There are 10 departments, including the Department of Architecture, all of which are good. Hostel facilities are also good, with 20 hostels providing accommodation for almost all year students, including 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th years.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is very good. The college provides a strict curriculum for students, which helps them to perform extraordinarily. The schedule for exams is also fixed, and a good level of questions is being asked. Teachers are also helpful and supportive, which is very helpful for students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: IIEST SHIBPUR Since 1856 - REVIEW.

detailed_review.Placements: About 85 percent of students are placed in my department (Department of Computer Science and Technology). My average package is around 19 LPA, and the highest package is around 56 LPA. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Unstop, and Meta visited our campus. Top roles like software developer were offered in my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Sports ground available for sports like cricket, basketball, badminton, and football. In each, there is one television, carrom board, and badminton court. Hostel Wi-Fi is also available. There are various labs available for each department, and the quality of food in the hostel is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors, unlike other college professors, are very helpful, qualified, experienced, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is above average compared to other colleges in West Bengal, except IIT Kharagpur. The course curriculum is not so well relevant for first-year students, and semester exams are not that hard. The pass percentage is around 99 percent.
detailed_review.Other: There are various tech fests and art and cultural fests organized in my college.

reviews.review_title: Strong placements, great facilities, and vibrant campus life are available at IIEST Shibpur.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85% of Mechanical Engineering students at IIEST Shibpur get placed. The highest salary package offered is 15 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 8.7 LPA. Top recruiting companies like PwC, Tata Steel, and Vedanta Oil visit the college to hire students. About 30% of students secured internships, including at IITs and IISc. Roles offered are span analytics and core mechanical engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities at IIEST Shibpur for B.Tech include Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a vast library with physical and digital resources. Hostels provide basic amenities with moderate cleanliness. The mess offers decent food, and the canteen has additional snacks. It provides sports facilities like grounds for cricket, football, and courts for badminton. Medical care is available through an on-campus dispensary.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at IIEST Shibpur are knowledgeable and qualified. They are often helpful when approached. Their teaching quality varies, but it is generally good. The course curriculum is industry-relevant, covering core concepts and practical skills. Semester exams are moderately difficult, testing understanding rather than written learning. The pass percentage is typically high, and it is above 85%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to pursue a career in engineering, driven by an interest in problem-solving and technology. The best aspects include a strong curriculum, hands-on experience, and exposure to various engineering fields. Improvements could be made in more industry tie-ups for internships and better practical training. The campus organises vibrant events and fests, offering opportunities for cultural and technical engagement. The campus crowd is diverse, fostering a collaborative environment. Connectivity is good, with access to nearby transport. Surroundings are peaceful and ideal for studying. Scholarships are available for eligible students. Extracurricular activities are also encouraged here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgy and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur,is the second oldest engineering clg

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly, 80-90% get placed off-campus. The highest package offered was 39 LPA and the lowest was 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, Netflix, Tata Steel, JSW, SAIL, etc. Top roles include Production Engineer, Operation Analyst, and Cost Estimator.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are a total of three hostels for first-year students at IIEST Shibpur. Hostel 8: This hostel is the oldest among the three. The mess food and sports facilities are better compared to the other two. Hostel 9: This hostel is slightly similar to Hostel 8. Hostel 10: This is a newly built hostel, and its infrastructure is much better in comparison to the others.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors and staff are very helpful and supportive. All are well-qualified and experts in their fields. Academics are slightly harder than in other NITs. The semester examination is divided into two parts: 1. Mid-semester examination 2. End-semester examination. The mid-sem is easier than the end-sem.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because the Metallurgy and Materials Department at the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, is the second oldest metallurgy department in India. Placements are very good, with top recruiters such as SAIL, JSW, and Tata Steel.

reviews.review_title: Good campus life and exposure. Old infrastructure but enough. Good placements and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% of students were placed last year. The highest package was 22 LPA in Mechanical. Top recruiters were JSW, JSL, Tata Motors, ICICI Bank, Haldia Petrochemicals, PwC, etc. Roles offered are mostly those of Graduate Engineer Trainee. Many students prefer to take jobs in tech, but many prefer to take jobs in core companies. Everyone gets an internship through the DTPC of the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is of good speed, and the library is very good, but there is no AC. Canteen facilities are very good, and you will get multiple canteens. Sports facilities are good, especially for cricket, volleyball, football, table tennis, and basketball. You can be a member of the institute team and participate in inter-NIT events if you are a good player. Labs are also more than enough. The infrastructure is old but sufficient.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, but only some teachers teach well. Every professor has something unique to teach you other than studies. Some teachers have a personality that will teach you how to enjoy life, and some show you the importance of seriousness in life. Overall, the faculty is nice, but don't compare their classes to YouTube tutorials. The course does not actually make you industry-ready, but when you complete it, you get enough knowledge that you can become industry-ready in the 6-month training period of the job offered to you. Exams are tough.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty members, good placement in 2020, good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: On average, about 75% of students got placed. Circuit branch students have a 90% placement rate, while core branch students have a placement rate of only 60%-70%. The highest salary package offered is 50 LPA, and the lowest salary offered is 6 LPA. The average salary package offered is 10 LPA. Around 50% of students secured internships. Top roles offered in our course are structural engineer and manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms are okay but the sound system is very bad. Backbenchers can't hear anything. Labs are very good. Library is open from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Mess food is very bad, but there are vegetarian and non-vegetarian sections. All hostels have particular gym and badminton court.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, well-educated and graduated from top colleges in India. The teaching style of all the teachers in unique. They are very friendly. Course curriculum is relevant and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are very tough. Pass percentage is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: In myrank, this course was the last option. The best thing about college is this is a government college. Annual fest Rebeca and tech fest Instro are conducted. Campus has greenery.

reviews.review_title: Dissatised with infrastructure and placements. Really good teaching faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: College has a robust placement record, attracting a number of reputable companies across various companies like TCS, Wipro, Google, Texas Instruments, Vedanta, L&T Ltd, and some others. The highest placement package in 2024 was 45 LPA. The average salary package was 7.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIEST is the second-oldest engineering college in India. So, the infrastructure is not as good as expected. Food in the hostel mess is not very tasty, but it is healthy. Both indoor and outdoor games are available at the hostels. They conduct inter-hostel competitions among the hostels. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel and classrooms. Campus has 4 canteens. Hospital facility is available 24 hours on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: As per my knowledge, the student-faculty ratio is 11:1. All the teachers are good in their subjects, and their background in research is remarkable. Most of the faculty members are good at interacting with students. There are two semesters in a year. The difficulty level of the paper is moderate. The number of classes is very less during the mid and end-semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: I am a Civil Engineering student. I chose this course because the college itself started with the Civil department, and the alumni network here is almost very big. The job opportunities are somewhat less, many students opt for higher studies. College offers various scholarships like Bharati, Amazon, Reliance, etc. The nightlife at the IIEST Shibpur is very good and enjoyable. College organizes events like INSTROU, the largest technical fest in Kolkata which is handled by IIEST students. REBCA, is another fest organized for 3 days, where the college is decorated with lights and flowers.

reviews.review_title: College with billion dreams, which come true because of knowledge delivered by the teachers here.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of our college students are placed definitely in spite of any circumstances. Many startups like Markit Up and Blinkit hire our seniors in college. The highest salary package offered is 55 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 5 LPA. About less than 20% of students are getting internships on our campus, which is not at all a good thing. Software developed, data analytists and machine learning engineers are selected mainly for top packages on our campus .
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi frequency and quality are average I would rate about 2.5 stars for that out of 5. Overall infrastructure is nice. Classrooms have good air conditioning with lot of windows and stuff. Students have no issues at all while learning in classrooms. Hostel is very poor for freshers like us they won't provide hot water also, food tastes very bad. I wouldn't recommend this college for a South Indian boy or girl they can't tolerate here. Medical facilities are top-class and sports are very often held here so students can actively participate in them.
detailed_review.Faculty: Here, the best and most important thing is teachers are highly qualified and knowledge is infinite. They will provide and explain every concept in detail to every student. I'm very grateful for that one particular thing. Course is not that much relevant, but it's moreover outdated so students must learn other skills by themselves. I would rate 6 out of 10 for difficult exams.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIEST Shibpur is a reputed engineering Institute in Howrah, West Bengal, India. It is an Institute of National Importance. IIEST Shibpur campus has the mix of old colonial charm and modern architecture. The campus area is114 acres. It includes various hostels and halls. It ranks 49th among engineering institutes in NIRF 2024.

sections.heading: Infrastructure Overview:
text: IIEST is the 3rd oldest engineering colleges in India. The university has 16 departments, 8 schools and more than 250 faculty members for 44000 students departments. The key campus highlights are mentioned below:

sections.heading: Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIEST provides UG, PG and PhD programs in Engineering, Science, Architecture and Management. The classrooms comrpises Smart boards, hybrid learning tools, AC and tiered seating for large lectures. Research-grade labs in Internet of Things, Robotics, Civil Modelling, Electronics, CAD, CAM and Central server are available . IIEST, Shibpur is recognised as an Institute of National Importance under MHRD by the Government of India along with IITs and NITs.

The area of the central library is 3,000 square meters. The collection of books is about 1,58,000 and 41,000 bound volumes of journals , and a collection of documents, such as patents, standards, technical reports and pamphlets. The library has old and rare books and journals from the nineteenth century. The campus has a school, so children of the faculty members or PhD students can study here.
