reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students got placed from my course last year, and around the same number for this year. Also, the highest package offered is 52 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Microsoft and Amazon. Only around 5-6 students were offered a paid internship in the 3rd year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the department is very good. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, but some hostels are not as good as the MBH rooms, which are very good. The rest of the hostels, which are 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 rooms, are very tiny, making it a struggle to live there. Food quality, sports facilities, and medical facilities are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty depends on branch to branch, like the IT branch faculty, which is not as good as some professors are good in teaching but won't give marks, and some are very strict. Curriculum is up to date for most of the subjects, and in academics, it is good as they work on reviews for a subject and make changes accordingly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: I think things are changed, if a person who studies well he will definitely get a job.

detailed_review.Placements: According to seniors, till the end of the year you will get a job if you study. Like a senior who passed out last year got a job of 8 LPA even though his CG is 7. Last year the highest package is 52 LPA, basically 4 people got it, and the lowest is 6 LPA, one of them is also from the ICE department who got that.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course is good, but the hostels are still not that great because they are old. However, a new hostel is under construction, and its facilities are really good. The sports facilities are good too, there are TT courts, badminton courts, and a tennis court.
detailed_review.Faculty: The ICE department faculty is very good. They are fully supportive, and if you share your problem personally with any of them, they will resolve it. Currently, the HOD is helpful and interactive with students. The ICE faculty are also interested in your research ideas and often refer you directly to many opportunities.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are good, the main fest is called Utkansh. Last time, Jubin Nautiyal came for a concert, it is my first concert. The college is also selected for many government scholarships like NSP, as well as private scholarships given by Reliance, Airtel, and other companies.

reviews.review_title: Really well-furnished infrastructure of our college with a new building and very good placement.

detailed_review.Placements: 43.5 percent of students got placed in the batch of 2021, and 59 percent in the 2024 batch. The top recruiting in my branch in the 2025 batch is 13.5 lakhs in Flipkart and 13 lakhs in Sigma, and the top recruiters are L&T, Flipkart, and many others. An internship is mandatory for every student after the second year, so it is a necessary thing and a role in a company as an SDE at Flipkart.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are different labs in our department, like the concrete technology lab, surveying lab, geotechnical lab, and AutoCAD lab. There are ample number of classrooms in our department. We have a 3-story library in our college, and the department also provides a seating area for studying in labs and departments. For the hostel, we have a well-equipped hotel with sports facilities like table tennis and badminton court, and a gym with a common room, library, TV room, and fully air-conditioned mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. They have published many research papers, and they also have good teaching experience. The course curriculum is industry-ready, skill-based, and laboratory-based, all of which are needed for a job in civil engineering. The college exams are a little bit difficult, but above 85 percent of students pass the exam.
detailed_review.Other: The honest reason behind this is my rank, but after getting to this college, I understand that college is a choice, not a branch you can achieve in any branch or any stream.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life is good and interactive. The seniors are the best.

detailed_review.Placements: A lot of students, more than 95% in each branch, have been placed. The maximum package was 53 LPA, and other than that, the off-campus highest package was 1 crore LPA. This has been one of the highest so far. Many recruitment companies come, such as Adobe and Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are approximately 15 hostels for boys and three hostels for girls, namely the MGH, the ILD, and GH1 and GH2. GH1 and GH2 are allotted to the first year, whereas the other hostels are allotted to the girls of the other years. The senior and junior interaction is good, and the in-time for girls is 10 PM.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of the college is very good and interactive. They teach in a very good way and address doubts well. Only sometimes do the exam levels go much higher than expected, but the overall scores become good if one follows the syllabus relatively.
detailed_review.Other: There is not much extra, but being an NIT, it has all its benefits.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at NITJ is experienced by every student.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate is good, with 91%, and the average package is 11 to 12 LPA, the highest package in the CSE branch is 52 LPA, and the average package in the CSE branch is around 15 LPA. So placement-wise, the college is good compared to other good colleges in Punjab or India.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, and all basic facilities are also good in the college, like gym, library, and classrooms, which are neat and clean. Also, Wi-Fi facility is available throughout the college. So infrastructure is good and nice, and basic facilities are provided.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty are experts, and most of them have completed Ph.D. in specific subjects. Some persons lag in teaching, but their concepts are mostly clear. The curriculum is also well updated and includes modern subjects and topics. In one year, 4 exams are conducted, and 2 exams are conducted per semester.

reviews.review_title: My college is good, but my department is not.

detailed_review.Placements: In my department, ie. Mechanical engineering. All the students who were eligible are placed. Basically, CG above. The highest package is 18 LPA from EIL, and the lowest package is 3.6LPA from Proxima and Infosys. Top companies are Amazon, Flipkart, and PSUs. Around 40% students got internships from my course in BIS, Honeywell, and Mondelez. Top roles offered are for a Design Engineer, Data Analyst, and GET.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities of NIT JALANDHAR are awesome. Institute Wi-Fi is everywhere, even if you dont recharge, you will be surviving easily on Wi-Fi throughout the whole campus. In my department, the labs and some of the classes are not air conditioned. Labs, I can understand maintaining the temperature of the setup, but in classrooms. The quality of the mess food is average, edible. In the first year, I got such good food, but when I jumped into the second year. I got food poisoning and stomach infections, but my body adjusted. Medical facilities are good, we mech boys take out multivitamins, skincare.
detailed_review.Faculty: Mechanical teachers are famous in our whole college for their strictness. Teachers are helpful, but only a few. The course curriculum is outdated. Ice engines and all. Semester exams give no gaps, no preparatory gaps. They set hard papers. You have to study to get good grades.
detailed_review.Other: I will be honest, the campus life is boring, 0 exposure. I chose this course because I wanted to be placed in an automobile company. Events are dead. Scholarships are mainly for low income families with an annual income of below 2 Lakhs.

reviews.review_title: Lively campus life and scope for improvement in industry exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: In chemical engineering, around 50% of students were placed in 2021. The highest package for chemical engineering was 16 LPA. The lowest package was 3 LPA. Average package was 5.5 LPA. Recruiting companies were Reliance and Trident. 20% of students got internships at Reliance, Trident, and IOCL. Junior engineer due to covid placement was less.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Jalandhar's chemical engineering department provided well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi, modern infrastructure, and good library. Hostel facilities were decent. Mess was very nice. Food was good. Rooms were clean in single room 2 occupancy for 2 years, 3 occupancy for 1st year, and 1 for 3rd and 4th year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful. All teachers were Ph.D. qualified. They had good knowledge of the course. Course curriculum was relevant. Mostly for IOCL and production, IT subjects were there so students could take placement in IT industries. Passing percentage was 4 CGPA. Exams were average, not that much hard.
detailed_review.Other: You could take a course based on your marks in JEE exam. I have an interest in chemistry so I chose this course. Overall, you will enjoy here. It provided a nice experience. 2 major events happen every year.

reviews.review_title: Good for career but a little bit disappointing campus life. It is small space close to other areas.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 85 students eligible for placements and out of which 75 get placed. The highest package offered is 18 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. Top recruiter is Trident. Top roles are in management and sales. 88.8% of students have gone for placements. Placement statistics are good in college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of college is good. There are two libraries, one is traditional and other is digital. Students can borrow books from the library. There is good service of Wi-Fi on campus. Medical facilities are also good as there is one dispensary open from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM daily. There are two ambulances on campus for emergencies. Mess facilities are also good. Food for every region is provided as per the weekly schedule. Hostel rooms are good for every year but in case the first year goes for BH1, BH2 because good facilities are provided there. There is a gym at the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified. Curriculum in some branches are relevant to today's industry. College exams are tough enough if someone has not attended lectures properly. Question papers are based on class learning. You have to attend proper lectures and take notes from your teacher.
detailed_review.Other: So my batch is 24-28 B.Tech mechanical engineering. My father is an automobile mechanic so I had having typical interest in this field. It is also considered an evergreen branch of engineering so I chose this. Some of the subjects are now irrelevant to our course college is removing them one by one. Events are good in college they happen only once in year the large event utkansh for three days. Campus crowd is also good. There is no ragging system. Students enjoy the company of each other. Scholarship section is also there which is very helpful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has provided good placements in 2025 and has a good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, you can check the details online to see if they have been updated. The ICE branch achieved 100% placement, with the highest package coming from Microsoft at 52 LPA and an average placement of 10 LPA - 10.67 LPA, with companies like Microsoft, Trident, and Flipkart hiring. The roles offered involve controlling instruments within any company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-organized labs and classrooms in a separate department that comprises the ECE branch. There are 2 libraries: a new library, which is fully AC and used for study and contains PCs, and an old library that has thousands of books and a study area. Wi-Fi facility is provided all around the campus. There is a good supply of internet in the library to ensure no pause in study.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are talented and knowledgeable distributors, and everyone loves to attend their classes. Teachers are qualified up to the top level, and some teachers are researchers in specific industries. Although some teachers have average teaching quality, but rest are superb. This is sufficient to make students industry-ready. The pass percentage is 40%, and semester exams are moderate to a high level, but it may be possible that it could be easy if mid-semester were so tough.

reviews.review_title: My bright future with NITJ

detailed_review.Placements: There is a placement percentage of 95%+ of students in the college. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the average is 9 LPA. There is a TPO Placement Cell that invites new companies and helps in the placement of students of NIT Jalandhar. Our students work hard.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our hostel is good, and the food supply is also the best daily. Mess workers also serve food in proper ways. The whole mess system is completely good. The mess workers’ nature is also good, and their behavior with all the students is good. Food quality is also the best.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers completely help the students in their studies and make the students more proficient and the best. Semester exams are not very difficult, and the pass percentage is 90%+. All the teachers help the students solve doubts and assist in the placement procedure.
detailed_review.Other: There are so many events organized by the college for entertainment purposes.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college life I lived. Good infrastructure, hostel rooms must be AC.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of students get placed from all the eligible ones. The highest package offered is 18 LPA, and the lowest salary is 5 LPA. PSUs are top recruiters. In civil engineering, students have to find internships on their own if they want to work in any private organisation. But the faculty members are very helpful if students want to research internships. Top roles in civil engineering are basically technical management training and graduate engineer training.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are well-built with Wi-Fi facilities. Libraries are new with all the Wi-Fi and LAN facilities. Classrooms are really neat, clean, and spacious. Talking about the food in hostel, it's really good. Just feel like home internal dispensary is there if students are facing any issues even late night. Ambulances are always there. Staff is very supportive. NIT Jalandhar promotes sports at a very good level.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They are always available for students. They teach all the things that are related to our curriculum. Talking of the difficulty of semester exams, they are not that much difficult exactly what that difficult is teaching in your classroom.
detailed_review.Other: The teaching and atmosphere are engaging students don't feel like they are away from home. It's overall learning with fun and knowledge. One thing I would like to say, we should improve is site visits, or in hand experiences except for the labs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, college is good.

detailed_review.Placements: There is a good score above 90 percent for the placed students in the CSE batch. The highest package is 52 LPA, and the average package is 13 LPA - 14 LPA. Top recruiter is Microsoft. Around 60% of students got internships in companies like Google, Amazon, Optum, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure for our department is very good with all facilities like library, Wi-Fi, labs, etc. Overall, quality of hostel is very good at college with various facilities. Mess food is also good in canteen too. It has good medical facilities and sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and helpful too. Teaching quality is good. Course curriculum is relevant like the courses offered but some courses seem irrelevant. It is moderate and depends on the type of exams like mid-semester or end-semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life at National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar.

detailed_review.Placements: Before 2025, the placement ratio is 90% in CSE. I think due to AI, the placements are going to be decreased soon. The highest package offered is 52 LPA. Companies like Microsoft and Google visited our college last year. The internship ratio is also mid.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities are very good, in the first year, we will feel the college like our home. There is 24x7 Wi-Fi for us and the same for the library. There are two libraries on campus and both are with AC. Food quality is also good but after the first year, we will realise, the quality of food is not good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is very good but after hustling in JEE, we don't want to study all root learning subjects. According to the Indian education system, we have to study only root learning subjects in the first year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with decent placement opportunities, good infrastructure, and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements have been good, and around 92% of students from my branch (instrumentation and control) got placed in 2024. The highest package is around 26 LPA by Nvidia. The average package is 10 LPA and the lowest package is 5 LPA. The 2025 placement season is currently ongoing and the currently the highest package given by Microsoft is 52 LPA. Various top MNCs like Amazon, Meta, and PSUs like BPCL are visiting for software and core respectively. We might see an increase in average placements and packages this year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Overall, the hostel experience in my first year has been good. Hostel infrastructure is well-maintained and hygienic. Hostels are on a sharing basis double-seater and four-seater in the first year (depending upon our hostel). Mess food is quite good as well and contains a good variety of cuisines. The hostel has a decent Wi-Fi facility. The library is newly constructed so its overall infrastructure is quite spacious and well-equipped with AC, Wi-Fi, and computers. Medical facilities are good for mild diseases. There are multiple canteens on campus like snackers, night canteen, dominos, Nescafe, and juice shops. Sports facilities are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members depend upon the department although in the first year, the majority of subjects are the same among all branches. Teaching quality is decent among professors, and some are good but some do not put any effort into teaching. Some courses are not currently updated according to the industry standards. Exams are moderately difficult and we have to put in efforts to maintain a good CGPA throughout your course.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in electronics so I chose this course. Placements are quite decent as compared to other alternatives and I am getting according to my JEE rank. The campus is located on a little outskirts of Jalandhar. I enjoyed it a lot in fests. Overall, my experience has been good and I hope it will help students.

reviews.review_title: It provides a robust academic environment.

detailed_review.Placements: Since I am a first-year undergraduate student, so I don't know how these things happen. Majorly, all big FAANG companies visit our college in the placement drives. The highest package offered is 52 LPA this year by Google. So it is good in our college. It is our choice to go for technical or non-technical placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire campus, including hostels and the academic blocks, is Wi-Fi enabled with a decent amount of speed. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Laboratories are also well-equipped with advanced technical instruments (some of the laboratories). The food quality is good in the mess of BH1.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful (not all). The course curriculum is designed as per the new education policy in our branch, and it's our choice whether we want to take the minor degree or not in some other field of interest. Exams difficulty level is moderate.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good college (must have experience).

detailed_review.Placements: Over 80% of the students get placed each year with major recruitments being from PSUs like HPCL and BPCL along with some private companies like Reliance Petroleum and EIL. Major recruitments are in the energy sector and some of the students are placed in the core along with some others in teaching companies like Google and Microsoft. Overall the placements are diverse in field and help students land the jobs of their interest.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is almost new and all the services can be availed by students almost at any time of the day, labs classrooms and libraries are equipped with Wi-Fi and are fully air-conditioned. The hostels are also decent though a little congested but the food is good. Medical facilities are free of cost along with college-owned ambulances. The students get an athletic ground with night light for their interest in sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very supportive and you get to work under them if the student is sincere in his/her work. They are well-qualified and experienced. The courses offered are relevant to industry standards and the examination conducted is also not that tough. Over 75% of students pass easily.
detailed_review.Other: I have been in college for about 2 years now college life is amazing the college fests the people around the environment everything is amazing. The campus is completely secure from any external threats 24/7 surveillance cameras along with on-duty security guards. Overall the college is amazing and offers a must-have experience.

reviews.review_title: Some insights of NIT, Jalandhar.

detailed_review.Placements: The institute ensures 100% placements in the mechanical department,  but the packages do not meet expectations. The highest package offered this year is 17LPA, and the average package is 9 LPA. Companies that visited this year for placements are Amazon, Reliance, Wipro, and Infosys.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Taking a further glance at the infrastructure, as the college is primitive, buildings are from old times, but they are being renovated in a timely manner. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the campus, and the speed is also appreciable. The dispensary here remains opened till 8 in the evening. The ambulance is available all the time in case of an emergency.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are unlike private colleges. They will support us in every possible way they can. Apart from academics, they are approachable and one will never feel inferior asking any doubts to them. The courses are also being revised, and they introduce a design thinking course in the first year itself to some branches.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Green campus and nice exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75% of students got placed in my course. Cisco, Flipkart, Infosys, and other companies come here for placement hiring. There is a special consideration for female candidates also. The positions of database analysts and AI trainers are seen to be more important.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college when compared to other NITs is quite different. Classrooms, library, and all associated buildings have well-maintained facilities. Hostels are also well-equipped and the mess food quality is okay. The campus has a dispensary to take care of medical facilities and supports sports too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful when it comes to doubt clearance. The course syllabus keeps on changing for each batch to include updates. Semester exams are quite tough which increases the level of healthy competition. The total mark of 40 is required when adding up the whole of mid-semester, end-semester, and internals.
detailed_review.Other: I always had a passion for computer science. The exposure to NITJ has helped me to develop and grow my skills in computer science field. The campus holds two events cultural and technical fest.

reviews.review_title: Review of National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, i.e., the B.Tech. in Information Technology, the percentage of students who get placed is 93%. The lowest package ranges from 14-15 LPA. The average package is 17 LPA. The highest package is 62 LPA. Top companies that visit the college for placements are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, Nvidia, and Samsung.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My college has 11 hostels for boys and 1 more mega hostel is under development. There are 8 hostels for boys and 3 Mega hostels. Names are BH - 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 7E and MBH -A, B and F. The infrastructure of the college is really nice but hostels are not that impressive. But all hostels have LAN and Wi-Fi which student can access with their mail ID. There are many restaurants and a canteen in the college. Mess food is average but BH 2 and 7 have really nice mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are PhD holders. They have a lot of experience. Many teachers are great but there are a few who are short tempered and students must not make them angry or irritate them in any possible way. Overall, they are supportive and helpful towards students. The course curriculum is highly relevant to us. Exams are not as tough as JEE but since they are subjective it is a little hard.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college in Punjab for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, 86.31% of B.Teach students were placed, with the highest package offered being 52 LPA In 2024, the average package for B.Teach students was 9.48 LPA In 2024, the highest package offered to M.Teach students was 34 LPA. Recruiters are Amazon, Nvidia, Google, HPCL, Samsung Research Bangalore, Lowe's India, Oracle, Wiingy, Certify Technologies, and Engineers India. The career and training placement office organizes internships, including summer opportunities for third-year B.Teach students. Many students secure internships, with some receiving stipends.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Most hostels have internet access All hostels have geysers, water purifiers, and water coolers. Outdoor sports include a 400-meter track, an international standard swimming pool, football, volleyball, hockey, kho-kho, kabaddi, and cricket grounds. Indoor sports include a badminton court and a table tennis playing arena. There are also basketball courts. The institute has a library, digital library, labs, seminar halls, and classrooms. There is also a hospital or medical facility. There is a shuttle service. Outdoor sports include a 400-meter track, an international standard swimming pool, football, volleyball, handball, hockey, kho-kho, kabaddi, and cricket grounds. Indoor sports include a badminton court and a table tennis playing arena.
detailed_review.Faculty: I'm dissatisfied with the faculty and staff of the college. Teachers are qualified but not very helpful and students had issues with them also. The teaching quality was average. I don't think the course curriculum is relevant because of teaching problems in the college.

admission.title: NIT Jalandhar Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: NIT Jalandhar course admission is granted on entrance score basis. The institute provides UG, PG, and PhD courses. It is available in different streams, such as Engineering, Management, and more. Some of the NIT Jalandhar popular courses are BTech, MBA, MTech, etc. The accepted exams are JEE Main, GATE, etc. Students must check the eligibility criteria before applying for a course.

faqs.question: Can I join NIT Jalandhar directly?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar admits students on the basis of merit in both UG and PG programmes. The merit lists are notified in reference to JEE main scores and GATE score for UG and PG resoectively. Students cannot get direct admission into the college. They must clear JEE main/GATE exam in accordance with the selection criteria of their preferred course. applicants must also register and attend the JoSAA/CCMT counselling process before seat allocation by the institution.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission in NIT Jalandhar must qualify JEE Main for UG and CCMT for PG. Candidates must check the eligibility requirements for their preferred course before applying. Hereafter, candidates must register for the JoSAA/CCMT counselling process for UG/PG respectively. Subsequently, the college allocates seats on merit basis with reference to JEE Main/ GATE scores and candidate's preferneces recorded during the counselling process.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar admits students to its UG and PG programmes on merit basis. The college accepts JEE Main scores for UG programmes and GATE scores for PG programmes. Candidates must ensure that they are eligible for the preferred courseby checking the minimum eligibility requirements.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to get admission to B.Tech at NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: The National Institute of Technology Jalandhar offers a four-year full-time BTech course, covering several specialisations. To apply for the NIT Jalandhar BTech course, candidates must have valid JEE Main scores. Apart from the entrance test score, students also need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria set by the exam conducting body - NTA. NIT Jalandhar BTech eligibility is a Class 12 pass with a minimum aggregate of 75%. Aspirants must also hold the relevant documents as a proof of eligibility.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pass Class 12 with at least 60% aggregate to apply for UG courses at NIT Jalandhar. Aspirants have to complete their UG degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate to apply for PG courses.

faqs.question: How are candidates shortlisted for NIT Jalandhar PG programme?
faqs.answer: The admission process for PG programme at NIT Jalandhar is merit based, with the college accepting GATE scores for the same. Candidates must check if they are eligible for the PG programme at the college and additionally must also register for the CCMT counselling process. After, attendiong the counselling session, candidates are shortlisted on the basis of merit with reference to their respective GATE scores.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in NIT Jalandhar for BTech with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: The minimum eligibility for BTech admission at NIT Jalandhar is passing Class 12 with atleast 50% aggregate. Hence, with 60% in Class 12, the candidate is eligible for applying for admission in BTech at NIT Jalandhar. The selection criteria for the same is JEE Main and JoSAA counselling. Hence, the candidate must aslo clear JEE Main and Register and attend JoSAA counselling to be allotted a seat at the college for BTech on merit basis.

faqs.question: What percentile is required for NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: For NIT Jalandhar %ile between 80 - 98.73 is needed. The cutoff changes every admission year depending on the entrance test. The required score of exam is specified in the cutoff lists released by the entrance test bodies or NITJ.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: How to apply for MBA at NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar MBA application is conducted in an online mode. Candidates must visit the official website of NITJ and fill an online application form with all the relevant details. Check the steps below to fill out NIT Jalandhar form for MBA: 1: Visit the official website of NIT Jalandhar (nitj.ac.in). 2: Click on the application link and register. 3: Upload the important documents. 4: Pay the application fee. 5: Submit the application form.

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech course at NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: Dr BR Ambedkar National Institute of Technology Jalandhar BTech fees is INR 5 lakh. This is the tuition fee for all the BTech specialisations. Apart from the tuition fees, candidates also have to pay Hostel Charges and One-time Payable Security Fees. Candidates are advised to visit the official website for more details around NIT Jalandhar BTech fee.

faqs.question: How can I get into NIT Jalandhar BTech?
faqs.answer: For NIT Jalandhar BTech admission you must have passed Class 12 with a minimum of 75% aggregate. Candidates are selected based on JEE Main exam followed by JoSAA Counselling. If seats are left vacant after JoSAA, those are filled by CSAB counselling.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to M.Tech at NIT Jalandhar without GATE?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar M.Tech admissions are entirely based on a valid GATE score. Candidates are selected as per their rank obtained in the entrance exam score and the final seat allotment is done through CCMT Counselling process. The first preference will be given to GATE rank holders. However,  if the seats remain vacant after admitting GATE qualified candidates, then the students will have to appear for a department-level entrance test to try their chance for admission.

faqs.question: Who can apply for M.Tech at NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a valid BE/BTech degree from a recognised university can apply for NIT Jalandhar MTech course. Aspirants must have scored at least 60% aggregate to apply. Aspirants must have the relevant documents for verification.

faqs.question: How to get admission in NIT Jalandhar for M.Tech?
faqs.answer: A two-year MTech programme is available at NIT Jalandhar. There are 16 specialisations available for this programme. There are two options for students to be admitted to the M.Tech programme at NIT Jalandhar. They either need to qualify for GATE and appear for CCMT Counselling. Another option is to get admission through the Self-Sponsored category via only a GATE score. Additionally, non-GATE-qualified candidates can also be admitted by taking the entrance test held by the particular departments at NIT Jalandhar. Students must meet the minimal requirements for eligibility and pass the applicable admission exam with a passing score. To meet the minimum eligibility criteria, the candidate must be a graduate with a minimum 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA with BE/B.Tech subject from a recognised university. To apply for M.Tech at NIT Jalandhar, students are required to apply via GATE. The application process for GATE 2024 consists of three steps, I. e. , registration, form filling & document uploading, followed by payment of application fees.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for the MBA course at NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar offers a two-year full-time MBA course in the field of Humanities and Management. Admission to the MBA programme at NIT Jalandhar is done basis of CAT/MAT/CMAT score followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview. Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum of 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST/PwD) to be able to apply for the MBA course.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Jalandhar MBA?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar MBA admission is entirely entrance-based. The aspirants with a valid UG degree in any discipline with minimum 60% aggregate can apply for the NIT Jalandhar MBA course. Selection of the candidates is based on merit scores of MAT/ CAT/ CMAT exams, followed by group discussion and personal interview round. To apply for the course, aspirants shall visit the institute’s website (nitj.ac.in) and fill an online application form.

faqs.question: What is the cost of studying MBA at NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for a two-year MBA course at NIT Jalandhar is INR 1.4 lakh. Candidates also have to pay Hostel Charges and One-time Payable Security Fees. This information is taken from the official website/ sanctioning body and may change. Candidates must visit the official website for more details around NIT Jalandhar MBA fee.

faqs.question: What is the fee at NIT Jalandhar for MBA course?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for a two-year MBA course at NIT Jalandhar is INR 2.2 lakh. Candidates also have to pay Hostel Charges and One-time Payable Security Fees. This information is taken from the official website/ sanctioning body and may change. Candidates must visit the official website for more details around NIT Jalandhar MBA fee.

faqs.question: What are the MSc courses offered by NIT Jalandhar?
faqs.answer: NIT Jalandhar offers MSc in three specialisations. The two-year is available in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics disciplines. Mode of study for all these courses is full-time. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: CSE and MNC courses in IIT Jammu are better than the IIT lower branches.

detailed_review.Placements: 2024-25 placement data has not been updated till now. The highest package is recorded off campus. In the year 2023-24, around 85-90% of students got placed. The placement cell is working hard to get us placed. Top recruiting companies for our course are Graviton, Samsung, MediaTek, Qualcomm, MathWorks, BP, L&T, Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, and Flipkart. 80% of students got internships in DRDO, Adobe, Samsung, T&P, etc. For the 2023-24 batch, the highest package is 53 LPA, and the average package ranges from 15-19 LPA. The lowest package is 9 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: C3i labs are highly equipped with the latest technology. It has new libraries, and a reading hall has been recently built. Classrooms are really huge and the biggest one has 160 seating capacity. We have Nescafe which is open on all days till 1 PM. We also have a canteen near the academic building. The food quality in the mess is not so good, but don't worry the breakfast here is always good, so students should not miss it. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Nearly every sports facility is present here, and we can literally explore a lot here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and knowledgeable. For the teaching quality, I would rate 4 out of 5. The course curriculum in the 1st and 2nd semesters includes some courses that are not related to our branch. The main departmental courses start from 3rd semester, so students can trust the process. We should keep hustling side by side to develop other skills. Semester exams are too easy, and we can easily get an 8.5 SGPA by studying one night before exams. The pass percentage varies usually, and it remains more than 90%.
detailed_review.Other: Our batch is competitive but supportive. We have each type of people here. I chose CSE in IIT Jammu because the average package is good enough for a fresher, even though it is a new IIT and still developing. The best thing about the course is that it is not too hectic and we will have time for other chores. We have an annual cultural fest named Anhad and an annual tech fest named Nexus. It organises an annual sports fest named Pravah. We will enjoy the campus, and events will keep us engaged.

reviews.review_title: The college is good considering academics, hostels, and placement in tech.

detailed_review.Placements: This year there is approximately 80% placement in IIT Jammu. The highest package on-campus is 45 LPA while the lowest is 6 LPA. However, one student got a package of 85 LPA off-campus. The average package is 13 LPA. I am from the MnC branch which is relatively new. None of the batches of MnC has passed out but it has a very good scope as per the current scenario. CSE has a 100% placement start. Talking about internships, you will get an ample amount of opportunities and college support too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classroom is air-conditioned and there are 2 libraries. There is a study hall too in which you can go and study. You will get institute Wi-Fi 24/7 in the hostel as well as classroom and library. The hostel has some study rooms and TT table setup. The food in the mess ranges from average to good depending upon the mess you get. Talking about sports, there is one football ground (one in the making too), one basketball court, one volleyball court, cricket nets, 2 badminton halls (one indoor and one outdoor),2 gyms, and some indoor games setup (pool, carrom, etc.).
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are well-qualified and easily approachable in most of the cases. However, in some courses, you have to study on your own. The course curriculum is similar to that of other IITs. The semester exam can range from very easy to very tough depending upon the professor. Approximately there is 85%-95% of pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is currently in the developing stage. So, you may find it small compared to other IITs. The recent fest was Anhad in which some major names were Pranav Sharma and Monali Thakur. In another event, Madhur Virli had come to perform. Talking about sports.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's a great place to live in with an amazing infrastructure and growing tech culture.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch (third year) about 16/40 students got internships in companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Warner Bros, Samsung, etc. Even I got 2 internships as an SDE intern at WBD and the other as a 6-month summer intern (SWE role) at Amazon. The highest package till now in our senior batch is around 62 LPA which is an offer given by Atlassian.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great. It gives a luxurious feel. A new academic block has been built this semester only, which has bigger AC classrooms and well-equipped labs. The campus has access to 24/7 Wi-Fi with good speed. Mess services are okay, could be worse. Sports culture is improving day by day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Majority of faculty members in the CSE department are good. They are very easily approachable since there are less number of students here compared to other IITs. Course curriculum is good, can be improved a bit, but it's okay, it makes students industry-ready if they are interested in tech. End sem exams are on the tougher side maintaining the standards of IIT, but going to class will help you a lot.
detailed_review.Other: I want to solve a big myth about IIT Jammu about it not being safe. It's completely safe, majorly everything that happens in the Kashmir side which is very far away from us. Jammu is a very safe city with very simple people so don't opt the idea of joining in here because it is in Jammu and Kashmir.

reviews.review_title: Getting an IIT itself is a big thing.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students get placed in our course. The average package is 14 LPA and the highest is 50 LPA. Top roles are in Data Science, ML, and software development. Top recruiting companies like Qualcomm, Intel, Nvidia, Amazon, and Silicon Labs. Almost the batch gets internships. There is nothing hard to get.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Talking about the infrastructure, it is one of the best due to the new emerging IIT. Hostels are the best I have ever seen in my life with so many facilities, night canteens, and a good mess. Medical facilities are also good. A proper gaming area building is there, along with a huge ground for football.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They are well-qualified and have a lot of experience. What they teach is not able to get on YouTube and sometimes not even in books. They make us industry-ready. Exams are quite intuitive. It's not like you study everything and go for the exam. It's still possible that you won't be able to solve it.

reviews.review_title: Comprehensive, supportive, and growth-oriented college experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students were placed in IIT Jammu. The highest package was 50 LPA, the lowest was 8 LPA, and the average was around 15 LPA. Top recruiters include Microsoft, Amazon, and L&T. Nearly 85% got internships at companies like DRDO, ISRO, and Tata. Top roles offered are software dev, analyst, and engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no shortage of water here. However, there are no rooms with air conditioning, though classrooms do have these facilities. I am a vegetarian, and the food in the mess is average in quality. The registration process is simple and smooth. The library is open 24 hours, while the gym closes at 11:30 PM and the cafeterias stay open until 3 AM. On campus, you must return by 11 PM. There are some hangout places outside, including fast food spots and many restaurants. Yes, it is completely safe.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful except some and mostly are knowledgeable. Teaching quality is also very good. The course curriculum is relevant except some courses make students industry-ready. Some courses are difficult and some are moderate. Passing is approximately 25 to 30 out of 100.

reviews.review_title: Good college in tier 3 IITs.

detailed_review.Placements: In electrical engineering, the last time that is 2024 batch had an astonishing record of 87% placed. The highest offered was around 50 LPA and the average was 18 LPA. I don't know about recruiting companies but so many companies come to recruit. Around 70% were given internships from my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are quite good. They provide full-time Wi-Fi. Labs have so much equipment. Classrooms are neat. Even the library has a vast collection of books. The quality of food is below average as you cannot expect anything much better because it is located in Jammu and I am a south Indian who likes to eat more spicy, they cook food which is sweet. Medical facilities are also good. They also conduct good events based on sports and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are very helpful, qualified, and highly knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is also very good. The given course curriculum is also relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are also average like if you study it would be easier. The pass percentage is 95%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the above average colleges in IIT Jammu.

detailed_review.Placements: I do not know but average package always lies between 18 LPA to 24 LPA. Around 85% of students get placed in CSE every year. The placements are good in CS branch while other branches have bad placements. We should get atleast 7.5 CG to get good placements. All students above are placed by considering their merit but not CG.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is fine but room cleaning is not so frequent. The mess doesn't provide non-veg because of some budget issues. But the food is okay and hygienic. The taste is not good but the quality is good. The 1st and 2nd year students have 2 shared rooms and 3rd and 4th year male students have 1 shared room with inbuilt air-conditioning.
detailed_review.Faculty: Whatever faculty members teach is not so much understandable to people who have language barriers like South Indian. I am a South Indian I personally think that teachers on Youtube teach way better than college teachers. So I always study on Youtube and attend classes only for attendance.
detailed_review.Other: They form communities and racism exists but no ragging in this college. Racism means all kinds of racism. But people act respectfully in front of all girls and other people. Most of the college people are good.

reviews.review_title: The institute has great infrastructure and facilities and is one of the well-emerging third-gen IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students were placed in our course. Almost all students secured internships from our course. The majority of them were placed in other IITs, small-scale industries, as well as companies like BPCL, RIL, and many other chemical industries. Students also gain greater exposure by participating in hackathons.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is rated 4.5 out of 5. The infrastructure is top-notch, with newly established hostels and well-facilitated. The quality of food available is rated 3.8 out of 5 (less spicy), and hygiene is great. Sports and Games are highly encouraged and well-facilitated. Students selected for inter-IIT events receive greater privileges, and the coaches do a perfect job in their respective fields.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are top-notch and influential in their respective industries. The curriculum is relevant and prepares students for the real world. Semester exams depend on the professors, and their difficulty ranges from medium to hard. The pass percentage varies from 30% and also depends on the professor. Grading is most likely relative.
detailed_review.Other: Festivals are well celebrated, and having AIMS, IIM, and IIT in a single city provides more development opportunities. With a set lower limit of CGPA, students can directly pursue an MBA at IIM. The I2EDC and I3C functions run efficiently, and technical fests create a hub of connections with top industry leaders.

reviews.review_title: Weather and studies are excellent.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, 70% of students from our branch are placed. MediaTech is the top recruiting company. Nearly 90% of students have secured internships. The highest package offered till now is 47 LPA. Top roles are Electrical Engineer, Marine Engineer, and Business Analyst. That’s all about our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has excellent hostels for boys, with AC in single rooms with a single person. Labs are also good. Food in the mess is good, and the canteens are also good enough. Classrooms are one of the best I have ever seen. It is fully high-tech and pleasant for studies.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here are excellent, both for Electrical and other departments too. It is a great opportunity to learn from them. Curriculum is very good. There is a stress-free and happy environment. Faculty members are more interactive with the students at any time. It is a great opportunity to study here.
detailed_review.Other: None .

reviews.review_title: An Enriching Journey with Excellent Facilities, Supportive Faculty, and Great Opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: I got placed in Meesho as a Business Analyst. Around 80 of students from my course were placed. The highest package offered was INR 25 LPA, the lowest was 6 LPA and the average was 12 LPA. Top recruiters included Meesho Reliance and Vedanta. About 70 percent of students got internships in companies like ONGC, Reliance and Tata Steel. The top roles offered were Process Engineer, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our Chemical Engineering department at IIT Jammu has modern classrooms with projectors well-equipped labs a library with a good collection of books and campus-wide Wi Fi. The hostel facilities are clean and well-maintained, with spacious rooms and 24/7 Wi Fi. The mess offers decent food with a variety of options and the canteen serves snacks and beverages. Medical facilities include an on-campus health center with basic care. Sports facilities are excellent with grounds for cricket, football and courts for indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in our Chemical Engineering department are highly qualified, knowledgeable, and supportive. The teaching quality is good, with a focus on both theory and practical applications. The course curriculum is relevant and includes industry-oriented topics, making students job-ready. Semester exams are moderate challenging, but regular study and practice can help students perform well. The pass percentage is usually around 95 percent showing that most students are able to clear the exams without much difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Chemical Engineering because it combines problem solving with real-world applications in industries like energy and manufacturing. The best things about the course are the hands-on lab work and the wide career opportunities. I wish there was more focus on modern software tools and interdisciplinary projects. Our campus hosts fun events and fests, and the crowd is diverse and friendly. Connectivity is improving, and the surroundings are peaceful. Scholarships and extracurricular, like clubs and sports add to the vibrant campus life.

reviews.review_title: Have a look at IIT Jammu, a new IIT having pretty good performance compared to other 3rd gen IITs.

detailed_review.Placements:
Last year about 60% were placed on and off campus. Placements are pretty average here; nothing like crores of packages. The highest package is 45 lacs. 
The average package is 19 lacs. 
The lowest package is 11 lacs. 
Top recruiters are Microsoft, Qualcomm, Samsung, Nvidia, etc. About 70% of students get international and domestic internships as we have collaborations with the Taiwan study center also. Top roles offered are software engineer, business consultant, web developer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have very good infrastructure, new buildings, AC classes, all types of equipped laboratories, and good Wi-Fi connection. The library is not up to expectations; it is quite small with low capacity. Mess food is average, sometimes really bad, sometimes good; special dinner is quite good. Medical facilities are up to the marks; basic medical facilities are available within the campus, and for any major problem, a 24/7 ambulance is available for the nearest good hospital. A new gymkhana is opening in a few months, giving absolutely all good sports like badminton, basketball, and volleyball (still we have courts). In the new gymkhana, there are more. We have 2 fully equipped gyms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified, but I personally didn't like most teachers way of explaining. The curriculum is midway; it has good modern courses like AI and also old-school subjects. Definitely, students can't rely only on college for placements; we have to keep learning new technologies by ourselves too. Semester exams are again not so difficult to score; if you do all questions given by the teacher in tutorials, you can easily be in the toppers of the class. Pass percentage this semester was 30% in most courses.
detailed_review.Other: This was what I was getting based on my JEE advance rank; that's why I chose this. It's an IIT, so it always has an edge compared to other colleges. Many improvements can be made, such as better explanations of topics, better timetables, etc. Main events Anhad and many other events keep happening throughout the year; recently we have Convoquor and Pahal as sports events. Good scholarships for economically weak students are provided.

reviews.review_title: IIT Jammu: Superb college for IIT with best infrastructure and facility.

detailed_review.Placements:
85% of students were placed in my course. 
The highest package was about 30-40 lacs. 
The lowest package was about 20-25 lacs. 
Top recruitment companies were TCS, Goldman Sachs, etc. Almost 80 to 90% of students got internships from my course in companies like TCS, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Faculty members are always educated and acknowledged in the first structure; super labs and classrooms are hi-tech, and the library is good. 
Facilities in my hostel are of superb quality; the food available in the mess is good, and canteen medical facilities are superb. Sports and games are also superb.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Teachers are very helpful and qualified. Teaching qualities of these teachers are super personal attention is provided. 
This course is curriculum-relevant; it makes students industry-ready.
Semester exam makes students prepare for final exams.
detailed_review.Other: This course is related to my field, which I like. The best thing about my course is my favorite subject: math and computers.

reviews.review_title: It has natural beauty, but not sure about the quality of education.

detailed_review.Placements: Out of 22, only 7-8 students got placed. Two of them secured jobs in land management, one in management, and the rest in teaching profiles. Unplaced students opted for higher studies. The highest salary package offered is 14 LPA and the minimum salary package offered is 7 LPA. All students secured internships. Top roles offered in our batch are software developer and data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Materials science lab is well-equipped with all the necessary instruments, such as SEM, TEM, XRD, and more. There is also one dedicated lab for materials students that includes a muffle furnace and many other things. Recently built hostels are good, all are single occupancy rooms with air-conditioning. There is one separate building dedicated to mess only, which is of 4 floors.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good but not much. Most of them have completed their education from esteemed universities, mostly from outside India. Only a few of them teach well and other's teaching style is so boring. Pass percentage is 33%. Exams are easy to moderate, if we know concepts then we can score good grades.

reviews.review_title: A decision to join in IIT Jammu.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 60% of students get placed in the chemical discipline. I don't know the exact statistics for 2024, but based on 2023 data, the highest salary package offered was  53 LPA and the lowest salary package offered was 5 LPA-6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are mainly petroleum companies like Hindustan Petroleum, among others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good, with average food quality. Wi-Fi is available, but the speed is not very fast—it's average. There is a water cooler facility and a table tennis table in the hostel. Rooms are well-lit, and LAN ports are available in the rooms. Rooms are of two occupancies for first and second-year students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, and the quality of teaching is extremely skillful and good. Teachers have completed their Ph.D. and M.Tech from various colleges and IITs. Course curriculum is aligned with those of IITs. I believe the course makes students industry-ready.  Semester exams are more difficult than those at other private colleges, and the pass percentage is approximately 72% to 90%.
detailed_review.Other: As you all know, the Chemical Engineering branch is growing and is better than Civil Engineering and Materials Engineering, which is why I chose this course. Campus is not very crowded, as there are only 240 students in the first year of the B.Tech undergraduate.

reviews.review_title: IIT Jammu - Indian Institute of Technology review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage is 100%, with the highest package being 60 lakhs and the lowest package being 8 lakhs. Top recruiting companies include Unilever and Microsoft. On-campus placements are also good, with many top companies visiting and offering very nice packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are watercoolers and washing machines in every wing of the hostel at IIT Jammu. The library is very big, fully air-conditioned, and quiet. The hostel rooms are comfortable, and a regular bus service is provided to take students to the academic block.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Jammu has very good and experienced faculty, but the only thing is that they don't teach well. The difficulty level of semester exams is very high, which makes it difficult to score well. However, it is possible to pass the exams by studying one or two days before the exam.
detailed_review.Other: The college is ragging free.

reviews.review_title: IIT Jammu - Indian Institute of Technology review.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Jammu is a typical third-generation IIT. It has been an average kind of year for placements. However, the placement system seems impressive and assuring enough that it will be improved by the time I graduate in 2028.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Being newly built, its infrastructure and structure are well thought out and efficient. We have every facility needed by any student, and medical facilities and sports are very good. Being a third-generation IIT has the advantage of letting every individual play. The mess hall serves above-average food, which means they make some good food as well as some not so good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in my branch are not up to the mark, which may be due to their lack of experience. They try their best, but they can't match the level of what an IIT teacher should be like. Another problem is language; they have good knowledge but are not able to communicate it effectively to us.

reviews.review_title: IIT JAMMU - A new, beautiful IIT is being created, and that is IIT Jammu.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package offered for the batch 2022-23 was 53 lakhs per annum. The highest stipend offered was 2 lakhs per month. 65+ students have received a CTC of more than 20 lakhs per annum. And as you know, IIT JAMMU is a new IIT, so after some years, this IIT will offer more good placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are both AC and non-AC rooms now. AC rooms are available for 3rd and 4th year and MTech , PhD students. After some time, it will also be available for 1st and 2nd year students. As you know, this IIT is new and it is not fully built yet. But at times, it has very good facilities and also good hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Their faculty is very good, as IIT students deserve their teacher  (professor). He  is very good . They give their 100% for students, and as you know, IIT does not take bad faculty, so no doubt their faculty (professor) is good and helps students in their studies.

reviews.review_title: College infrastructure is very developed.

detailed_review.Placements: About 67% of students are placed last year from this college. Top multinational companies gives very good packages to students. They offer high packages. Almost 80 percent students got internships from my course in many good companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi problem is very weak and library system is very good and very interesting. My collage labs are very good and my collage labs are very good and very big. Full items are available, and the lab teachers are very good and they give good explanation experiments.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful. They are too qualified and teach very, very well. The course curriculum is very relevant. The exams are very much difficult. It happens monthly; they are too tough; it is very difficult to score well in it.
detailed_review.Other: I didn't choose this course; I got this in josaa choice filling. The events and fests happen very much and students enjoy a lot here.

reviews.review_title: Although it's a new IIT, it gives tough competition to 2G IITs. Placements are getting better.

detailed_review.Placements: 66% of students are placed in this year and the highest package offered was 35 lakhs, 15 lakhs was the average package offered, and the lowest package offered was 5 lakhs. IBM is the company that recruits the highest number of students. Students got internships at Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: So, there's a new academic block on our campus and it has the best infrastructure among all 3G's and 2G's IITs. WiFi also works here but some sites are restricted . The quality of food is decent and there's a night canteen too. The best sports facilities are available here.
detailed_review.Faculty: All of the faculty of IIT Jammu are highly qualified to teach in an institution like IIT, and they teach like professionals. Yes, the course curriculum is appreciated by me; it makes students industry-ready. They are quite hard as other IITs, as I talked to my other IIT friends.
detailed_review.Other: I chose chemical engineering because here at IIT Jammu I get a chance to do an internship in my core branch . More faculty should be joining the course . Fests are like festivals here.

reviews.review_title: Placement is not so well as compared to older iits but it has a good infrastructure as it build

detailed_review.Placements: In year 2022, highest package for chemical and CSE was 52 LPA. The current scenario of the placement is that package of CSE, MNC, EE, CH, CE,MT are in order of their packages. Companies like Atalasian, Nvidia ,are also coming here . In this college there is another specific group known as CDS to meet up the student with suitable companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Although college infrastructure is under construction, old block consists of a library and well conditioned classrooms. The new classroom consist of evrything which is required for a classroom. The new block is under construction, it will be fine in about 3-4 year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is all right here although some of the faculty are not much expert as compared to older IIT but overall the other sessional program is fine.  But some of the faculty are well in their research. Overall you have to study on your own. The teacher provide you only guideline.
detailed_review.Other: Although it is a new IIT, but there are a lot of clubs like robotics , coding ,artistic, musical ,dancing etc.

faqs.question: Is it worth joining IIT Jammu?
faqs.answer: Successfully making it to the list of various ranking agencies at the national level, IIT Jammu ranked at 62 position in the recently released NIRF ranking 2024. Additionally, it also holds a record of offering the highest and average package of INR 53 LPA and INR 18 LPA, respectively, to the students. Other than this, a number of verified alumni and current students of IIT Jammu have mentioned in their college reviews the following statements: Keeping in view the factual data and the student testimonials, IIT Jammu can be considered a decent option for BTech in India.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in IIT Jammu without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, candidates seeking admission to BTech at IIT Jammu must have qualified JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced for admission. Final selection of candidates to IIT Jammu BTech programme is based on their JEE Advanced ranks. The counselling process is managed and regulated by JoSAA. Candidates are allotted seats via multiple rounds of JoSAA Counselling. Final seat allotment is based on the college cutoff and candidate's preference of courses and colleges.

faqs.question: How is IIT Jammu for CSE?
faqs.answer: The IIT Jammu highest and average package offered during BTech CSE placements 2024 was INR 52 LPA and INR 19 LPA, respectively. A total of 114 companies participated in the drive and 132 offers were made during IIT Jammu placements 2024 for BTech course. In 2023, IIT Jammu has concluded the placements with an 85% placement rate. As per the latest report, over 129 recruiters participated in the placement drive and offered 224 job offers to the batch of 2023.

faqs.answer: IIIT Allahabad accpets JEE Main score for admission to the BTech courses. The Round 1 closing rank for BTech ranged between 4817 and 8428 for BTech. So, considering the previous year Round 1 and the Last Round closing ranks, candidates seeking admission to IIIT Allahabad must secure a rank over and above 4800 and 9600 for the General ALL India category candidates. faqs.question: What is the fee of IIT Jammu for BTech? Is it costly?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for IIT Jammu is INR 8 lakh . Other than the tuition fee, students have to pay other one-time charges and those who opt for hostel facilities are required to pay an extra amount for it. The one-time payment other than the tution fee that students end up paying is INR 15,880. More details on the fee break-up can be fetched from here . This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. To answer the second question of whether IIT Jammu BTech fee is expensive or not, the fee for all IITs is almost similar to each other. However, it is comparatively less than other top BTech colleges such as BITS where the BTech tuition fee goes up till INR 19 lakh.

faqs.question: How many seats are there in IIT Jammu for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total seats available for all BTech branches combined are 280 seats. This intake is incluseive of the Gender Neutral and Female-only (including Supernumerary) pools and is inclusive of all student categories, such as Open, Open-PwD, GEN-EWS, GEN-EWS-PwD, SC, SC-PWD, ST and ST-PWD, among others. Candidates are offered seat in IIT Jammu BTech course based on JEE Advanced score.

faqs.question: How much rank is required for IIT Jammu admission to BTech CSE?
faqs.answer: For 2024, IIT Jammu Round 5 cut off was 6310 for General category candidates in All India quota for BTech. in Computer Science and Engineering in IIT Jammu. For female candidates in general category under All India quota, 12,108 was the closing rank. BTech cut off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant.

faqs.question: What is the opening and closing rank for BTech in Electrical Engineering at IIT Jammu?
faqs.answer: The opening and closing rank depends on the category and quota of candidates. For general category under All India, closing rank was 10,005 in 2024. Cut off are differant when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. In All India, closing rank for female candidates was 18,177. Admission to B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering in IIT Kanpur is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE Advanced. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: Can I pursue MTech from IIT Jammu without GATE score?
faqs.answer: No, students seeking admission to IIT Jammu for MTech are required to have a valid score in the GATE exam. Other than this, the institute also conducts a written test and interview for further selection as per the official brochure. To add, students are also required to have passed their BTech degree in relevant branch. This information is as per details released by the institute for admission to its MTech course. However, for any other information around direct admission, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of the college for details.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for IIT Jammu MTech programme?
faqs.answer: The minimum eligibility required is a bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science (4-year course) or a master's degree in Science with marks not below the specified minimum. Relaxation of 5% aggregate or 0.5 CPI is offered to SC/ST/PwD category candidates on the minimum eligibility score. However, candidates who wish to apply to the MTech programme must have a valid GATE score. However, candidates are screened based on their CGPI in BE/BTech and GATE score and then the shortlisted ones are further called for a written test and interview for final seat allotment process.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Jammu infrastructure has a permanent campus at Jagti, which is a forest area near Jammu city at the foothills of the Himalayas, covering 400 acres of land. The campus has an amazing view of the Trikuta Hills. A 6-floor academic block has several laboratories, classrooms, faculty offices, and much more. The campus has all the basic facilities, such as 24/7 wifi, a medical unit, surveillance, and well-maintained hostels. To know more about IIT Jammu infrastructure, see below:

sections.heading: IIT Jammu Campus Highlights
text: IIT Jammu campus covers around 400 acres. It  has all the latest facilities, like CCTV cameras, modern labs, etc. The campus also has a big library, well-maintained hostels, and a safe and comfortable environment. Refer to the table below for few highlights:

sections.heading: IIT Jammu Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Jammu has a 6-floor academic block, consisting of 50 laboratories, 10 classrooms, and 125 faculty houses . The classrooms are modern and have the latest technology. 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi is available for students. There are modern labs with advanced equipment such as FTIR, GC-MS, and NMR, as well as a Central Instrumentation Facility. These facilities offer microscopy, spectroscopy, and X-ray characterisation services. 24-hour high-speed wifi is available on campus for smooth and speedy internet. Various short-term courses, workshops and faculty development programmes are being held from time to time.
Campus View:

sections.heading: IIT Jammu Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: IIT Jammu has separate hostel buildings for boys and girls on its permanent campus. For fresher students, there is a dedicated Hostel 16 , while the students of the second and third year are shifted to other hostels. The hostels are well-equipped and offer comfortable lodging and boarding facilities. The rooms are offered on a twin-sharing as well as single occupancy basis. Essential amenities such as basic furniture, internet facilities, indoor/outdoor games, and reading rooms are present in the hostel premises.

The hostel facilities offered are a garden, an indoor as well outdoor gym . Every hostel has a washing machine and a music room . There are common rooms where most hostel-level meetings take place. The mess facility ensures that students have access to nutritious and delicious meals.

highlights.summary:
Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati is also known as IIT Tirupati. It is a government institute and was established in 2015. IIT Tirupati has been declared as an Institute of National Importance under the Act of Parliament of India (Institutes of Technology Act, 1961). It was established under the Ministry of Education, Government of India and has ranked 57 in the BTech category by NIRF Raking 2025.
IIT Tirupati courses are offered to students at the UG, PG and PhD levels, through its 9 departments such as Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, etc. Some of the popular courses offered at the institute are BTech, MTech, MSc, and PhD. These courses are offered to students in full-time mode and across several specialisations. Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati courses nurture creativity, innovation, quality, teamwork, communication skills, and others.
The institute also offers placement assistance to students. During the placement drive, top recruiters like Accenture, Deloitte, Adobe, etc, visit the campus. According to the NIRF report 2025, the median package offered during IIT Tirupati placements 2024 for BTech and MTech programs stood at INR 11 LPA and INR 8 LPA, respectively. IIT Tirupati admission 2026 is entrance-based. The institute accepts several national-level entrance exam scores such as JEE Main, GATE, IIT-JAM, etc.
