IIT Tirupati Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Excellent new infrastructure and world-class research faculty, but placements need improvement.

detailed_review.Placements: Most B.Tech job offers come from non-core engineering, IT, and software roles. The average package is around 10-12 LPA, which is respectable but modest compared to top-tier IITs. High-paying roles above 25 LPA are fewer. The Placement Cell works actively to bring reputed companies, but industry connections are still developing. Most students from our Civil Engineering batch (2027) are now targeting non-core software roles because very few core civil companies visit the campus. Those companies do often offer comparatively low packages that many do not find satisfactory.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: When I joined in 2023, almost half of the campus was still under construction. Now, most of the work is complete. The campus infrastructure has significantly improved. Since facilities are newly built, we have access to modern amenities and well-designed, high-quality hostels. The classrooms are modern, and labs are equipped with state-of-the-art instruments. Crucially, the entire campus is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi access for all students, supporting both academic and research needs. The central library is well-stocked and fully digitized. Furthermore, the campus has excellent sports facilities and a modern mess dining hall.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty at IIT Tirupati is unarguably its strongest asset. Professors are young, highly motivated, and hold Ph. D.s from top international and national institutions. They are extremely knowledgeable and committed to research. They often encourage students to participate in ongoing projects. They are also highly approachable. They guide students not only academically but also personally. They help with internships and clarifying complex concepts with patience. Their willingness to help makes the environment feel almost like a family. Exams are mostly easy to pass, with many students studying just one night before the exam. However, scoring above a 9 GPA is quite difficult.
detailed_review.Other: To be honest, many students join newer IITs because their JEE Advanced rank might not have been sufficient for the older IITs. I join IIT Tirupati with the hopeful expectation of securing a top-tier placement. While my two years here are academically enriching, filled with excellent research opportunities and a supportive faculty. The placement outcome does not entirely meet the highest expectations set by the IIT tag. For me personally, the most fun part about college is the inter-IIT tournament and the annual fest of IIT Tirupati.

reviews.review_title: College created tons of memories.

detailed_review.Placements: Alumni's were working in leading positions with well-settled top packages. The packages arranged by the colleges range from INR 2.9 LPA to 5.8 LPA. Our college alumni got such offers and elevated to next level of careers with such experience only. Until now, the best package received by our discipline students was 8.3 LPA at Syngene as research analyst at 2023 placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's truly an environment that provided us the same with what we manifested before while during the initial stage of college days. A special department was appointed to find out and address the problems of the students. College created tons of memories with affordable charges.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers had a good soul, kind-hearted, ready to interact, and clarify the students' doubts. They had good thoughts about the students' success. They were too strict in filing complaints against the students when they were involved in any inter-disciplinary action.

reviews.review_title: Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Employment opportunities for students are exceedingly high, with nearly 95% of students getting placed in overseas multinational corporations with seamless placement processes. The average package is 16 LPA, with the highest being 40 LPA. Tata Motors, Jio Ltd., Google, Meta, and several others are the top recruiters and visit the campus for hiring. The college also offers internships every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on campus, and LAN is available in hostels. The labs are fully equipped and excellent. The library contains all types of books—over 2 lakh books. The food can be rated 2 out of 5; the medical and sports facilities are good. The few hostels provided for second-year students are not good. The rest of the hostels are good. The food is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and have very good experience. Our course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are very difficult on our campus, and we have to study more than enough to score well on the end-of-semester exams. So, overall, the faculty members are good and approachable.

reviews.review_title: My Review of this college.

detailed_review.Placements: A lot of students get placement here. The Placements of M.Sc. programmes at IIT are beneficial both in terms of salaries and work roles, given that jobs are offered at really high packages. The best known companies come and offer jobs. The internships are also being provided, and at the personal level, professors also guide students and keep them informed. The famous recruiters Tata Consultancy, Microsoft, Deloitte, HCL, Amazon, etc. Overall,90% of the batch got placed in good job packages. The highest offered salary was around 22 LPA. The average package offered around 6 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course gives overall knowledge of the area related to the course, and also gives an idea of the market we would be facing when we pass out. This is a good branch for Research, as you can decide what you like and then contact any professor. Hostel food and facilities are awesome. Like food quality is too good, there were always all options in the South and North Indian food. Breakfast is too good, all that you want is available. Dinner is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The faculty are highly educated with years of experience. It was a great time learning from such highly learned instructors. They would be willing to share nuggets of information and extra help whenever needed. They were very kind in dealing with the students. They would not force the students to study. We had enough freedom to choose the courses and timings also. Exams are held semester wise, where student has a few mandatory courses and a few electives available within the
department. One can also opt for courses of interest from different departments. Two Internal and one semester exam happen every 6 months.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Tirupati - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Students of the PG and PhD courses are eligible for placements after completing their coursework. In M.Tech, the highest package offered is around 40 LPA till now, and the lowest package offered is 18 LPA in CSE. 80% of students get placed. My plan is to go for a postdoctoral position abroad. Overall, placements are average here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and labs are good. Classrooms are also fine with a projector, etc. The library is big and has enough books. Hostel rooms are clean but not so big. Mess food is okay, sometimes good, and sometimes bad. The canteen is small but fine. Medical help is also available. A sports ground is also there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. They all are PhD holders. The course curriculum is relevant to industry needs. Besides, students have to prepare themselves as well. Each semester has 2 exams, i.e., mid-term and end-term. Students need to have at least 35% in order to pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has a very beautiful environment.

detailed_review.Placements: It has good placements, and many companies visit our college. It has good placement support. Many of my seniors are placed with regular training sessions and mock interviews. Many reputed companies visit our campus, and top MNCs also visit our campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has good and decent classrooms and neat and good hostels. It has a library with all types of books available, and the library has online support. We can read books online. It also has 24/7 lab support, so we can train ourselves.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good and well-educated professors. They are good at the subject. It has a good curriculum, and there are 3 exams: one in a semester, test 1, test 2, and an end-of-semester exam. These questions are based on real-life problems in the subject.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty members, placements are more or less good, and infrastructure is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Percentage of students placed is 13%. The highest package is 13 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and average package is 8 LPA - 9 LPA. Top recruiting companies are THC, Toshiba, ONGC, DRDO, Velo, and TI. Top roles offered are structural, environment, infrastructure design, R&D, and some software-related placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good and well-equipped with library, classrooms, lecture hall, Wi-Fi, canteen shops, stationery shops, etc. Hostel facilities are good like they have Wi-Fi, common room, gym, washing machines, water cooler, day canteen, and stationery shops. The quality of food they provide in the mess is awesome.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good and qualified as well but their knowledge delivery is not that good. Not 100% but I can say that they can interpret but cannot build the infrastructure. Exams are medium (not very hard and not very tough). Civil engineering at IIT Tirupati demonstrates solid opportunities in core department.
detailed_review.Other: This course has many government job scopes and we get to know things on practical basis. I think facilities they could improve like they don't have night canteen and like cycle shop they don't have but rest things are good as mentioned above.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Challenging college journey.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college placement staff took responsibility for identifying the students' interests and sharing job vacancies related to such sectors. Also, teachers help us in gaining skills in our interests, which leads to a successful career journey for all students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's a Hi-Tech campus, which would be a costly campus, for getting admission to various courses is not an easy thing. College infrastructure was well-constructed with extensive facilities. Students were more secure and protected on the college campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Only a limited number of faculty members were available for all the subjects. During the time of examinations and other speaking times, we were unable to reach them to clarify our doubts. They were so good at resolving the issues of the students every time.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Crisp review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Microsoft, Amazon, GEP, Versa Network, and Factset are some of the recruiters that take part in the drives. They stands for 18.5 LPA as their highest package, which would keep on varying throughout the year. Also, during the internships we may be able to get a stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are so aesthetic with vibrant looks, equipped with modern technologies. The modern technologies like digital classrooms, digital libraries, and air-conditioned laboratories. All the simulation projects are properly done under the proper guidance with the enhanced support.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are fully committed to doing their responsibilities and maintaining the consistent results of the students. As they push hard to concentrate and focus on their studies. They are mostly concerned about the students' examinations and results.

reviews.review_title: Chemical Engineering at IIT Tirupati.

detailed_review.Placements: 50% of students are placed in my course. The top recruiting companies are TCS and HPCL. The highest package so far is 32 LPA, and the lowest is 9 LPA. The top roles in the core sector. We are assigned to process engineering, while in the non-core sector, roles such as ML and AI engineer are offered. 20% of the students get internships in TCS and some core companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch. You get 24/7 Wi-Fi access anytime, anywhere. Labs are so good, it has well-developed a lot each student can access the lab and do practicals in the lab itself. We also have a computer lab for freshers. Hostels are also good, and while the food is average, there are many dhabas and hotels nearby from where we can order if we don’t like the hostel food. All medical facilities are free. We have two sports complexes with well-equipped courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly, and we can reach out to them anytime we want. The teaching quality is so good, and we are able to learn concepts in depth. The curriculum has been improved, and for our juniors, it is now one of the best for securing jobs and internships. It makes students industry-ready with minimal training. The end-semester exams are quite difficult and challenging, but they are what set us apart from other colleges. The pass percentage is 95%.

reviews.review_title: IIT Tirupati is a good college with a good environment.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80-85% of students get placed in our course. The highest salary package offered in our college is 45 LPA, and the average salary package is 14 LPA. The lowest salary package is 6 LPA. Companies like Aditya Birla, Tata, and PhonePe recruit students from our course. Every student gets internships in the 2nd or 3rd year through their hard work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available in our hostel include Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms are available in our college. A central library is also available on our campus, and books can be issued by students. The quality of food in the mess is average. There are three canteens on our campus, and the fast food is good. We have a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are highly qualified and helpful in every academic sense. They provide high-quality and industrial-relevant content. The course curriculum is somewhat outdated and is planned to be updated in the near future. Exams are held periodically that is 2 times in a semester. Exams are easy to pass.

reviews.review_title: Masters life at the college of IIT, Tirupati.

detailed_review.Placements: Students from all the departments go through the same placement training. We had undergone hectic competition, pressure to come in top position from the whole. Such training gave me the spirit to compete with anyone. The top packages secured by students from our department would be 17.62 LPA. The aim of the institution is to make students succeed in terms of placements and academics.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Top-notch meals are cooked and served everyday in the institute mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: Innovation and technology updation leads to success of IIT, Tirupati's educational standards. Faculty members are best in teaching fields. Most teachers keep on studying even now, but they won't encourage the students in extracurricular activities. The main focus of them is to make the students in getting the highest grades in exams.
detailed_review.Other: There are very minimal opportunities for us to concentrate on extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Sophisticated campus area.

detailed_review.Placements: Maximum probability of students getting hired in core companies like LG, Sony, Ericsson, and R&N. Most probably 80% to 85% of students got placed with multiple roles. I had attended four drives, and from it, I received two offers with package of 5.4 LPA and 3.1 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Friendly campus and gave me some hope, and confidence to achieve something in life. It's an enlarged green campus with separate blocks for all departments. We use campus bus, cycle, or bus to move from hostel to our classrooms. All departments are seperate from one another by following some set of rules.
detailed_review.Faculty: Mostly syllabus contains higher parts of equations and diagrammatic concepts but without any hurries, teachers complete the syllabus with better clarifications. There are fewer theoretical parts when compared to all other portions. After completing the MCQ test on completed portions they move on to the next part.

reviews.review_title: Course at college of IIT, Tirupati.

detailed_review.Placements: Not only the students, but the placement in-charges were also performing heavily to make their students get placed in various top companies. Mostly 75% of students got placed in the department of core sectors while others looked for opportunities in non-core sectors. Colleges arranged such opportunities for all kinds of students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Expertly designed laboratories with technological advanced assistance are appointed to take care of the lab areas. Most importantly, Wi-Fi facilities were available on the overall campus which would be accessible to students, staff, and workers. Libraries would be accessible to students using biometric process.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were experts in the subject portions and guided us in the proper way of writing the exams. They also guided us about how to present exam papers, key points, and other validating processes required for passing the exams with top grades with excellence.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college. It provided amazing placements in 2024.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement process is so smooth. Almost 95% of students got placed in multinational companies all over the world. The highest package is 40 LPA and the average package is 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Tata Motors, Jio Ltd, Google, Meta, etc., visit the college for placements. Internship opportunities are provided by the college every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Best-in-class infrastructure is available at IIT Tirupati. All types of amenities and large fully furnished rooms are available for students residing in the hostel. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus. It has a large sports stadium, medical departments, and e-classrooms with air-conditioning and water purifiers in the department.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here at IIT Tirupati are well experienced and their teaching quality is also very good. The course curriculum revolves around practical lessons at IIT Tirupati. Teachers teach all important concepts essential for the corporate world. Exams are tough and the questions are application-based. Students need proper practice before exams.
detailed_review.Other: Scholarships are available for students. The college organises events and fests every month.

reviews.review_title: It is an awesome college with a beautiful campus.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Tirupati recorded a 73% placement rate for its B.Tech CSE batch of 2024 as of May 21, 2024. The highest and average packages offered to B.Tech CSE students during IIT Tirupati placements in 2024 stood at 41.64 LPA and 10.57 LPA, respectively. Further, the highest and average packages offered to M.Tech CSE students during IIT Tirupati placements in 2024 stood at 14.42 LPA and 11.92 LPA, respectively. I didn't know much about placements, but I heard from my seniors that they were okay. More companies were coming, and my seniors mostly trying new ideas and thinking about startups. Our college encouraged startups, and there was a separate department with a great head.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Tirupati is spread across 548.3 acres of land and had a library, hostels, classrooms, and cafeterias. Some of the other campus facilities included. All classrooms were well-equipped with internet access, projectors, desktop computers, screens, and audio systems. To improve acoustics, appropriate treatments were applied. Additionally, a 120-seater virtual classroom was set up. The library was equipped with a library automation system with an Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC), which enabled the computerization of library operations. Labs were well-ventilated and had new, modern, state-of-the-art equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum was strong, faculty members were supportive, and placements were great, with excellent infrastructure. All faculty members were highly qualified and fully supportive. They cleared all our doubts at any time. They were very kind, punctual, and had a lot of experience.

reviews.review_title: College Review of Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati

detailed_review.Placements: Our batch is of 84 members, and we are studying in the first year. As per the seniors, the average package of the college was around 21 LPA, the minimum package was around 8 LPA, and the highest package was 45 LPA. Many companies come to the institute to hire students like Oracle, Google, Amazon, and Microsoft, and they also hire interns from our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is superb. The classrooms are very good, and the hostels are also very clean as they clean the rooms daily. The hostel food is eatable and hygienic. The quality of food is good, and we also have a good ground and equipment for sports. Medical facilities are also present on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty here is outstanding, with very good knowledge about the subjects they teach. They write many articles in research journals. They help us with our doubts in the subjects with live examples. The curriculum is good. It is designed by some expert professors, which helps us face the competitive world. The semester exams are tough, and the pass percentage is around 60 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I got this course because of my rank in JEE Advanced, and our course is very good, and there are no betterments required. As I am in IIT, the campus life is superb, and we do have many fests and clubs where you can join and learn many new things.

reviews.review_title: The fastest growing 3rd gen IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% students are getting placed. The highest package was 13 LPA, the least was 6 LPA, and the average was 8 LPA. MathWorks, Texas Instruments, Amazon, Samsung, Microsoft, L&T, Toshiba are some of the top recruiting companies that visited the college. 40% students choose to go for internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are diverse facilities offered here. There's a gym in 2 of the boys' hostels. High-speed Wi-Fi is present all over the campus 24x7. The classrooms look top-notch with various seating capacities. The library here is still developing. The mess food is good enough. There's a health center here that operates all the time with an ambulance at service. Presently, there's only one ground, but there'll be one more ground coming up in the next few years.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members for the course are highly experienced and qualified, not only in the subject but also in philosophy. They try their best to support us in learning the things. Every student is free to take the project under professors of their choice. There'll be exams every 5 weeks.
detailed_review.Other: The college organizes an annual techno-cultural fest, TIRUTSAVA, in the month of January. It's a 3-day fest and consists of various technical and literary events. Apart from that, there are several student clubs in the college like Sargam (music club), PFC (photography club), Xcite (dance club), Techmaniacs, Oratory Club, E-cell, and a lot more, which conduct various events on a regular basis.

reviews.review_title: Our college has provided good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85 to 90% of students in this college get placed every year. The highest salary package offered is 15 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. The top roles are electrical engineer and network engineer. The top recruiting companies are BHEL, NTPC, and Wipro. Around 70% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in our college is good. The facilities are good at our college. The classrooms are neatly maintained with comfortable benches for all students. The labs are well-equipped. The library is well-stocked with books. Wi-Fi facilities are also available. There is an absence of hostel facilities for both girls and boys.
detailed_review.Faculty: At this college, the teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. The teachers are student-friendly. They are experienced in their subjects and clarify our doubts. The course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are difficult. The pass percentage is 69%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Nothing nooooooooooooooooo.

detailed_review.Placements: IT Tirupati started its academic services in August 2015 from a temporary campus on Renigunta Road. So far, none of the batches have entered their final year to get placements. At the end of the sixth semester, every student is expected to do an internship. A placement cell was established in August 2017 to conduct all placement activities smoothly. Around 80% of students got internships. Many big companies offered internships to our students, such as Mahindra, Amara Raja, Tata, Isuzu, and Nvidia.

The faculty recruited for the first and second semesters are mostly from IIT Madras. Once the institute started recruiting its permanent faculty, there were some notable additions. The number of permanent faculty at our institute will surpass that of some second-generation IITs like Gandhinagar and Mandi by the end of the autumn semester of 2018. The professors are very well qualified with impressive profiles. Many teaching methods are used, such as web seminars and practical experience. The course curriculum is almost the same as that of IIT Madras, which is one of the best in the country.
detailed_review.Faculty: The Indian Institutes of Technology are the premier institutes in the country for technical education. In 2015, M.H.R.D., Government of India, started two new IITs. IIT Tirupati is one of them and is being mentored by IIT Madras. It currently operates from a location on Renigunta Road. There are two boys' hostels, one in Laksminagar and the other near Alipiri. The hostel facilities are excellent. The transit campus is expected to be ready before the convocation of the first batch.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Tirupati infrastructure has well-equipped classrooms with internet access, projectors, desktop computers, screens, and audio systems. To improve the acoustics, appropriate treatment has been done. Also, a 120-seater virtual classroom has been set up. It also has a library with a library automation system with an Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC), which has enabled computerising library operations. Its labs are well-ventilated and have new and modern state-of-the-art equipment. It also offers separate hostel accommodations for boys and girls.

The Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati (IIT Tirupati) is one of the new-generation IITs. It has rapidly built a reputation for offering a modern and sustainable campus infrastructure. Check the video below to learn more about IIT Tirupati infrastructure.

sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Campus Highlights
text: In 2015, the institute was established under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Started at Renigunta Road, the institute is now located in Yerpedu, near Tirupati. The campus has a scenic mountain backdrop and is spread over 530 acres of land. The campus follows global standards and environmental sustainability. IIT Tirupati infrastructure is synonymous with a learning ecosystem. The IIT Tirupati campus houses eight 60-seater classrooms and one 120-seater classroom, which were developed with the necessary furniture. A virtual classroom with a capacity of 120 students is also available for the students. It also features a health centre to cater to the medical needs of the students. On-call doctors are available in case of medical emergencies. The institute also has multiple clubs for recreational activities among the students. Some of them include Actomania, Nisarga, Neeti Bodh, PFC, Sahayog, etc.

IIT Tirupati has well-designed and equipped research centres, incubation labs, and collaboration hubs. These spaces encourage a research-driven learning culture. From renewable energy testing labs to High-tech equipment for nanotechnology and materials research, the institute has it all. Some of the key campus highlights of IIT Tirupati are tabulated below:

sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Hostel
text: IIT Tirupati has 6 multistoried hostel blocks for the students. The hostel rooms are allocated on a sharing basis. The hostels are separate for girls and boys, faculty, and staff members. IIT Tirupati hostels are spacious and have study areas, Wi-Fi, and round-the-clock water and electricity facilities. All the hostel rooms are equipped with basic furniture, such as chairs, study tables, cots, almirahs, drying stands, etc. For recreational purposes, each hostel block has a common room where the students have access to TVs, indoor board games, newspapers, and magazines . Hostels of IIT Tirupati are fully wifi enabled. It has a rooftop solar system for hot water, RO for purified drinking water, water coolers, washing machines, and other necessary facilities. The hostels are taken care of by student representatives and resident assistant wardens. They work under the guidance of the council of wardens.

IIT Tirupati also has a canteen, which offers students a variety of snacks, food items, and refreshments. It is located in the basement of hostel C . It also provided mess and dining facilities and provided hygienic food for the students, faculty, and staff members. The menu offers a number of dishes to cater to the diverse student community. Moreover, residential quarters are well arranged for faculty and staff, creating a close-knit community where students and teachers can interact beyond classrooms. sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Library
text: The Central Library at IIT Tirupati is a resource centre for learning. Owing to its premium facilities, the library received the Wiley Library Awards in 2019. It boasts a comprehensive collection of information resources, including print and electronic. It has implemented RFID technology to enhance the circulation system. The IIT Tirupati library is well-equipped with all the modern infrastructure to support the academic and research needs of the students. It has a dedicated reading space where students can focus on their research projects. IIT Tirupati library timings are 09.00 am to 12.00 am from Monday to Friday. During Saturday & semester breaks, the timings are 09.00 am to 07.00 pm , and on Sunday & public holidays, it is 09.00 am to 05.00 pm . Some of the library collections are given below:

sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Sports Facilities
text: Not only academics, but also physical fitness is a prime objective of the institute. Thus, IIT Tirupati offers outdoor and indoor sports facilities, along with a modern gymnasium and open-air theaters and auditoriums for cultural activities. The campus has grounds for cricket, football, athletics, and other outdoor sports. Courts for badminton, basketball, and table tennis are available on campus. IIT Tirupati has a high-tech multipurpose indoor complex for badminton, table tennis, chess, yoga, and gym. International standard basketball and tennis courts are also available. A turf pitch, cricket ground, and football ground, along with a standard athletic track for track and field events, are add-ons.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the IIT TirupatiCampus
text: Students residing on the IIT Tirupati campus can explore many nearby places. Perfect for a spiritual evening, students can visit Sri Venkateswara Temple and Srikalahasti Temple. Those who want to spend some time in the lap of nature can consider visiting Talakona Waterfall, Nagari Hills , and Swami Pushkarini Lake with their family and friends. For food, some of the famous destinations are Minerva Coffee Shop, Blue Fox, Sri Lakshmi Narayana Bhavan , and others.

Manipal University Jaipur was established in 2011 as a private university in Jaipur by the Manipal Education and Medical Group alongside sister institutes such as Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE, Karnataka), Manipal International University (Malaysia), and Sikkim Manipal University (Sikkim). Jaipur Manipal University has since received an A+ Grade accreditation from the NAAC. Manipal Jaipur is also recognised by the UGC.
MUJ Jaipur is highly ranked by national bodies such as NIRF 2025 which ranked Manipal University Jaipur under different categories. The university has been ranked at 58th position under the Engineering category by NIRF 2025. MUJ rankings have also been given by QS. As per the QS Sustainability Ranking 2026, the university has been ranked at the 1201-1250 position. The other recognitions for Manipal Jaipur courses include those from the NBA, AICTE, BCI, and the Council of Architecture. Manipal University Jaipur India provides courses in different fields of Engineering, Law, Management, Health Sciences, Arts, etc. The Manipal University Jaipur campus features all the necessary facilities for pursuing academic excellence but the university also provides distance and online learning programmes for students. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Quite a good university giving average placements, great infrastructure, and vibrant culture.

detailed_review.Placements: There have been companies like Deloitte, Dell, Amazon, and others for recruitment, with quite a good number of students being placed. Though you gotta put in your personal efforts if you want to get into any of the good roles. There has been an average package of around 8-10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Great and vibrant infrastructure with lots of amenities and activities. You have different messes with food that are better compared to other universities that I have known and heard of, and many facilities like a gym, sports like TT, billiards, basketball, football, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: To be honest, you have good and average teachers, not just here but everywhere. My personal opinion is that you need to put in your personal efforts and hard work alongside what's being taught while you take any professional course. The rest is all normal.
detailed_review.Other: You have different events and fests, technical, cultural, hybrid, and many more. You won't ever feel like you have missed something. Now and then, you will find some of the other festivals happening.

reviews.review_title: Very good infrastructure and very good amenities.

detailed_review.Placements: 50 percent of students were placed last year in my course. The lowest package is 2.5 LPA, and the highest package is nearly 5 LPA. Top recruiter companies are AU Bank, SBI Bank and other finance-related companies. Almost 80 percent of students get internships. Roles are cashier, Managerial, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every corner of our campus has Wi-Fi, and each course has its labs and a central library which has a seating capacity of nearly 500 students. The mess food is average, and the hostel amenities are good. The college has a small clinic for emergencies, and it has a ground for cricket, football, badminton, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are well qualified and have done Ph.D. in their fields. They teach very well. Every semester we have a mid-term exam, and then we have to give the end-term exam, and we have to give an assignment and presentation, and papers are set at a very good level.
detailed_review.Other: The college is near my house, and it has the course that I want to pursue. Placements are to be more. Language is to be easy. Every month we have functions and events, and once a year we have a big fest for 3 days, which is called Oneiros.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: If you have money then only come to this college, else no need.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement scenario in MUJ is overall quite good. In my course, around 90–94 percent of students get placed. The highest package ranges from 80–84 LPA, and the average is 8–9 LPA. Some of the top recruiters that visited our campus include Amazon, Dell, and Deloitte.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: MUJ has a modern and well-planned campus. Classrooms are smart and spacious, labs are well-equipped, and the library is excellent. The hostels are clean with good facilities, and the campus has great sports grounds and a vibrant environment. Opt for hostels if you want access to more sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: MUJ faculty is supportive and knowledgeable, though teaching quality varies by department. Exams are of moderate level, not too tough, not too easy. Continuous assessment, midterms, and end terms keep you consistent throughout the year. Here, exams are conducted on E-pad, not in pen-and-paper mode.

reviews.review_title: The college has very good infrastructure and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate at my college is average. About 20-25 percent of students got placements. Top recruiter companies are Amazon, Infosys, Accenture, etc. Many roles are offered, like software developer, app developer, website developer, data analyst, web programmer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities of our college are top-notch and have a beautiful infrastructure. They provide Wi-Fi hotspots, AC classrooms, a central library, 4-5 auditoriums, a cricket ground, a football ground, a running track, a badminton court, a basketball court, and many other sports facilities. We have a very good food court.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college has very well-educated faculty who have studied in reputed colleges and provide very good support with studies and any other issues. We have to take an exam for 1 semester first, the midterm exam, and second, the end-of-semester exam, and we have to submit assignments, projects, and presentations to the faculty.
detailed_review.Other: Campus is very beautiful and aesthetic, and events are happening every time, and Onerios is organised by the college, which is the biggest fest of the year.

reviews.review_title: This is a decent tier-2 college with average placements and great campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements in this college are average, though. For B.Tech CSE, the average package is 8 LPA-9 LPA, and also many students have been recruited by Infosys and TCS for low packages too. The highest package range is up to 35 LPA-40 LPA. The placement rate is good in this college, but the range of salaries varies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is too good but expensive compared to other colleges, and it has various food outlets in the college and hostel too. The sports facilities are really good, and there is also a great campus life in this college, as well as a hostel. I am really loving the campus life over here.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams are done on an iPad, not on paper, and the gadget causes problems many times. That's a drawback, apart from that, the syllabus is good compared to other universities, and exams are not that tough either, but I feel the syllabus is too much to handle within such a short duration.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested in biotech. This is really a good college for this course, and the faculty is good too. The college is too crowded this year, but it has a strong alumni network, too. This is a good college, but the fee is too much compared to other private colleges.

reviews.review_title: The college makes us industry-ready.

detailed_review.Learning Experience: The course covers all the topics related to being industry-ready. The university organizes many seminars to provide knowledge, there are many competitions organized for students, and many industry experts come for the lectures. The attendance policy is strict (75%), and the university provides good placement opportunities. The only con that the university has is its location.
detailed_review.Placements: College provides internship opportunities, but mainly they say to find it yourself, and the internship is mandatory. Currently, our placements season is in progress. Till now, 3 companies have come. The college has good placement opportunities. It depends on the students which package they can grab on the university side. They are doing their best.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. The lectures are 50 minutes long, and the syllabus is covered systematically. They don't hurry or waste time, and hurry in the end, the marks are divided into 3 parts: the CWS, midterm, and end term. CWS is the combination of a PowerPoint presentation, assignments, some quizzes, and classroom attention, which is for 30 marks, the midterm is of 30 marks, and the end term is 40 marks, but the paper is made of 80 marks. Whatever marks you get will be divided by 2, and not all the exams are on an E-pad.
detailed_review.Course Support: The course makes us industry-ready, covers all the topics, and the university supports us in the best way possible. It is easy to pass the exams but difficult to score. Overall, the course will boost your confidence as the classes are interactive.

reviews.review_title: Manipal University Jaipur is the upcoming premier Institution of India.

detailed_review.Placements: Overall decent placements. Department of Law placements have started, and several leading law firms and chambers have been pleased to offer internships to the students. Competitive as almost every student has done some co curricular activities. As of now, mostly off campus placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Excellent library and classrooms. Well equipped library with rare titles. There is a central library where you can get early sprint versions of very old books, which are practically extinct in the market. Well furnished athletic centers as well as well equipped gymnasium, football, basketball court, tennis court, swimming pool, table tennis, cricket ground, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exam questions are analytical. The semesters are short, only 4 months of classes, and in the 5th month, we have our end terms. Midterms carry 30 marks, and the end term carries 80 marks, downscaled to 40 when the final calculation is worked out, along with assignments of 30 marks each subject.
detailed_review.Other: Great faculty. Scholarships are provided, which can go upto a full waiver of tuition fees.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good college with some flaws.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 120 out of 150 were placed last year. The average salary is around 14 LPA as per as the documents I got last year. The highest salary is 1 crore, and average salary is 14.4 LPA for CSE alone, and 30 LPA for top 30% students. But for seniors the real average package is somewhere around 8 LPA - 9 LPA some say it's 6 LPA - 7 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College has excellent infrastructure especially if you are going to live in the hostel facility of college GHS. The college is not that big. It has a main building called as dome building with library in it for B.Tech and other branches. We have 4 other blocks and 2 messes in total with many cafeterias around the college university. We also have a cricket ground with basketball court, badminton, and tennis court along with a football area. The infrastructure is excellent, to be precise.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good for many courses. For some courses, they are just bad like university keeps on introducing new courses every year. So most of the time, no teacher in university knows any of them, so they just watch youtube videos just like us before teaching us. While talking about exams, they are not constant for every course like CSE and data science. The exams are the hardest for AI, IT, IoT, CCE, and ECE, they are medium to easy.

reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and good faculty!

detailed_review.Placements: 80-85% is the percentage of students getting placed in my course. The highest was above 50 LPA, and the lowest was, I think 20 LPA, according to the teachers. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Dell, Google, and Amazon. 95% of students got interships at Dell, Microsoft, etc. Top roles offered are cybersecurity, AI/ML, coding, and ethical hacking.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has air-conditioned classrooms. The college has Wi-Fi, good and big libraries, good faculty, really high-tech computers in labs, and a lot of food canteens available. The rooms are really good and feel very high-end. The food is good. There are two types of meals, and medical service is provided.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, helpful, and knowledgeable, and most of them are Ph.D. qualified. The course is very relevant, and it does make the students industry-ready. It's not really difficult, if you study nicely, you need at least 35-40% to pass the exam.
detailed_review.Other: It's a good alternative to B. Teach. The best thing about my course is that it teaches you everything about the internet and the web, which keeps it interesting. Everything is good; the campus is really good, with a great crowd, and really good fests and many extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Welcome to Manipal University.

detailed_review.Placements: I am not very clear about the number of students placed but it is around 93% in engineering for the year 2024. The average package was 9.5 LPA (as of 2024), and for the highest it was 88 LPA (as of 2024). Top recruiters included Microsoft, Amazon, Dell, Accenture, Intel, Adobe, Philips, Deloitte, and Capgemini. Not sure about the internship numbers but approximately 94% are from internships and placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the facilities are top-notch, you never feel missing your home, you get more than a vip college. It has a perfect campus, good Wi-Fi, clean and air-conditioned classrooms, more than 3 libraries, and well connectivity between hostel and college. Hostels are also pretty decent. We get Wi-Fi, decent mess food sometimes, due to excess crowd we have to wait last long to an hour. Medical facilities are also good. There is always an ambulance available 24X7 for the Manipal Hospital, Jaipur, for any serious issue. Both indoor and outdoor sports areas are given to us with a numerous variety of games including snooker, indoor football, table tennis, basketball court, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are pretty knowledgeable and polite with their subjects and loyal. They are able to clarify subjects, yet I would say the first year subjects are unnecessary for someone who has got CSE degree as I would study biology, chemistry, etc. Almost 80% of students pass the semester exams. The exams are pretty easy, last 2 weeks of preparation can give you more than 8 GPA.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had a great interest in CSE since my 9th class. Due to my family being in IT sector, I had an interest since childhood to get into computer industry. I think the best thing about my course is how easy they are when you know a little bit of it previously it's just some extension of that. The things to improve should include a focus on more practical than theoretical. We get 2 major events to celebrate per year, clubs, and many other minor events happen every week.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Manipal University, Jaipur.

detailed_review.Placements: There are only 2 batches of the course I am in (CCE), so the percentage of students is lower in my course. The highest package at MUJ is 85 LPA, with an average of 9.5 LPA, and the lowest is 3-3.5 LPA. Many reputed companies like Google, Amazon, etc., visit for placements. Internships are offered through the hard work done in clubs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is excellent. It is very large, and many facilities are available. The hostel is also good, with two messes. The food is very good, and there are some outlets. There is a recreational room where we can play table tennis and pool. There is a cricket turf and a football turf.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are more teachers than needed, but some teachers need to improve their teaching methods. The course is mostly relevant, although some subjects are not part of the curriculum. Semester exams are tough because some teachers don’t even provide the proper study materials.

reviews.review_title: It's a good college for students who are eager to find their career.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently studying B.Sc (hons. biotechnology). I am in second year now. For the freshers who are all coming here. You will know that placements after B.Sc are not that great. But this college gives you a great working place for your research-oriented skills, only if you are interested.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at MUJ (Manipal University Jaipur) is magnificent. The buildings give royal Rajasthan Mahal's look. Wi-Fi network is all around the campus. Labs are equipped with high-end equipments. The classrooms are air-conditioned with a projector. Library is open for 12 hours a day. You can get a variety of books out there. For sports like volleyball, basketball, tennis, a number of courts are built. A cricket ground is also being built now. So that's pretty great.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very knowledgeable. They will always help you if you try to reach out to them. You can also work with faculty members in the lab if you talk to them. The curriculum is planned according to recent needs in the industry. Semester exams are decent at a difficult level. You can pass the exams with good marks if you attend the classes regularly.
detailed_review.Other: We have our fest called Oneiros in the month of February every year, that's actually very great.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities. Great opportunities for growth.

detailed_review.Placements: Many people get internships from this course. Recently only many people went to Singapore for an internship. It's really great. It has many great opportunities since it is affiliated with TCS, Dell, and all. You can easily get any internships since they provide many.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is really great. The food is also good though some hygiene issues. Hostel life is really fun with one or another event always going on. Don't have many hardcore rules just mediocre. Medical is also good. Wi-Fi though is weak and power cuts are sometimes done. Overall, the hostel has a great vibe.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They have a practical approach and teach us to use real-life things. Semester exams are not that hard and you can easily get more than 8 CGPA. To pass, you only need 28/100 which is quite decent.

reviews.review_title: It has a good infrastructure but it needs to work on certain things.

detailed_review.Placements: Khaitan & Co is the top recruiting company in our course. Many students do internships at courts and firms. There is a placement cell in our course which helps students to find internships and placements. Some students do internships at tier 1 firms and get placements from them.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. Many facilities are provided like online research resources and free Wi-Fi. The library has most of the books and magazines. In the hostel, there are facilities like a laundry and there are many outlets. There is a basketball court and a sports room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful. They provide relevant materials for exams and solve student's doubts. Semester exams are moderate in nature but some teachers check papers in a strict way. Teachers also tell their experiences and tell us things that are relevant in the outside world.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am interested in it and I like subjects I study. I wish there were more practical subjects that would help students become job-ready. There is an annual fest which happens in February and students come from many different areas.

reviews.review_title: My private college experience.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently pursuing a BCA in Manipal starting from the 2023 batch and will finish it by 2026. The average salary package offered ranges from 4-6 LPA. Companies that offer jobs are Wipro, Deloitte, Cisco, etc. BCA students mainly get software developer roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities in the college are very good. All the necessary things are there in the college. The hostel is very good. It has all the essential facilities like a play area, mess, gym, and library so that students enjoy college life.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of the college are okay. They know everything about their domain but lack some teaching skills. They have to hire more professional professors so that students can understand things in a more efficient manner and progress. It provides a good job in future.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: For campus life and enjoyment, the college is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are average and depend on the students to determine if they will be placed or not. For engineering, last year's average package was 8 LPA, while the overall average package of the college was 6-7 LPA. Companies such as TCS and Amazon recruit Manipal students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and laboratories are fully air-conditioned, and the labs are well-managed. There are different buildings for various courses; for instance, the engineering building is separate from the law building. The food quality in the hostels is average or sometimes below average, but sports facilities are good within the hostel as well as on the college campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are generally helpful, though some may not be. They are qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is average, and not every teacher is effective. Semester exams are moderate and occasionally challenging. Currently, exams are conducted on e-pads, and it's not difficult to pass, as students generally achieve average results.
detailed_review.Other: The campus crowd is decent, but you need to find people who share your interests, as not everyone is good. Festivals and events occur regularly. Outside campus, you can visit stalls, and there are several shops where you can buy necessary items. Numerous scholarships are available, all listed on the official website.

reviews.review_title: Life at MUJ can be distracting.

detailed_review.Placements: Since a majority of students go for litigation or judiciary, only a few students sit for corporate placements. A majority of those students have completed a number of internships. A high number of students got placed with a good package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Law school has the newest academic block with air-conditioned classrooms, smart boards, clean hallways, a massive library with updated books both physical and electronic, and Wi-Fi access. The mess is clean and hygienic. MUJ has been awarded as the cleanest university in Rajasthan.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are friendly. However, most teachers are ongoing PhD students themselves. The course curriculum is very relevant to the latest trends. Since it is a private college, the competition and benchmark are low. Exams are easy and passing those exams is even easier.
detailed_review.Other: MUJ is a university, with various courses so the attention of directors is distributed. However, law school at our university knows how to bring attention to itself. There is versatility in students, some achieve a lot both in academics and cocurricular. However, it is a private university, so most people are only here to get a degree and enjoy it. It is up to students which crowd they want to be a part of. Life offered at MUJ is very great. Fests happen at a great level. The hostel life is happening. Faculty members are friendly. The campus provides students with a lot of opportunities.

reviews.review_title: College is good and I am satisfied.

detailed_review.Placements: I am doing my BBA from this college in online mode. There are more than 300 to 400 students. I am still doing my course and I have not had an opportunity yet, but I have researched this. The highest package is 15 LPA and average package is 9 LPA something and the lowest package is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This university is very good. I visited it once and found it clean and well maintained in all departments. The Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and library are all excellent. Anyone would love it.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and despite some online class challenges, the teaching quality is excellent. They offer both live classes and pre-recorded lectures and recorded lectures are available for every subject. If you don't understand a lecture another teacher provides a recap. It's a great advantage to learn from three different teachers and the exams are well-organized.

reviews.review_title: I think that management is a subject if you want to take admission in engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a fresher, so I'm not sure about the package. I guess it's around 7 LPA to 17 LPA. Usually, the top students are chosen by companies. If you maintain a good CGPA of above 9, do internships, and gain skills, you have a higher chances of getting selected.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I have heard that the hostel is very good, although the food provided is not of very good quality. A very big library with ample books, research papers, and theses is available. The library also accommodates computer desktops, helping students to use technology.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable, with Ph.D. holders having multiple research papers and theses to their names. The courses teach everything that is relevant to the industry. New inventions in our industry and the ongoing changes in the economic background of the country are all taught.

reviews.review_title: Perfect fit for all so go for it u will surely like it

detailed_review.Learning Experience: According to bachelors and that in commerce it?s perfectly fit for students as they are even giving placements too around 3/4 lakhs and faculty is well knowledges and interactive and cons is that fees is bit higher as compared to other colleges that is around 1 lakh per year

admission.title: MUJ Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: Manipal University Jaipur admission 2026 is both merit and entrance-based. The college offers various courses at the UG, PG, PhD, online and certificate levels. These include- BTech, BA, MA, MBA, etc. BTech and MBA are some of the most popular courses at Manipal University Jaipur.

faqs.question: What is the expected Manipal University CAT Cutoff 2025?
faqs.answer: As the Manipal University CAT Cutoff 2025 is not out yet, according to the Manipal University CAT Cutoff 2024, the qualifying cutoff was 25 percentile for General category candidates under the All India quota. The CAT cutoff for 2023 was also the same. So, going by the previous years' cutoff trends, the CAT Cutoff 2025 would fall around this level. Please note that this is just an estimation and the actual cutoff may vary.

faqs.question: How can I apply for BBA at Manipal University?
faqs.answer: Manipal University BBA application process is conducted online on the official website of the University. The BBA application forms for the academic year 2024 are released on the official website of Manipal University . Manipal University BBA application process is given below.

faqs.question: Can I join BTech at Manipal University, Jaipur without JEE Mains?
faqs.answer: Yes, Manipal University conduct Manipal entrance test (MET) every year for admission in B.Tech and other UG courses. and it does not accept the score of JEE mains.You can also get admission through CUET-UG in various courses and direct entry is also available for some courses. Candidates must have to meet the eligibility criteria set by the institute for the BTech programme.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for MCA at Manipal University?
faqs.answer: Candidates willing to secure admission at Manipal University Jaipur MCA can check the below table for detailed eligibility and selection criteria: Graduate in BCA/ BSc (Computer Science)/ BSc (IT) / BE/ BTech (CSE) / BE/ BTech (IT) or equivalent Degree. Or Any graduate preferably with Mathematics in class 12 and at Graduation level Obtained at least 50% marks (45% marks in case of candidates belonging to reserved category) in the qualifying examination.

faqs.question: What is the fees of Manipal University Jaipur for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee of the BTech programme at Manipal University ranges between INR 5.37 lakh - INR 16.40 lakh. The fee has a range because the BTech programme at Manipal Universitry Jaipur is also offered as a lateral entry programme and as this is the three-year course the tuition fee for this programme is comparatively less. The fee range mentioned above only consists the cost of tuition and does not include the mess fee or the hostel fee. The fee is taken from unofficial sources and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: How costly is studying at Manipal University?
faqs.answer: Manipal University offers undergradute and postgradute courses across various streams such as Engineering, Management, Science, Commerce, and others. The Manipal University fees has been mentioned:

faqs.question: What is the XAT 2025 exam date for admission to MBA course at Manipal University Jaipur?
faqs.answer: XAT 2025 was held on the first Sunday of January 2025, which was January 5. The exam dates had been officially announced by XLRI Jamshedpur on July 15, 2024, by the XATONLINE website. The exam was conducted in 72 cities from 2 pm to 5:30 pm. The registration process continued until the first week of December 2024.

faqs.question: When are Manipal University Jaipur application forms out?
faqs.answer: Manipal University Jaipur application forms are currently closed for all courses except BArch and MArch. Students should note that as the admissions depend on entrance exam scores or merit (Class 10 and 12 boards) the release of application forms should coincide with these two processes and check accordingly.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by Manipal University Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Manipal University Jaipur has an entrance test on courses like the BTech. The first exam is referred to as MET (Manipal Entrance Test). Applicants to the BTech programme are required to have a Class 12 pass of 60 percent aggregate or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as core subjects and Chemistry/Computers Science/ Biotechnology/Biology/ Statistics/ Engineering Drawing as optional subjects.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Manipal Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Manipal University Jaipur does not provide direct admission to all the courses. However it does provide direct admission to some of the courses such as BCA, BBA, BA, BCom. highlights.summary:
Manipal Institute of Technology is a private institute is located in Manipal. It is a constituent institute of the deemed university, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) in 2000, and was established in 1957. MIT MAHE is one of the first self-financing engineering institutes in India. MIT Manipal is sponsored by the Department of Science and Technology, CSIR, AICTE and the Ministry of Environmental Sciences for its research courses.
MIT MAHE offers UG and PG programmes in engineering, computer applications, and science. The flagship courses at MIT Manipal include BTech and MTech. The institute also provides the option to conduct full-time or part-time research.
The institute offers admission on the basis of the merit and the entrance exam scores for various programmes. MIT also offers placement assistance to the students. The highest package at MIT MAHE stood at INR 11.76 LPA during the recent placements. Further, the institute also offers scholarships to meritorious students.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Construction Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: Good course and facilities in college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are good compared to most colleges in India. The average stands at around 9LPA for all branches combined with computer related degrees getting higher packages. Majority of the students get placed or go for higher studies. The highest package stands at 54LPA offered by Microsoft currently. Students start getting internships through college or through personal connections. Some of them are paid internships and they usually receive about 10k as a stipend per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is well built at apt location. All mess hostels are inside the campus. The library is top notch strict & and resourceful. Classroom has E board laptop that can be connected to AC speakers are all good. Sports activities take place regularly. Many technical clubs that push students to do better and have better knowledge. Cultural clubs and music clubs collaborate with outside talents during fests.
detailed_review.Faculty: In my civil department there was a good faculty to student ratio. I am not aware of other departments. All the staff were either Ph.D. holders or were trying to get one. Thorough knowledge. The interactions were very peaceful. We could ask them anything anytime. Always helpful. The course was very effective. The course was revised a year ago when I joined. It was up to date. It helps us to deal with real world so many things I learnt are resonating with my job now. There were exams every 2 months.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Financial Technology
reviews.review_title: Really good college life and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85-90% of students get placed every year. For CS-related branches, placements often exceed 95%. Major recruiters include Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Deloitte, Accenture, Infosys, Bosch, etc. Common job roles include software engineers, data analysts, consultants, business analysts, etc. The highest package is 50-60 LPA, with an average of 11 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs are awesome, with modern infrastructure; everything is functional, and the classrooms are cozy. The library is very quiet and contains many books. For Wi-Fi access, you need the administrator's permission. To mention the canteens, it is such a pleasurable mess in Manipal. The food tastes, ohh, not like home but also not less than it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly. No doubt they will help you a lot when you need them. You just have to be respectful, and boom, they are always ready to help you. The curriculum is mostly outdated, somewhat between industry-ready and not. To mention the exams, they are tough. They are really tough.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the college course because I liked every part of it. Manipal provides the best college experience you could ever imagine in a private college. To be more precise about my course, I chose it because it was the only CSE course I was taking. Otherwise, I would have had to take ECE. I am loving it now. Campus life is fire. You would love it. Probably the best campus life in India, even better than IITs.

reviews.review_title: B.Tech in Aeronautical Engineering at MIT, MAHE, Manipal.

detailed_review.Placements: ABB, Altair Engineering, Aerx Labs, and Addverb Teach are mentioned recruiters in the field of aeronautical engineering. The mean package offered to aeronautical engineers is moderate, ranging from 5 to 7 LPA. The expected placement range is between 45 to 60%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college management is highly oriented with students' ideas. It makes easier for students to connect with them. The management is well aware of its crucial responsibilities. The college has good networking, which helps students connect with higher professionals easily.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members think from diverse perspectives because they are assigned a short period of time to cover the syllabus. Within such time, they ask us to write tests, teach lessons, and prepare students for examinations, which is usually a great deal for them.

reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, good curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement scene is quite good. Actually, once you get an internship, you are expected to work hard and convert that internship into a placement. However, placements are offered. Various companies come in the second year of M.Tech to offer placements. But yes, many companies prefer B.Tech over M.Tech. Salary range from about 4.2 Lacs PA to 7.5 Lacs PA. No. The college does not provide an internship. However, it facilitates internships which are offered by various companies such as Philips Lighting, Wipro, CG, etc. The stipend offered by these companies ranges between 15k and 20k per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One of the best sets of hostels available in the country. There are various lodging options such as single seater room, twin sharing room, single seater with common batch, attached bathroom, dormitory, etc. The rooms are well ventilated, airy and regularly maintained. The classroom has a centralised AC with a projector and board. Almost all books are there in the library, and a wide collection of journals. There are a lot of clubs, almost for everything. There is great exposure to the outside world as everything from sports to gym, from the garden to the lakes, is nearby on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very well qualified and motivated. Many teachers here are pursuing their PhD in the field of Illumination, which makes learning from them even better. The course on Energy Auditing, Lighting system design, Building automation systems, etc., are courses that you will not find in many other engineering colleges. You are loaded with assignments and submissions, presentations, mini projects, etc. The exam structure is a continuous evaluation with 50 marks for the semester evaluation and 50 marks for the end semester evaluation.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good opportunity for a great start.

detailed_review.Placements: I am studying at MIT, Manipal, ECE, in my first year. As of now, it is a great start, and I talked to many seniors, to summarize, I can say 90% placement in core streams. 99% placements in CSE, but it depends on your hard work, whether you are going in list of students who are not placed, and ample opportunities are given for higher studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I stay in hostel block 5, room is small, but comfortable and sufficient. Moreover, depending on how you study, you get a choice of rooms, like if you are studying really good you have plenty of options in rooms like AC, non-AC, single seater, double seater, triple seater. But if you are not studying good and your CGPA is low, you have fewer options in room or sometimes the worst option or even no options, but then all rooms are good, it depends upon your needs. There is free Wi-Fi too.
detailed_review.Faculty: All instructions are given clearly, and we also get a trial chance to do everything, like answering a question or doing something in the lab. Student-to-teacher ratio is great, such that we can spend even 2 hours with them in their cabins. We also have multiple teachers in same subject, so we have an option to go to whichever teacher we like to solve our doubts.  Whole syllabus is set in a way such that you need not go for extra coaching for GATE or other higher education entrance exams.
detailed_review.Other: Campus crowd is not a thing to worry about, if you have seen the crowd in VIT.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Information Security
reviews.review_title: Decent college with okay placements and basic facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from M.Tech Electronics batch of MIT. About 60% students were placed. Highest package was 12 LPA, lowest salary package was 3 LPA, and average package was around 5.5 LPA. Companies like Infosys, TCS, and Qualcomm came. 40% got internships at Wipro, Bosch, etc. Roles were mostly developer and analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our depth had good labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms with projectors. Library also had enough books. Hostel was okay-okay, the rooms were a little small. Food in mess was not so good, but canteen was better. Medical help was available, but slow. A sports ground was there, but not much equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful and knew things, but some did not teach well. Teaching quality is mixed. Syllabus was mostly relevant but not fully industry-type. Exams were a bit hard, need to study. Pass percent was around 75%. Some subjects were tough, some easy. It's quite good.
detailed_review.Other: I am from M.Tech Electronics batch. I chose this course because I like electronics and tech. Best part is lab work and some good teachers. But syllabus needs to be updated and include more projects. Fests happen, crowd is mixed, campus is fine. Need better Wi-Fi and more activities.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Construction Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: My honest review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements and job opportunities are pretty good, as much as compared to the best engineering colleges in India. The recruiting companies are Amazon, Microsoft, Google, GE, Yamaha, Honeywell, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, IBM, Maruti, Goldman Sachs, and many more. The packages for core roles go up to 18 LPA, the average is around 6 LPA, and MRCs offer around 3- 3.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are much better compared to other colleges, with the infrastructure and the kind of facilities provided. There are enough rooms to fit in all the students, plus all options all available, like single (AC/non-AC) and double (AC/non-AC). The mess food is good in terms of hygiene, but for obvious reasons, it becomes boring if you eat there every day.
detailed_review.Faculty: There is specialized faculty for every subject. Most of them have a Ph.D. or a minimum of a Master's in the subject they teach. The faculty is very much interested in helping students who are actually interested. Motivating and keen on students going into the research side and developing things rather than simply looking for jobs. The structure consists of a total of 100 marks per subject in a semester. The first sessional is 20 marks, the second sessional is 20 marks, and again, 5 assignment tests (2 marks each) for 10 marks. The semester examination is of 50 marks. This is the structure for every theory subject in all semesters. The course structure is good enough in terms of understanding the concept, but it is not up to the mark when it comes to focusing on research. The selection of electives is based on the CGPA, and students with higher CGPAs usually fill the seats for more preferred electives.

reviews.review_title: Overall good if you have money and want to have the time of your life.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch has 250 students. Top companies visit are Goldman Sachs and Microsoft but very few are selected even for internships. I do not have any idea about the lowest but the highest don't cross more than 30 LPA median somewhere lies about 10 LPA a very small percentage around 10% or 20% of students got internships.
