reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: Great infrastructure and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year was the first outgoing batch of my branch, and to my knowledge, 60-65% were placed. The highest package was around 35 LPA. The top recruiters were TCS and Infosys. Around 30% got internships in companies like Amazon, Nvidia, etc. Top roles were AI developers or software developers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Multiple labs with fast Wi-Fi for various subjects. Spacious classrooms and also all lectures are recorded. The food they give is a bit bland, but it is balanced and has many meal facilities with different types of food available. Hostel rooms are good with regular maintenance. Various sports facilities, including football, basketball, cricket grounds, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and skillful at what they teach and help students individually if needed. Provide important materials and external sources to learn from. Course curriculum is designed to cater to the current world requirements and technologies. The sem exams are application-based and test your fundamentals of the subject.

reviews.review_title: Overall, decent college with good infrastructure and bad placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 32% of the mechanical branch intake is placed while around 51% of total students are placed. The highest package is around 60 LPA, the lowest is around 1 LPA, and the average package is around 20 LPA. Top recruiters are Honeywell, Deloitte, Microsoft, JPMorgan, etc. Top role of any student is class representative in a branch, whereas in a student club the top position is on the board of members.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are air-conditioned with Wi-Fi. 5 academic blocks are present, all with air-conditioned classrooms. Most labs are air-conditioned apart from mechanical and chemical. Hostel facilities are above average, depending on your rank in MET hostel is allotted in grounds, if you have a good rank, you get to choose better hostel blocks i.e. single rooms with AC, certain blocks have an elevator 11-story means blocks. Wide variety of mess options to choose from, menu in each mess varies daily or weekly. I would recommend opting for the mess run by TIK. Sports facilities are plenty, Arena has the best facilities but you have to pay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are good and experienced, some are approachable. Most have PhDs. Course Curriculum is relevant and up to date. Credits are allotted based on the program, around 40-50 credits per year. Students are made industry-ready by the course and are exposed to much learning by student clubs and especially student projects like TMR, Formula Manipal, RoboManipal, MRM, ThrustMIT, and AeroMit to name a few. Semester exams in 1st year are the same for all, the ease of exams depends on your prep in 11th and 12th and your ability to self-study. Pass percentage is around 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical engineering at MIT as it seemed like one of the most up-to-date colleges when it comes to mechanical engineering and also because of the proximity of the college to my hometown. College has its fair share of vice, like drug use, alcohol abuse, etc., and not much strict action is taken. Also, PDA is very much allowed anywhere on campus and even in classrooms. Fests on campus are held frequently and to a large extent. Participation is in large numbers. The scholarship is availed based on MET rank and CGPA in subsequent years, so maintain your grades. Lots of extracurricular activities are conducted. I would say this is the best college for it.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Digital Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really a good engineering college .

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80-90 percent of students were placed in our course in my session. The highest package offered in our course was 24 LPA. The average package offered in our course was 7 LPA. Top Recruiting Companies were Amazon, Jio, Bharati Airtel etc. Top Roles were Engineering, Product Design etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: They provide us world class laboratories, innovation centre to facilitate multiple disciplinary research. Library was available in the college and have excellent references resources. Full Wi-Fi campus available in the college. The quality of facilities available in the hostel was good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors were helpful qualified and knowledgeable in their own fields of study. Course curriculum was relevant. Students were become ready for industry jobs. Semester examination of the college was quite tough. The passing marks was 40 percent.

reviews.course: Discontinued(AUG 2025)- B.Tech. in Computer and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: MIT Manipal- a complete review of academics, hostel, and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, taking into account the recession happening, placements are pretty decent. Around 65 percent of the total students who applied are placed, with the percentage being higher in CS branches. The highest package is not officially released for this year, but it is said to be 52 LPA from Microsoft, offered to students from CCE. The average for overall branches is around 9 LPA, and for CS branches, it is 13 LPA. Companies like BlackRock also take students for internships, which are not counted in the percentage.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I'm staying in a non-attached, non-AC room. Cleanliness is very good, and it's peaceful. Toilets are cleaned once every day. Rooms are cleaned once every two days or more if we request. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hostel, with a constant speed of 15 Mbps. Classrooms are equipped with projectors, blackboards, whiteboards, AC, podiums, and so on. The library is easily accessible to any student with an ID card. Mess food is very clean and hygienic, but you do get tired of it after some time. Still, there's a ton of variety.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are good, but there are some bad ones as well, as in any college. The course curriculum is the same for all first years. Honestly, it's not very relevant since everyone is made to study subjects like Biology, Chemistry, and EVS. But, some other subjects like electronics, electrical, and math are very much relevant for all students. There are two exams each semester, along with numerous quizzes and assignments. Semester exams are not too hard if you prepare 1-2 weeks in advance.
detailed_review.Other: I am always interested in microcontrollers, signaling, and so on, which is why I chose Computer and Communication. The course is very interesting from the second year onwards. The campus crowd is decent, with all types of people. You just have to find your type. Lots of student projects, student clubs, and student projects are funded by the college. Campus life is one of the best in India for sure, with absolutely no restrictions. There are lots of hotels, restaurants, bars, clubs, beaches, pubs, malls, etc., nearby. The in-time for first years is 10 PM (10:30 PM for hostels), and for the second year, it is 11 PM (11:30 PM for hostels).

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered was 32 LPA, and the median salary offered was 7.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course were Nvidia, Qualcomm, MediaTek, etc. Some of them were got internship offers also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were sufficient for research and knowledge. Today's essential facilities like Wi-Fi and a library were available in the college. The quality of facilities in the hostel was also good. A sports ground was available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. But, remember since we were master's students, it was important to make a good relationship with professors for project approval. The course curriculum was relevant, and students were make on many real-life projects. The semester examinations were a little hard.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of the good infrastructure and technology.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50 out of 80 students in total sit for placements, and around 67% of them are now placed in various companies. The median salary is around 7 LPA. The lowest package offered is 6 LPA, and many others are going for higher studies with recommendations from the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college hostel and infrastructure, like the food courts, football ground, and cricket grounds, are very nice and comfortable. There is a huge library open from morning till night at 11:30, along with group study halls. The campus also has a place called Student Plaza for socializing.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are all conducted on an E-pad (like an iPad) to be more environmentally friendly, and exams are pretty competitive. All teachers have a Ph.D. and are well-trained. Exams are moderate to hard in terms of difficulty. Lab exams are also important.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is very student-friendly with diverse student backgrounds.

reviews.review_title: A great college for socialists.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage is about 60–70%, with the highest placement package at around 50 LPA and the average package at 10.49 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Qualcomm, and many others. Multiple internship opportunities are present during the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th years, along with projects.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure for Mechatronics are decent and growing, as it is a relatively new branch. Labs are well-equipped, classrooms are neat and well-ventilated, and there is a huge library with access to the required knowledge. Wi-Fi access is given to each student, along with a learner ID through which they can use all amenities, including online ones like Grammarly and others. Plenty of sports amenities are also present.
detailed_review.Other: Multiple student clubs such as drama clubs, dance clubs, some related to theatre-related clubs, art clubs, music clubs, and others. Student projects are also available for students to enroll in. These clubs help build portfolios.

reviews.course: Discontinued(AUG 2025)- B.Tech. in Data Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Manipal Institute of Technology, MAHE provides fun learning for students.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90% of students get placed just through campus in my branch, and the remaining got it from outside or went for masters. The highest package is 43 LPA and the average package is 16 LPA. Microsoft is one of the top recruiting companies of our course. Around 20% of students got internships. Business or data analyst roles are offered to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities of MAHE are world-class. Labs have systems that can run a company if we have manpower. The food is good as it actually has options for all the people no matter where they come from in India. The mess serves 4 meals a day.
detailed_review.Faculty: The student-teacher ratio is very good. If we have interest then teachers can be like our big siblings throughout the whole college. The data science branch has subjects pertaining to statistics which plays a major role in the field. Exams are relatively easy but the frequency of exams is very high.
detailed_review.Other: Extracurricular activities are also amazing.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Construction Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: Very satisfied because of facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students who were placed in my course was 60 percent. The highest package was 12 LPA, the average package was 8 LPA, and the lowest package was 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies were TCS, Tech Mahindra, and Infosys. Many students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our department were very satisfying. Classrooms and labs were clean and comfortable. The campus was very environment-friendly. All the required resources were present in the well-stocked library. Mess and cooking arrangements were hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very qualified and knowledgeable. All faculty members and staff were very cooperative and supportive. The teaching quality was good. Our course curriculum was relevant and it made students industry-ready. The semester exams were quite difficult.

reviews.course: Discontinued(AUG 2025)- B.Tech. in Data Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very dissatisfied because the campus is hygienic.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 45% of students got placed in our course. The highest package was 7 lacs and the average package was 5 lacs and the lowest package was 4 lacs. Very few companies recruit in our college and few students also got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Washrooms and hostel rooms are very dirty and hygienic. No proper water supply or ventilation. Wi-Fi does not work properly. Classrooms and labs are average. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not tasty. Very limited medical and sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not so qualified and skilled. The teaching quality is nice. All the faculty members and college staff are rude and unhelpful. Our course is not curriculum-relevant because the college does not conduct such types of activities. The semester exams are quite hard.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Construction Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: Manipal Institute of Technology is for higher education.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements of our college in my course are outstanding. The best offers are provided in the computer science branch. The highest package offered in our course is 32 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Larsen & Turbo, Reliance Construction, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Other facilities like Wi-Fi and the library are available in the college. Digital Classrooms are present. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good. Sports and games are held in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff members of our college are good. They are helpful, qualified, knowledgeable, and experienced. The teaching quality of our college faculty members is great. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students ready for the industry. Semester exams are medium.

reviews.review_title: B.Tech Mechanical in MIT Manipal.

detailed_review.Placements: Mechanical placements are decent, with companies like Bosch offering 13 LPA. Offers, but the highest offers are mostly off-campus in non-tech consulting analyst roles. The highest package for non-tech roles, such as Amazon, is 25 LPA. In core mechanical, it ranges from 10 LPA to 15 LPA, with 4 LPA to 5 LPA being on the lower end.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good, with a wide range of hostels available, from AC to non-AC, shared to non-shared, and deluxe rooms as well. There are also quite a few messes with decent food quality and good hygiene. Wi-Fi is slightly on the lower side, but the gym facilities are top-notch, with the arena being the best.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-qualified, though they can be boring sometimes, and you'll learn mostly outside classrooms in college clubs and student projects. Mechanical exams can be slightly tougher compared to CS branches, and the average CGPA is also lower. The mechanical course is quickly becoming irrelevant, but industry internships help.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd and exposure are immaculate, with a very diverse set of people from all around the globe. Very good learning culture with zero ragging. Fests also happen on a very big scale, and there are many beautiful places to visit nearby the campus on weekends.

highlights.summary:
Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology Gorakhpur was established in 2013. It was earlier known as Madan Mohan Malaviya Engineering College. It is a state university and is accredited with NAAC 'A' grade becoming the first state university in UP to get this grade from NAAC.
MMMUT Gorakhpur is approved by UGC of India, registered under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. Additionally, it is an AICTE-approved institution and secured top 100 ranking in the Engineering, University, and State Public University categories of NIRF 2024. The university has signed numerous MoUs nationally and internationally, improving opportunities for learning and research.
MMMUT Gorakhpur courses include BSc, BTech, MSc, MTech, and PhD in various Engineering, Mathematical Sciences, Science, and others. MMMUT Gorakhpur admissions are mainly entrance-based and the university accepts UPSEE, JEE Main, GATE, etc. The MMMUT Gorakhpur fees for BTech/ BE and MTech programmes is around INR 2.4 lakh to INR 6 lakh. The university also encourages financially and categorically backward students with several scholarships to promote equal opportunities.
Madan Mohan Malaviya University Gorakhpur Placements are conducted by the university's Placement Cell. The highest and average packages stood at INR 48 LPA and INR 7 LPA, respectively. The university has a library, auditorium, seminar or conference halls, guest houses, internet & Wi-Fi, hostels, and canteen. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Tier 3 college-wise, it is good and improving.

detailed_review.Placements: 80-85 percent of students are placed in the CSE department. The highest package is 55 LPA, which is off-campus. The average package of on-campus placement is 6  LPA. The lowest package offered is of 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, IBM, Cognizant, TCS (Tata Consultancy Services), and Infosys. 75 percent of students got internships from my course, they did internships in TCS, Wipro Technologies, and Infosys. The top roles offered are Software Engineer and Cyber Security Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the CSE department is good. The hostels are average, but they are big in size and contain a ground in between. Wi-Fi is provided both in the department and the hostel. Classrooms are better and newly made with air conditioning. The library has a vast collection of books, but it's not 24/7. The mess food provided is average. The mess fees are Rs. 18,000 for six months, and the hostel fees are Rs. 30,000 per year. There is a medical facility, but they don't have many medicines. You must go outside for a better curve. There are nearly all sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are well educated and qualified, some of them are helpful, and some are not. The teaching quality is average. The course curriculum is relevant because, as a CSE student in the first year, I am studying Physics and Chemistry, which, in my opinion, will not contribute to my subject. The semester exams are not tough, all we need to do is solve PYQ's. The passing percentage is 40 percent overall, and you must also get more than 15 marks in 50 in semester end examination to pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course based on the trends of today's era and my interests. This course is useful in the AI era. Various events are occurring throughout the year. There are two fests, one is a cultural fest named Heats, and the second is a technical fest named Techsrijan. The connectivity is very good, you have all the modes of transport available. The campus is surrounded by a jungle on one side. No specific Scholarship by the college. There are the UP scholarship and the private scholarships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Not much dissatisfied but overall experience is okay. A good decent college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement in 2021 is 100 percent. The companies that come for placement were Cummins Wheel India. Ltd Flipkart etc. The lowest package for placement is 1.6LPA. The highest role for the placement was Jr. Engineer. Some student got their dream job as they required.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our hostels are okay, but the mess food is average, as no one can compare it with home food. Wi-Fi is 24hrs classrooms are Centralized AC library is the 3rd the biggest in UP. Medical facilities are available, as a dispensary is there, and sports facilities are also available. Hostel rooms are about 4 persons in 1 room, plus bathrooms are clean, 4 times meal in a day. All includes under 18000 rupees in 6 months and hostel is 30000 for a year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, but since this is a hostel environment, you mostly have to study on your own. faqs.question: What is the seat intake for MBA at MMMUT Gorakhpur?
faqs.answer: At MMMUT, students can study a two-year MBA course. This  course is affiliated with AKTU and taught by the Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology (MMMUT) respectively. The total seat intake for MMMUT MBA courses is 75. Admission in this course is given on the basis of CUET (PG) score or Malaviya Entrance Test (MET) which is conducted by MMMUT itself. There are some eligibility criterias also to get admissionn into this which includes  that the candidate should have passed  from the recognised Bachelor’s degree of minimum three years duration from any University of India as recognised by UGC with at least 50% marks (45% in case of candidates belonging to SC/ST category).

faqs.question: Can I join MMMUT Gorakhpur directly?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission in MMMUT is not possible. This autonomous university give admission on the basis of scores obtained in entrance examinations. All the seats of B.Tech is filled on the basis of JEE Main score, for BBA and B.Pharm you have to qualify CUET UG, to get admission in all the PG courses except M.Tech you should qualify CUET PG, and for M.Tech, admissions are given on the basis of GATE or Malaviya Entrance Test (MET) score. After entrance examination subsequent rounds of online counselling is done so as to get branch accordingly your rank secured . According to the rank obtained by the student, the seat is allotted without any biasing. Thus, you have to work hard to get into MMMUT Gorakhpur.

faqs.question: How to get a seat in Madan Mohan Malviya University of Technology for MBA?
faqs.answer: MBA seats offered by Madan Mohan Malviya University of Technology are allocated via a university-level counselling process. To be able to take part in counselling, students must fulfil the eligibility criteria and have a valid score in CAT/CMAT/CUET PG. Moreover, students must apply for a preferred MBA course at the university's official website.

highlights.summary:
The Government of India's Department of Space established IIST Trivandrum in 2007 as an autonomous body. It is deemed-to-be-University and offers full-time BTech, MTech, MSc, and dual-degree courses at UG and PG levels in Aerospace Engineering, Earth & Space Sciences, Physics, Avionics, and others. It also offers PhD through its various departments.
Dr APJ Abdul Kalam was the first Chancellor of the university. Professor U.R Rao, renowned space scientis and former ISRO chairman is the second chancellor. The university has multiple MoUs with international universities and organisations. These include University of Caltech, the University of Cambridge, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, Danish Aerospace Company, etc. The major highlights of IIST Trivandrum are as below:
Check out more on IIST - Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology Highlights in the below videos:

college_info_program.intro:
IIST Trivandrum comprises 7 departments, including the Department of Aerospace Engineering, the Department of Avionics, and the Department of Physics, among others. Through its departments, IIST offers various UG, PG, and PhD courses.
The BTech and MTech programmes offered at IIST are very popular among the students. IIST Trivandrum offers two, four-year BTech programmes: Aerospace Engineering, and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Apart from this, IIST offers postgraduate programmes in fifteen areas of space science, space engineering and others. The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of space engineering and technology. IIST also provides its students with the opportunity to work extensively in specialised areas of research in collaboration with different ISRO centres.

IIST Trivandrum Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied if you like the subject with really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Mainly, ISRO offers placements until 2024. After the bond between college and ISRO reached its peak, it fell down. Now this is the first year of placements after the bond reached its peak; as of now, only 34 were selected out of 62 in ISRO, and others were placed in other startups ranging from 8-38 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College is one of the best in student-faculty ratio at 7:1 and the space lab constitutes students to do projects with the guidance of professors without any restriction of CGPA scored. The hostels are spacious enough for one and the food is obviously like any college food that will be average .
detailed_review.Faculty: Obviously helpful courses were taught in the course curriculum as real-life experience projects were also given under assignments and as a premium institute, semester exams are tough because it requires the accuracy in this field of work. The pass percentage is quite a bit low .
detailed_review.Other: We have a technical fest, concsentia and a cultural fest, Dhanak, to showcase talent beyond studies and I chose this course because of my love towards ISRO.

reviews.review_title: Best placements for 2025 .

detailed_review.Placements: ISRO recruits most of the students, and all others are recruited by top companies like Texas Instruments, etc. Along with that, many startups come here. The highest package of the passing out batch of 2025 is about 38 LPA. There are many startups from the college that are offering jobs to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi service is available in all hostels with centralized AC classrooms. There are various sports facilities like badminton, cricket, football, squash, table tennis, chess, carrom, basketball, volleyball, etc. available. There is also a gym with various equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors are excellent, and their way of teaching is amazing. All the professors are Ph.D. holders and are from different IITs and IISc. Along with that, the teaching assistants are very good as they help you in every possible way with labs and courses.
detailed_review.Other: For aerospace engineering, this is an excellent college as you will get various opportunities for learning about it and doing research.

reviews.course: Discontinue (Apr 2022) - B.Tech + M.Tech in Optical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied and happy.

detailed_review.Placements: 100 percent placement till now due to ISRO. Around an 8 LPA package. Till now, only ISRO is the major recruiter. Everyone got internships, mainly in ISRO centers or IIST itself. Roles include optical engineer and various other roles such as system designer, tester, and laser technician.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, classrooms, and library are all good and present and are really at the top. The library is state of the art, only needing some power backup. Hostel quality is good but very far from the city. The mess food is good and can’t be complained about. They also keep changing the menu regularly.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, all teachers are good and qualified. They teach well and concentrate more on understanding than marks. Yes, the course helps in making students industry-ready and helps us learn the standard software. Semester exams are challenging enough, with around a 90 percent pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: Very good college. Teaches how to live, not only academics.

reviews.review_title: IIST - Unique or just another IIT?

detailed_review.Placements: One of the main reasons students select this college, other than research, is ISRO placements. Every year, more than 60% of students in the whole batch get placed in ISRO if they meet the requirement of a 7.5 CGPA till the 8th semester. The ISRO interview is generally taken during the 6th semester, in which students must have a CGPA of 7 on a scale of 10. Other than ISRO, other core and non-core companies also visit.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since the college started in 2007, hostels have been pretty new and always clean. Since it's not a very populated college, you will always find it calm and peaceful here. In the first year, one has to share a room with 2 other batchmates, which turns into 2 people per room from the 2nd year onwards.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good, except for some. They are well-qualified and often explain the subjects well. The curriculum is not difficult but not easy either. You will be grinded for the whole semester with assignments, quizzes, labs, and practicals. Now, quizzes have changed to mid-sems, but still, it's not that easy. Exams are of moderate level, and it's relatively graded.
detailed_review.Other: The only reason I chose this course was because of Aerospace and ISRO.

reviews.review_title: A good institute for study and research.

detailed_review.Placements:
You can get placed directly in the ISRO organization in IIST after completing your course. Criteria required by ISRO organization to recruit the IIST students. 
1. You have to attain a CGPA greater than 7.5 at the end of your course. 
2. Maintain the proper discipline throughout the college year; you are going to be placed in a country space organization at the end of your college life, so for that you have to make yourself better to that extent. Information regarding placement. 
1. There are 75 seats in our batch (aerospace); from the seniors and the data I got, more than 40 students were able to get the ISRO job by the ISRO organization. 
2. For ECE and engineering students, the number is about the same extent. 
3. Companies that were visited in previous years other than ISRO: Agnikul Cosmos, TATA Consultancy Service, TATA Elxsi, Artificial Brain, Mercedes Benz, Infosys, and many more. About the package offered:
1. The highest salary package offered last year in the aerospace course is around 13 LPA, and for ECE, the number is around 23 LPA. 
2. Median is around 10.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
1. The infrastructure is really good; the college was set up in 2007, so you can imagine how new the department buildings are:
2. Personally, I am amazed after seeing the lab facilities in IIST. There are more than 30 labs in IIST that are well-functioning. You will find one or two Ph.D. students working in the labs always. (for example, we have a space lab in our college. I personally visited that lab and did some work also. 
3. Talking about other facilities, classrooms are very nice (having AC and a digital projector along with a big blackboard). Sitting chairs in classrooms are very comfortable. 
4. The library is good; you will get the option to issue the books also (min. 6 in a month). One thing that I don't like is the losing and opening time of the library; actually, it is 8:15 am to 9:00 pm, and I always thought, why is it not 24/7 like one can get the mood of study anytime, right (and I am not joking; I am serious; don't laugh).
5. Wi-Fi is very good throughout the campus with a decent speed. 
6. Talking about the hostel room, it is well painted, has three beds, and has three almirahs along with a table and chair. So, rooms are really good. 
7. Mess food is okay; personally, I'm from the northern part of India. So, I have the taste problem. It does not mean it is not good; you will get the variety and also the quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really good, well knowledgeable, and qualified. Apart from the professors, there are two assistant teachers in every subject. So, one can get help from the TAs also about the academic problem. You will get the tutorial from time to time, not in every subject, but, yeah, in core subjects you will get it. Talking about the semester exams, it is not that difficult; one can easily get a good CGPA after focusing in the class and giving two hours daily to study. The problem one can face is in core subjects. You have to do hard work to get a good CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because I am interested in space science and wanted to work in ISRO. About the campus life, I will say it is a little bit boring, although we have different fests, such as Conscientia, Dhanak, and events like Konchords Night, but still the social life is boring. The reason I can say it is a research organization is that the institution focuses on the research and study.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college in terms of education.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80% of students got placed in the last year's batch. A few students choose to study further. The main recruiter is ISRO, so there are no highest package criteria. Along with ISRO, there are a few other companies like Skyroot and Agnikul Cosmos. Everyone got internship offers in ISRO and a few other companies and institutions.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Apart from sports facilities, all facilities are available like labs, classrooms, a library, etc. The hostel facilities are good. The quality of the food is good. The taste is not good. I don't know what the staff says. It's South Indian food. I am a South Indian but I don't like the food. Medical facilities are good. There is only one small canteen in the entire campus. It is open only from 8 AM - 11 PM. It is difficult to find a canteen facility during exam time, so we need a night canteen.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified and exams conducted by them also little challenging.Frome 2024 they made few changes is curriculum..they kept few credits for extra curricular activities it's good thing for future students.academics wise no complaint. IIST Is mainly focused on academics so study wise no problem
detailed_review.Other: Since my childhood, I wanted to be a scientist, so I chose this course. The easiest way to join ISRO is IIST, so I opted for this college. Sports facilities are good. The crowd in our college is very small. Due to less crowd, a few problems arise during college fests and events. Our college is far from the city. We have to depend on KSRTC. The connectivity is the main issue. Extracurricular activities are not supported by our college management. I am from a dance club IIST. There is no support from the management. We ask for permission for everything that we require.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: Our college is good for students who have an interest in space science.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest salary package offered in the avionics course in 2024 is 23 LPA. The highest salary package offered in the aerospace course is 13 LPA. The average salary package offered in the avionics course is 13 LPA. The average salary package offered in the aerospace course is around 6 LPA - 8 LPA. I don't know much about engineering and physics. I don't think it has much scope from here. If students are coming here, come only for knowledge, not to seek jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If students want to work in labs, this place is a heaven. Hostels aren't top-notch but they are better than NITs. Wi-Fi has restrictions for games and some websites like other institutes. The mess is not good. It does not provide good food like other colleges.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very helpful. If students are enthusiastic about knowledge, this is the best institution. The curriculum is very difficult. Exams are difficult. Most of the work is lab-based so students can get industry-ready. The only bad thing here is the attendance. The attendance percentage is 80%.

reviews.review_title: Learning and enduring platform.

detailed_review.Placements: The recruitment drive is not that strong, and mostly off-campus students get placed. The highest package offered was 10 lakhs per annum, and the lowest was 3 lakhs. However, there are good internship opportunities related to projects that students get, and generally research-related roles are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department is huge. We have various types of labs for experiments and research. We have a library and the hostel also provides us with basic amenities. The medical care and help are also available. The food is hygienic and taste may depend upon individual choices.
detailed_review.Faculty: Specialization options are provided to students and accordingly, the curriculum focuses on building the chosen area knowledge in depth. There are various seminars and webinars conducted to help us get industry exposure. The exams are a bit difficult.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: A hidden gem of a college (better than new IITs).

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are mostly directly to ISRO, all students with a CGPA above 7.5 are placed in ISRO, other companies include space startups such as agnikool, SkyRoot, etc. Approximately 80–90% of students get placed, while many choose to go for higher studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Excellent course infrastructure; the library is very huge with a large collection of books; 24hr 5G Wi-Fi for students; quality of food is average, but there are various food joints nearby, so that is not a big issue. Sports facilities are also good and improving every day, as now the B.Tech students will have credit for sports too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teacher is highly qualified, and we have a very good student-to-teacher ratio of 9:1. Every teacher can connect with you at a personal level; keeping less student intake is, I think, a pro for IIST. The course curriculum is relevant, and we are also taught some space-specific stuff. The freshmen now also have the option of various minors.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to learn robotics and ML from the age of 14, so I took this course. The college is lovely and above many new IITs in the studies and research aspects. I think the facilities are not at that level, but considering that the strength is approximately 1000 students. Overall, it is pretty good.

reviews.course: Discontinue (Apr 2022) - B.Tech + M.Tech in Optical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIST - Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology.

detailed_review.Placements:
The placements of IIST are amazing; the students get placed in ISRO; some of our alumni are working in NASA/JPL also. 
Apart from ISRO, the placement is dismal, and generally 60% get placed in ISRO. Other than that, some other companies like MathWorks, Texas Instruments, Accenture, Infosys, etc. do come. The average package is around 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are newly built, and they are well managed. The warden is a painter. IIST is very strict on rules. Washing machines are not available; you will have to pool your money and buy one yourself, and the cleanliness could be better. The course is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are really good; they have great Ph.D. and work experience; they teach on blackboards generally; they are interactive with the first benchers; many of the Physics faculty are not that into attendance policies; they are easy going. The exams are tough; getting a good CGPA is tough.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: Everyday starts with excitement and ends with new learnings.

detailed_review.Placements: Just the previous year, I started my college journey. Undoubtedly, the Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology offers huge placement opportunities. For instance, in 2023, they had a 97% placement rate. Top companies like TCS, Siemens, and Persistent hire our college students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Basically, it’s a superb environment with all the necessities. Through various extracurricular activities, they pave the way for our development. Because of them, we are able to showcase our skills like leadership, passion, and empathy. This environment makes us feel our social responsibilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Personally, I'm okay with all the lectures. I admire and am amazed by their work. However, they are very strict about our dress code. They play a major role in making us responsible individuals. Finally, coming to exams, it’s quite easy to pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: It is a very good beginning for a new life.

detailed_review.Placements: There will be no partiality among students during placements. Everyone asked to attend the same coaching for placements. Depending on our performance, students got placed at various companies in our campus drives. Our alumni got placed in companies like Oracle, KPIT, Reliance, and EY.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has a very good environment. In our library, we have 5-6 copies of books for an individual book.
detailed_review.Faculty: I was very worried about my academics but later all such frustrations faded away from me. All these things were possible because of my teachers. Our teachers worked with us during research. They strictly banned ragging in our institution.
detailed_review.Other: While organising, cultural events we easily collaborate with our juniors and seniors for the smooth happening of such events. We perform and organise events together happily.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, good placements, and really good infrastructure and facilitie

detailed_review.Placements: The average package is around 15 LPA. Top companies include ISRO, Mercedes Benz, etc. All students must complete a compulsory internship in their third year. There are opportunities to go abroad for internships, with all expenses funded by the college. Top roles include grade A scientist, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Faculty members come from all over India and have post-doctoral degrees in their specific fields. Many have been educated at Ivy League colleges. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The library is excellent, fully air-conditioned with six floors, and includes educational books, scientific papers, and novels. Hostels are also good and clean, though they lack AC and have common washrooms. Food at the mess is varied—some is good, some not so much.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are extremely helpful and supportive. They are very knowledgeable and experienced in their fields. The curriculum is considered the best in India for aerospace engineering and is designed by the college itself. Semester exams align well with what is taught in class, with some high-order thinking required.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with academics, sports and extracurricular activities.

detailed_review.Placements: In recent years, the majority of students were placed at ISRO but now the 2025 batch does not have a bond with ISRO and we are not sure of the number of companies that would come for placements from our campus. The advantage is that we do not have to submit a paper with ISRO conduct to get a job there.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi's are sometimes unstable but yes, they are efficient. You do not get Wi-Fi or any Internet in your classrooms, of course. There's a 5-story library and more than 35,000+ books there, mostly related to space and the course. There's not much in the literature section. The food is hygienic but not tasty enough but yes, you won't get sick. Sports are evolving there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers are knowledgeable and experienced; mostly, they are IITians teaching there. Some of the teachers are helpful. The semester is a little difficult but yes, it requires a daily 5 hours of studying to get 8 points. Pass percentage is, I guess, around 70%.
detailed_review.Other: This college is basically for people who love studying. This campus is not yet ready for any extracurricular activities. I mean, there are sports and fests, but they are not that good.

reviews.review_title: IIST review: good infra, facilities and placements but lack of extra curriculars.

detailed_review.Placements: The 2020 batch of IIST has a bond signed with ISRO, so all the students whose CGPA > 7.5 have been given placement opportunities at ISRO, with packages varying from 8-12 LPA. In earlier years, the main recruiter was the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), but now, in Aerospace, many new space startups have provided placement opportunities. In the 6th semester of the course curriculum, a mandatory internship must be completed. So, most students in their 3rd year have opportunities for internships at ISRO centers, making 95 to 100% of interns.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms and labs at IIST are fully furnished, with air conditioning available in most labs and some classes. The Wi-Fi facilities are available all over the campus. Our campus contains free medical facilities, indoor and outdoor sports, a gym, and other amenities. The sports facilities are not great, but we have a wide range of sports activities, including outdoor sports like cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, and basketball, as well as indoor games like chess, carrom, table tennis, and pool. IIST is well-renowned for its library facilities. The library is six stories high, fully air-conditioned, with millions of books and journals, e-books, and other resources available for 16 hours (8 AM to 12 AM).
detailed_review.Faculty: The Director, Chancellor, Registrar, Heads, and Professors are well-respected personalities in their fields. The Professors are highly knowledgeable and qualified in their respective expertise. The course curriculum for Aerospace is very relevant, with theoretical, technical, and practical applications making their students industry-ready. The course curriculum for IIST, particularly Aerospace, is considered very hectic, with lectures, tutorials, tests, labs, assignments, and projects going throughout the semester, along with difficult mid-semester and end-semester exams. In spite of the difficulty, the pass percentage has always been above 85%.
detailed_review.Other: IIST was the first and best college in the Aerospace Department in Asia. Rockets and space have always fascinated me, and getting the opportunity to learn from the best Professors and the most relevant technology is a dream come true. The course curriculum is almost perfect, but more practical applications in aerospace could improve the quality of the course. The college authorities, students, and clubs organize fests, sports activities, cultural events, festival celebrations, and many educational and cultural programs. IIST has even organized a TEDx event. IISTians get the opportunity to receive scholarships-based internships at ISRO centers and many prestigious universities around the world, like JPL, Caltech, LASP, etc. The campus crowd and the lack of extracurriculars compared to other colleges with the same educational status are the only negative points I need to mention. IIST is located in the hills of Valiyamala, offering the most scenic views from the college. The remote location of the college leads to less connectivity.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: Many opportunities for working in ongoing projects and research work like in Space lab, Rf lab.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, most students who were placed in ISRO had a CGPA above 7.5. From 2021 onwards, ISRO's bond has been suspended, so it is expected that other recruiters will visit the campus. For ISRO recruitment, students don't need to write ICRB like students from other colleges, but they do need to pass an interview.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is new, and the labs are well maintained, with some labs having advanced equipment. The entire campus has excellent Wi-Fi connectivity, and there is a large, air-conditioned library building with many books for coursework and extracurricular reading. The mess food is not particularly tasty but is very healthy. There is a 24-hour medical facility on campus, and excellent sports and games facilities are available, including cricket, basketball, football, badminton, pool, table tennis, chess, and carrom.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio at this college is good. Most of the teachers were very helpful. The academic curriculum was really hectic, as the focus was more on studies and research than other activities. The syllabus was based on the requirements of ISRO and space companies. Grading was relative and depended on the faculty.

reviews.review_title: It's a good college if you really want to study, and campus life is also good .

detailed_review.Placements: Actually, we aren't sure about the placement because the ISRO bond has been removed so the placement thing will be masked starting next year without the ISRO bond. The college has an average package of 10 lacs. You can get internships from many companies inside and outside India in the space sector.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Yes, the infrastructure is good, and the college is growing and modifying the infrastructure; they are making new hostels, cricket stadiums, swimming pools, etc. And it's a kind of green campus; you will find trees and grasses all around the college with the protection of CIF.
detailed_review.Faculty: They are good, all the teachers are highly qualified and they just do an amazing job. The difficulty of the semester exam varies from moderate to hard so if you want to pass the exam, you have to study. You can't take it lightly and constantly perform well for a good CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: It's the best college for the aerospace engineering. Events and fests all are average.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: Really good academics, not so good extra curricular and more about my experience in IIST.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college till my batch, you would get directly absorbed by ISRO if your CGPA is above 7.5 on a scale of 10. But other than that the placement situation is not as good as some IITs. From the Next batch onwards there is no direct absorption in ISRO so our placement cell is trying to get better placement for the students. Top companies include Accenture and TCS. There are also some renowned start-ups like AgniKul which is operated by IIST alumni and you can get a package of around 8-10 LPA there. The highest package is around 14 LPA from our placement cell while the lowest is around 2 LPA. The average package is around 5-6 LPA. Now there is a mandatory summer internship between the 6th and 7th semester. Students go to various ISRO centres or do their internship in the campus or any companies outside. You can also do other internships in various companies, though that can put a lot of pressure on your academics. So it's up to you.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are good and can accommodate a large number of students. The labs are very well maintained. There is 24-hour Wi-Fi inside the campus. The library is excellent, almost all the books are available. The hostels are clean and well-maintained. The bathrooms are cleaned every day so no worries about that. You can access the medical facility whenever you want. The mess/canteen food is really good and clean and most of them are tasty. Now the infrastructure for sports and games is not as good as some of the other colleges but you can certainly play sports if you are interested.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very well qualified and really helpful. You just have to approach them. The exams are neither easy nor very difficult, you have to put some effort to do well. You can pass easily and very few students fails the exams. The course is very relevant, but I wish there was more specializations in the B.Teach course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: The college was offering the best quality placements and faculty in our course.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college offers multiple placements to its students. Around 50–60% of the students get placed in our course at this college. The average package offered here at this college was between 4 and 7 LPAs. Top recruiters in the college were Infosys, Teach Mahindra, Wipro, Philips, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college was providing the best-quality facilities to the students. The infrastructure available for our course was good. The entire college campus had Wi-Fi facilities for students and teachers. Labs were available for the students with all the required equipment. The library, canteen, hostel, sports, and all other necessary facilities were available for the students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at IIST for our course were highly qualified and knowledgeable. Teachers were offering the best quality teaching to the students. The course curriculum of this college is relevant and makes us industry-ready. Semester exams at our college were not hard to pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Avionics)
reviews.review_title: Review for IIST - Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% of the students have been placed. Due to the limited number of students at IIST, all of them have excellent placement opportunities. If you have a CGPA of 7.5 or above, you have the chance to be recruited by prestigious companies such as ISRO, Bosch, Benz Mahindra, Tata, and more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus will have 24/7 medical facilities available. There will be two white canteens on the premises. All types of sports courts will be accessible including inter-house tournaments held annually. The mess will serve both north and south Indian varieties and the campus will be filled with greenery.
detailed_review.Faculty: Experienced and qualified faculty teach at IIST, with an eco-friendly approach. Semesters are tough, but provide a bright knowledge that makes students industry-ready. The pass percentage of students is 80%.
detailed_review.Other: All events and festivals will be held on campus. Onam is celebrated grandly. Every even semester, we have Dhanak Fest, which is highly celebrated.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The Library and Information Services of Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST) is housed in a six-storied building at the hub of the campus. The operations of the library are fully computerized and the Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) is accessible from anywhere in the campus on a 24X7 basis. E-resources deployed in the campus-wide network provide access to more than 5000 e-journals, hundreds of conference papers, standards etc. The e-resources include ACM Digital Library, AIAA, AIP, APS, Annual Reviews, ASME, Cambridge Online, IEL Online (IEEE), JSTOR, IOP, JSTOR, Optic Infobase, Oxford Journals, Royal Society of Chemistry, and Science Direct. Access has been provided to these resources through the library portal.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: IIST has 11 hostels on the campus. There are separate hostels for B.Tech, M.Tech and Research Scholars. Each hostel has provision for safe drinking water with hot and cold water dispensers, 24 Hr uninterrupted power supply with generator backup, housekeeping services, reading room with national and vernacular newspapers, indoor games facility, LCD television with satellite connection etc. and centralized gym facility with modern fitness equipment. All hostels are WiFi enabled with High-Speed Access to the Internet, Digital Library and other Digital Learning Resources. A laundry service provider, a nationalized Bank with ATM facility and a bookstall is available in the campus in the close vicinity to the hostels to meet the needs of resident students.

facilities.name: Sports Complex
facilities.description: The University has 2 volleyball courts a clay court and a sand court for playing volleyball. IIST also houses two indoor badminton courts for training and practice and two other badminton courts for leisure playing. Swimming camps are organized once in a year in a nearby swimming pool where students are trained in different styles of swimming.

facilities.name: Gym
facilities.description: IIST gym has Various facilities like treadmill, multigym and ab machine, weights and dumbbells. Weights of different segments are available for training students in powerlifting. Two instructors are available exclusively to train students in various types of equipment.
