MNNIT Allahabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Awesome placements and crowd, decent enough infrastructure and curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements here are awesome, as reflected by the states. 72 percent of the students are placed on campus with a median package of 12.5 LPA. Other than the core sector, students are also placed into the technical sector as well. In our college electrical engineering students can sit for both core and technical roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs are well equipped. Some equipments are old but the majority is in good condition. The first year hostel is great with a small garden in the front and back side and also a badminton court on the ground floor. The mess food is decent and edible, but definitely not something one will look forward to.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are okay. Some faculty members are really helpful and supportive while others are rigid and cranky. Most of the senior faculty members are old, therefore, they are not very helpful. Most of the faculty members teach in the class very poorly so that half the time you will be falling asleep. The curriculum is really well designed for someone aiming for the core sector  it also has some CSE related courses as well. The exams are not very hard to pass. You can good CGPA with just 1 week of studies before the exams start, given you pay at least some attention in class. Teacher assistants (TAs) are responsible for helping the students perform the experiments and are very helpful.
detailed_review.Other: The events and fests are good but some people might find them too restricted, like with the strict rules in times etc. The campus is decent, has all the major sports facilities except swimming. The campus has greenery but is small. A large area of the college is reserved for the faculty members and female students where guys are not allowed.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied by whatever I am getting here and surely will you.

detailed_review.Placements: Being an institute of national importance, placement is assured if anyone remains consistent throughout their academic years. The placement state is nearly equal to decent IITs and absolutely far better than private colleges. The average placement is on a higher side for circuital branches such as CSE, ECE, and EE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus area is not that big as of few IITs, but still vast greenery can be observed throughout the campus. Basic sports facilities are being provided. There is a gymnasium for both boys and girls. The infrastructure of the hostel can vary as there are 4 different hostels for each year. The quality of food that is being provided in mess is better as compared to other NITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Surely the teachers are well qualified as being professors in MNNIT. If someone keeps attending their lectures and keeps following their commands, they will certainly score well in exams. The marking criteria is slightly biased for the students which are known to the professor.
detailed_review.Other: The environment of the college majority focuses on academics, yet fests are being organized on a regular basis, which are the only eventful days in our campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement, poor infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement of MNNIT is even more than some IITs. Last year, out of 408 students in my branch, CSE 397 got placed. Almost 90 percent of students got placed every year in my branch. The highest package of last year is 74 LPA, and 2 years before it was 1.25 crores per annum. The average package is 23 LPA. Some top recruiting companies on our campus are DE SAHW, JP MORGAN, Nvidia, Qualcomm, Google, and many more. Out of 400 students, 100 students got internships easily in my branch in the 3rd year with a good amount.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of MNNIT is not so good, it was just to spend and cut our 4 years of life on campus. The college campus is not so big, and also only 1-2 canteen is good, there is only one main playground and only one net practice for cricket and also no regular sports are held here. Wi-Fi speed is 90 mbps only, classrooms are decent, not so dreamy here, even the most demanded branch CSE department looks like a primary school here. The 1st year and 4th year boys' hostel are excellent, but the 2nd and 3rd year are poor.
detailed_review.Faculty: It is fine that teachers are well-educated and supportive in class and outside the class. Teaching quality is also good for some professors, but it is also not so good for some of them. The course curriculum is relevant, and it also makes students industry-ready so that they get an internship. Semester exams are not too difficult if you study average, then you can easily get 8CPI here.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of its placement, only because before joining, I knew about the infrastructure and college life, but I compromised it for placement. CSE of MNNIT is too good and comparable with IITs. If the infrastructure of the college is changed, then it stands to be the top 1 NIT, which is the only thing that hides the real potential of this college. The annual fest name is Culrav and is an awesome tech fest, and many events are arranged during these 5 days. Garba night also happens during Navratri, and a hackathon is also arranged every year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied review of MNNIT by an ECE student.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, an average 80% students get placed every year. In my course, the highest is equivalent to CSE, which is 72 LPA. Google, Microsoft and all big tech companies of India come to recruit students. The internship is not that good, but 25-30 students got it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is one of the cons of MNNIT because we get a 4-seater room in our first year with it. When you go in the second year, you have to live in a double seater, whereas the rooms are too small to live in. They have a CPI criterion too for students. Facilities are the same as every college has, like some of them are good and some are not.
detailed_review.Faculty: Many of the teachers are helpful in every phase, but some professors have egos, too. I usually avoid them. Course curriculum is related to placement because, as we studied our core branch subject from first year inside the mechanical labs, odd sem are always difficult, I don't know why.
detailed_review.Other: Culrav and Avshikar are college annual fests, mainly held in odd sem. They don't have different timings, both are happening together simultaneously. EE is good here because professors are helpful, and with it, they give more cpi.

reviews.review_title: Pretty good placements, needs to look after the infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost the entire batch is placed, and students can either go into circuital or teaching depending upon their interest, the internship scenario is also good, my one senior got an internship in Microsoft, this year the highest package is about 75 LPA, and the average is also good around 15–18 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not so good, Wi-Fi doesn't work all the time but the speed is good, labs require upgrades as the equipment is really old, I live in DJGH (Diamond Jubilee Girls Hostel) which is pretty nice except that it is triple seater, mess food has a whole bunch of varieties and is okay, there are common halls on every even floor for table tennis and other activities, there is a badminton court, and lifts are available as the hostel has six floors.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are knowledgeable but the teaching quality varies; if you are expecting JEE sort of teaching then you would be disappointed as they just teach and go, but if you pay attention and study beforehand, you can understand it, and there are some teachers who genuinely love teaching, so don’t be scared as you will get used to it in the end.
detailed_review.Other: The placement scenario is pretty nice, Electrical is a reputed branch of this college, the professors are experienced though sometimes cranky, but their knowledge is second to none, the college is located near the army region, and if you wish to go shopping or to malls you have to go to Civil Lines which is far away, and extracurricular activities are also available with societies and committees where you can explore everything you want.

reviews.review_title: Good coding clubs, good for CSE, ECE and EE branches, and decent for other branches.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% eligible got placed in biotech course. The highest package is around 15 LPA, and average is 8.4 LPA. One of our students cracked GSOC and got an internship at Rolls-Royce and Max. Role in our course is consulting. Very low core company come on our campus for biotech branch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a decent infrastructure for our course. It has common classrooms and decent labs in biotech department. For the first year student at MNNIT there is above average hostel and mess facility. For the second and third year, provide below average hostel and for fourth year there are excellent hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: In MNNIT, there are highly qualified faculty members. Curriculum is also good, and exams are also conducted according to academic calendar. In our college, semester exam is not tough as we think, and we have good pass percentage. Here curriculum is relevant according to our courses but not as good as IIT.

reviews.review_title: In short, everything is very good and I am well satisfied.

detailed_review.Placements: The best point of MNNIT is that the placement here is very good. If I talk about my branch (mechanical engineering), it is good, and the average packages are also approximately 10 LPA to 11 LPA. As we know, in this department, initial placement was not that high, we get higher as our experience grows, although the highest package is around 70 LPA according to the 2023 placement data. The percentage placement is 70 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I think the facilities provided by the institute are good, but as we talk about infrastructure, it is not that good, but it is fine. Some classrooms, like those on the second floor (sew7 and sew8), are not as good as we expected from the institute. We talk about other things. The best thing is the greenery of this campus, it has lots of greenery, and also the canteen is good, the sports are good, and some sports are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are very supportive and helpful. They are very knowledgeable, and the quality of teaching is also good. The course curriculum is relevant and prepares students for the industry. Semester exams are a little hard, some subjects are marked based on who makes the paper. The pass percentage, I think, is about 70 to 80 percent.
detailed_review.Other: A simple reason why I chose this course is that I am planning to join a good college, so depending on my marks, this department is good in the list. The best thing about this department is that you can pursue many careers, such as automobile, industrial, and other fields. If I talk about fests, they are very good, and extracurricular activities, scholarships are also available here. The seniors are very supportive, which helps us in every situation, like connectivity to other things.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Placement means MNNIT Allahabad.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90-95 percent are placed in my branch, CSE. The highest package is around 71 LPA-72 LPA, the lowest is around 8 LPA, and the average is around 27 LPA-28 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Infosys, Deloitte, etc. Almost 80-85 percent get an internship in the 3rd year and in the same recruiting companies. Roles offered are software developer, web developer, AI/ML, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college offers good infrastructure and facilities campus has Wi-Fi facilities, well-equipped labs, and classrooms are okay. The library is an average library. Hostels are good for first years and last years. Mess food is normal, like in other colleges, sports facilities are decent, lots of events are happening, and the canteen is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable. Overall, teaching quality is good, the curriculum is very relevant and focused on individual skills, CPI, etc. Semester exams are of moderate difficulty, which can be managed by around 80-90 percent of students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Tier-1, impressive college with wonderful placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 70-80% of people get easily placed with decent packages. The highest is approximately 72 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. Internships are also a good thing that the college provides on a decent level. Top roles offered are SDE, Project Manager, etc. Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, etc. come for campus placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great. First-year hostels are great, spacious, and airy, which makes it a perfect stay, and it doesn't give the feeling of those dark, average government hostel rooms. The classrooms are mostly air-conditioned except for some of them, and the canteen is pretty impressive.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are nothing different from an average government engineering college. They come in the class, take lectures, solve doubts (if any), and then leave no more interactions. They start teaching core subjects in the 1st semester. The exams are tough to improve students' knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: Electronics and Communication Engineering is a course that will provide me with versatile knowledge about software as well as hardware. It has a growing scope in the future, and MNNIT is a tier-1 college that gives an edge above other tier-2 and tier-3 colleges.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: If you want placements along with enjoyment, come to MNNIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students who are eligible are placed. The highest package is around 70 Lacs, the lowest package is 3-4 Lacs, and the mean package is 28 Lacs. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Microsoft, Intel, and D. E. Shaw. Half of the students get on-campus internships; the rest get off-campus internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is well-kept. The first-year hostel is the best. Mess food is delicious, but if you are a non-veg lover, there might be some problems. Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. The library is also good. Second-year hostels are not as good as first-year hostels. The sports culture is great on our campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified, but most of the time you have to complete your course with YouTube one night before exams. The course curriculum for CSE is great. Semester exams are quite difficult. You can't be dependent only on the teacher, just like any other engineering institute in India.
detailed_review.Other: Placements are the main reason to choose this course. Events are good; we have Culrav, where top celebrities come to perform.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A college with good placement but average college life with decent infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement ratio in ECE is 82% in 2025, with the highest package of 72 Lacs and an average of 20 Lacs. Top recruiting companies were Amazon, TCS, Qualcomm, Accenture, and many more. There is no exact percentage of internships officially published. Top roles are software engineer, full stack developer, VLSI design, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire campus of MNNIT is Wi-Fi enabled. LAN ports are available in hostels. Classrooms are decent, and there are many labs in ECE which are maintained well. There is a central library that contains a large collection of books. Hostels are decent in the first year; usually, you get a 4/3 seater room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. Even many professors are involved in research and funded projects. Lectures are generally good, and there are lab sessions too which are nice. The course is relevant; it makes students ready for the industry. The course contains various subjects like analog electronics, digital electronics, VLSI, and many more. Semester exams are difficult, but the pass percentage is nice.

reviews.review_title: Just an average college. Only prefer for placement.

detailed_review.Placements: I'm currently in chemical engineering at MNNIT. The placement for my branch is quite good, with 90%+ and a 12-13 LPA average package, and the highest is about 60 LPA. So, in terms of placement, it is in second position among NITs. So, if your primary goal is placement only, then it is a good college for you.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are very good. There are Ethernet ports in each room for Wi-Fi. Washrooms are also very good. First and fourth years have the best hostels. Mess food is the best compared to most colleges, but the labs for chemical engineering are quite small, though manageable. Professors are also fine. Classes are small, and some are non-A.C.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are highly educated, but they lack teaching experience. They don't explain properly, but it’s manageable with online resources and the PDFs and presentations they provide. The courses are very nice, and seniors are very supportive. Semester exams are difficult, and about 80% of students pass them.
detailed_review.Other: There are many scholarships provided by the central government, so there's no problem regarding money. I wish that the professors were much more supportive and explained the chapters more easily.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college has really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 96 percent of students were placed in our course. In my course, the highest package is about 1 crore 35 lakhs, the average package is 28 lakhs, and the lowest package is about 4 lakhs. Top companies such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, etc., are the recruiting companies for my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In my college, there are lots of lab classrooms and a library. Also, the Wi-Fi facility is available for each student through LAN connection, and the quality of food in mess is so delicious. There are medical facilities, and sports and games are also available here. Many facilities are provided in my hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: In my college, the teachers are helpful, well qualified, and knowledgeable, and their teaching quality is excellent. The semester exams are of medium tough level in my college, so students have to be well prepared for the exams. The pass percentage is about 4 CGPA.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement, average campus life, good competition.

detailed_review.Placements: As much as I know about my college placement, it is really better than all NITs except some top ones, especially for CSE and ECE students. The highest package was 1.2 crores, I guess, in 2022. After that year, it is below 1 crore and above 75 lakhs. Top recruiters include Google, Amazon, Microsoft, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As it is a government college, there is not much modern infrastructure. Lecture buildings are old. Spaces are not completely utilized. The campus is sufficiently good, not like the lavish campuses of private colleges or IITs. Wi-Fi is not available all over the campus, but you will have LAN in your hostel. Classrooms are average.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is better than that of private colleges, and faculty members are well qualified, but students have to work on their own like in other colleges. Even if it is IIT, you will have to do work on your own. Competition among students helps you to grow. Semester exams are not easy, but as grades are relative, you just have to score above average to get a good grade (6-7 GPA).
detailed_review.Other: The only reason for going to this college is the placement stats. The campus can be improved by installing some multistory lecture halls. Annual fests CULRAV and AVISHKAR are good. The college is well connected through all modes of transport. Extracurricular activities are not good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the campus life and the facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of the Computer Science Branch is placed, and the rest of the branch has 50% placements till now. The highest is about 63 LPA, the lowest 4 LPA, and the average is around 28 LPA. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, etc., are the top recruiters. About 20% got internships. Software engineering is the top role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Very poor facilities for labs, classrooms, and even the library. The 1st and 4th-year hostels (SVBH FIRST YEAR) are good, but the 2nd and 3rd years are very poor. The best food is good, and the canteen is average, but medical facilities and sports and games are of poor quality, meaning having no proper facilities for these basic needs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers of my branch are helpful and qualified, but not well-versed. None of the teachers are graduates from international universities. The course curriculum is good, but not student-industry ready as it consists of very old courses. The difficulties are not very hard; the semester exams in the college are quite good, and the passing percentage is also normal in my college within the Computer Science branch.
detailed_review.Other: I think I chose this source because of the Computer Science and Engineering branch, and the placements are very good from that college. However, college life is not very good in that college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: There is nothing apart from placements here, I wouldn't suggest joining this.

detailed_review.Placements: For batch 2025, the placement percentage for CSE was 96.75% with an average of 27.7 LPA, the highest was 72 LPA, the lowest was 6 LPA. Top recruiters include D. E. Shaw, Apple, Google, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Cleartrip, Texas Instruments, etc. Out of 350 CSE students, 144 students got internships in 2025 in companies like D. E. Shaw, Goldman Sachs, Google, Microsoft, Texas Instruments, Salesforce, etc. Top roles offered in CSE generally include SWE (Software Engineer) or Developer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College labs are well-equipped with all the facilities like Wi-Fi, computer systems, furniture, ACs, etc. Also, recently, old systems have been replaced with new ones in most of the computer labs. All the classrooms and labs include facilities like whiteboards, a projector for PPT presentation, ACs, etc. The library is also available on the campus, which is open 5 days a week for book issue and all. Apart from that, there is a facility to sit and study in the library as well, though occupancy of the library is very small, so you may often not get a seat there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is average, like most of the other colleges, you have to study on your own. Here, professors are quite strict, though CSE don't have many such professors, but other branches have many strict professors. They don't give marks easily, and the exams conducted are very tough in this college. Curriculum is up to date according to NEP, but the semester exams are quite difficult here to score well, which is why it takes a lot of your time in academics, also, min 75% attendance is mandatory here.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is the best course currently for placements, which was my prime reason to choose it. Events and fests are very low quality here, you won't enjoy much, and you won't bother to attend fests and events 2nd year onwards, because they are such low-grade and low effort. You will get a diverse crowd here, although since seats have been increased, there is a larger crowd these days. Campus surroundings are not good, as it is located in the less developed region of the city.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is good, placement is better but not best, and the lack is in college infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement that I have heard after coming to college is that if you study, then placement is confirmed. Mainly, placement is done by Computer Science students, and here there are approximately 400 Computer Science students. For other branches, mainly ECE and Electrical, placements are also available.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mainly, MNNIT Allahabad is famous for its Computer Science, and for only Computer Science, it has a separate building. The hostel rooms are good, and labs are also well-equipped. For mess, in the starting, every day there are new dishes which are better, but after 1 to 1.5 months, the mess food becomes tasteless.
detailed_review.Faculty: Here, teachers are good and qualified, but they lack teaching skills. You can’t totally rely upon teachers’ teaching; you have to study online also. For passing, the first semester could be tough because it is completed in 3.5 months.
detailed_review.Other: Things should be better, like good classrooms and infrastructure. Some classrooms of MNNIT are like ancient classes.

reviews.review_title: Review of Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: A super percent of students placed in this college is so good, nearly 90 percent. The highest and the lowest packages in this course are so close to 18 LPA. The top recruiting companies in my course are so superb. The percentage of student internships in this course is 60 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in this college are very good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and library are available. The food in the college canteen is very tasty, but medical facilities are not available. Sports and games are present in this course for all the students in college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in this course are so superb. The teaching quality is so good. This course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. The semester exam in this college is so good and easy. The pass percentage is more than 90 percent in my college.
detailed_review.Other: Events and the campus crowd are so superb. Scholarship is also available.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: MNNIT is a great Institute, by a MNNITian.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the CSE branch, and a lot of my friends are placed this year. Although I got a great internship opportunity, in my batch, there are 400 students, and most of them got an internship offer. The overall placements of the college are good. Placement stats of my CSE branch are very good. Around 87.44% of students from the last batch got placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. We have good drinking water, clean and sanitized washrooms, and well-maintained single rooms. I will say the infrastructure is great. Although the classes also have centralized ACs installed this year, the Wi-Fi connection is also good. We are provided with routers as well as a LAN. The library is also good, has a lot of books, and provides an e-book facility as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here are polite, intelligent, and well-experienced. Apart from studies, they also help us carry out our other problems, whether they are related to relationships, stress, or they help us like friends. They teach us concepts in detail, and we also respect them. The curriculum is also well designed, and exams are good and help me a lot to learn more about computer science.
detailed_review.Other: Many pieces of information I have already provided about my batch; the college has 2 great fests: Culrav and Abhishkar. Culrav is a cultural fest, and Abhishkar is a technical fest. Culrav is excellent; most of the celebrities come here, and many singers and dancers as well. Abhishkar has many events, hackathons, and some other events like robotics events.

reviews.review_title: Good placement in 2023, ragging-free, and mess food is good.

detailed_review.Placements: In civil engineering, placement percentage is generally about 90% every year. The highest package is about 28 LPA this year 2025, the lowest is about 8 LPA, and the average is about 9.28 LPA Top recruiters are L&T and some PSU companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on the college campus. Classrooms are quite good. AC does not work properly. The condition of lab is not that good. All the machine equipment is old. The hostel facilities are good. Water cooler is provided. The quality of food in the mess is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in nature. Every professor has Ph.D. degree and well knowledgeable in their respective field. Course curriculum is relevant about 4-5 hours of class run daily and 5 days a week. I will not say the student is well prepared for the industry level, as there is much needed training to prepare.
detailed_review.Other: The rank in my JEE is not that good. I am getting into a good college with civil branch so I decided to go there. There is a need for innovation and creative thinking to get some interest in the civil course. Campus life is good, enjoyable, and friendly nature. There is no ragging on campus.

admission.title: MNNIT Allahabad Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: MNNIT Allahabad admissions are entrance-based. The institute ranked at '62' under the 'Engineering' category in NIRF 2025 rankings is known for its BTech course. Admission to its flagship BTech course is based on JEE Main rank of the candidates. Besides BTech, MNNIT Allahabad also offers MBA, MCA, PhD and MSc. The selection for MTech is based on GATE scores whereas IIT JAM scores are considered for MSc programme. Candidates have to apply via exam conducting body. Aspirants need to fill out the application form on the institute's website for MBA and PhD.

faqs.question: How can I get admission at MNNIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: MNNIT Allahabad selects students for BTech based on valid JEE Main score. They are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to M.Tech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Allahabad MBA admissions are based on CAT score and the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.

faqs.question: Which all courses are offered at MNNIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: The institute offers one UG and four PG courses in full-time mode. It also offers some doctoral programmes. MNNIT Allahabad offers BTech , MBA , MTech , MSc , MCA and PhD courses in Science and Technology fields. Aspirants need to fulfil the course-specific eligibility conditions in order to seek admission to the desired course. Candidates need to pass a minimum of Class 12 to apply for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. Admission to MNNIT Allahabad courses is based on national-level entrance exam.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Is it worth taking admission in MNNIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: MNNIT Allahabad is one of the recognised NITs of India. It is well-known for its academic offerings and contributions to research, making it one of the top engineering schools in the nation. Ranking: MNNIT Allahabad has been ranked by NIRF from last three-years under the 'Engineering' Category. It has been ranked at 60 in 2024 NIRF rankings. Further, the placement rate recorded during MNNIT Allahabad BTech placements 2023 was 92.3%.

faqs.question: How much marks are required to get admission in MNNIT, Allahabad?
faqs.answer: The score requirement is different for different MNNIT Allahabad courses. Candidates need to qualify a minimum of Class 12 for UG and graduation for PG programmes. Below is eligibility criteria for top MNNIT Allahabad courses: Popular Courses Common Eligibility Class 12 with Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry/ Biology/ Biotechnology/ Technical Vocational Subject from a recognised board with at least 75% aggregate BCA/ BSc (Hons)/ BSc/ BIT with at least 60% marks or score 6.5 CGPA aggregate (candidates belonging to SC/ST category need to obtain at least 55% marks or score 6.0 CGPA ) Graduate in relevant subjects with 60% Bachelor's degree with at least 60% aggregate or CPI 6.5 (55% aggregate or CPI 6.0 for SC/ ST/ DA) BSc in relevant discipline with at 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST)

faqs.question: What is the selection criteria for MCA at MNNIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: Admission to NIT Allahabad accepts admission to the MCA course through the NIMCET entrance test. The exam is conducted every year specifically for admission to MCA courses at NITs. Candidates are shortlisted and seat allotment is carried out based on the aspirant's score in the entrance examination.

faqs.question: Is MNNIT Allahabad good for BTech?
faqs.answer: BTech is the flagship programme of MNNIT Allahabad. The institute has been ranked by NIRF under the 'Engineering' category in 2023 rankings at 60. Talking about placements, the highest and average package offered during MNNIT Allahabad BTech placements 2024 stood at INR 63.78 LPA and INR 16.06 LPA , respectively.

faqs.question: What is the criteria to get admissions in BTech at MNNIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pass a minimum of Class 12 with Physics , Mathematics and Chemistry / Biology/ Biotechnology / Technical Vocational Subject from a recognised board with at least 75% aggregate is required to apply for the MNNIT Allahabad BTech programme. The seat allotment process is based on the college cutoff and the candidate's preference for courses and colleges. For the selection of candidates for vacant seats, the college also accepts admission through CSAB Counselling .

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for M.Tech at NIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission to M.Tech at NIT Allahabad, students need to be graduated with minimum 60% aggregate with BE/BTech from a recognised University. Candidates also need to present the relevant documents as a proof of eligibility. The documents have to be uploaded during GATE form filling and will be required at the time of form filling as well.

faqs.question: Which M.Tech specialisations does MNNIT Allahabad offer?
faqs.answer: NIT Allahabad offers a two-year M.Tech course in over 20 specialisations. sections.heading: Introduction
text: The infrastructure of MNNIT Allahabad is well-maintained and modern. The institute has a variety of facilities that are available to students and staff members. These facilities help to create a conducive environment for learning and research. Here are some of the recent developments in the infrastructure of MNNIT Allahabad:
These developments testify to the institute's commitment to providing its students with the best facilities.
Campus Building:
list: The institute has recently built a new library with a capacity of 1 lakh books.
The institute has also built a new hostel for girls with a capacity of 500 students.
The institute is building a new sports complex with a swimming pool, a track and field stadium, and a gymnasium.

sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Residential and Hostel Facilities
text: There are seven Boys and two Girls' hostels at present in the Institute. The capacity of the boys' hostel is 1800 (1044 single-seated rooms and 252 triple-seated rooms ), and that of the girls' hostel is 145. Room allotment is done in such a way that students from different parts of the country freely intermingle with each other, depicting national integration. Hostel messes are run on a non-profit and non-loss basis. The messes are managed by nominated representatives of students under the overall supervision of wardens. The foreign students run their separate mess, known as the international mess. In this mess, non-vegetarian food is also served.

The newly admitted boys are kept in separate hostels away from senior students to avoid ragging. The hostel administration grants financial assistance to meet the mess bills to many needy students. One new hostel has also been constructed to accommodate an additional number of students. Several new facilities are being provided in the girls' hostel, viz., washing machines, refrigerators, computers, and internet connectivity. One PCO booth is also working in the girls' hostel campus.

There is a team of wardens in charge and a warden for each of the hostels. They look after the affairs of the room allocation to the individual students and issue the 'Concession Forms' for the students going home during the Institute vacations. All the student complaints regarding the room maintenance are routed through the warden of the hostel to the concerned authorities.

sections.heading: MNNIT Allahabad Library
text: The Central Library is one of the central facilities of MNNIT Allahabad. It is spread across 2500.00 square meters and is covered on two floors (ground and first). One of the aims of the library is to assist the educational facilities of the institute. It is well-maintained and serves as a knowledge hub for the entire institute. It stocks an extensive and selective collection of high-quality knowledge resources in the field of Science & Technology, Social Science, and Humanities. It supports the institute's learning, teaching and research activities. It supports the mission of the institute in offering academic excellence.

The NIT Allahabad library is located in the centre of the institute, which makes it easily accessible. It is fully furnished with all the new and modern technologies. There is a CCVT surveillance system and a smoke alarm system. The reading halls/sitting areas are fully air-conditioned. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement going in this year, great companies are coming.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 95 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 1.6 CPA, and the lowest is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Nvidia, and De Shaw. Internships are very good in this college. Seniors are very helpful. In companies like NVIDIA, Qualcomm, De Shaw, and many more, internships are available, including research internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Labs are clean and big and have all the essential things for doing work. Mess food is good. There are facilities for football, basketball, volleyball, a ground, tennis court, squash, and many more. It has good medical facilities. Hostels are big and clean, and have AC in every room, cupboard, and study table.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, helpful, and highly qualified. Almost every professor has a Ph.D. from a foreign institute, and many professors were professors at foreign institutes, so they are pretty good. The course curriculum is very effective in today's world and makes students industry-ready. The semester exam is a bit difficult, but there is rarely any student who fails.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics
reviews.review_title: Great campus, strong academics.

detailed_review.Placements: 96% of students who got a CGPA of more than 6 were placed with the highest of 50 LPA and the lowest of 6 LPA from top recruiting companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Natwest, Meesho, etc. Around 20% of students got paid internships with good stipends. The teaching staff is good, with proper teaching assistants. I hope you find that review useful.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIIT Delhi has Wi-Fi, modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich digital library. Hostels are clean and comfortable with proper connectivity. The mess and canteen provide good food. The campus has reliable medical care and proper sports facilities with proper equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, helpful, and deliver concepts clearly. The curriculum is modern, practical, and aligned with industry needs. Semester exams are moderately tough but fair, focusing on understanding. The pass percentage is generally high with consistent performance.
detailed_review.Other: I'm from the CSAM batch at IIITD. I chose this course for its strong teaching focus and research culture. The best parts are practical learning, projects, and industry exposure. I wish for lighter workloads at times. The campus is vibrant with fests, clubs, good connectivity, and strong extracurricular options.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and VLSI Engineering
reviews.review_title: Excellent faculty, good infrastructure and facilities, placement is also good, and the campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is good. B.Tech Eve, being a new course, no batch has passed yet, so placement hasn't taken place for this course. Qualcomm, Western Digital, Nvidia, and Texas Instruments are some of the companies that come for placement for the ECE branch. It is also very easy to get software roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Although the campus is small, the facilities provided are very good. Wi-Fi coverage is in every building. There are labs with up-to-date equipment, a clean campus, classrooms of all sizes, etc. We also have a library building, which is very good in terms of the books available. Mess facilities are available for everyone, and the food is of good quality. There is also a sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are some of the best in the country. They have extensive research experience, and they also teach very nicely. The curriculum is highly relevant to go deep into the subject. It makes students industry-ready, but it also makes them research-ready due to the depth of courses. Semester exams are somewhat difficult, and the pass percentage is also good. Around 20-30 students fail or opt for doing that semester again out of 600 students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there is going to be a semiconductor boom in India and it's going to be wonderful for ECE and related students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College curriculum is tough with high fees, but high placement and great faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement record of last year's batch was somewhat around 80 to 85%. This ratio varies among different branches. The minimum, according to my knowledge is 3.5 LPA, and the highest is somewhat around 1.2 crore. Approximately all the MNCs (Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Qualcomm, Nvidia) visit our campus to recruit students. Around 80% of students get placed among the shortlisted students (shortlist based on CGPA above 7).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All day high-speed network is available on the campus. We have top-class infrastructure with modern facilities, all-time medical support, hostels are too good, having an AC in all the rooms, quality of food is not that much better but eatable, sports and gym open 24X7, and students can roam around the campus anytime, no restriction like other colleges have.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college has great teaching faculty members. The course is relevant, and this can make the students industry-ready. But semester exams are tough, and we also have a plagiarism policy so curriculum is too tough. Atleast 20% fail in a particular subject but this varies from subject to subject.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best placements and good infrastructure, but academic life is stressful.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is not good initially. But later on, almost 300+ students get placed out of 500, with an average package of 24 LPA, showing strong and well opportunities for future and development. If you're looking for the most advanced tech curriculum, this is the place.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is internationally graduated and is some of the best I could study with. However, some professors do not have the best teaching methods. Teaching and knowledge are two different things, but the professors never get stuck on the questions I ask. Faculty is supportive, and exams are a bit trickier than I expected, but this prepares us for the best. The course gets hectic, and academics are challenging. Every other day there are tutorials and quizzes that carry a lot of weight. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you don't attend classes, even YouTube can't save you.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a great college because of its placement records and excellent college life.

detailed_review.Placements: This college is known mainly for placements, as it has an excellent placement record. Every top company comes to our college, from Google and Microsoft to Adobe and Goldman Sachs. The average package is around 28 LPA, with almost 80% of students getting placed, even during the recession. These are the actual figures from the placement season 2024-2025. Everyone knows how much of a recession is going on in the CSE field. The college website might elevate the numbers, but every college does this. The top package goes around 1.0 crore, and even the lowest package is 8 LPA. The median package is around 25 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is great, with good Wi-Fi speed in almost every part of the college. The library is open 24/7, even at night, so that students can study, and the canteen is also open 24/7. There is great nightlife in the college with no restrictions for anyone. Hostels are great too, with proper cleanliness. The mess food is also good. Hostels are much better than those in IITs. Sports facilities are also great and are open 24/7, with a gym and an indoor swimming pool.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. Most of them are PhDs from abroad. Our director, Pankaj Jalote, is one of the most qualified teachers across India. The course is highly relevant in today's world. They start teaching DSA in the first year itself, and they don't teach any Physics or Chemistry courses like in other colleges, which makes the curriculum highly relevant. This also leads to academic sincerity, as the curriculum is on the tougher side. They have a plagiarism policy that doesn't allow the use of AI tools. Overall, it's all worth it, and the college is really good and helpful.
detailed_review.Other: Apart from academics, the college is great for fests and events. Many events go on throughout the year, like Bollywood Night, Cultural Night, Freshers, Tech Fest, Cultural Fest (Odyssey), and every fresher's favorite period. Which is Induction, when every fresher goes to college for the first time. I chose this college mainly for its great placement record and, most importantly, its relevant curriculum, which is missing in most colleges. A little bit of leniency in deadlines, in my opinion, would be really appreciated. Apart from that, everything is great in the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students are placed in my branch. The highest CTC is 77.42 LPA, and the average is 20.76 LPA. Qualcomm and Synopsys were some of the top recruiters. 30-40% of students got internship offers. core electronics and SDE roles are offered to the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every facility is available, whether it’s Wi-Fi, all kinds of labs, research labs, library, 300-500 seater classrooms. The quality of the food is good. Medical facilities are available 24/7. The sports center is open 24/7, with a swimming pool, table tennis, volleyball court, badminton court, basketball court, football and cricket shared ground, cricket nets, lawn tennis court, squash, billiards, pool table, chess, air hockey, and many more. The hostel infrastructure is really good, with AC rooms available.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members have done Ph.D. in their domain from prestigious institutes all over the world, and they are highly knowledgeable. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is industry-relevant and almost makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are difficult, but almost the whole class gets passing marks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIITD: Great for R&D, tough workload, beautiful campus, good crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: About 85 to 90% of students are placed. The highest salary was above 1 crore, the average was around 28 LPA, and the lowest was about 7 LPA. All the top companies visit our campus. Approximately 40 to 50% of students begin securing internships from their second year onwards. Many skills such as web development and data handling are emphasized.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi speed is excellent throughout the campus. Labs and libraries are all equipped with Lenovo computer systems. Classrooms are also well-maintained. The hostels are very nice, and the food is good; we are provided breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks in the evening.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are skilled, qualified, and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant and prepares students for the industry. Semester exams here at IIITD are somewhat challenging but manageable. The passing percentage varies by subject, averaging around 30%.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to explore the coding and computer science fields. It would have been better if it were a bit less hectic. There are many events like Teach Fest, Odyssey, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIIT Delhi - A good and bad college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements of the college are very apt. They make efforts to get the students placed after that it's up to the student's efforts and vigor whether they get selected or not. Around 60% of students got placed. The highest salary is 51 LPA, and the lowest salary is 3 LPA. Top companies are Microsoft, Adobe, etc. They hire mainly for tech roles. From CSE, around 80% of students got the placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very modern and great. It is a recently built college and the infrastructure is very great and better when compared to other Delhi Colleges. Hostels are also very nice and modernly built. Only problem is that the AC only runs from 7 to 7 in the hostels which makes it difficult to survive in very hot weather.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are also very qualified. They are great at teaching. They also care for student's feedback and mental health. One issue is that they sometimes overburden the students with quizzes and assignments. But this is justified also given that it's a big college.
detailed_review.Other: The fests are bad and they don't put much effort into conducting them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Hectic routine placements are going down, but it's best for research people.

detailed_review.Placements: 10% of students opt for this branch as it is a comparatively hard course. The average package for this branch is around 23 LPA. STM, Nvidia, Qualcomm, etc., are top recruiters. Few students get internships, but it all depends on the student. ECE is vast, so it has many roles that can’t be just started here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs and all the needed things for the course are top-notch, and the Hostel and food quality are really good. You can completely depend on them. Sports Block has everything you would want, and they also have a good medical center, so no worries.
detailed_review.Faculty: It all depends on the teacher. Some teachers just want to take the lecture, and there are teachers who want to teach, I hope you get it. Most of courses and the curriculum make students industry-ready. Exams are not very difficult. 30% to pass every course, but the grade distribution is good, so it's not easy to fail. Professors are really good. Some are strict, but they are all very helpful if you seek their help.
detailed_review.Other: This course is evergreen but really hard. If you're truly interested in it, only then take it else look for something else. My interest and the live things happening in labs, along with doing all, it make me understand better. Events, fests, and all the extra activities are good and happen every month.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design
reviews.review_title: It has an amazing campus life. There is no amazing course curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: To be honest, on-campus placements lie between 60-70%. The average package is 20 LPA and it goes up to 1 crore per month if converted internships to PPOs. The top recruiting company was Nvidia last year. Many top companies visit our college. Internships are basically provided in the third year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are top. There are no limitations on time. We can go out whenever we want and we just need to do entry and exists. Sports facilities are available 24 hours. The canteen is open 24 hours along with one Nescafe both of which are open 24 hours which is near hostels. Hostels are comfortable with good Wi-Fi.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified but we get problems in understanding. The course curriculum is highly tough. Semester exams are very tough. The pass percentage depends on the course. Sometimes, it is too good and sometimes it is too bad. There is a proper system to communicate with teachers.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Biosciences
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with college. Placements and campus life are good, overall, it is worth the money.

detailed_review.Placements: Top recruiters like Microsoft, Google, Flipkart, Amazon, and SanDisk etc. Visit our college for placements. The highest package this year is 51 LPA, and the average package is around 25 LPA. Most students get placed in all branches except CSSS.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs and classrooms are better than those in most colleges since they are new. The entire campus is equipped with Wi-Fi facility. Mess food is decent and better than that of other NITs or DTU. The library has three floors with different study rooms. Sports and games facilities are not very good. Hostels are the best.
detailed_review.Faculty: The semester exams are difficult and require students to study. The pass percentage is moderate, as most students are able to score passing marks. Some courses are difficult, while the rest are easy. The university focuses more on practical knowledge. Professors are well-qualified.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are the best. Odyssey and many other tech fests take place every year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics
reviews.review_title: It is a great college with a lavish campus and excellent placements, but with extra academic loads.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 95% of students are placed in my branch this year. The highest package is around 50 LPA, the average package is 20 LPA, and the lowest is 12 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google and Microsoft. The internship rate is very high, around 80%, in companies like Microsoft and Goldman Sachs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is great as it was established in 2008. The new and developed buildings are there. Wi-Fi is available in every corner of the campus and is different for mobiles and laptops. Labs and classrooms are well maintained, while the library has access to every type of book in every genres, whether academic or non-academic. The hostel facilities are also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, with more than 10 years of experience from prestigious institutes. The course curriculum is very relevant, it's foreign-type and thus makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are a little tough.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests, like Odyssey, Astra, and Esya.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The infrastructure is excellent, placements are relatively good, and the faculty is incredible.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course this year, about 75% of students are placed so far. The highest domestic package is around 51 LPA. The lowest is about 3.5 LPA, and the average stands at around 20 LPA to 23 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Myntra, and Mykaarma. The percentage is unknown, but students get internships at companies like Google, Microsoft, and Mykaarma. Top roles include Software Development Engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent, with various types of niche laboratories equipped with sophisticated instruments that are easily accessible to students. As for hostels, the food is certainly above average, hygiene is acceptable, the taste is okay, and the variety is great and highly cost-effective. The canteen also serves reasonably priced food. Medical facilities are adequate and available whenever required. The sports and games facilities are amazing; there is a dedicated sports block with all kinds of racquet sports courts and even an indoor swimming pool. We have 2 lawn tennis courts, a basketball court, and a playground. Notable points include a gym facility with trainers and coaches available for various sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified and extremely knowledgeable, with excellent problem-solving skills. The course curriculum and flexibility to intermix courses from various disciplines provide holistic academic support. Along with excellent peer groups, students become industry-ready by the end of the course. Semester exams are generally challenging, but due to the emphasis on regular assessments, quizzes, mid-semester exams, and assignments, students view the difficulty as more of a fun challenge.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course particularly in this college due to its reputation in IT education, the overall industry relevance of the course, and my interest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: This is one of the best college in India.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch has a strength of 650 students, out of which 120 are CSE students. Around 87% of students in my college are placed in companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Flipkart. Almost 20% of students get internships in their 3rd year from top companies in India. Multinational and foreign companies also visit the college to provide job opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus provides 24/7 lab facilities. The hostel has no restrictions, and the infrastructure is excellent. All necessary amenities are available, including a gym, swimming pool, playground, basketball court, football court, cricket ground, labs, library, music rooms, dance room, and yoga room, all within the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are excellent, with top educators teaching here. Almost all faculty members have studied at foreign universities. The curriculum of this college is highly up-to-date, providing good practical knowledge in robotics and other technologies. The college also offers a supportive environment for start-ups.
detailed_review.Other: My course has the highest placement ratio and is a core branch, allowing me to opt for all the sub-branch courses. The curriculum of this college is excellent, even better than that of most IITs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Social Science
reviews.review_title: Overall good for study, but if you're interested in sports, you may be disappointed by facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is 2023, and in my batch, the placement rate last year was approximately 92%. It is very good among all colleges, but there are heavy workloads in IT. The lowest package from TCS was 3.6 LPA, and the highest this year, so far, is 51 LPA, by Microsoft to 13 students, all of whom received PPOs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Faculty members are highly qualified and more innovative toward research, with a helpful nature towards students. However, some professors make courses too hard just by making grading difficult. This creates mental pressure on students, and because of this, many students leave the course at the beginning.
detailed_review.Faculty: According to me, the course is not absolutely job-ready, but it provides a base for it. The semester exams are harder due to the grading system. The exams are normally hard compared to other universities, but they make you more hardworking. It is also hard to maintain a CGPA, so if you are coming, be prepared to work hard.
detailed_review.Other: I just want to go towards social science courses. They can improve by making them more grounded.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics
reviews.review_title: Very hard to sustain because of many deadlines, but really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements:
Our college is best for placement if you're capable of studying.
Placement percentage is around 65% this year, which is good as this year was very different.
My branch has the highest placement percentage, which is around 80%. Many companies are there, such as Goldman Sachs, Winzo, etc.
Software engineer and many high-level roles were offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our infrastructure is very good; it is not vast as it is only 35 acres, but the buildings and everything are very good. Hostels are very good compared to other colleges. Wi-Fi in the college campus is very good and never disappoints. Labs are very well maintained, and the PCs are good there. Classrooms are vast, and the lecture halls are spacious. The library has three floors; it is very good, and each section is divided for studies and discussion. The hostel mess is very good as there are 2 messes. It has good sports equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable, but some teachers were not that good, to be honest. The course curriculum is very good, as it does not teach Physics and Chemistry in the 1st semester and focuses on skills, coding, and Maths. Exams are not that difficult, and grading is relatively easy in almost all subjects.
detailed_review.Other: I like Maths and engineering. I would like it to focus more on coding, as it is a Maths course. Events are not that good, but the Odyssey fest is very good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIITD College walkthrough.

detailed_review.Placements: Great placement stats, almost 100 percent students with an average package of 18 LPA. All companies are either A or A+ tier. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and BNY. Top roles offered are SWE, SDE, and analyst. Around 70 percent of the batch got internships within 1 semester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is fast, big hostel rooms with centralised AC, mess food is good, better than other colleges for sure, the library is big, many books are available, great study rooms, hostel fees could be lesser, and the cleaning staff though takes a lot of time to arrive but does their work with passion.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is excellent. All are Ph.D.s from foreign universities and hard-working professors. The curriculum is updated. Exams are on the harder side but test both for knowledge and skills. However, overall difficulty depends solely on the professors, and the courses could be harder based on the level of the course, e.g.,. 2x, 3x, and so on.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life is kind of dead. Fests are great, however, clubs are dead.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Heaven to see and lucky to study.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 95% students got placement in big MNCS like Zomato, Facebook, etc. Around 60–70% got internships every year and others may get opportunities for higher studies and placement offers. The placement statistics of IIIT Delhi are good and challengeable .
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Top-class infrastructure from tables to chairs and a good atmosphere, a green campus, each and every facility available, nice housekeeping staff, great teaching facilities, as well as opportunities here. Full-time Wi-Fi connection with brilliant security system and all AI tools to check the cheating or any other MS activity done by the students during examination.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are top-class and highly educated, mostly IIITians and curriculum and exams are up-to-date and relevant according to modern science and technology. IIIT DELHI majorly works on the fields of computer science and technology and electronic communication. They provide skills along with good discipline to their students.
detailed_review.Other: There are fewer students in IIIT DELHI, which shows the quality over quantity of the college. They maintain the safety and security of each and every student. Provide all the needed luxury to their students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics
reviews.review_title: Worth the money, providing great opportunities, and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, the number of people placed in our college was quite low, with an average percentage of 30% placed. Applied Mathematics branches can apply and are always selected for any CSE or CSAI departments. The number of people offered internships was also quite low compared to the previous batches. Many companies that were supposed to provide PPO's did not provide PPO's. The top roles offered in placements were SDE roles. Jio, Oracle, Meesho, IBM,  SCry Analytics, and Microsoft being among the top recruiting companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very nice, and the classrooms are top-notch, including the labs, library, and RND. The labs are open to whoever don't have any access to any laptop or device or are just looking for a place to sit between classes. The hostel is also very nice; we have FMS services, which will take any complaints, clean your room, and service the AC in your room. The washrooms are also clean, as they ensure a daily cleaning policy. The quality of food in the mess is average; some day's you'll get good food, and some days you won't. The food available in canteen is below average. Most have to order on food delivery apps.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is very nice and supportive and are well reputed in there respective fields. The teaching quality for some professors is very good; others vary. The evaluation varies from professor to professor, but you'll get plenty of time to focus on extracurricular activities or any other thing you are planning to do, as there is no strict attendance policy (which may vary from professor to professor). The course curriculum is very relevant, and most professors follow the curriculum from Stanford, which is difficult but is used in the respective fields. The curriculum is very rigorous compared to any other college, with the constant assignments. Quizzes give a very heavy workload but prepare the students for the on-coming industry. The semester exams are tough compared to other colleges If you are regularly attending the classes, you'll notice it is slightly easier, but compared to peers in NSUT or DTU, it will be like walking in the park. You are graded based on a curve, so the passing percentage varies according to the average marks. Some professors prefer absolute grading.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the CSAM course at IIIT because it perfectly combines the rigor of CS with the analytical depth of mathematics. This course helped me to equip with essential skills to tackle complex real-world problems, making it an ideal pathway for a career in data science, machine learning or algorithm development. The best things about my course are strong faculty support. They are not only experts in there respective fields but also mentors who encourage innovation and exploration. Also, there are abundant opportunities for research, allowing students to engage in projects that push the boundaries of their knowledge. Also, the course is aligned with industry trends . IIITD hosts exciting events like Tech Fest, cultural celebrations, and hackathons that enrich student life and foster collaboration. The diverse student body creates an engaging atmosphere, encouraging the exchange of ideas and collaborative thinking . The campus is conveniently located near 3 metro stations. The closest being Harkesh Nagar, the other two being Okhla NSIC and Govindpuri. The campus is really beautiful and well maintained, proving a conducive environment for both studying and relaxation. Various scholarships are available for fees and some provide you with devices such as laptops. The campus also has a sports block having activities like squash, badminton, table tennis, and swimming pool. Pool and snooker table—the equipment for these is provided apart from swimming.

admission.title: IIIT Delhi Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: IIIT Delhi admissions are based on scores in entrance exam. The institute accepts JEE Main, GATE, GAT-B, etc. for admission to specific courses. IIIT Delhi offers admission to its flagship programme BTech based on JEE Main scores followed by JAC Delhi Counselling. The institute offers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in the Engineering stream. Besides, IIIT Delhi also offers PG Diploma courses in association with IBM and Great Learning. The application process varies course-wise at the institute.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for BTech in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics at IIIT Delhi for other than general categories?
faqs.answer: In 2024, the cutoff ranks for BTech in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics at IIIT Delhi other than General category was - 23566 for OBC, 94128 for SC, 103550 for ST, and 13240 for EWS. While the admissions are based on the scores/rank obtained in JEE exam, the last cut offs also change a lot depending on All India quota or Home State. Moreover, the cutoff rank also varies if the applicant is a female.

faqs.question: Can I take admission in IIIT Delhi M.Tech without GATE score?
faqs.answer: No, you can't take admission in M.Tech at IIIT Delhi without appearing for the GATE exam. The institute offers this two-year full-time programme at the postgraduate level. Aspirants must meet the basic eligibility of passing graduation in the relevant stream from a recognised university in addition to clearing the GATE exam. For seat allotment, candidates have to register for the CCMT counselling.

faqs.question: Is it expensive to study BTech at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: IIIT Delhi offers the flagship BTech course. The total tuition fees for IIIT Delhi BTech is INR 19.55 L.

faqs.question: Are IIIT Delhi PG Diploma admissions open?
faqs.answer: IIIT Delhi PG Diploma admissions are ongoing for Data Science and Artifical Intelligence. Aspirants must submit the application within the due date. The admission dates are not available as of now. All the admission dates/deadlines are updated on the official website of the institute.

faqs.question: Is JEE Main compulsory for BTech at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates seeking admission in the BTech programme of IIIT Delhi must have a valid JEE Main score. The cutoff is usually less competitive for IIIT Delhi. The highest cutoff scores usually is of Computer Science Engineering. Candidates based on their JEE Main score are allotted seats through JAC Delhi Counselling. In 2024, the JEE Main cutoff for CSE was 6695.

faqs.question: What is the official website to apply for JEE Main 2026?
faqs.answer: Visit the official website of JEE Main  website- jeemain.nta.ac.in .Apply for JEE Main 2024 on the online JEE Main 2024 application form.Candidates who are willing to appear in the exam must register for the JEE Main 2024 and submit the application form before the last date. faqs.question: When will JEE Main 2026 be conducted?

faqs.question: How to take admission in MTech at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply by visiting IIIT Delhi official website. Admission to the MTech CSE, ECE, and CB is based on GATE score. For CB course, selected candidates have to go through an online interview round as well. Moreover, for the MTech CB DBT seats, aspirants are selected based on GAT-B exam scores followed by an interview round. Additionally, for MTech (Research) course admission, PGCAT-IIIT Delhi exam score is accepted following which candidates have to go through an offline interview round. For some of the seats, aspirants are selected on merit-basis.

faqs.question: What is the fee for IIIT Delhi BTech?
faqs.answer: BTech total course fee is cumulative of various fee components, including tuition fee, hostel charges (if applicable), alumni fee, security money, etc. The one-time fee includes a security deposit, admission fee, etc. Table given below showcases the IIIT Delhi BTech fee structure : Fee components Amount (4 years) Tuition fees INR 19.55 Lakh Hostel fees INR 4.40 Lakh One-time payment INR 12,000 NOTE: The above-mentioned fee is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

faqs.answer: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi, accepts the JEE Main entrance exam, followed by JAC Delhi counselling for BTech admission. faqs.question: What is the opening and closing rank for BTech in Computer Science and Biosciences at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: Opening and Closing rank depends on the category and quota of candidates. For the General category under All India, opening rank was 4554 and closing rank was 4659 in 2023. The cutoff in 2024 for the all-India quota ranged from 6695 to 9975 . Cut off are differant when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. Admission to BTech in Computer Science and Biosciences in IIIT Delhi is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for IIIT Delhi BTech courses?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to be Class 12 pass with minimum 70% aggregate in five subjects including Physics , Maths and Chemistry and 70% in Mathematics in Class 12 from a recognised board to become eligible for the BTech programme. Moreover, the aspirant should have passed the qualifying exam from a recognised board. During the form filling and at the time of admission, candidate must hold the pass certificate for verification purposes.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to MTech without a GATE score at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to a MTech course is IIIT Delhi is accepted without GATE score. However, it depends upon the chosen specialisation. GATE score is mandatory for the MTech CB course admission. However, admission to MTech CSE and ECE programmes is done based on merit in GATE, plus PGCAT-IIITD exam scores are also accepted. Additionally, for the MTech CB (DBT seats) admission, the selection is done based on GAT-B score.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for M.Tech course admission at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a valid BTech degree or PG Degree in Science/Mathematics/IT/Computers/MCA from a recognised university can apply for admission. It is further also necessary that the candidate passed the qualifying examination with a minimum of 65% aggregate for admission to CSE, ECE, and CB MTech courses.

faqs.question: Is it expensive to study PG Diploma at IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: The fee varies for both the PG Diploma courses. The total course fee is also inclusive of multiple fee components. Candidates can check out the below-mentioned table for IIIT Delhi fee for PG Diploma programmes: PG Diploma Course Total Tuition Fee Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence INR 2 lakh Data Science & Artificial Intelligence INR 2.48 lakh NOTE: The mentioned fee is taken from external sources. Hence, may vary. It is also inclusive of 18% GST.

faqs.question: Does IIIT Delhi offer a PG Diploma?
faqs.answer: Yes, the institute offers two PG Diploma courses. It offers a nine-month long Diploma course in Data Science & AI (DS & AI) programme with IBM and 12-month long Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence (CS & AI) Diploma with Great Learning. Admission to the CS & AI course is based on merit in an online admission test followed by an interview round. Further, for DS & AI course, candidates are shortlisted and directly called for an online interview round.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for PhD in IIIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: The technology institute admits candidates to PhD courseson merit and respective entrance exam scores. The accepted entrance exams are GATE/ UGC NET/CSIR NET. Candidates shortlisted based on exam scores are then invited for the interview round for final selections. Moreover, for some of the PhD courses, candidates are selected based on performance in the last qualifying examination. It is also crucial that each of the aspirants meet the required eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: What is the IIIT Delhi selection criteria for PhD?
faqs.answer: Admission to the IIIT Delhi PhD programmes is merit and entrance-based. Shortlisted candidates have to go through an interview round for final selection. The accepted entrance exams are GATE / UGC NET / CSIR NET . Based on the candidates' scores in the accepted exam, the candidates are shortlisted.
