sections.heading: Introduction
text: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi) has state-of-the-art academic block with smart classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, and a library. IIIT Delhi has separate hostels for both boys and girls with modern amenities, like air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and laundry facilities.

The college also has a well-equipped sports complex with facilities for cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, and swimming. The institute also has a medical center, a gym, a post office, and a bank. Some more features are as follows:
Campus Building:

sections.heading: IIIT Delhi Academic & Residential Facilities
text: IIIT Delhi Campus features a modern academic complex that includes a 500 ‑seat auditorium, 25 lecture halls of varying capacities (ranging from 25 to 300+ seats), and specialised teaching and research labs spread across dedicated blocks. There are six core departments and several cutting-edge research centres—like the Infosys Centre for AI and the Centre for Sustainable Mobility—that reflect the institute’s commitment to interdisciplinary R&D.

IIIT‑Delhi gives a balanced ecosystem: world-class academic and research infrastructure harmonised with comfortable, well-secured, and socially active residential life, making it a compelling environment for tech-driven education.

sections.heading: IIIT Delhi Library
text: The Library & Information Centre at IIIT Delhi is a multi-level, RFID-enabled facility giving collaborative study zones on the ground floor and extensive print and digital collections upstairs. The IT backbone is robust: over 500 computing nodes, 1 Gbps internet connectivity, 10‑Gbps campus optical backbone, full Wi‑Fi coverage, personal LAN ports in hostels, and a centralised data centre with 45 TB storage.
The collection includes a robust mix of:

sections.heading: IIIT Delhi Hostel Facilities
text: There are four hostels at the IIIT Delhi campus: three for male students with 508, 416 & 454 beds, and one for female students with 380 beds plus 22 married‑PhD accommodations.

Each room has fast Wi‑Fi and LAN connectivity. Basic amenities like water purifiers, laundry services, and 24×7 security & CCTV monitoring are standard across hostels. There's a common mess for all residents during semesters and vacations, which is air-conditioned during lunch, and mess participation is mandatory for hostelites. Also, two cafeterias—one in the academic building and one in the mess complex—serve snacks and refreshments.

paragraphs: IIIT Delhi scholarships are provided under various criteria for the UG and PG level students. The scholarship amount or percentage differs according to the income of the parents.
Chairman’s Merit Scholarship for top BTech aspirants, admitted through JAC Counselling:

Any Delhi student with a JEE Main rank of less than 2,000, seeking admission at IIIT Delhi through JAC Counselling is entitled to a scholarship of Rs 1.25 LPA for four years, provided that the student maintains a CGPA of 8.5 or above. These students are not eligible for the income-linked fee waiver scheme of the scholarships.
Students pursuing any degree from IIIT Delhi are entitled to this scholarship based on following eligibility parameters:
Parents of the wards come under Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
The gross income of parents in service is up to Rs 6 LPA and the last school fee paid is less than Rs 25,000 per year
The gross income of parents in service is between Rs 6 LPA-Rs 8 LPA and the last school fee paid is less than Rs 45,000 per year

highlights.summary:
Established in 2015, IIT Palakkad is one of the third generation IITs in India. IIT Palakkad is currently being mentored by IIT Madras. The college is currently being operated from the temporary campus at the Ahalia Integrated Campus in Kozhippara, Palakkad and the permanent campus in Kanjikode. IIT Palakkad is one of the prestigious colleges of India. It has been ranked 64th under the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF Ranking 2025. About 500-acre of land in Pudussery village of the Palakkad district, Kerala, is planned for the permanent campus of IIT Palakkad.
The institute has signed a study abroad agreement with Auckland University of Technology (AUT), Auckland, New Zealand, The Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, The University of California, San Diego and The University of Texas at Austin among others. These agreements will give BTech final-year students a chance to study one semester at a foreign University.
IIT Palakkad offers BTech, MTech, MSc, MS and PhD programmes across various disciplines such as Chemistry, Civil Engineering, Humanities & Social Sciences, Mechanical Engineering and many more. Candidates can check the IIT Palakkad overview in the following table:

IIT Palakkad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Masters course in the department of Physics.

detailed_review.Placements: As 70% of graduates got placed on campus, from them 73% of students got placed in core companies like Dell, LG Electronics, Hyundai, and the rest of them got hired in their passionate roles like banking, software roles. There are no certain limitations for the students to participate in any of the companies arriving on the campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The specialized equipment and apparatus required for laboratories are maintained in proper conditions to provide accurate results during experimentation. For master's courses in all the departments, only 40 seats are available. Seats are provided on a first-come, first-served basis.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers take the curriculum that is highly relevant to the subject according to the regulations. The schedule for conducting examinations, tests, and taking classes is usually prepared by the teachers based on their convenience. Teachers also use their leisure hours to complete portions on time.

reviews.review_title: Not able to tolerate the professors activities.

detailed_review.Placements: Considering it was a realistic emerging scope, there will be massive offers available for the specific disciplines, with the top offers of 17.8 LPA. Companies like MathWorks, Adobe, and Morgan Stanley are ready to hire. The students from this academic background. One of the demanding courses with the best offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College officials provide seats to the students based on both direct admission and merit admission. All their activities were officially published on their official website, keeping them updated on the social platform. The Institute had consistently been a part of preparing young talent for the nation.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors rule the college, they take all things more casually, which seems they show little interest in the education standards of students. Professors exaggerate even small issues to the biggest ones, which creates anxiety in the minds of the students.

reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with the faculty members and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70-80% of students got placements in recent years. The highest package in this course is approximately 36 LPA, average package is around 15 LPA - 17 LPA, and the lowest package is below 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Accenture, TCS, BNY Mellon, Infosys, etc. Top roles offered are embedded system engineer, hardware design engineer, control system engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are too good. Campus is spread across 504 acres, which is near the Western Ghats. Wi-Fi and classrooms are best. In every class, projector is available, and well-stocked library is present on campus. Food quality is good, and separate hostels are available on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Highly qualified faculty members are available, and mentorships are available in which every student is assigned a faculty advisor. Exams are semester-based and mixture of tests, labs, and assignments. Semester exams are little tough, and in every subject 30% marks are required for passing.

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is the best institute for the B.Tech in Electrical Engineering course.

detailed_review.Placements: Recruitment at the college is good. This year, our seniors are the first batch to sit through the placements. Top companies like ABB, BHEL, NTPC, etc., visit the university. 90% of the students get an internship from our college. The salary range offered is Rs 24,000 to Rs. 30,000. Approximately, 95% of the students are placed. Top roles offered are electrical engineer, power systems engineer, and so on.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's nice that each branch has its own building and labs. The college and hostels offer Wi-Fi. The digital screens are installed in the projector classrooms. The college contains a cricket pitch, followed by a badminton pitch and a basketball court. On campus, you can play indoor games like TT, chess, carrom, and more.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college employs some of the greatest teachers, who are extremely helpful and friendly with students. In any given year, each department has approximately 30 teachers for 70 pupils. Almost all departments have five head teachers. The semester examination is simple, and the pass rate is greater than 93%.

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is the best Institute for a Ph.D. in Chemistry course.

detailed_review.Placements: The enrollment rate in our study is 86%. The average package is about 19 LPA. The top companies that hire civil engineers are Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Lupin Limited, Tata Chemicals, etc. Research scientist, professor, etc., are the top roles offered. Each student has internship opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, and sports facilities are all available on campus, which is excellent. The food in the college canteen is good, and the hostels are very nice. I didn't face any infrastructure issues during my time. There is also a free clinic for students in need, and we have a very good library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our department has a wide variety of instructors, some are exceptional, some are good, and some are extraordinary in some way. There is a lot of student-friendly faculty on campus. They have a great knowledge of our society. Some have a very different teaching style that many students cannot understand.

reviews.review_title: Master's studies in my native place.

detailed_review.Placements: Firstly, the most talented M.Sc. graduates got hired by the college as assistant professors. Also, the interested graduates are permitted to participate in the company drives that commonly occur. Blockrock offers the highest pay for students in the role of finance and banking.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's a campus where even the unknown strangers immediately help us when we reach out to them. It's a cool, hill hostel with fewer conditions, but it's mandatory to fill out the hostel records while living and entering the hostel zones. Transport facilities are available for good safety purposes.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are much quicker at solving complex problems very easily. They had given unique ideas to remember the formulas used in the class. Also, with their guidance, even the failing students pass the papers with good grades. Teachers usually preferred to solve problems in the textbooks.

reviews.review_title: Maximum companies would be the core companies.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement results of our discipline are lower than other department results but alumni of our discipline work in good companies with top-rated packages. They were assured of providing at least one offer with minimal pay which helps to develop skills and work experience. They are good at building networking among core companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Possibilities for exploring industrial visits, and tours are very less but students are allowed for such activities at least once a year. Immediate suspension is raised from the side of college management if we are involved in any unnecessary activities. Food shortages often occur in the canteen zones.
detailed_review.Faculty: As my disciplines mostly belong to the core segment, so mostly include practical knowledge and experience. For uniqueness and complexity, I completely chose this destination. Teachers are enriched with years of excellence in the field of mechanical engineering.

reviews.review_title: Phenomenal college with good values.

detailed_review.Placements: Causal conducting of placement drives starts from orientation to tests, followed by the process of interviews. Most of the electrical industries like BHEL, Havells, and L&T often visit the campus for recruitment. Even though the expected twists and turns happen in the drives. The packages are affordable.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is a little far from the college. But I chose to reside in the college hostel. Hostel food is okay, but I crave my home food. So I left the college every weekend, and it required a lot of approval. It is a phenomenal college with good moral values.
detailed_review.Faculty: Lectures focus on providing comprehensive learning of the technologies from the fundamentals. Usually, teachers build up formal conversation between the students. They won't talk about anything apart from the studies. Frequent assessments are held in the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college with good recognition.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of recruitment from the computer science and engineering department is up to 75% randomly and it is the highest when compared with other courses. The type of training decided by ourselves to attend would decide the pay gained by us in the future. I chose the extreme level of training so I got a package of 13.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Faculty: Special attention to students is given by the faculty members, which creates partition among Us. Sometimes faculty members decide the range for students in academics by themselves which makes some students lose their interest in studies. I would give them 3.5 out of 5 stars for their teaching.
detailed_review.Other: Crowd campus with a thousand of graduates completing their full-time courses from our college. The perspectives of our college in providing education to the students are different from others which is somewhat creative and innovative. Sometimes, some extra charges are collected yearly by showing some reasons.

reviews.review_title: Overall perspectives of mine.

detailed_review.Placements: The comprehensive course curriculum and diverse career opportunities in electronics offer students a wide range of prospects, from embedded systems, telecommunication and VLSI design. The mean package provided to the hired students would potentially between 4.3 LPA to 6.17 LPA.
detailed_review.Faculty: They provided nurturing guidance, helping students navigate challenges and unlock their potential. Their dedication inspires confidence and motivates students to excel. But most of the teachers often navigate to some other colleges for some reasons. For me, exams were the most boring subject of all time.
detailed_review.Other: Students showcase extensive performance in various technical and non-technical fields. Events are organized in the college for the isolated students' union of all the disciplines. So the organisation was literally busy managing the colleges and didn't have enough time to deal with these problems.

reviews.review_title: As being a fresher of IIT, Palakkad.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college placement team only allows students with zero backlogs for placement recruitment. While others are required to attend drives for the companies offering the lowest salary packages. Mostly top performers in academics got placed in good companies and rest of them got placed in other companies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The overall students' rate of success in exams is above 80% all year. For getting such results, we are motivated by faculty members, and they actively making arrangements for scholarships and rewards to lessen the tuition fees required for studying. Faculty members are well-known for their contributions in terms of academics to the department and to the college. Even now, teachers are more scared about their professional growth and keep on improving the same. They also share useful ideas to crack the exams in our first attempt itself.

reviews.review_title: Quite disappointed with the facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of the students who are placed in my course is 55%. The highest package is 10 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, Capgemini, and TCS. Many students also got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure and facilities available for our course are average. Classrooms and labs are outdated and getting old. The hostel rooms are small and comfortable. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is hygienic. No time to play sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified and experienced. They always help students in classes and on the campus. The teaching quality is awesome. Curriculum activities only happen at the start of semester. The semester exams are difficult and have to study a whole year to score.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with IIT Palakkad.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Palakkad had an impressive placement rate of 95 percent and students had a variety of companies to choose from. Companies like JP Morgan, Deloitte, Hindalco etc. Many others arrived for student recruitment. Internships were provided by the college itself every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here was excellent and all facilities were available for students including Wi-Fi, labs, a library, sports facilities and medical services. The campus life was amazing and all necessary amenities were provided to students. The food quality in the canteen was very good with a variety of options available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here were well-educated and quite experienced, but they were very rude. Their teaching methods were not effective, and students faced many difficulties in understanding the lessons. However, the course curriculum was relevant and helped make students industry-ready. Semester examinations required a lot of attention, and the passing percentage was above 40%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of B.Tech in computer science and engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement packages are really impressive which are literally between 3.5 LPA to 28 LPA. The highest package offered is 25.4 LPA given to the students of computer science and engineering at IIT, Palakkad. Most of the reputed corporate companies participate in drives.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Fully climate-controlled classes with comfortable seating for a limited number of students are there. Also, sitting is arranged with drawers and lockers for keeping our books and notes safe and to avoid overloading of the students. We should also be accessible to online learning platforms in case it is needed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Evaluation process of examinations is quite different from other colleges. The best performers from the academics are approached for higher studies abroad which are quite impressive and motivating. Students' marks and their external performances are immediately reported to the higher authorities of the college.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Manufacturing and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: I lived a manifested life at IIT Palakkad.

detailed_review.Placements: I gave a rating of 4.5 out of 5, as it is known for its excellent placement performance. It was one of the top courses for placements with good networking connections among the alumni. The placement team worked hard throughout the year to create records for recruitment.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For every department, there were usually 8 to 10 classrooms with required features like smart boards, green boards, projectors, and laptops or computers. To protect students from health issues. A hygienic environment was maintained with clean restrooms and sanitized study areas.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers made students more interactive and attentive by approaching lesson plans with their own creative ideas, which was quite impressive and encouraged students to engage in class without fail. They took their own time to complete the syllabus without any pressure.

reviews.review_title: Student from IIT Palakkad.

detailed_review.Placements: Only a limited number of students pursued an M.Tech in data science at IIT Palakkad each year. Also, nearly 82 to 90% of students got placed every year. The overall placement training provided to students was a step-by-step process, making the training easier.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Students from various localities, habitations, and races lived similarly without any differentiation or discrimination. The campus was very good, with parking facilities, a lounging mess, transportation, and accommodation. There were specialized laboratories with air-conditioned classrooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: The schedule for examinations was unannounced, occurring once a month. Preparing for examinations, writing exams, validating papers, and then preparing for the next exams was the routine for academic excellence that happened in our college. Every student's status was communicated to their parents by the class charge.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A complete review of IIT Palakkad, Is worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year, mostly 92% of students are placed at IIT Palakkad. Many companies visit colleges, like TCS, Infosys, etc. The academics here are good, and they teach very well on the basic topics so that everyone on campus understands the concepts perfectly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here is decent and follows Kerala's tradition, which makes it look perfect. The environment around the college is evergreen, so we get fresh air that refreshes our minds and gets relief from stress. Hostels are also good and offer facilities for playing table tennis and other indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: In terms of faculty, they are highly qualified in their respective fields and teach excellently. We can approach them anytime during college hours to clarify any doubts. The exams are not difficult if you study hard, but studying one week before exams doesn't help.

reviews.review_title: Good college and good facilities are available.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 50 percent of students were placed. The highest package offered in our college is 12.5 lakhs per annum and the lowest package offered is 4 lakhs per annum. Many MNC companies visit. More than 5 percent of students got internships. The top roles offered are teacher posts, journalism, lecturer posts, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Excellent infrastructure and better facilities are available, like unlimited Wi-Fi access, well-cleaned classrooms, a library, and labs provided with new equipment. Hostel food quality is acceptable, and medical facilities are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very strict and have a good helping nature. They have good qualifications and knowledge in teaching. The teaching quality is excellent, which helps us understand the concepts. Exams are very tough, and we have to study well. Fifty percent of marks are required to pass the semester exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good faculty and staff, decent placements, "85% attendance is mandatory."

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package and average package for B.Tech placements is 41.6 LPA and 15.88 LPA respectively. For CS Department, the highest package is 41.6 LPA and median stood 15 LPA. Placement percentage is 79.07%. For Mechanical Department, the highest package is 20 LPA and median stood 10 LPA. Placement percentage is 76.67%. For Civil Department, the highest package is 20 LPA and median stood 6.28 LPA. Placement percentage is 57.89%. For Electrical Department, the highest package is 36.72 LPA and median stood 15 LPA. Placement percentage is 63.89%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Pros: About classrooms and lecture halls, they are air-conditioned, have projectors, and sufficient space. About computer labs, it is free for everyone (except class timings), even at night. The computer labs have 32GB RAM and 11th Gen i7 Intel processors. High-speed Wi-Fi is available in the campus area and hostel rooms. About Mess, the food is good with many varieties. The food is more North Indian in taste and less spicy. If you don't like the mess food, there is a canteen where you can eat anything of your choice but you have to pay for it. There is also a bus facility to help students and professors reach the required destinations both inside the campus and in Palakkad city. The sports facilities are still growing and are actively participated in by many, you will enjoy them on the lush green campus. There are libraries in both campuses, and if you don't find a book in one library, you may get it in the other library. Cons: There are two campuses, Nila and Sahyadri, almost 2 km apart. Some classes are in the Nila campus and others in Sahyadri. You need to catch the bus, and sometimes the buses are full, so you either wait for the next bus or come by walking. Surviving in this college is hard as you need 85% attendance and will be flooded with assignments. Manage your time well.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty here are really helpful and friendly. Yes, about the teaching part, they teach well, but you will be flooded with assignments and homework. The course curriculum is not completely relevant; you need to learn some skills by yourself, especially soft skills. About assignments and semester exams, they are moderate to tough, so you need to study well.
detailed_review.Other: One thing is, being a new IIT, the clubs here are active so you can make sure you join them in the 1st year and explore and find your interest.

reviews.review_title: The best quality facilities, placements and faculty are available for the students at this college.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT's are holding a very good record for on-campus placements. Around 60–65% of the students get successfully placed in the IIT Palakkad Civil Engineering course. The average package offered at the college for computer science was between 3 and 8 LPA. Various government and corporate companies visit the college for placements. Students were getting multiple placement opportunities at this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Palakkad has very good infrastructure for the civil engineering course. The campus of the college is pretty big and beautiful. The campus of the college is lush with greenery. College management offers facilities such as labs, libraries, canteens, Wi-Fi, sports, etc. that are properly maintained. The quality of these facilities is also good. A hostel facility is also available for college students. The food in the mess and canteen is also good to eat. Various sports and other facilities were available for the students entertainment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors at IIT Palakkad are highly qualified and knowledgeable. All the professors have good experience in the teaching field. They are giving their best for the students. The course curriculum at our college is relevant and it makes the students industry-ready. Professors were also helpful and supportive of the students during placements. Exams were of a medium-difficult level in our course. Various workshops and industry visits are organized by the college professors for the students.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Palakkad has a lively infrastructure spread across an area of 500 acres . The institute has two campuses, namely, Sahyadri Campus and Nila Campus . The Sahyadri Campus has a large academic complex, Saraswati, which has a classroom complex for up to 2000 students. Nila Campus is the initial campus, having modern facilities like multimedia-enabled classrooms, student labs, a library, and Wi-Fi-enabled hostels. Overall, the campus has an inviting atmosphere and beautiful surrounding hills.

sections.heading: IIT Palakkad Campus Highlights
text: IIT Palakkad is one of the top-tier institutes in the country for academic excellence as well as infrastructure facilities. The institute is sufficient with all the basic and additional facilities. There are well-equipped and well-furnished classrooms with comfortable seating. The auditorium is huge enough to carry out events and seminars. The labs are efficient and have all the latest technological equipment. There are six hostels for male and female students. To know more details about the IIT Palakkad infrastructure campus, read further:

tables.IIT Palakkad Campus Highlights: Classrooms, Hostels, Library, Auditorium, Sports Facilities and more

sections.heading: IIT Palakkad Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Palakkad provides academic and research facilities, including specialised labs for electronics, physics and civil engineering. These support research across chemistry, civil engineering, and more, utilising equipment like the High Performance Computing (HPC) cluster. The campus also features multimedia classrooms, a library, and Wi-Fi-enabled hostels, with academic spaces named Samgatha and a laboratory complex named Manogatha.

sections.heading: IIT Palakkad Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: The IIT Palakkad offers hostel facilities to boys and girls. The hostels ensure a secure, comfortable, vibrant and exceptional living experience. The campus has six hostels: four in the tranquil Nila Campus and two in the serene Sahyadri Campus. At the accommodation in the Nila campus, there are rooms on double/triple sharing occupancy, while at the Sahyadri Campus, the rooms are on single/triple occupancy.

sections.heading: IIT Palakkad Library
text: As the informatics centre of the Institute, the Central Library provides a great learning experience with a carefully developed collection of :

The library also has the support of the national consortium E-Shodh Sindhu (INFLIBNET) to fulfil the maximum journal requirements. The operations of the library are fully computerised and enabled with the RFID system for fast transactions, for ease of access, as well as for the security of the library. The library is also equipped with Wi-Fi and LAN facilities for unlimited high-speed internet access. Online facilities of the library are available 24/7/365 days for its registered users. Users can renew, reserve books through the Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) at any time. The library also renders services such as Reference and Consultation, as well as updates the users with the Current Awareness Services. The users of the Central Library of IIT Palakkad are also registered with the National Digital Library sponsored by MHRD and coordinated by IIT Kharagpur.

sections.heading: IIT Palakkad Sports Facilities
text: IIT Palakkad has a wide range of sporting facilities. These include those for cricket , football , badminton , table tennis , volleyball , chess , and athletics . There are well-equipped gymnasiums in both Nila and Ahalia campuses, along with fitness instructors to practice fitness routines.  A physical training instructor manages these facilities, coaches, as well as a student sports secretary who organises sporting events regularly throughout the year. The sporting events and facilities are open to all students, staff and faculty. Dedicated sports secretaries are also appointed for individual sports to facilitate increased participation of students in various sporting activities.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around IIT Palakkad
text: IIT Palakkad offers many beautiful places to visit nearby. There are pretty waterfalls nearby, such as Dhoni Waterfalls and Meenvallam Waterfalls . Rock Garden or Fantasy Park can be visited for recreational purposes. For those interested in historical monuments, Palakkad Fort can be visited. Other places include- Kava View Point- East , Malampuzha Ropeway Station , Seethargundu Viewpoint , Pothundy Dam , Seetharkund Waterfalls and more.

highlights.summary:
National Institute of Technology Delhi also known as NIT Delhi is one of thirty-one NIT Colleges in India that was established in 2010. It is spread across 51 acres of land, Institute is located in Narela, Delhi. NIT Delhi functions under support of Ministry of Education, Government of India. NIRF has ranked it 65th under Engineering category and India TOday has ranked it 22nd under engineering. Furthermore, NIT in Delhi is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
NIT Delhi has many departments through which it gives many UG, PG, and PhD programmes. NIT Delhi courses include BTech, MTech, and PhD. The highest package offered during NIT Delhi placement 2024 stood at INR 62 LPA and INR 15.6 LPA, respectively.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The next top institute of India.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, 87.6 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 67 LPA, the lowest is 8 LPA, and the average is around 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Nvidia, and Google. Almost 50 percent of students have internships this year. The top roles offered are SDE, Data Scientist, and Business Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are available for all students who want them. Sports facilities include a football ground, cricket ground, table tennis court, badminton court, and basketball court, along with many indoor sports. Labs are accessible with permission from the authorities. Wi-Fi is available 24/7. All classes have smart boards. The library is small but has enough books, though seating space is limited. In the hostel, a night canteen is available, and medical facilities are accessible day and night.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members have at least a Ph.D. They explain topics well and are highly qualified. They have strong knowledge in their fields and use PPTs and visuals to teach. They are good at solving doubts if asked. The course is well-suited to industry level, though some subjects from other departments are not very relevant. Semester exams are moderately difficult. Around 90 to 95 percent of students pass every year.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it has good potential and supports my career advancement. I wish more trees and greenery, as there is a lot of pollution in Delhi, or that the college authority could provide air purifiers. We have many events and fests in the college. Overall, it has great environment.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Perfection does not need any review of placements.

detailed_review.Placements: As you know, NIT Delhi is one of the fastest-growing NITs in India. So, as the growing speed of their placement rate is also increasing year by year across all departments. Its placement rate reached 100 percent in the last few years. In the CSE department, there is 100 percent placement rate in 2025, with 58LPA the highest and 18.27 LPA the average package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is an issue for boys that their hostels are 6 km away from the college, which is why many students are not enjoying their campus life efficiently. Food quality is extraordinary. All classes have a separate Wi-Fi system and all labs have an individual system for each student.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are so many teachers who are knowledgeable and helpful for us in all our activities. All teachers teach us like a beginner, and they give relevant knowledge to us and make difficult exam papers so that we can analyze our problem-solving capability very efficiently.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I think it was the best choice according to my rank in JEE Main. I wish to add other programming languages to my curriculum. There are several activities held in college, like sports, events, Zeal, fests, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Delhi decoded easily.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement scenario of my college is far better than that of other colleges, and the percentage of students who are placed is around 90 percent. The highest package is 50 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. The top companies come to this college because it is a government institution.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The best infrastructure with good campus life, having good facilities, and not only this, but also the campus provided me the opportunity to explore many things. The labs are air-conditioned and the college is giving Wi-Fi, and most importantly, the mess and canteen are far better.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are better not the best, but the most talented people from a good college, having so much experience in teaching, teach us the best possible course. The semester exams are difficult, but you can pass them easily and clear them because if you studied hard, you can.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A brief of the NIT Delhi.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all the ECE students are placed well in both core and technical areas. The average package is 10-12 LPA. The recruiting companies are Microsoft, Samsung, Wipro and more. Some students are placed in the same company where they intern. Many tech companies are also coming for only the CSE branch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is under construction, so sometimes it does not feel that comfortable. But the new hostel is awesome, where the LAN facilities are also available rather than Wi-Fi. The mess food is not that good. There is also a night canteen. The college provides many sports and gym facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are PhD holders (all experienced) and very humble in nature and supportive. The course curriculum has changed in the last two years to include new subjects like AI, machine learning, etc. There are two exams in the semester, mid sem and end sem.
detailed_review.Other: The events and fests are awesome, which give the full college life vibe.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I had two valuable years at NIT Delhi.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Delhi has a great placement record each year. The average salary offered is one of the highest among all NITs. The highest package offered in 2024 was 62 LPA, and the lowest package was 16 LPA. The average package was 17 LPA. Companies like Adobe, Amazon, Microsoft, and Deloitte visited the college for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: At NIT Delhi, construction is undergoing. It has shifted to a permanent campus, and it is a well-furnished campus. All LTs ( lecture theatres) are air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped and have all the required equipment. Currently, there is only one hostel for boys and one for girls. The other hostel is expected to be complete by August 2025. Sports facilities are good. It has most of the sports courts and grounds.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Delhi has one of the best curriculum systems, as the NEP ( new education policy) is implemented here. All faculty members are PhD holders and experienced in their respective fields. Exam patterns are suitable for students. There is not too much pressure for the curriculum.

reviews.review_title: I have to say about placements that NIT Delhi has a good record and average salary is 12.5 LPA.

detailed_review.Placements: We are the first batch in NIT Delhi in the department of mechanical engineering. We will pass out in 2026 as a student of first batch in mechanical branch. We don't have seniors to guide us for placements and others so we have to do our best by ourselves. We are the seniors but I have to say that our faculty members are too good here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Courses are completed at the end of the semester as we all know our college has recently shifted to the new campus at Bakoli village. So infrastructure is all new and according to the new beautiful design. All facilities are provided better than expected.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are too good. But the criteria for maintaining the attendance is at least 75% which I think no student wants. Most of the day scholar students are not even able to attend the lecture due to the busy traffic in Delhi on time. So it would be very difficult to attend the lecture for day scholars. Also, if they don't allow in the exam if attendance is less than 75%.
detailed_review.Other: The reason for choosing this branch is that I come from a rural background where I see so many physical things like automobiles, other machines, and materials. All these things motivated me to go into this field. One more thing is that my rank is also around to get into this branch for college like NIT. I want to come to Delhi to pursue my degree that's why I chose this college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life at NIT Delhi is overall a good experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95% of students get placed here. Top recruiting companies like Amazon, Google, Flipkart, Meesho, Walmart, etc., provide good placements to software students. Core companies like Bansal, Tata, and Reliance also offer good opportunities. Internship opportunities are provided to the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course infrastructure and syllabus are best. Facilities available in labs and library are also good. The food quality in the mess is good. Sports and games are also great. The mess and canteen provide food at an affordable price.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and supportive. The curriculum is also relevant to real-world problems and makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are not very difficult, based on the syllabus. The pass percentage is 33%.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course is that it makes you industry-ready. The practical knowledge and information it provides are relevant to the real world. Events and fests are usually organized here. Scholarship facilities are also available for students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied with the mess food, but absolutely good placements and a wonderful college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75 to 80 percent students were placed every year in our college. The highest package of our college is 82 LPA, the average package is around 15 LPA, and the least package is 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Wipro, Isuzu, and some Japan-based companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college, hostel, and the course is very nice. You will be provided with well-spaced labs and very nice classrooms with AC. Wi-Fi facility is also available here, but the speed is not up to the mark. The library consists of nearly more than 20,000 books. The facilities provided in the hostel are okay, and the food quality provided by the mess has to be developed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the faculty is very much helpful and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is very precise and perfect. The course curriculum is very much related and relevant to the present life situations. Yes, all the required skills and lessons were taught here so that a student can be ready for the industry. The difficulty level of the semester exams is nominal.
detailed_review.Other: There were a lot of cultural fests and events to participate in, and you will definitely enjoy a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in VLSI Design and Technology
reviews.review_title: Residential life of NIT Delhi.

detailed_review.Placements: Very good placement is offered by our college. The average package of NIT Delhi is one of the highest among all NITs. Recently, 64 LPA, the highest package, was offered. This year, 4 to 5 students are offered packages above 50 LPA. Many of the companies, which are MNCs, visit our campus, like Walmart, Google, etc. The college also provides internships with good stipends. Some students also get stipends of 1 Lakh per month. Many students get stipends of around 50k per month. Companies visiting for internships also offer PPO to some students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is still under construction, so the infrastructure of the college is not that good. But according to its model photos placed in the admin block, the college will get a brilliant look after the completion of the construction. The campus contains all the basic needs required by students, like a common room, library, sports room, health center, canteen, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at NIT Delhi are well-graduated from decent colleges and have published many research papers. Most of the faculty members are a member of international conferences in their respective fields. Course curriculum is very good, as it has the designed recently. It is designed according to the current requirements of companies. The difficulty level of college exams varies depending on the teacher to teacher and subject to subject. Some teachers make strict markings, while some make it very smooth. The majority of students pass exams, and only 2 to 3 get backlogs in subjects.
detailed_review.Other: VLSI is going to have a very bright future in India, as the government is focusing on semiconductors. Our course contains a chemistry subject, which could be removed, as it is not majorly used. The college conducts 4 fests throughout the year, but all the fests are not that good due to the ongoing construction of the college.

reviews.review_title: College with good infrastructure but not fully constructed and dissatisfied with the hostel.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Delhi provides decent placements to the students, with an average package of 16 Lacs per annum and the highest package of 85 Lacs per annum. Some of the companies that recruit from our college are Accenture, BlackRock, Swiggy, Zomato, Flipkart, Meesho, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Delhi got its permanent campus recently, so its infrastructure is very good but not fully constructed, with smartboards in classes, properly functioning labs, and all the necessary infrastructure and machinery provided. Moving to the hostel, it is average, not too good, and the food is just eatable.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the professors are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, with good teaching quality. Moreover, the course curriculum is totally inclined towards the current demand in society. Every semester compromises of two exams: one is the mid-semester exam of 25 marks, and the end-semester exam of 50 marks, out of which there is no limit for mid-semester marks, but a minimum of 15 is required in the end-semester exams to pass.
detailed_review.Other: Being a college of national importance, the college authorities, professors, and teaching quality are average, but more improvement in teaching quality is required. Moreover, there are no fests organized, which means campus life is almost dead, which is quite concerning.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: We have a very good placement states and college life is fun too.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Delhi has a strong placement record, with 80-90% of students getting placed. The highest package offered was 40-50 LPA, the lowest was 5 LPA, and the average package in CSE was 15 LPA. Companies that visited the campus included Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Gamescraft, and DeShaw. In addition, 70-85% of students got internships that led to pre-placement offers. This year, the highest package offered was 64 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our hostels are very clean and comfortable. Each room has two attached washrooms, and the mess food is quite good. The admin block has a lot of labs and classrooms, all of which have projectors and air conditioning. We also have canteens on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are very helpful, and the semester exams are not that difficult. The passing marks for each subject are 30%, and there is a 75% attendance requirement. The courses cover a variety of topics, including AI, ML, and data science. The college also offers minor degrees.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested in software development. I like the college environment very much, and all the students, seniors, and professors are very helpful. The college organizes many events, and I participate in many of them. Some of the events are organized by various clubs in the college, such as Teach Fest Anveshna.

reviews.review_title: Facilities and infrastructure are good.

detailed_review.Placements: It is a new NIT, established in 2010, but even after being new, NIT Delhi shows good placement records. Its placement is growing exponentially fast. The classes are very good, nice, and clean. The faculty is also very good. The highest placement offer is around 82 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. All the major recruiters come, like Microsoft and Atlassian. The percentage of internships is also good, but there is a majority of software-related companies. Even other branch students also prepare for software internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. We have Wi-Fi, good clean classrooms, and a library. But the hostel is not so good; the rules are very strict. The mess food is just okay; you have to compromise here. The mess price is a bit on the higher side, but they still don't provide good quality food, so this is the major thing where you have to compromise.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are good and helpful. Semester exams are a bit tough. The pass percentage is about 90 percent. The syllabus is similar to the GATE syllabus. Teachers help you if you are preparing for any competitive exams like GATE, CAT, UPSC, and others.
detailed_review.Other: NIT Delhi also offers lot of cultural and technical fest and a lot more during regular intervals.

admission.title: NIT Delhi Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
NIT Delhi admission 2025 starts with the registration process for JEE Main January session. Admission to NIT Delhi is subject to various national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main and GATE. Consisting of six departments that offer BTech, MTech and PhD across various specialisations, the flagship programme of NIT Delhi is BTech which is offered across three specialisations. Admission to BTech is based on JEE Main scores followed by JoSSA Counselling. Read on to know more on NIT Delhi admissions.

faqs.answer: IIIT Allahabad accpets JEE Main score for admission to the BTech courses. The Round 1 closing rank for BTech ranged between 4817 and 8428 for BTech. faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted by NIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: NIT Delhi conducts admissions to its flagship BTech and M.Tech courses through the entrance test basis. Students can appear for the prominent accepted exams for Engineering programs and obtain valid scoring. Entrance exams include Junior Entrance Examination (JEE) Main, Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE), and Centralized Counselling for M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan (CCMT).

faqs.question: What is the hostel fee for B.Tech students at NIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: The BTech courses hostel fee at NIT Delhi differ acc. to the accommodation. The institute has two facilities in hostel rooms- AC rooms & non-AC rooms T he caution money for the mess & hostel is INR 10,000 each. The total fee amount is taken from the official site/sanctioning body & can change anytime.

faqs.question: How can I apply to NIT Delhi for MTech?
faqs.answer: All the programmes of NIT Delhi are entrance exam based and seats are allotted through individual counselling. M.Tech seats are allotted through CCMT counselling. To apply for the same, candidates need to visit the official website of GATE and fill out the application form followed by paying the prescribed application fee online. Check out the application process of GATE here.

faqs.question: Does NIT Delhi offer seat reservations in BTech course for Delhi students?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Delhi offers seat reservations in BTech course for Delhi state quota or home state quota. The institute reserves 50% of seats for candidates from Delhi (Home State quota). Candidates seeking admission under the Home State quota must provide government-approved and verified documents as proof of residence in Delhi.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for M.Tech course at NIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: While filling out the GATE application form for admissions to the M.Tech course at NIT Delhi, candidates are required to pay the application fee after the submission of important documents. The application fee varies according to the students' category. Check out the application fee below: For Examination Centres in India Regular Period During the Extended Period Female candidates (per paper) INR 750 INR 1,250 SC/ST/PwD category (per paper) INR 750 INR 1,250 All other candidates (per paper) INR 1,500 INR 2,000

faqs.answer: NIT Delhi JEE Main cutoff 2025 has been released for round 1. The cutoff was released for candidates belonging to the All India quota. Among the General AI category candidates, the closing ranks in round 1 varied between 6610 and 23444 . Among the OBC AI category candidates, the cutoff ranks varied between 2371 and 8056 . Apart from General and OBC category, the cutoff was released for SC, ST, and other categories. Candidates can check all the information for NIT Delhi JEE Main cutoff here . faqs.question: What is the selection process for B.Tech at NIT Delhi? What is the minimum score required in JEE Mains?
faqs.answer: The selection process for the BTech course at NIT Delhi depends on the scores achieved by applicants in JEE Mains scores followed by JoSAA counselling. Initially, the minimum eligibility criteria required by the institute is candidate ' must qualify for their Class 12 from Science stream with a minimum aggregate of 75%. The institute does not specify the minimum score required to get admission to UG engineering courses , the required score can vary each year depending on competition, seat availability, and the category of the candidate . For Computer Science and Engineering , the last year's i.e., 2024 JEE Mains ranks on which the admission closed was 8018. Additionally, candidates can check out the past eight-year JEE Mains cutoff for the BTech course at NIT Delhi from here: NIT Delhi Cutoff .

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to NIT Delhi for BTech?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Delhi BTech admission is given based on the valid score in JEE Main. Students must also attend the JoSAA Counselling after giving the exam. For remaining seats, students can apply for the CSAB Counselling. Students must also have done their Class 12th with 75% as an aggregate (for the General category).

faqs.question: Can NIT Delhi be considered a good college?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Delhi is a good college. NIT Delhi functions under the aegis of the Ministry of Education, Government of India. NIT Delhi is one of the thirty-one NITs that was established in 2010 by an act of parliament and the college has been declared an Institute of National importance. The National Institute of Technology Delhi is ranked 51 by NIRF (National Institutional Ranking Framework) 2023 for BTech. NIT in Delhi is approved by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education) and through six departments, offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes to students. These programmes are provided across Applied Sciences, Engineering, and various other streams.

faqs.question: How expensive is the BTech programme of NIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: The fee for BTech NIT Delhi is INR 5 lakh. The fee mentioned here is the total tuition fee & is taken from an unofficial source. For the detailed NIT Delhi BTech fee structure info, students are advised to contact the admission department of the University. Additionally, students are also required to pay INR 1,000 (application fee) for boys & INR 800 for girls.

faqs.question: What specializations are offered for M.Tech programmes  at NIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: NIT Delhi offers two-year M.Tech programmes with the following specializations: Analytics in Computer Science and Engineering, Power Electronics and Drives in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, VLSI in Electronics and Communication Engineering, and CAD/CAM in Mechanical Engineering. Students are admitted based on their GATE scores and through the CCMT counseling process. Each programme offers 15 regular seats and 2 seats for DASA students.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to M.Tech course at NIT Delhi without GATE scores?
faqs.answer: For NIT Delhi M.Tech admissions , GATE scores are a must. For candidates who wish to apply for the course through the centralised d CCMT ( Centralized Counseling for M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan.) process., NIT Delhi follows the rules and regulations of the CCMT admission process that requires a valid score in the GATE entrance examination for admission in regular M.Tech PG programme. However, in some instances, NIT Delhi does accept candidates without a valid score in the GATE examination. But this admission procedure can be done if some seats are vacant after GATE -based admissions , some of the vacant seats can be offered to sponsored or part-time students. It must be noted , that to secure these vacant seats at NIT Delhi requires candidates to fulfil certain eligibility criteria i.e. , candidates must have a certain period of work experience, a recommendation letter, certain scores in graduation, and might need to qualify for an interview conducted by the institute.

faqs.answer: JEE Main is conducted in two sessions each year, with session 2 usually held in April. faqs.question: How can I apply for NIT Delhi in Delhi?
faqs.answer: The application process of NIT Delhi is same for all the candidates. NIT Delhi application process is online . The institute accepts JEE Main scores for admission to its BTech programme. Admissions to NIT Delhi are granted through the JoSAA counselling . Candidates who want to pursue higher education from NIT Delhi must appear for the course-specific entrance exams accepted by the institute. After qualifying for the course-specific entrance exams, candidates must apply for the counselling process. In the case of BTech, after qualifying for the JEE Main exam candidates must apply for the JoSAA Counselling process. Candidates can apply for JoSAA on its official website.

faqs.question: What should I do to get a direct admission in NIT Delhi for BTech?
faqs.answer: For direct admissions at NIT Delhi for BTech, students must first ask if such provision is even available in the college. If there is a provision, the students must timely apply for the course.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The National Institute of Technology Delhi has a big campus and provides various facilities to undergraduate and postgraduate students. The National Institute of Technology Delhi has a central library, modern classrooms, and provides various facilities for students. National Institute of Technology Delhi has a canteen and provides transportation facilities for students.

(As per the NIT Delhi Shiksha review, " The infrastructure of our college is one of the best among the NITs. As of now, NIT Delhi offers UG and PG programs like B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D. for UG. There are six programs: computer science engineering, electrical and electronic engineering, EE, ME, and civil engineering." )

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The Institute's library has a collection of 14026 (with 2500 Titles) printed books including textbooks/ book bank/ ref. book, 4450+ book bank, 6000+ e-journals. The library uses Web-based Libsys 7 library automation software for the automation of various activities and services of the library. The users can search and find the bibliographic details of all the collection available in the library from any location through Internet or Knimbus Mobile App.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The boys hostels are located in the main campus of the Institute in Narela, while the girls hotel is located at Rohini, Delhi. Currently, boarding facility has been extended to almost 150 students at hostels (both boys and girls) and adequate bus facility has also been extended for commutation of students staying at YWCA Girls Hostel, Rohini as well as for day scholars.

data.description: The NIT Delhi faculty are themselves scholars. The National Institute of Technology Delhi has well-qualified and experienced faculty members. NIT Delhi faculty are diploma, PhD, and master's degree holders. National Institute of Technology Delhi faculty members have years of successful experience in relevant fields.

highlights.summary:
Established in 1961, Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) Surat is recognised by the UGC. It is a part of the 30 NITs that have been recognised by the Indian Government due to their national importance. SVNIT Surat courses are offered at the UG, PG, Doctoral and Integrated degree courses in the field of Engineering and Technology. Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology ranked 66 in the Engineering category by NIRF 2025.
NIT Surat is recognised for its Quality Improvement Programme at MTech and PhD levels by the GOI. The Institute also has a Centre of Indian Knowledge System and Centre for the Tribal Technology Devolopment.
SV NIT Surat scholarships can be availed by eligible students on the basis of merit and need. The National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students is one popular scholarship to which students apply to every year.
