SVNIT Surat Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Getting admission is completely worthwhile.

detailed_review.Placements: I am B.Tech 2nd year student in the Department of Civil Engineering at SVNIT, Surat. Placement ratio is about 57 percent. Girls placement ratio is more than the boys. Top companies include Cem India. Top roles offered by the course are construction and building management, planning etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure is good enough for living with proper Wi-Fi, a hygienic environment and spacious rooms. The department has a good study environment, with a central library with a fully equipped infrastructure and books. AC are available. Spacious enough for a large crowd.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful, and every faculty member is a graduate from a recognised college of the country, having good industry connections, which is helpful for the students. They also offer internships for the students which prove to be beneficial for them because they help them to experience a real work experience.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is good and feels like a family far from home. Living with that many people is a good life experience.

reviews.review_title: I am quite satisfied, except for the sports facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course (Civil), placements are quite decent. It is around 50 to 60 percent in recent years. The highest placement is 16 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA, while the average salary is 6.8 LPA. Overall, placements are good. Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Adani Group, and Reliance Industries are among the top recruiters, but they generally don’t offer more than 8-9 LPA. Top roles include site engineer, executive engineer, and junior project manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of our college is above average. The CSE, Electrical, and Chemical departments have very good infrastructure, while the Mechanical department buildings and classrooms are the worst. The Civil Engineering department has good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is not available in most departments. Classes have a separate building. There are two more buildings, Civil A wing and Civil B wing. Separate drawing halls and labs are available. Hostels have good room space and facilities. Mess food varies, but overall, it is decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Civil Engineering faculty members are highly qualified and the best in their field. They have a good reputation outside the college as well. They provide projects and on-site internships for field research and are very helpful if approached. Exams are easy, and students can score a decent CGPA by studying for around one week before exams. Some exams are hard. Around 90 percent of students pass without any backlog or supplementary.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Civil because it has good opportunities in both the government and private sectors. Civil engineering allows a lot of time for extracurricular activities and sports. The biggest improvement needed is in sports facilities and equipment quality, as there is no separate ground for each sport. There is no shortage of events. Almost every week, there are games, dancing, or singing events. Along with the freshers' party (Kashish) and annual fest (Sparsh), there is also a technical fest (Mind Blend).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfying placement with good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a student of Electronics and Communication Engineering department. In our batch, till now around 50-60 percent students got placed. The highest package is around 40 LPA, the lowest package is 5 LPA, and the average is around 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Apple, Meesho, Oracle, ZS Associates, and around 20-30 percent, students got internship. Roles offered are software side only like frontend developer, backend engineer, AI/ML engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All general facilities are available in our campus such as Wi-Fi, library, labs, and all are well maintained and perform satisfactorily to help a student grow in their field. Talking about hostel infrastructure, it lags in some facilities. There is no common room for study and gaming instruments depend on hostel, in some hostels there is a playing area and in some hostels there is none. The mess is well maintained, but you can't expect home-like food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified and they are very knowledgeable in their field. Teaching quality depends on teacher; some teachers are just trying to complete their hours and some try hard to explain the concepts to students. The course syllabus is very relevant to industry standards. Semester exams are difficult, but if you solve past year papers and class notes, then you will pass the exam with good CGPA.

reviews.review_title: A lot of events, fests, and seminars are conducted on different topics in BHU, students can enroll.

detailed_review.Placements: The overall placement of college is good, M.Sc. courses, placement is 50% and the average is about 7.5 to 8.5LPA, and while B.Tech courses offer more placement records, but the core branches and the M.Sc. courses grab almost the same.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the departments are excellent, and many departments are undergoing major renovation. LAN is provided in all hostels and a library, overall, the infrastructure is good, and hostels are clean, but in some wings, there are issues in the bathroom areas. There are also times when the LAN does not work for 2 to 3 days, and there is also a connectivity problem in the rooms on the first floor of Gajjar Bhavan.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are well qualified here, and they know enough to teach each one of you. The core branches of the curriculum are a little tougher than the other branches. Curriculum is a little old, I personally feel, but with the internet and self learning, you can do a lot better here.
detailed_review.Other: I chose integrated M.Sc. because it has decent placement statistics and overall good exposure for research. You can go globally for higher studies, like Ph.D., fully funded, because of the reputation of the NITs, and also because of your research experience.

reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied with placements, infrastructure, and the education course.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75% students are placed this year in my course. The highest package is 36.42 LPA, the lowest is 3.30 LPA, and the average is 10.25 LPA. Top Recruiting companies for my course are Siemens, Larsen & Toubro (L&T), Mercedes-Benz, and Bharat Petroleum, alongside prominent IT and consulting firms such as Amazon, Qualcomm, Intel, Deloitte, TCS, and Infosys. Around 25% students got internships in my course in companies like Reliance, L&T, etc. Top roles offered in my course are core positions in Power Systems, Power Electronics, and Control Systems, to non-core roles in AI/ML, Data Science, and Software Development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and course departments have no Wi-Fi. The quality of food in Mess is below average, and in some hostels it's the worst. Canteen food is roughly average. Medical facilities are not very good. Many sports and games faculty members are also lacking, like a football ground, a proper gym for everyone, badminton, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is not as expected as from a NIT here. The course is more focused on theoretical knowledge instead of practical knowledge. The course is not proper according to the faculty. Difficult levels for exams are average. Overall, the pass percentage is good.
detailed_review.Other: I thought Electrical Engineering would be a great choice for my career, and it also matched my interests. The syllabus must be more focused on practical rather than only theoretical knowledge. Events and fests are very poor due to huge corruption. Extra-curricular activities are also lacking. The infrastructure is very poor.

reviews.review_title: Review of Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate is around 75%. It includes both on-campus and off-campus opportunities. The highest package currently is 12 LPA. But this year, a student secured a 75 LPA package through an off-campus placement at Google. Almost everyone gets an internship by the third year, provided they’ve stayed consistent and haven’t made major mistakes. A wide variety of roles are offered, and it's up to each student to decide which role suits them best or is more valuable. Everyone has their own path.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) Surat has a decent campus. Most of the area is covered in greenery. A significant portion of the campus is also occupied by unused or abandoned buildings, beyond the currently usable infrastructure. The hostel conditions are better than those in some NITs but worse than others. Overall, not always up to good living standards. However, that’s part of the charm of college life. The internet connectivity is quite poor, but the labs and classrooms are decent. The library, on the other hand, is excellent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my course are qualified and knowledgeable. But I do not think most of them know how to teach effectively. I believe this is not just an issue at Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology Surat, but a common problem in many government colleges. That said, the teachers are generally helpful. The curriculum is relevant but outdated and quite basic, especially for core subjects, so if you are aiming for placements, you will need to put in extra effort beyond the syllabus. Students generally do not score very high grades in my course, but most of us do manage to pass.
detailed_review.Other: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) Surat is a national-level college with the NIT and 'Institute of National Importance' tag. However, the teaching style and events are quite basic compared to those in IITs.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Transportation Engineering and Planning
reviews.review_title: It has a really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students got placement offers in our course. The extremely high salary package offered in our course is 18 LPA. The average package offered in our course is 8 LPA. 70-80% of students got internships in our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available in the college. The library has a huge collection of good-quality textbooks. Sports facilities are good. The quality of the hostel is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors of our course are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective fields. The teaching quality of our faculty members is extremely good. The course curriculum is relevant. Students become ready for industry jobs. Semester examinations are quite tough.

reviews.review_title: My college is good in every manner.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 160 out of 200 got placed in my field, and the average salary was 6 LPA. Minimum salary was 2.5 LPA, and maximum salary was 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies were John Deere, AMNS India, and Vedanata. Internships like 40% of people got core branch work mainly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities were good and infrastructure was also good for my course. Classroom was not that much comfortable but other than that everything was good. Hostel quality was superb and their food was also good. Medical facilities were also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very helpful, they even helped a lot regarding doubts. Some teachers had good technical knowledge about their field. Course curriculum was relevant and it made the students ready for industry. Semester exam was moderate but checking was tough.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I love machines. I also love that how they work and which kind of mechanism was there. Some technical knowledge needed to improve like in-depth need to take information. They arranged many events and extracurricular activities were very good

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: SVNIT to explore better.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year total 70% of students got placed in electronics branch. Top recruiting companies are Visa, Master Card, Samsung, etc. Roles offered are software engineer, GET, and data or business analyst. Roles related to engineering disciplines like civil, mechanical, electrical, and electronics. The highest package offered at SVNIT Surat is 52 LPA. About 50% of students got internships from our course in companies like Tata, Microsoft, L&T, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Our college has good networking for the alumni association. SVNIT has 
Wi-Fi facility for the students and staffs. The institute has a central computer central center that takes care of the internet access requirement throughout the campus, including administration and academic departments, hostels, staff quarters, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: SVNIT is considered well-qualified, knowledgeable, and helpful. Teaching quality is generally good. The course curriculum at SVNIT Surat is generally considered relevant and aims to prepare students for the industry. Generally manageable with a high pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because this course has a better future in semiconductor industry in India. Coding culture we have to improve in our college. Cultural fest is Sparsh and technical fest is Mindbend.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Recession affects the placement of every tier of college.

detailed_review.Placements: In the current year, there are almost 70% of students got placed in the CS department. Because of the recession, internships are affected badly. Only 30-40% of students got internships. In this course, top companies offer the role of SDE. For smaller startups, they can also give development-related roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For the course and department, facilities are average. There are labs and a library. There is poor connectivity in the department. In labs, systems are outdated, but we can manage it. The hostel quality depends upon which hostel is given to us.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are kind of helpful if we approach them or else they don't care much. The course curriculum is relevant to some extent but it doesn't make the students industry-ready. Students need to prepare themselves for the industry. Semester exams are difficult as compared to other colleges.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is okay. Good companies do come here and some faculty members are good.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 65-70% of students from the computer science and engineering course got placed in the year 2025. The highest package offered off campus is 54 LPA by Amazon and on campus, it is 31 LPA by Visa. Top recruiters are VISA, Fanatics, Oracle, Well Fargo, Searce, etc. From the 2026 batch, around 35 students got internships in companies like GE Healthcare, Placewit, Visa, Cisco, etc. The top roles offered are software engineer, analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities in the department are good like water facility, electricity, etc. The only thing that I didn't like was the LAN/ Wi-Fi facility because sometimes it didn't work in labs. Rest all things are good. Labs are clean. Hostel facilities are good and the mess food is also good if students are vegetarians.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and professors teach by PPT slides which does not give a good understanding of the concept. Not all teachers are bad, some professors like Dr. Balu L Parne, Alok Kumar, and Keyur J Parmar are excellent professors. The course curriculum is okay and not that level of industry. Basic concepts are good like OS, CAN, OOPS, DSA, etc. Semester exams are difficult if we study one night before.
detailed_review.Other: First and the obvious reason is my rank was under this college and the second reason is I have interest in computers since my school time, so I chose it. Practical Knowledge of industry-level things like AWS, GCP, etc., in Cloud instead of CloudSim should be provided. Events and fests are good. Sparsh and Mindbend are two big events that occur here. In Mindbend, technical competitions like web wizards and Code wards, etc., are conducted. A treasure hunt is also organised.

reviews.review_title: The college is good. The education level and curriculum are not good.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed. In the Mechanical course, the highest package is 18 LPA and the lowest package is 5 LPA. PSU is the company for our course. Companies like Bajaj and John Deere also visit to hire students. Around 20% of students got internships, and getting internships is very competitive in this college. Many companies offer an R&D role but companies also offer roles like managerial, maintenance, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are the best each year, and we will get a new hostel. However, they are old really and need some construction. Mess food is bad here because it really tastes bad. There is only one canteen till now but one cafeteria is under construction which will be completed by July.
detailed_review.Faculty: Only a handful of teachers have real knowledge and experience but the rest do not have teaching skills. In this college, education is only mugging and writing the exam, etc. To become industry-ready, I don't think that thing exists at NIT Surat. Semester exams are pretty easy.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about mechanical is syllabus, which is not shabby and long. It is quite fun and subjects are also good, In NIT Surat, 2 mega events are organised named Sparsh and Mindbend.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college because it is NIT.

detailed_review.Placements: The package offered is 8 LPA and almost 70% of students get placements. The highest package is 19 LPA and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The top recruiting company is Bajaj. Internships offered are very poor, and only 15% got it. Roles offered are mainly production and management.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's an old college, so we should not keep high hopes on infrastructure and hostel. The library is new and some of the departments are being rebuilt. There is a sports complex with a gym for all. We have a tennis court, stadium and also a cricket ground with football in a single stadium.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are difficult if we don't study. Professors are very good and we may get industry knowledge as well. The pass percentage is 35% as usual but scoring more is better so we should maintain a CGPA and get good offers from companies. They also help us get internships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has a good environment. It has a big campus but poor sports infrastructure. Academics are good.

detailed_review.Placements: 75% of students get placements till now from the senior batch. However, the internship percentage of my batch is not good. For the 2025 placement batch, placements are overall good. Mainly IT and software companies came followed by core companies which are less in number and along with some companies with management roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Electronics department has very good infrastructure with good lab facilities and good professors. The coursework is somewhat difficult. Hostel facilities are good. The only mess part needs to be well maintained. The quality of food is not good in the mess of most hostels excluding some.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-trained and experienced. They are ready to help with any kind of project or guidance. The course curriculum needs some modification and it becomes a little bit hectic. A good part is it aims to make students industry-ready. The gap between the college academic and continuously upgrading industrial skill set is huge for every academic institution, still, it works towards industry oriented curriculum, which is commendable.
detailed_review.Other: The extracurricular activities of this college are very good. It has many engaging and entertaining fests and activities from cultural to technical and in between fests all are mind-refreshing and entertaining.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am not satisfied with the faculty. Placements are average. Infrastructure and facilities are good.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60-70% of students got placed with the highest package of 36 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are JP Morgan, Visa, and John Deere. Some companies offer internships, and the other companies for internship recruitment are Algo University and Placewit. It offers various roles like software development intern, data science intern, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good and it is good value for money. LAN is available in each room. It has a maintained library. Each hostel has reading rooms as well as a sports room. Classrooms are classic and like old school but clean. Labs are well maintained. The food offered in the mess is not bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really helpful as most of them are TAs. They are also well-qualified. The course curriculum is relevant to the industry level but lacks sync with current technologies. They also provide research interns and guides to build industry-level projects. Exams are from moderate to tough levels.
detailed_review.Other: The main motivation behind taking this course is that it is CSE which is a great course irrespective of college.

reviews.review_title: It is a decent college with placements, infrastructure, and college life.

detailed_review.Placements: 68% of students get placed here. The lowest package is 5 LPA and the highest package is 20 LPA. PSU gave the highest package. Companies like John Deere, Tata Motors, Baja Auto, Tech Mahindra, and Prozeal Energy hire students from the college. There is no data given but around 10-20% of students get internships. Roles like graduate engineer trainee, design engineering, product engineering, and management roles like business executive and quality engineer are offered to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A newly made hostel named EWS is good and the rest are not so good. Some rooms have very poor ventilation. Mess is average. Classrooms are normal. Some contain a projector and a smart TV. The canteen is reasonable and good. Sports facilities for badminton are good but too much crowded. Rest is not good. Labs are okay but some are not functional.
detailed_review.Faculty: As everywhere some faculty members are good and some are not good. The course curriculum is like every other engineering college. It is a little outdated and theoretical. The course does not make us completely industry-ready but it will give us enough knowledge so that we can start as a fresher.
detailed_review.Other: I wish more practical knowledge and guidance were given as they are the actual skills required in the industry. I chose this course as this is one of the good options according to my rank. The connectivity is good as it is the main city. The campus crowd is also decent. Fests are okay and not very great. All government scholarships are valid and there is nothing from the college side. Clubs are there for extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: By my review, you can easily make decision whether you want to take admission in this college or not

detailed_review.Placements: In my +1 batch, the majority of students are placed in JPMC for the SDE role, approximately 19 students got PPO. But now, this company offered to only 2 students, and 1 student rejected the offer. The top companies that visited this year are Wells Fargo, Visa, and JPMC. The placement percentage for CSE this year is 63%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library is good with good infrastructure. The LAN works well, but sometimes, it doesn't work well. In the mess, only veg food is served, instead of eggs. Some hostels have good space for 2 students, but hostels like Nehru and Tagore Bhawan have less space for 2 students. So, never take this hostel during the 3 year course.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teacher is well-qualified, but sometimes the academic exam can be tough. Not every course exam is tough, like the MIT exam is too tough in the CSE branch. In my year, out of 138 students, 48 failed in end-semester exam at MIT. Also, in some teachers' portions, scoring marks is too tough.

reviews.review_title: My experience at SVNITSurat.

detailed_review.Placements: 55-70% get placed (varies by year and student interest in jobs vs. higher studies). The highest package is 18 LPA to 20 LPA (typically in quant or data roles, sometimes off-campus). The average package is 6 LPA to 8 LPA. The lowest package (on-campus) is 3.5 LPA to 4 LPA. Recruiting companies are Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Byjus, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is changed every year and mess is good. In first year, mess is completely vegetarian. Department infrastructure is under construction so at present not good. Department has computer labs and classrooms with no AC. Wi-Fi is not present in department. In hostel, sports facilities are available. Medical facilities and indoor games are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very supportive and kind to every student. All professors and T.A. are well-qualified and experienced. Exams are difficult at end semester. 80-90% is the passing ratio. Course curriculum is relevant and does not make students industry-ready directly, and you can check the syllabus at the SVNIT website.
detailed_review.Other: Course is good and easy to understand, and in first year 12th class portion mostly less time to cover the whole syllabus. NIT Surat is majorly known for its events and fests. College is inside Surat city.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with overall college facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: My branch is mechanical. The average package of my branch is 9.14 LPA, and the highest salary is 18 LPA. The lowest salary is 5 LPA this year. All the top companies like Tata, Amazon, HP, etc., hire from our college. It also provides internships to 70% of students at various NITs, IITs, and companies around the globe.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has the best library facilities with centralized AC and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus and hostel. Hostel is well-equipped with basic amenities and facilities providing water cooler on every floor, good quality food, and recreation rooms too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum at SVNIT exam is upto the mark with excellent world-level faculty members. Faculty members are supportive and approachable. The semester exams are quite moderate and predictable as per PYQs. The college provides students with real field experience in workshops and labs making them industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I got this branch on the basis of my JEE Main rank although it has the best faculty members and facilities for students. The college organises tech fests like Mindbend and annual fests like Sparsh at a very grand level.

reviews.review_title: Good campus and good location in Surat. Rich in sports but overall moderate level.

detailed_review.Placements: Usually, most of the students get placed in the final year. The highest package offered is 30 LPA for mechanical engineering. Different companies are Infosys, Amazon, etc. This company does come and give placement packages. Top roles are different data analysis to a team leader, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi levels are usually good. Labs are decent and classrooms need to get better over time. Library is perhaps one of the best in Gujarat. It has high medical services (basic level) and decent in sports and games. Mess and canteen are below average. We have a big ground.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Some are decent. Difficulty level is usually moderate. The course curriculum includes some subjects very relevant, some are not that relevant. But overall is decent course curriculum and makes one industry-ready.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: SVNIT Surat infrastructure consists of world-class classrooms, a library, computer centres, hostels, guest houses, etc. The institute has all the basic amenities to fulfil the needs of the students, such as a post office in front of the main gate of SVNIT. The institute has developed an effective security system for students' safety, and it also has a dispensary on the campus for both students and staff of the college. The college has a well-equipped canteen located behind the Central Library building. NIT Surat has one bank and two ATMs on campus to help students. Located at Ichchhanath, Surat-Dumas Road, Keval Chowk, Surat, SVNIT Surat is very well-connected by road and railway. SVNIT's Central Library is one of the major technological libraries in the field of engineering/ technology. The Library was established in 1968. It is a 35-year-old library that not only has a large collection of books but also has a collection of non-book materials along with electronic media available locally on the Institute Intranet.  Check the video below to learn more about the NIT Surat infrastructure.

sections.heading: SVNIT Surat Campus Highlights
text: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology is a residential institute. Spread over 250 acres of land, the institute provides a bus facility for connecting the main gate to different parts of the campus, including the hostel and academic zones, at frequent intervals. The SVNIT Surat campus has 10 hostels accommodating over 5000 students. The institute also has guest houses. The guesthouse in the SVNIT College is located on the opposite side of the SVNIT main gate on Surat-Dumas Road. There are 12 rooms in the guesthouse that are fully furnished, along with telephone lines and a television. It's a one-storey building. NIT Surat was the first institute in the South Gujarat region to get an Internet facility in 1995. The Central Computer Centre of the institute is the learning resource of the college. It is the heart of the computing resource of the institute, which acts as a carrier of the internet connection. Some of the key campus highlights are tabulated below:

tables.SVNIT Surat Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

sections.heading: SVNIT Surat Hostel Facilities
text: NIT Surat has 10 hostels for accommodating over 5000 students. Out of these 10 hostels, 7 are allocated for boys and 2 are dedicated to girls. 1 hostel is especially for married scholars. All the hostels are managed by chief wardens/wardens, supervisors, and hostel boys. SVNIT Surat hostels have all the basic facilities, including a computer table/study table, chair, cot, almirah , etc. Each wing of the hostel has several verandahs and balconies. All the hostels have a dining hall and several water coolers, a common room, a reading room , etc. The hostel has 24/7 wifi connectivity. For the safety and security of the students, the hostels are under the surveillance of CCTV cameras that are operational 24/7. The facility of the mess provides a balanced diet to the students at a very reasonable cost. For the recreational activities, each hostel has a common room. The common room is well-equipped with magazines, TV, newspapers, etc. Some additional hostel facilities of NIT Surat are as follows:

reviews.course: M.E. in Embedded and Real Time Systems
reviews.review_title: Overall best College for M.E. In the embedded and real time systems course.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students were placed in our courses. The highest salary is 12 LPA to 15 LPA, which was the minimum. 90% of students received their internships. The top recruiters were Intel, Qualcomm, Robert Bosch, Texas Instruments, etc. The top roles offered were Embedded Software Engineer, Firmware Engineer, and more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi system was awesome. Classrooms were good. The campus was awesome and clean. The campus had specially designed sports courts for basketball, volleyball, etc. The college system here was amazing, as here things are amazing, which helps us a lot. The college ensures cleanliness, and students also ensure that they do not have any problems inside the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers behave like friends, viewing our issues as their own and striving to provide the best solutions. I can claim the top instructors in college. They possess extensive knowledge and experience. In our curriculum, educators approach students based on professional expectations and promote proper behavior. Final exams were simple, and the passing rate was approximately 72%.

reviews.review_title: Good placements, campus, people, and a better you.

detailed_review.Placements: Students above 95% can easily get into our department. The highest package is 12 LPA, the average package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 2.4 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, and Zifo. Most of the students got their internships, around 50%, with companies like Biozeen, Biocon Ltd, AIIMS, and IGIB. The jobs are related to microbiologists, research scientists, quality control, and bioanalytical techniques.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is indeed a good Wi-Fi connection, library, and all, but the labs do not have advanced machines and tools. The classrooms are good enough. The hostel is good here. Based on our preference, they provide rooms with two sharing, six sharing, etc. Medical facilities are very good here. There are lots of sports and games activities available. The mess food is really good compared to any other hostels. They provide non-veg food three days a week.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is really good, and most of our teachers have completed a Ph.D., and their teaching is excellent. The course curriculum is indeed relevant and prepares students for the industry. Semester exams are a little bit tough, but we can handle them if we complete the portions regularly. The pass percentage for the semester exam is around 45/100, and most students will clear. The student pass percentage is above 85%.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to study something different, other than CSE. Also, I wanted Biology in my course as I could not clear the NEET exam. The teaching includes advanced lab equipment and more practical, hands-on lab practices rather than just theory. There are lots and lots of extracurricular activities conducted by our college. There are also many clubs here where you can get to know other students and seniors in depth. Campus life is good here if you make connections with friends, and scholarships are given by our college.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely 90% placement, a very good infrastructure, and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Minimum 50% and maximum 75% were placed. Highest salary is 13 LPA, and the lowest Salary is 4 LPA. Caterpillar and TCS are the top companies for our course. More than 60% students will get internships from our college. Production manager is the top role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a CAD CAM lab, and we have a separate block for our course. Food quality is expected as hostel food, not very good or less good. We have grounds, a football and a basketball court. In our hostel, we have clinic for 24 hours. Lots of sports are here, and a gym also.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have qualified faculty members, and their teaching was very professional. Course made students industry-ready. More than 70% students passed in the semester exams. Exams are not so difficult if we cover the daily syllabus. We can also be guided by teachers if we have any struggles.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have a passion for it. If we have more practical knowledge than theoretical knowledge, it would be better. Our college will conduct more events related to education, and we will do a lot of projects.

reviews.review_title: My honest review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in PSG are very good. The campus is visited by a variety of companies, from MNCs to local companies. The college first brings the MNC companies like Goldman Sachs, Intel, Amazon, Microsoft, eBay, etc. Then, the service-based companies like Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, etc., and the local companies are given a chance to recruit our students for those who wish to work in their hometown. During our final year, around 700 got placed in Cognizant, 60 in IBM, 28 in Wipro, 15 in Intel, 10 in eBay, and 8 in Amazon; all these are approximate values.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course curriculum provided in the college is on par with international standards. All the subjects are provided with an up-to-date curriculum review and are changed whenever a new and upcoming technology is dominating the market. Rooms are spacious; first-year students have to share the room, but from the second year onward, they are free to decide whether they want to continue or want a separate room. Rooms are plenty; there has never been any type of shortage. PGs' average rental at my time was 1200.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum provided in the college is on par with international standards. All the subjects provided are up-to-date, with a curriculum review changed whenever a new and upcoming technology is dominating the market. All the faculty in our college have at least 10+ years of experience and possess a wide knowledge in their field of expertise. They, along with other alumni, frame the course charter and curriculum to benefit the students.

We could choose and eat. If food is finished, then they will also prepare and provide it. If we want to use Wi-Fi, then we need to ask our floor supervisors.
detailed_review.Faculty: In my college, 3 internal exams will be there after that semester exam they will conduct. In semester, minimum 50% we need to take. It was mandatory. All teachers will speak Tamil and English in classrooms so no need to worry. All faculty members were good-hearted and teaching quality was awesome.
detailed_review.Other: In my college, they will conduct intrams like an annual day for every year. In hostel, they will conduct 2 times semester fests, and 1 time hostel day they will conduct.

reviews.review_title: A brief review of PSG College of Technology - Integrated M.Sc. course of 5 years.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of the students who study here get placed easily in many of the companies. As of my knowledge, nearly 90% of students get placed. The highest salary package offered is 1.2 crore. The average salary package offered is around 40 LPA. Top companies recruiting are Google, Microsoft, JP Morgan, and a lot of MNCs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: PSGCT has all the facilities and the infrastructure that are needed to be a perfect college. We have Wi-Fi everywhere and ample number of labs. We also have a very big library. The quality of the hostel is nice for the price, and the food is more than good. All the facilities such as sports and games are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified and helpful when it comes to academics and the quality is top-notch. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. The difficulty level of semester exams in this college is medium. The pass percentage is 99%.

reviews.review_title: Good college, Good placement and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50% of students were placed in the college. The highest package is around 30 LPA for the CSE course, and 3 LPA is the minimum package for all courses. Many companies visit for placements, and most placed students go for internships in their respective companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good labs, Wi-Fi, and a library in the college. The hostels also have good sports facilities and Wi-Fi connections, but the hostel fee is a bit costly. The hostel food is very good, and we also have vending machines and a library inside the hostel. We also have an entertainment room with a TV.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and knowledgeable. We have excellent coursework, but the software-related courses are a little overrated. The exams are a bit difficult, and the pass percentage is 50%. It depends on the subject and the faculty. Some are liberal in correction, so it will be easier to pass.
detailed_review.Other: The college has good club activities and sports facilities. We can enjoy a lot.

highlights.summary:
Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology is a private university and is also known as SIST. It is a deemed-to-be university and was established in 1987. The university was formerly known as Sathyabama University and is one of the oldest STEM-intensive university in the country. SIST is recognised by the UGC and has been accredited by the NAAC with an A++ grade. It has also received ISO 9001:2008 certification and has been accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA) as well.
The university has ranked in the band of 1201-1400 by the QS World Rankings 2026 in the 'World University' category. In addition, it has also ranked 93 under the 'Overall' category by the NIRF 2025. Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels, mainly in streams like Engineering, Management, Humanities, Law, Science, etc. Some of the popular courses offered at the university are BTech, BSc, BCom, BBA, MBA, MTech, MSc, etc. These courses are AICTE-approved and are offered in full-time mode. These courses are catered by 15+ departments and is facilitated by expert faculty.
SIST Chennai has signed various MoUs with national and international universities such as UNINT, NITTTR Chennai, University of Western Australia, and Taylor's University, among others. Sathyabama University admission is conducted on the basis of both merit and entrance-exam scores. Some of the popular entrance exams accepted by the university are JEE Mains, SAEEE, CAT, MAT, CMAT, XAT, etc. The university also has a dedicated placement cell that conducts different training and skill-development programmes for students. The highest and average package offered during Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology placements 2025 were INR 41.20 LPA and INR 5.57 LPA, respectively. reviews.review_title: Review of Sathyabama Institute of Science and Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: There are no placements for students with a history of arrears in our department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good, but AC in labs and classrooms would have been nice. Classrooms and bathrooms are not great, but manageable. It is still one of the best universities in Chennai, and this is not an excuse. A bus is available for almost every route in Chennai. Lunch is the best time with a good meal, both veg and non-veg. Lively canteen. The campus is walkable, giving it a pretty much Karan Johar college life.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is good enough, and teachers are good, but security is rude and not helpful. They should understand they are here to work for us and serve us, not the other way around. Attendance is strict, and students cannot roam around freely. If you enter the campus in the morning, you have to stay until evening. Exams are easy. They are given the question bank at the start of every semester. Dean is super egoistic, but he won't come in your way if you don't cross him. Professors are chill most of the time.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty.

Approximately 75 percent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our college is 50 LPA, and the lowest package offered in our college is about 5 to 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are like Google and Amazon.

detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in our class are somehow better, but they are all fully qualified and somehow better. All the teachers are knowledgeable and somehow better. This course curriculum is fully relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. The teachers are knowledgeable and qualified.

Training and placement cell provides aptitude and soft skill support, and it is a good college for interdisciplinary.

detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. They are very supportive with modern approach to teaching. Teaching quality varies by department. The curriculum is designed as per the modern technology features implemented in today's era, and the future helps to improve programming skills.
detailed_review.Other: College is good for exploring things in all terms.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely very good infrastructure and good placement in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of them are placed. The highest package is about 50 LPA. Recruiters are from most IT companies. More students got paid internships on companies in Bangalore. Seniors told that the placement is very good compared to other colleges. These companies are mostly tier one companies of IT.

The bus facilities are not good as they arrange less buses for more students. Nearly 10,000 students are studying so the college is always busy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and friendly. They are well-qualified scholars, and their knowledge is good. Students can develop skills through training in the evenings.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as I liked the aeroplanes.

reviews.review_title: A few friendly faculty members expect everyone to be like that.

reviews.review_title: Really great in placements.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has poor infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: The salary packages range from 6 LPA - 9 LPA. Companies: Zoho, smaller product startups, banking tech division, analytics firms. Reason for their presence: They require improved problem-solvers but do not offer "FAANG" scale compensation. Requirement: Good projects on your resume and solid coding skills in one language (Java/C+/Python.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: To be candid, the infrastructure operates on a strict policy of 'bare minimum. If viewed in isolation, the facilities are functional and liveable. The basics are there. However, the moment you benchmark our campus against peer institutions, the deficit becomes glaring. We are lagging significantly in modernization and maintenance, making the campus feel adequate only to those who haven't seen better alternatives.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is a mix. Some senior professors are extremely knowledgeable and helpful, while others stick strictly to the textbook. The teaching quality is generally decent for core subjects, but don't expect spoon-feeding; you often have to clear doubts on your own.
detailed_review.Other: Fewer events than you think on campus life.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements in IT industry.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: Sathyabama University has a central library with a total area of 25,000 square feet.The library has a collection of 60,000 books.It has subscription of  334 national and international journals.and subcribes to MALIBNET(Madras Library Network), IIT Library and British Council library through which we can access the library in and around Chennai City.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: A large Mess Hall with a capacity of 2000 members to dine at the same time enables all students and staff to have lunch and breakfast. reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A wonderful college to turn my dreams into reality.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80 to 85% of students are registered. The highest package is around 60 LPA, and the average is around 21 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and many more companies. Top roles offered are data engineer, web developer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The total campus is 9 acres of land with modern equipment and rooms made of good infrastructure. Coming to classrooms, they are comfortable for every batch of students. Library is well stocked with all kinds of books. Mess food is completely hygienic and consists of a variety of food items. Medical facilities are available 24X7. For sports, there is sufficient ground to play.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very talented and experienced more than 15 to 20 years. Course curriculum is completely relevant to the course that we opted for. Labs will also be conducted to gain hands-on experience, which makes industry-ready. Coming to exams, they are of moderate level. The pass percentage will be more than 90%.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIIT Bangalore is a premier institute for its engineering and IT programs.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students are placed in my course. The highest package is 65 LPA, and average package is 36.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Nvidia, Qualcomm, Apple, Microsoft, etc. 100% of people also received internship offers. Placement wise IIITB is very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are the best here. We have labs for almost everything related to electronics. Library has books of every sort, from fiction to reference books. Hostel is very good. We are provided with 3 sharing rooms with ample space to keep a table, bed, and cupboard.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are very qualified with HOD of ECE department, a Ph.D. from University of Alabama and other teachers are alumni of reputed universities. Course curriculum is very relevant, and we are not taught any subject that is not needed and is always relevant to the industry. Exams get difficult as we progress with semesters, and we also grow with that. The pass percentage is very good, and almost no one fails the course.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of expertise of the college in electronics field and placement data that is available. The best thing about this course is that we are not fed any irrelevant information and we focus on industry-relevant subjects only. I could probably make the course a little less hectic but other than that everything is best about the course. Main fest of the college is Infin8, and it goes for 3 days and happens in the month of April. Other fests such as Spandan and Umang also happen annually. We also have a spinoff of IPL, IIITB Premier League that happens twice a year. Seniors are really helpful and always available for any help. We are right in the center of city, and connectivity is best here.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Just few things about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90 percent of the students got internships and were placed and the average package is around 26 lacs. Some recruiters include NVIDIA, Qualcomm and many more. Few students were given the roles of basic engineers. And there is a lot of help provided to students during their placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good here. The classrooms are also very good and comfortable. The hostel rooms are of single occupation for girls and single to triple occupation for boys. The quality of the mess food is reasonable. And there is good encouragement for different kinds of sports here .
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are very knowledgeable and professional here. They are highly qualified, with PhDs from top universities in their respective fields. And they are also very accessible if students want to talk to them. They help students as much as possible .

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good college if the student focuses on knowledge and education.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students were placed this year. The highest package was 65 LPA, and the lowest was around 22-24 LPA. The median and average package revolved around 35 LPA. Top recruiters were Qualcomm, Amazon, Cisco, Intel, Adobe. As part of summer internships, almost all were placed in different companies such as Jio, Cisco, Oracle. Top roles offered were Data Analyst, Software Developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are better than other colleges. Each floor and each room are well-equipped with Wi-Fi. Labs are well-managed and up-to-date with technology. Classrooms are better than usual classrooms, equipped with ACs and proper digital smartboards. The library is quite impressive as it holds a large number of books to choose from. The facilities in the hostel are very good. Proper maintenance and cleaning are done on a regular basis. The food in the mess are better than other colleges' food. The variety offered in the menu is great, and the taste is satisfactory. Medical facilities, sports, and other games go hand in hand.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified. Most of them have PhDs. They are helpful, interactive, and easily approachable. Teaching quality is good, but the curriculum is quite advanced and tough. The students are made industry-ready as they conclude their course because of the difficulty of the curriculum. The semester exams are difficult so that students can learn out of the hard questions. Despite being so hard, the teachers pass students. The pass percentage is 100.
detailed_review.Other: This course has a rigorous curriculum; hence it improves knowledge. The best thing about this course is the quality of the content they teach. The curriculum is highly updated and stands at par with modern knowledge. Events and fests are less. The college is focused more on academics; hence, fests happen rarely. The connectivity of the campus is good. It is in the heart of Electronic City; hence, traveling here and there is easy. Scholarships are offered in the college based on merit.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great college with nice faculty and placements. Except for the campus, which is really small.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 98 to 99 percent of students got placed; the highest package for CSE was INR 65 LPA. The same is true for ECE. Average for CSE: INR 35 LPA. For ECE, it is INR 29.6 LPA. The median package for ECE is INR 23 LPA. The median package for CSE is INR 27 LPA. Top recruiters: Adobe, AMDA, HP, Oracle, Qualcomm, IBM, Mercedes-Benz, Microsoft, etc. Many students do get pre-placement offers for the Samsung Net app and Morgan Stanley Rippling
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is great Wi-Fi service provided by the college. Even the mess food is good. The lab is fully functional and kept up-to-date. The hostels are really kept clean and tidy. They have staff to look after cleanliness. The food is also good for nutrition and is a balanced diet. The classrooms are well maintained. The labs also allow you to learn about real-world problems.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really helpful. They are quite experienced. The curriculum is also to the point, perfect for industry. The exams are at a moderate level. You can approach your faculty directly in person, or you can contact them via mail. They take care that you have a better understanding of each and every topic. They also appoint seniors who did really well in that particular subject to mentor you, so you can ask them about your queries.
detailed_review.Other: I really think that in the future, ECE will do great. As more companies come, demand will also increase. The festivals are also good. Teach Fest does take place. I get the option to work as software develops, even if my course is ECE. I can also practice core ECE, but the college provides a flexible course selection. Either of the branch students get a few elective subjects from other courses.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college provides good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 96% of students got placed in our course. The highest salary package offered is 2.02 CPA. The average salary package offered is 3.78 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 10 LPA. The top role offered is software developer. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Intel, etc. All students got internships from our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, a gym, a basketball court, a tennis court, a badminton court, a football ground, a volleyball court, etc. The hostel facilities are good and clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are helpful and qualified. Their teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is relevant to the industry. A student must score a CGPA of 2.4 out of 4 to pass. Semester exams are not much difficult, but assignments are sometimes difficult.
detailed_review.Other: The campus has a good coding culture. There are various scholarships available in our college.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good exposure to explore more opportunities. Excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 100 percent of students were placed in my course. The highest package 2Cr, the lowest package is 8 LPA, and the average is 24 LPA. Top companies are Flipkart, adobe, Walmart, IBM and Oracle. Software Engineer roles were the top roles offered. Around 60-70 percent students get summer 2-month internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available at almost every place in the Institute with excellent speed. Classrooms and Labs are very good with the latest technologies like projectors etc. The library is well built and has a wide collection of relevant and the latest books. The hostels, mess food, and canteen are all very good. Doctors frequently come to campus for medical facilities, every student has health insurance for emergency cases. Almost every sport facility is provided in the campus, Just the football ground could have been of a larger size.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, helpful, and reachable here. IIITB has one of the best professors in India. The course curriculum is updated yearly to keep it relevant to the current industry, this definitely makes the students' industry ready. Semester exams are not very easy not very hard, they are of medium difficult level. The pass percentage depends on the course, it is not the same for every course.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in computers that's why I chose this course. One course related to full-stack development would be great. Events, fests, and extracurricular activities are good but not as grand as compared to IITs or NITs.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I feel blessed to be part of one of the best colleges in India.

detailed_review.Placements: IIIT Bangalore has amazing placement records in both CSE and ECE branches, they are increasing every year. I will be providing data for 2022. About 100% placement has been marked in both CSE and ECE branches. The highest package in CSE integrated M.Tech is 2.02 CPA. The highest package in ECE integrated M.Tech is 46.25 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Apple, Amazon, Adobe, Netapp, Microsoft, Mathworks, Goldman Sachs, Flipkart, Walmart labs, Nvidia, Cisco, Samsung, Qualcomm, Oracle, IBM, etc. About 90-95% of students got an internship in their final year and pre-final year. Roles offered are SDE profile, data engineering roles, and electronic profile roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is well furnished, we have single rooms from 3rd year till 5th year in case of integrated M.Tech and case of M.Tech, we get a single room from the very first day. Fooding is also awesome in terms of hygiene, we have meals four times a day each day that contains milk and curd all the time. We have 24x7 Wi-Fi available with a speed of more than 200 Mbps. Our library contains a plethora of books from all fields, the library is fully air-conditioned and it is open for students till 1 AM.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well versed in their areas, Most of the teachers are from IIsc, IITs, and foreign universities PHDs. The curriculum is updated at regular intervals, we are exposed to subjects like DBMS, OS, and computer networks in the first two years of the course, which helps us in placements. Our college offers extensive courses in artificial intelligence, deep learning, and machine learning. Talking about semester exams, they are of good level, questions are conceptual which will test your overall understanding of topics. About 95-100% is the pass percentage and in most of the courses, our pass percentage is about 100% because of our awesome professors.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because of the peer group that I will be getting and also because of the professor from which we are going to be taught. Our courses provide flexibility, we can choose any field in 3rd year, whether it be cryptography engineering, cyber security, AI, or ML as per our interest or we can also stick to algorithms and data structures if we are interested in it. I never felt any need to change anything in our pre-designed course structure as it gets updated within regular intervals, so we never felt lagged in terms of curriculum. Events and college life are also balanced but our college is a research institute so research is more than fests. Our college has a very less crowd because of the high cutoff in JEE main ranks which ultimately helps us during placements a lot. We have a lot of clubs like music club, dance club, web development club, competitive programming club, turiya club, etc. The college surrounding is full of greenery and there is proper maintenance of each resource in the college.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the placement facilities and opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: As always, IIITB has maintained its legacy of 100% placements. According to the official website, in 2021, the M.Tech batch had the highest package of 45.6 LPA and 30 LPA for CSE and ECE, respectively. The average package is around 25-27 LPA. The lowest package is more than 10 LPA. The top recruiters are Apple, Adobe, Appdynamics, Microsoft, Google etc. Almost all students got internships which is a part of the curriculum here in companies like Microsoft, Salesforce, Uber etc. The top roles offered are SDE-based.

The menu is changed every 2 weeks. From this year onwards, non-veg has also been introduced to mess. Medical facilities could be better as the doctor is not available 24*7. In sports, we have volleyball, basketball, cricket, football, badminton, table tennis, foosball, etc., are available. Sports equipment is well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very well-qualified. Almost all the teachers hold PhDs or doctorate degrees from foreign universities or top IITs. All the teachers are helpful and very easily approachable. Their knowledge in their respective domains is vast, which gives deep knowledge to students.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course is that it is very well-designed according to the need of the industry. The subjects are completely relevant.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIITB was the institute of my dreams.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85% of students got placed in our course last year. The highest package offered was 30 LPA, and the average package was 22 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Apple, Amazon, Adobe, Google etc. Almost 50-60% of students got internships. Top specializations in our course theory and systems for computing and data, artificial intelligence and machine learning, networking and communication, and VLSI systems.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many labs and classrooms on our campus. It has an electronics lab-CEEMS, HideS, robotics club, BITES etc. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. We have a huge library (big enough for all the students on campus) with a very good collection of books on all kinds of educational topics. Hostel facilities are quite good. Even if we get any problems with the facilities, the administration sorts them out quickly (this is one of the things I like so much about the college). Food quality is quite good (better than what I expected). The canteen also has some good quality food to offer. There are 2 doctors visiting the campus every week. Sports facilities are good except the football and cricket grounds (small but well-maintained).
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality is top-class, no doubt about that. Many professors have done some serious research and know a lot about the things they teach. The course curriculum is flexible. Our curriculum is really different from other colleges. We don't have any courses which are not useful. Semester exams are quite hard but doable if you are well prepared and have knowledge about it. The pass percentage is good as all the students who join here are very good (no reservations).
detailed_review.Other: I did a lot of research before joining the college. Being in ECE, I can do all CSE courses too. One of the things I liked, flexibility in the curriculum. Being in open category, I know the pain of not getting selected into good colleges. But this college provides equal opportunities to all the students. Events and fests on campus are really awesome. As the strength of the entire college is not that big, it gives a feeling that everyone is like a family. There are always some sports events going on in the college.

reviews.course: Advanced Certificate Programme in Data Science
reviews.review_title: IIT Bangalore has a great infrastructure and amazing learning experience.

detailed_review.Placements: From our current batch, after the first semester, many students got internship opportunities in companies like KPMG, Upgrade, Amazon and many other startup companies. The highest salary package offered for a data science graduate is around 54 LPA-56 LPA, and the average salary package offered is around 15 LPA-18 LPA. We need to have a minimum of 2.65 or 4 GPA in our academics. Nearly 60%-70% of the students from a class get their placements and internships. A few of the students continue to pursue their PhD as well. Job profiles offered include roles of various streams like big data engineer, BI developer, data analyst, data engineer, data scientist and machine learning engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college is situated in Electronic City Phase 2 and has a beautiful campus with greenery around. The classrooms are really up to the standard of any top-notch college in India and abroad. We have access to the vast library, and we get access to it even after completing the course for about 6-8 months. The hostel is decent, but as I am a resident of that location, I have not opted for it. Many of my friends stay in the hostel and are recommended for students who come from different places.
detailed_review.Faculty: The lecturers here have a vast amount of knowledge and experience, especially statistics and machine learning professors were my favourite, from whom I got to learn many things. Special connect sessions and webinars are arranged from time to time by industry experts and tech talks. We will get exposure to theory and practical aspects during the capstone project. It is a complete end-to-end experience.
detailed_review.Other: The data science stream is booming and the most desired field for working in the 21st century. Moreover, I like to solve problems with data and research around articles and research papers. So, I chose this course.

reviews.review_title: It is a great college to learn and innovate with excellent faculty members and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Current batch placements records are confidential. Last year placements were 100%. The highest salary package offered was 54 LPA, and the median package salary package offered was 17 LPA. Companies like Microsoft, Amazon, ThoughtSpot, Uber, Goldman Sachs, Morgan, IBM, HP, Samsung, Walmart, and also startups like Dunzo, Pluribus and MathWorks also visit the campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides large air-conditioned classrooms to accommodate 150 students and recorded lectures. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and the library is supported by Infosys, MINRO, i.e., Machine Intelligence and Robotics Centre to support startups. There are innovation labs like Goru labs. Computer labs are equipped with ubuntu installed in machines. In the hostel, single rooms are available for masters students. They provide hot water facility in the morning and evening and 24 hours water facility. Drinking water is available on every floor with dispensers containing hot, cold and normal water. Room cleaning service is also available every day, and laundry facilities are included inside the campus with 5 automatic machines in men's hostel and 2 in women's hostel. There are two men's hostel named Bhaskara and Vishwesharya and 1 women's hostel named Leelavati. Rooms are well-furnished. Mess food is good enough with lots of variety, but canteen is not that good. However, they provide with basic items at nominal prices. A doctor is available on the campus every day, and a counsellor is also available. Medical insurance up to 2 lacs is also provided by the college. For sports, there is a multi-purpose hall. Our campus also has a mini football ground, a cricket ground, tennis court, volleyball court, basketball court and badminton court. A new auditorium and badminton court are under construction.

Subjects like software's production engineering, software systems, algorithms, advanced algorithms, machine learning, automatic speech recognition, natural language processing, optimisation, learning and cognition, multi-agent systems, technical communication, wan, etc., are provided.
detailed_review.Other: Placements of the previous batch were excellent. Students have an option of doing a 6-month internship in the final semester or to write a thesis under the guidance of any faculty member. The course helps us to be industry-ready, and we often get to work in live projects to improve our skills. There are various events like college fest named Infinit, alumni meet named Sangam, inter-college sports event named Umang, foundation day, etc. M.Tech students get a stipend of Rs. 12,400 as of now. Our college is situated in the IT hub of Bangalore, i.e., Electronic City, and it is surrounded by various companies like Infosys, Wipro and Siemens.

reviews.review_title: Amazing Life at IIITB, One of the BEST college in INDIA !

The highest salary offered was 54LPA, the lowest salary offered was 10 LPA and the average salary offered was 17.5 LPA. IIITB has smart classrooms with smart boards, high-speed data networks and LCD projectors. There is a huge library with an immense number of books, journals and newspapers. The professors are always ready to help you out in your research projects, thesis, and course curriculum. The course curriculum is very well designed that offers its students a wide range of courses to choose from as per his/her interest areas, which makes its students ready to work for in the competitive industry.

Spandan is an annual sports fest in which almost every student, faculty and alumni participate and play indoor and outdoor games together. The above events, fests, sports and games contribute to the extracurricular activities in the college. The campus crowd is the best as almost every student is intelligent and helpful.
