college_info.college_name: IIIT Bangalore Admissions 2025: Last Date, Fees, Eligibility, Application Process

admission.title: IIIT Bangalore Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: IIIT Bangalore offers admission based on JEE Main scores of the candidates for its flagship BTech programme. Besides, the institute also considers scores in GATE, CAT, CEED, etc., for specific courses. IIIT Bangalore offers primarily (refers to UG courses), PhD, PG diploma, PG, and doctoral level courses in the Engineering field. Moreover, the institute also provides MSc, PhD, PG Diploma, MTech, BTech and Integrated MTech programmes. Candidates can fill out the application form online for the preferred course.

faqs.question: What types of courses are offered at IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore offers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in Engineering and Science streams. The institute offers BTech and Integrated BTech + MTech at the UG level and MSc and MTech at the PG level. Besides, the institute also offers diploma courses. Candidates have to complete a minimum of Class 12 to apply for any of the UG courses and graduation for PG programmes.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Currently, the applications are closed for all the courses. International Institute of Information Technology usually releases the application form in March. The application deadline differs with the course. Aspirants have to apply online on the official website of the institute for admission. Candidates also need to pay an application fee of INR 1,000 to apply for a course at IIIT Bangalore.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for B.Tech course at IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: For admission to IIIT Bangalore BTech course, the candidates must meet the eligibility requirements and have a valid JEE score. Aspirants who have passed Class 12 and studied Mathematics subject are eligible to apply. Candidates must use JEE Main as the application platform. The applicants who meet the course cutoff mark further become eligible for admission. Selected students can pay the admission fee amount for seat confirmation.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BTech at IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have completed Class 12 or equivalent pass with first class and studied Mathematics as one of the subjects can apply for IIIT Bangalore BTech programme. Aspirants must hold the documents relevant to their eligibility for verification at the time of admission.

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility requirement for IIIT Bangalore MSc course?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have passed a UG degree of a minimum of three-years in any discipline with a first division/ class from a recognised university are eligible to apply for IIIT Bangalore MSc. Those expecting to graduate by July 1 of the admission year may also apply. Aspirants must also have a valid score in CAT, CEED, CUCET or TISS NET for exemption from written test conducted by IIIT Bangalore.

faqs.question: What is the minimum cutoff for Computer Science and Engineering at IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: IIIT Bangalore offered BTech and Integrated M.Tech courses in the form of seat alloment rounds. The IIIT Bangalore cutoff 2024 has been concluded with the release of Round 6. The Last Round for IIIT Bangalore spanned from 8706 and 13176 for the General AI category candidates. Among all the courses available at IIIT Banglore through JEE Main, the Computer Science and Engineering stands out to be the most desired course. The minimum cutoff for BTech CSE was 8706 as per the Last Round cutoff 2024.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff of IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: IIIT Bangalore cutoff is based on JEE Main scores for courses including Integrated M.Tech CSE and Integrated M.Tech ECE. IIIT Bangalore JEE Main cutoff 2023 for Integrated M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and Integrated M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering was concluded after Round 5 of the Seat Allotment Result. Tabulated below are the IIIT4 Bangalore closing ranks for General category All India candidates:

faqs.question: How hard is it to get into IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Admissions at IIIT Bangalore are entrance-based. The institute selects students based on scores in national-level examinations such as JEE Main , CAT , MAT , GATE , XAT , CMAT , etc. Candidates need to qualify JEE Main exam to get admission to Engineering courses. Cracking JEE Main is surely not an easy task and requires complete dedication towards the study. But one thing that can make the JEE Main preparation easy is to study in a planned manner with a strategy. JEE's Main question paper is divided into three sections: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. All three sections are equally important, and therefore, aspirants should ensure that they cover the syllabus for all three sections.

faqs.question: Can I get IIIT Bangalore with 150 score in MTech?
faqs.answer: International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore accepts GATE scores, followed by the GATE Counselling process for admission to the MTech course. GATE COAP Round 1 cutyoff has been released for IIIT Bangalore. As per the cutoff list, CSE was the most competitive course with a closing rank of 591 for the General AII India category students. So, considering the latest cutoff data, candidates having a score of 150 can not get into IIIT Bangalore for M.Tech admission.

faqs.question: After doing Integrated M.Tech programme from IIIT Bangalore, where would I be placed?
faqs.answer: After doing Integrated M.Tech programme from IIIT Bangalore, students are usually placed in Core sector followed by Technology, IT and other allied sectors. The top recruiters during IIIT Bangalore placements 2024 included companies such as Amazon, Bosch, Oracle and Samsung.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for IIIT Bangalore PG Diploma courses?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to an IIITB PG Diploma course shall hold a valid Bachelor's or an equivalent degree in science/engineering/business administration/commerce/mathematics/computer applications or a Master’s degree in mathematics/statistics/commerce with at least 50% aggregate. Moreover, an aspirant should have passed the qualifying exam from a recognised university. The degree course mark sheets along with other documents have to be presented for verification purposes.

faqs.question: Is BTech available in IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Yes, IIIT Bangalore offers a four-year BTech course in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication and Data Science & Artificial Intelligence. Besides, the institute also offers five-year integrated MTech in CSE and ECE. Admission to BTech and Integrated MTech courses is based on JEE Main. The minimum qualification required to apply for these programmes is Class 12.

faqs.question: In which specialisations does IIIT Bangalore offer BTech?
faqs.answer: IIIT Bangalore offers BTech in three specialisations and integrated MTech course in two specialisations. It offers BTech in CSE, ECE, and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. The integrated courses offered are Computer Science & Engineering and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Both the programmes are offered in a full-time mode. The admission procedure is the same for these courses. These are further divided into semester pattern. Aspirants have to complete a project, go through an internship or opt for a thesis to complete the course.

faqs.question: Does IIIT Bangalore has management quota seats for its B.Tech courses?
faqs.answer: The institute does not offer any reservation under management quota. BTech and MTech courses have a combined total of 60 seats. Mentioned seat count is according to the official website. It may change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for B.Tech-M.Tech in CSE programme at  IIIT Bangalore?
faqs.answer: IIIT Bangalore BTech+MTech CSE cutoff is determined based on applicants JEE scores. The cutoff is released for admission until all the seats are filled. In 2023, the closing rank for BTech-MTech CSE at IIIT Bangalore was 9545 . Observing the last three years cutoff, a declining trend can be observed. sections.heading: IIIT Bangalore Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: The hostels at IIIT Bangalore offer secure, furnished, and technologically enabled living spaces on a fully residential campus. With single occupancy widely available, high-speed internet, and robust mess and amenity infrastructure, campus life is designed for convenience and community. Some students highlight areas for improvement, including policy flexibility, consistent Wi‑Fi, and occasional cleanliness concerns. Many praise the campus environment—green, close-knit, and ideal for both academic focus and student life.

sections.heading: IIIT Bangalore Library
text: IIIT Bangalore’s library combines a well-rounded print collection with extensive digital subscriptions in a modern automated environment. Open long hours, backed by responsive staff, reprographic support, and remote access, it serves as a strong research and study hub for students and faculty alike. The open-access model encourages self-service, and OPAC PCs are available to check mail and search catalogues. The library committee and staff, supported by the maintenance and housekeeping teams, ensure the orderly upkeep, periodic stock verification, and maintenance of the physical infrastructure. Student feedback is encouraged through formal mechanisms, enabling ongoing improvements in space use and resource availability.

highlights.summary:
NSUT also known as Netaji Subhas University of Technology is a state-level university. NSIT was established in 1983 and in 2018 the institute was given university status, hence making it a non-affiliating university. Earlier it was affiliated with the University of Delhi. NSUT Delhi is recognised by the UGC and AICTE. NSIT Delhi University ranked 2nd under the TIMES All India Engineering Institutes Ranking Survey 2024.
NSUT Delhi offers undergrdaute, postgraduate, and PhD courses across various streams such as Engineering, Management, Architecture, and others. The flagship courses offered at NSIT are BTech and MBA. Netaji Subhas University Delhi course admissions is based on merit and entrance exam scores. During NSUT placements 2023, the median package is INR 17 LPA and INR 15 LPA, respectively.
Netaji Subhas Institute of Technology has various centres such as Electronics Design & Technology, Excellence in Artificial Intelligence, and Central Computer Center. The university offers scholarships to meritorious students. NSUT has well-equipped infrastructure which includes classrooms, a library, a sports complex, a medical centre, a gym, a hostel, and others. The major highlights of NSIT Delhi are tabulated below:

NSUT Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: It offers nice courses and amazing infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Since I am in the first semester, I heard that this year, out of 160, around 30-35 students got placed. The average package is 18 LPA, and the highest package is 50 LPA. A lot of tech companies offer placements and internships at this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are clean. Food in the Mess is pretty average. The security guard is there every time, so they are strict with rules and regulations. However, they have structured everything.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are amazing. Classes are held every day. The subject and topic taught come in the paper, and the paper is all based on the curriculum. There is security, and invigilators are checking strictly. Even though they are on time, and they do not delay things, it is a value for money. The course structure is above average. In semester one, we have a foundation subject, but in the next semester, subjects like CP (computer programming) are provided.
detailed_review.Other: Seniors are amazing, very supportive, cheerful, and friendly. There is no scope for ragging, even though they provide us with the study materials.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence)
reviews.review_title: I would recommend this college only for the tech branches. For non-tech, one should opt for DTU.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, around 90 percent of students in my branch got placed. It is a good number. The average package was around 22 LPA, and the highest was 1 crore. It was quite good. Top roles offered for my branch were AI engineer, machine learning engineer, and data scientist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library and computer center are very good. The SAC is usually busy, and there is no indoor badminton or basketball court. The APJ Complex classrooms are good, but the others are just average. The quality of canteen food is above average, but the mess food is only average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is very knowledgeable, but most students do not pay attention in class. They are very helpful, except for a few, who can be rude and seem not to know anything at all. The semester exams are of medium difficulty and are easy to prepare for.
detailed_review.Other: As I preferred CSAI over non-tech in a Tier 1 NIT, I chose this college. Many might ask why I did not choose DTU. The main reason is that I took my jiju as my mentor. He is also a software developer at Google and recommended NSUT over DTU, so I chose this college. The events and festivals here are very nice. I do not need to elaborate, NSUT’s fests are already quite famous.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely the best in JAC Delhi.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good if you're good enough to maintain a CGPA above 8-8.5 CGPA, and with decent skills, you can expect a job at least, especially if you are from CS to ECE, below ECE it's quite 50-50 you have to grind more that the above branches peeps and usually some company don't allow below ECE or EE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good. They've each lab for each course for the practical. Wi-Fi is mostly fast and working in only some of the rooms, there are some issues where they don't have it, but 90 percent of the campus is connected with Wi-Fi. The college canteen is there, and everything is available almost, and they have Amul for dairy and a Nescafé for coffee and more, and even Safal milkshake and Maggi are too good, so you have multiple options inside the campus as well. The library is too big 2 floor no Wi-Fi problem.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is updated as compared to other government colleges in NIT, and the faculty members are good as well. If you listen to them thoroughly, you will understand what they are telling, and if exams are at a moderate level, you can score above 8 CGPA if you start from 2 weeks before the exam date starts, but you have to perform quite well in labs as well.

reviews.review_title: The combination of flora and fauna under and education system known as NSUT.

detailed_review.Placements: This university provides an express experience in placement rules. Companies that approach the university for good candidates are, on average site like not well-known companies but not common companies they provide. Average package is around 30 LPA, and the lowest provided is 6 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: You can find cats and dogs across the street from this university. They have different types of flora also but at some places it's very tense, and the sports facilities are not that great. The ground has very long grass ground maintained only when a competition or any other big event is going to happen.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is very relevant to the industry. It makes students industry-ready. This university provides very experienced teachers. They are very knowledgeable about the course. You can ask whatever they know about the course. Semester exams are not that hard. If you concentrate in class, you can score well on the examination.

reviews.review_title: Review of NSUT Computer Science course.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage for computer science students is around 60 to 70%. There are many recruiters which come to campus. The roles that offered are software engineer, AI engineer, web developer, and software developer, along with some finance and non-tech roles as well. Top recruiters include De Shaw, Microsoft, Google, LinkedIn, Infosys, TCS, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi available for students in hostels as well as throughout the college campus. There is a common student library which has enough books to meet the students' needs. There is a canteen and some outlets inside the campus. There is great infrastructure for sports including athletics, running track, cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, tennis courts, basketball courts, and table tennis. There is also a gym.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very qualified and knowledgeable. The curriculum taught is quite relevant, and makes the students industry-ready. It helps students build skills to be ready to gain experience and apply those skills in the real world. The college exams are not tough, it is easy to pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: All about Netaji Subhash University of Technology, Delhi.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is good. Around 70%-80% of the batch got placed. Most of the students of the top branches, like CSE and ECE got placed. Top recruiters are companies like Microsoft, Google, and most tech companies, a lot of core companies also come to recruit students. Median package is around 10 LPA-11 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is great infrastructure and big lecture halls with proper air conditioning. Wi-Fi works all around the college. A big 3-storied library with a good environment for study, a huge sports ground that facilitates almost all sports. The hostel is good, with spacious rooms, and the mess food is also decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Curriculum is mostly relevant but also tough. Most of the professors are great and helpful with a great knowledge of their subject, but there are some bad professors. Semester exams are on the tougher side. You have to give a decent amount of time to studies to maintain a decent CGPA, but finding resources for study is not a problem.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd is good with helpful seniors. Good college to go to if you want to build a career in engineering, tech, or non-tech.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a great college.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80-85% of the students are placed. The highest went up to 75 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA. The average package was around 14-17 LPA according to the branch. Top recruiters are Nvidia, Google, Microsoft, Texas Instruments, etc. I don't know much about internships. The top role offered is software engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-air-conditioned labs, air-conditioned classrooms mainly for first years, and Wi-Fi is everywhere. The library has enough books and resources. The quality of food is also good in the canteen and mess. Just the hostel rooms look a bit old. Above average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are of an average type only. They are qualified but not very helpful. The curriculum is relevant to the industry. Exam difficulty depends on the teacher setting the exam. Sometimes too difficult, sometimes easy to do. Almost everything is good academically.
detailed_review.Other: I have a B.Tech in ECE because I love both hardware and software technology. So it is in my interest after all. I would like it if the college could improve the professors and provide leniency for attendance. It would be good. Fests and extracurricular activities are really great. Something is going on throughout the whole year, each and every month. Seniors are also friendly and good. Recommended.

reviews.review_title: The college has strong placements, good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and vibrant fests.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at NSUT are among the best in Delhi. CSE, IT, and related branches have top offers from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and Adobe, with high average packages, often in double-digit LPA. Core branches like Mechanical and Civil get decent placements, though many students shift to IT roles. The active T&P cell, strong alumni support, and abundant internships ensure excellent career opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NSUT's IT branch has modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and strong Wi-Fi connectivity. The campus is spacious, with libraries, sports facilities, and a good research environment. The hostels are decent, with Wi-Fi, mess, and basic amenities, though cleanliness and food quality can vary.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members at NSUT are experienced, with many holding PhDs and industry exposure. The teaching quality is good, though some classes feel theory-heavy. The curriculum is updated, focusing on core subjects, electives, and coding skills. Exams are moderate, neither too easy nor too tough. The testing concepts are well.
detailed_review.Other: Apart from academics and placements, NSUT is famous for its vibrant campus life. The university hosts Moksha (cultural fest) and Innovision (technical fest), both among the biggest in Delhi, featuring concerts, competitions, and star nights. Numerous clubs, including coding, robotics, dance, drama, and music, keep students engaged. Sports facilities and intra-college events also add to the lively atmosphere.

reviews.review_title: Satisfying campus and surroundings. Good placements and above average infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: 65-70% of students get placements. It is great for the core sector. Internships are limited to upper branches like CS, ECE, or MAC. Recruiters are like Mahindra, Tata, etc. The highest package is 24 LPA while the average is 7 LPA - 8 LPA only but you can get placed easily if you work hard here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are great. There is a decent library. Wi-Fi is average, and can be better. There is only one main canteen where you can have many options. Sports facilities are there but you have to find your friends to play because crowd is not much active here. Food quality is not great but can be taken on good side.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are great and helpful. Course curriculum is relevant. Academics are on the tougher side. You have to spend a lot of time with academics. The curriculum is relevant. If you follow everything that is done in classroom, you can get a decent package.
detailed_review.Other: Not much events or fests are conducted. Crowd is average. Extracurricular activities are not conducted.

reviews.review_title: Do not expect too much from Mechanical Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 63% students are placed last year. The highest package offered is 26 LPA, the average package offered is 8 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Maruti Suzuki, ONGC, and DRDO in core. Many students get internship offers from DRDO, ONGC, and Maruti Suzuki. Roles offered are Product Management and Product Manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good on the side, but the hostels are not good. You can use Wi-Fi only for study purposes. The Library is a silent place that is less crowded. Student activity center where you can play tennis, go to the gym, and have fun with friends. Hostel is just for living. Do not expect too much from hostel food and hostel conditions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are teaching in English due to more private schools. Faculty are student friendly, they help you if you get Stuck Somewhere and motivate you. Some are good, some are bad, some are very rude. Overall, the faculty is good, and the Syllabus is not too outdated and not too modern.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) (ECAM)
reviews.review_title: NSUT East Campus detailed review.

detailed_review.Placements: ECAM (Electronics and Communication with AI & ML) at NSUT offers excellent placement opportunities. Top recruiters include Microsoft, Amazon, Qualcomm and NVIDIA. Average package range 12-18 LPA with the highest up to 50 LPA. Strong industry demand for AI/ML roles ensures high placement rates.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure includes smart classrooms, modern labs, a central library, sports facilities and a food court. Proximity to academic blocks makes it easier. Library is above average with access to a variety of books and is air-conditioned with proper seating plans.
detailed_review.Faculty: NSUT boasts highly qualified professors with strong academic and industry expertise. Many hold PhDs from top global institutes and actively contribute to cutting-edge research. Approachable and supportive. They focus on practical learning, creativity and guidance enhancing student's technical and research skills.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are organised alongside the main campus with placements carried out together.

reviews.review_title: NSUT is fun, but sometimes it disappoints in a few things.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 65% of students were placed in the CS course. The highest package offered is 1.2 CPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA, while the average package goes around 15-20 LPA. Top recruiting companies for the CS course are Google, Microsoft, Infosys, Deloitte, Adobe, etc. Around 50% of students got internships in companies like Zomato, Infosys, and startups. Top roles offered are software engineer, AI/ML engineer, data analyst, and others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure provided for CS courses is very nice in NSUT as compared to other engineering colleges. There is a huge library for students to study, and labs are fully equipped with the latest PCs. A good internet connection is provided through Wi-Fi. The hostel facilities are average as students are not allowed to have their personal ACs in the hostel rooms. The mess food is so okaish for the hostellers, while the canteen provides a variety of food options. Medical facilities are very limited. Sports facilities exist but are not maintained properly.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, but some are very strict and rude with the students as they don’t feel nice helping students with doubts or study material. The course curriculum is relevant to our course and also makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are not that tough as students can pass them by studying properly in less time, while the passing percentage is around 85-90%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it is the new demand of the tech industry, and NSUT provides good facilities for my course. Campus life is fun as there are events and fests for the students to enjoy, and these fests also handle a huge crowd. There are also societies for coding, dancing, singing, and more.

reviews.review_title: You don't get IIT, but you get NSUT IIT crusher.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement of this university is fabulous; it gives competition to some top IITs. More than 80% of students got placed last year. The highest, lowest, and average packages they offered are about 1 crore, 40 LPA, and 60 LPA, and some of them are the biggest companies that are originally from abroad, like Microsoft, Google, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this university is so beautiful; they have different types of plants that make the NSUT campus road beautiful. In this university, we have a botanical garden for research purposes. Wi-Fi is not that fast but has super connectivity, and the classrooms are clean and big.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is super relevant because it helps to train students for industrial development. Exams are on the moderate side, but the exam faculty is very strict. If they find any student cheating, they give that student a suspension and call their parents. Teachers are highly qualified and super supportive.
detailed_review.Other: This college is very beautiful, but they have the biggest flaw in their fests; the events are super boring. They need to introduce new activities for students so they can enjoy them as well.

reviews.review_title: NSUT's CSAI program has good scope, but the campus life feels just okay.

detailed_review.Placements: At NSUT's CSAI department, around 70-75% of students get placed. The highest package went up to ₹60-65 LPA, the average is around ₹18-24 LPA, and the lowest is about ₹5-7 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Adobe. Approximately 15-20% of students secured internships, mostly at big tech companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Qualcomm. Most students get roles such as software developer, data scientist, or ML engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: CSAI has decent Wi-Fi and AC classrooms, but labs and overall infrastructure really need an upgrade. The library is good for studying, though. Hostels are crowded and not very clean. Mess and canteen food is just okay, edible but nothing to look forward to. Medical facilities are basic. Sports grounds are there, but not well-maintained. Some teachers are helpful, but a few are pretty strict, which can be stressful.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers in CSAI are well-qualified and know their subjects, but not all are super helpful. Some are strict or old-school. Teaching quality is okay, but it depends a lot on the professor. The course is pretty relevant and covers current technology, so it does help you become industry-ready. Semester exams aren't very tough if you study regularly. Around 85-90% of students usually pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSAI because I've always been interested in tech, AI, and how it's shaping the future. The best part of the course is the mix of core CS with modern stuff like ML and data science. I just wish there were more hands-on projects and updated labs. Campus life is fun, fests like Innovision and Moksha are huge, and the crowd is diverse and helpful. Being in Delhi, connectivity is great. The surroundings are average, not very lively. Scholarships are available for those who apply. There are lots of clubs for coding, drama, dance, and photography, something for everyone outside of studies.

reviews.review_title: It is a top-notch college in all manners.

detailed_review.Placements: This college is known for its placement offers in my branch as it has above 80% of placements. The highest package offered is 80 LPA. The lowest package offered is 20 LPA. The average package offered in my course is 40 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Uber. 60% of students get internships every year. It offers the role of a software engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are top of the line, and they stand out from the other universities because they have high-speed Wi-Fi and fully air-conditioned classrooms. There are fully equipped labs with all course-related equipment. Libraries are huge.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are super easy, and we can score with only one night of study. Teachers are very friendly, highly qualified, and knowledgeable. They provide quality teaching to all. Some of them lack experience, rather than all being the best. The course curriculum is super relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. There are so many faculty members in this university.
detailed_review.Other: Our college organises the fest named Moksha, which is top-notch and at the level of IIT Delhi. I chose this course because in the future it's very important. I would like to introduce a more practical session rather than a theoretical one.

reviews.review_title: Expect the unexpected in NSUT.

detailed_review.Placements: I got sad when I knew about the package. Previous years’ recruiters offered only 20 LPA as the highest and 6–10 LPA as the average. The number of students selected was very less, that was what I expected, only 34%. They offered very low-value jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Gym is well maintained, and everyone is welcome to use the equipment. The cafeteria is very small, so you need not worry about getting a seat. AC doesn’t work properly there. The library is the plus point, all course-related books are available and well maintained. Public areas are few, like Amul and Mother Dairy, and from upcoming times, Nescafe will also be available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are very moderate, you can score easily if you listen to teachers carefully. Teachers are very helpful and can help you with every tough question they give you as homework. Exam faculty is very strict, they check everything if someone gets chits or anything with them.
detailed_review.Other: Events are very boring. The most interesting event I attended is Moksha, the annual prize of NSUITY. The campus crowd is average, but the cafeteria is very small, so that’s a problem for seating.

reviews.review_title: Boring days at NSUT make them memorable.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement of this college is one of the reasons why I chose this college because they offer high-level packages with manager-type roles to at least 60 percent of students. The highest package they offer is about 64 Lacs per annum, and the average is between 20-25 Lacs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very beautiful. Different types of plants and animals are there, including friendly cats. The facilities include spacious classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, fully air-conditioned classrooms, and a large library with a vast collection of books. Labs are under construction, so they are not that great at the moment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are hard; you need to focus on class because teachers are very smart. They tell you what they are going to give you in the exam, like what type of questions or how you need to study to score. Teachers are very helpful; they provide everything they have: notes, practice questions, etc. The course curriculum is very relevant. It makes students industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I need to improve student life because it is very boring in this college. Nothing new is happening, like events, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Perfect infrastructure and facilities. Amazing and very experienced teachers and amazing placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 65-70% of students were placed in this course. Highest package was around 4-5 LPA, and lowest package was 5-6 LPA. Average is around 15 LPA. Invidia, Samsung, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs are the top recruiting companies of my course. Around 65% of students got internships at Goldman Sachs, Geeks for Geeks, etc. Top roles like VLSI engineer and web developer were offered in this course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, the infrastructure and facilities are excellent. A non-stop Wi-Fi connection, amazing labs, except for a few classrooms, all are fully air-conditioned classrooms, especially the APJ halls. The food quality is amazing in the hostel, and the menu is also good. Medical facilities and other facilities like games and sports facilities are amazing, no doubt, it's brilliant.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is amazing. I mean, you don't need any kind of YouTube or something, if you pay attention in the class, you will get good scores in the exam. See, the course is totally relevant, and it also makes students industry-ready. It's just that they have to work on themselves so that they can perfect their skills. The semester exams in this college are decent, definitely not easy, but yes, a bit on the tougher side. Passing percentage is 41%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested to learn about electronics and was curious about how things really work. The best thing about my course is that we have both the options of going into the software field or the hardware field. It's all about you, wherever you excel, join that. I wish this course were more about practical learning. I mean it is, but still, I want more interaction. Scholarships are available for every student according to their criteria. And everything is pretty good in our college, especially the fest, Moksha.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good pick if you are confused among Jack colleges, go with NSUT.

detailed_review.Placements: Average salary is about 16 LPA. Placement percentage is about 70%. For ECE, top recruiters are Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Samsung, Meesho, etc. I don't have the exact figure for internships but there are plenty of opportunities. One can easily get a good internship if they work hard enough, in my opinion. Roles offered are SDE roles, communication engineer, and embedded engineer roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is very good. Our college has very decent internet connectivity throughout the campus. There are beautiful, clean AC classrooms, and lecture halls. Labs are good too but some equipments doesn't work which can be frustrating at times. Student activity center and canteen can provide relaxation and recreational activities between lectures. I personally go to the gym. Infrastructure-wise NSUT is very decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are definitely knowledgeable and helpful but these old professors can sometimes come out to be a bit boring and unenthusiastic. Teaching quality and enthusiasm depend on the teacher. Course curriculum is decent, a bit slow-paced but it makes students industry ready I do believe that. Semester exams are manageable in difficult but exam checking is very difficult. Teachers do cut marks for even minor mistakes.

reviews.review_title: Lets hunt enjoyment at NSUT.

detailed_review.Placements: Recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Uber, etc. All kinds of companies are approached to give internships. They offer intern kinds of roles, not high-end. But if they like your work, they hire you directly. I am a second-year student so I am very new to this field. In 3 year I am able to attend internship program.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Gym is well-maintained. Everyone is welcome to use the equipments. Cafeteria is very small, so you need to worry about a seat. AC doesn't work properly. Library is the plus point. All course-related books are there. We have well-maintained public areas like Amul and Mother Dairy, and in upcoming time Nescafe is also there. The opening and closing times are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
detailed_review.Faculty: Don't have an idea about faculty to student ratio but the relationship between students and faculty is very strong. Faculty is always ready for students. I don't know the name but there is one faculty I don't like because they want only students who know about that field. If you don't teach the new students how they know about that field and all. Faculty members are slightly in favor of CSAI students' decision. Exams are on moderate side.
detailed_review.Other: The annual and technical festivals are Moksha and Resonance, these are the only fest that take place at this college. I don't like this college because they only announce fest and other colleges atleast organise 5 fests. Classrooms are the plus point. It has high-speed Wi-Fi fully, air conditioning, and sports grounds are good but they don't provide equipment at all.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in NSIT for MBA?
faqs.answer: No, there is no such provision to get direct admission in NSIT at MBA. Aspiring candidates must have a valid CAT or MAT scorecard without having a valid score in the aforesaid entrance examination student will not be eligible for any the admission round for MBA at NSIT. highlights.summary:
Banasthali Vidyapith University offers UG, PG, PhD, certificate, and other courses to students. These courses are provided across the Engineering, Management, and various other streams. The flagship programmes available at the university are BSc and BTech. The university offers scholarships to students as financial assistance. The university has over 25 departments and is a fully residential women's university. The institute is visited by top companies for placements, such as EY, IBM, Deloitte, etc. The university is spread across 850 acre of land and does not offer distance education to students. For higher education, the university uses both Hindi and English as a medium of instruction. The university is accredited with A++ Grade by NAAC.
Bajaj Engineering Skills Training is the flagship CSR initiative of Bajaj Auto, which it has begun in partnership with Banasthali Vidyapith. The university holds the rank 17th awarded by India Today 2025 for MSW and 22nd by NIRF 2025 for Pharmacy. detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this university is very good. The university occupies a lot of area. It provides many facilities, like Wi-Fi available all the time in the hostels and departments for students and faculty, so they can easily learn what they want. The classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and the library is very big and provides many opportunities for students. There are many hostels for students who live on campus. The semester exams are moderate in difficulty level.

It's okay about hostel food, I can survive without actual food, but my career means more to me. Events and fests are top-notch. Absolutely amazing, there are great fests going on the whole year.

reviews.review_title: I definitely do not recommend this to anyone.

detailed_review.Placements: I’m not sure about placements, but in my course, there are hardly any placements. Students have to find placements on their own after completing college. However, the college provides internships during the course if you are unable to find one. There are no placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many libraries, and each department has its own library. There is no Wi-Fi in the hostels. Classrooms and hostels do not have AC. Even coolers are not allowed in the hostels. There are no ceiling fans in hostel rooms, so students have to survive on wall fans and their personal fans.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are average, and the teaching quality is also average. Wherever you go, you have to study on your own. It feels more like a school rather than a college. The management system is worse. They have six periodicals in three days. Instead, they could have six tests in six days.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement in 2023, best infrastructure of department, and facilities are good.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2023, 100% were placed, and in 2024, 94% were placed ( because of seniors misbehaving with company percentage owned). Highest package is 26 LPA, lowest package is 4 LPA, and average package is 6 LPA. Vedanta, Xomobile, Accenture, TCS, Bajaj & 30 more are recruiters. 70% placed in Bajaj, and rest will be in Accenture, Goldman Sachs, and many more. An instrument engineer role is offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Well, Wi-Fi labs, virtual labs, e-learning labs, and classrooms are projected well, anytime access to library till 8 pm. Hostel rooms are quite enough for 3 people, a bed, an almirah, a study table, a chair for each student, and a mirror in the room. Canteens are good, everything is on campus only. Medical facilities, on campus hospital for basic dedication and for higher checkups, preferred to visit Jaipur or Niwai hospital.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, mostly teachers in my depth are done with their M.Tech or Ph.D. Teaching quality is good for understanding. Course makes students industry-ready, for that our college has a campus training department built by Bajaj. Exams are not too difficult for daily readers. Pass percentage is 35%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it has a scope either in India or outside India. They make sure everything about this course is clear at the time of admission. There are many events, fests, and scholarships for those in need.

reviews.review_title: Good laboratories, awesome faculty members, and supportive professors.

detailed_review.Placements: 150 students got placed. 50% internships are done by students from other places like Dehradun, Delhi, and Mumbai in the choice of their interest subjects like food technology, microbiology, and plant physiology from reputable university companies and colleges, and they gained experience.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is nutritional food, which contains many items that are good for the body, like curd, raita, and buttermilk. On Tuesday, we get special food like puri paratha, cholle sabji, or paneer, and the food we eat has good taste, and we get fresh and hot food after we come back in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, they provide sufficient content with knowledge so that we can write in exams more than enough and get good marks. Teachers are very helpful, they always help whenever we go to them and ask them about studies or further career options.
detailed_review.Other: All five-fold activities are present, which is very good. Many things we learn from this five-fold activity.

reviews.review_title: My college journey changes my life completely and make me to learn so many good things in life.

detailed_review.Placements: I am pursuing bachelors of design in interior design and the students placed in this course are approximately 25-35 per year. The highest package offered in this course varies between 8 LPA - 10 LPA, the lowest package offered is between 2 LPA - 3 LPA, and the average package offered is between 5 LPA - 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my courses are Live Space, Godrej Interio, etc. As mostly everyone gets internships from our course and in good companies that help in growth.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus is split into two different blocks, the first block includes all the hostels and the canteens, and the second block is completely institutional college and school. The departments have proper facilities, including proper spacious classes, labs for practical classes, workshop area, etc. Banasthali is fully residential college as it has almost 29-30 hostels, and has capacity of 150-400 students in the hostel depending on the size of hostel. Rooms are available in 2-seater, 3-seater, and 4-seater.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff is very helpful and available for every doubt. The staff is well qualified and has vast knowledge of the industry also. The teaching aspects include both PPT presentations and whiteboards, depending on the task. The course curriculum is fully relevant, and teach those things only that will help in surviving in the industry. Semester exams are moderate, and the pass percentage is 75%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as from the start I like to visualize things and incorporate into my home interiors. It built my passion for choosing interior design as a career option. My course gives a vast variety of career options, and it allows you to explore in many different ways. Campus is surrounded by greenery. Connectivity is good as we have proper buses running to travel from hostel to departments. College provides scholarships, and it helps us very much. There are five-fold activities running in my college which include different types of activities.

reviews.review_title: Outstanding, really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Banasthali provides us 100% placements. If you are a good student and average, you have more chance of placement in college. Recruiting companies are Sun Pharma, Aristo, and many more. 90% of the students got internships from big companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the facilities are available there. We have free Wi-Fi, gym, swimming, horse riding, a big library, well-furnished classroom, etc. The quality of food is very good and tasty just like homemade. The staff behaviour is also good. Our warden is very strict. So, it is easy to make discipline.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our professors are well-qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is very sharp and good. This course is now demanding, and in upcoming few years, biotechnology will be relevant. The semester exams are not too much difficult. 40% is the passing mark.
detailed_review.Other: I want to become a researcher in biotechnology, as it is best for me.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Excellent place to learn, explore, and have a great life of living.

detailed_review.Placements: Our previous batch was 100% placed. The highest package is 18 LPA. Recruiting companies are Amazon, Flipkart, Barclays, BNY, JP Morgan, Deloitte, and many more. 100% of students got internships in big companies as software developer. All the students got internships there. Our college provides very good placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the facilities are excellent. Classrooms are well designed, and they have library in each department. Wi-Fi facilities are there in the hostels, and labs have AC. Hostel facilities are amazing. The food quality is also good, and everything is just so perfect there.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very helpful. Teaching quality is also excellent. It makes students industry-ready, they have their workshops for that. 90% of students pass the exams. Everyone can pass the exams easily if they have their concept clear.

reviews.review_title: Review of Banasthali Vidyapith.

detailed_review.Placements: Some alumni say that there are 95% chances of good placements in our course. Top recruiting companies for our course are Raymond, Zee Media, Pear Global, etc. Vast roles such as art directors, graphic designers, video editors, and filmmakers are offered to students. The average package offered in our course ranges from 1-5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department infrastructure is not that good. There are leakage issues. Maintenance is not proper. There are labs with systems and AC. There is no Wi-Fi in the college. Wi-Fi facility is available only in the hostel with an annual charge of Rs. 2,000 and timings fixed per day with a limit of 6 GB per day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, friendly, understanding, and easily approachable. However, there is a mix of behaviour. Sometimes, they are strict and sometimes, they are lenient. So, overall, it depends on students to maintain a healthy environment on the campus by their attitude and way of grasping knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: I wish students could get more exposure, as the campus does not have any connectivity to the outside world. Students are kind of cut off from the entire world, which curbs creativity and thinking out of the box. Apart from that, the college is best at this amount.

reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with the college.

detailed_review.Placements: At Banasthali Vidyapith, there is no entrance exam for B.A. LL.B. program and it is based on the 12th class percentage. If we score more than 70%, our admission will be final. Companies visit the college for placements. Banasthali has 3 courses B.A.LL.B., B.Com LL.B., and B.A. LL.B. integrated course. We have to find our internships by ourselves. No internship is provided by the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the law department is not so good. The library is good, and every law book is available in the library. Newspapers are also available in it. Labs are not in good condition. Maximum computers are damaged. No internet connection is there on their PC. The hostel facility is good in Banasthali and they will provide 4 times food in a day with different foods daily. Sports facilities are also very fabulous. Every sport is available. Horse riding is also there. A cricket ground, badminton court, and everything is available here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in our department are very qualified. They give us every basic knowledge to higher knowledge. They teach everything about law subjects. For students who want to crack the judiciary or go into research, teachers will definitely help them in that field. Semester exams are not so hard, and it depends upon the subject. Some subjects are easy in law, but some are difficult. Otherwise, the level of the paper is very normal.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I want to pursue the teaching field. If students want to do a master's in law then teachers are very good. They will clear our basic theory and knowledge given by my teachers is very well. The thing that can be improved is placements. Fests are also very good in our department.

reviews.review_title: Overall, the college is good with nice faculty and a lot of extracurricular activities.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good for UG courses. Placement percentage is good, and internships are provided by the college in the final year of our course. Top recruiting companies for our course are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, IBM, Goldman Sachs, Oracle, Cisco, Flipkart, Amazon, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of hostels and the college is good. We will find it difficult to survive, especially in summer, as there is no AC and no cooler. We are only allowed to carry a stand fan or a table fan. There are a lot of restrictions inside the university. There are good classrooms and labs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course and faculty members are absolutely very good. Semester exams are easy. If we study notes of our professionals, then we will easily get a good SGPA. Almost everyone passes exams. Lab exams are quite easy with a moderate viva.
detailed_review.Other: Hence, it's a women's college, so no boys are allowed to sit in class with us. 3-4 fests are held every year, and we are allowed to wear a kurta only. Also, in class we are not allowed to wear jeans, crop tops, or tops.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The university has around 30+ girls’ hostels , with each room equipped with personal computers and Internet connectivity. Apart from this, the campus has a vast, well-maintained library, sports arenas for horse riding, rifle shooting, swimming and a flying club. It has its own community radio station and laboratories for Chemistry, Computer, Design, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, VLSI Design, MATLAB, Basic Electronics, Microwave Engineering, Microprocessor and Microcontroller.

sections.heading: Banasthali Vidyapith Campus Highlights
text: Banasthali Vidyapith has 850 acres of campus, which offers all the basic amenities such as an auditorium, conference and seminar halls, a sports complex and even an on-campus hospital. The university provides 29 hostels with different capacities. There is a well-developed sports complex, including the Laxmi Bai Maida, which is essential for the holistic development of students. The campus also includes a cafeteria, a gym, and other facilities like a shuttle service, an ATM, a medical service, and a general store. The entrance and parking of the campus are wheelchair accessible. To learn more about Banasthali Vidyapith's infrastructure facilities, read further:
Campus Building:

tables.Banasthali Vidyapith Campus Highlights: High-speed internet and power, a secure environment, a swimming pool, an athletic ground, hostels and more

sections.heading: Banasthali Vidyapith Academic and Research Facilities
text: Research has been an integral component of higher education in Banasthali even before its attainment of Deemed University status. However, initially, it was mainly in the form of Doctoral studies. Over the past ten years, the research efforts have expanded to include sponsored research and consultancy projects in various disciplines. A development in this direction has been made recently with the sanction of a Centre for Research in Mathematical Sciences at Banasthali University by the Department of Science & Technology. The establishment of this centre is going to boost the research environment in the institute as well as the state.

Encouraging and sustaining innovation and research in the regular academics of the institution required a sturdy administrative courage and strong concern for academic excellence, and the Banasthali University has continuously evinced it through its functioning.

sections.heading: Banasthali Vidyapith Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: Banasthali Vidyapith is a residential institute, which means that the students admitted to the college will have to join a hostel. This compulsion is not there if the student is a ward of the worker staying on campus or the student is residing within a radius of 2.5 km from the campus. There are 31 hostels on the campus of the university. The number of rooms in each hostel is different, ranging from 80 to 120. All rooms are well furnished with basic amenities provided. Each hostel has a separate mess , newspaper and telephone facility . It is the only university in Rajasthan to provide personal computers with internet connectivity to the PG students.

sections.heading: Banasthali Vidyapith Library
text: The library at Banasthali Vidyapeeth provides comprehensive resources to support research, teaching and learning needs. The Central Library of  Banasthali is very rich in its contents to facilitate research. Internet access is provided to the library by way of Campus Networking and by connecting to I NFLIBNET . Access to more than 9300 full-text online journals is also made available under the UGC INFONET scheme. There is are adequate number of books, magazines, journals and other sources to support the aim of academic excellence. The library commits to:
list: Build collections and create tools to support research and learning;
Maximise access to and promote the use of internal as well as external information resources;
Ensure the preservation and long-lasting availability of library resources;
Create attractive and comfortable  physical and virtual environments for study and research;
Collaborate with Vidyapith faculty and researchers to enrich the collection services.

sections.heading: Banasthali Vidyapith Sports Facilities
text: The institute offers extensive sports facilities for the female students. The campus features spacious playgrounds for various sports and events. Various inter-university competitions are being held at the institute. Students are encouraged to participate in the events being held from time to time. Both the modern and traditional sports are being held at the institute, including:

sections.heading: Places to visit in & near Banasthali Vidyapith
text: Banasthali University is situated in the Tonk District of Rajasthan. Numerous attractive sights can be explored near the campus. For students interested in historical places, the places to be explored include Sunehri Kothi (Mansion of Gold) , which has beautiful paintings, Rasiya ke Tekri and Hadi Rani ka Kund . For a religious expedition, students can visit Kalyani Temple, Jama Masjid, and Bilasdeo Temple . Bilaspur Dam is also a popular tourist destination.

facilities.description: the Central Library’s collection of 200000 books, reports, theses, dissertations, bound journals, manuscripts, albums, pamphlets, maps, charts, audio/video cassettes, gramophone records, CDs/DVDs, atlas, slides and many more. highlights.summary:
The Indian Institute of Technology Bhilaii is a technical and research university of Indian Chhattisgarh in Bhilai. It is an Indian Institute of technology located in India and established in 2016. The accredited university of IIT Bhilai is the University Grants Commission and the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE). The Ministry of Education (MoE) that was once known as the Ministry of Human resource development, Government of India also acknowledges it. Since 2020, IIT bhilai rankings have been on the rise. It has been ranked 72 th in the NIRF ranking 2025 as one of the top engineering colleges in India.
IIT Chhattisgarh has courses to offer at the UG, PG, PG Diploma, and PhD levels primarily in Engineering, Science, etc. streams. Flagship courses of IIT Bhilai are BTech and MTech.
The IIT Bhilai cutoff 2025 for BTech (CSE) stood at 6516. During IIT Bhilai placements 2025, the overall average package stood at INR 13 LPA. A record-breaking 100% placement rate was observed from the MTech DSAI branch in 2024. The permanent campus of IIT Bhilai is a complete, self-sustaining residential campus, and it will be developed subsequently in a phased manner. The institute offers various facilities, including a 3-D printing lab, fabrication lab, electrical lab, computer lab, library, etc. The facility of the IIT Bhilai hostel is offered separately to boys and girls.
