reviews.review_title: It has very good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70-80% of students got placed in our course. There are some challenges to getting a job in our course, as an M.Sc. is not a vocational course. The highest package offered in our course is 12 LPA. The average package ranges from 6-7 LPA. 50% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. It has unlimited internet access, a well-furnished library, spacious classrooms, etc. It also has well-equipped and high-tech laboratories. The hostel quality is good. Medical facilities are available. Multiple sports complexes are present here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Well-trained and well-experienced teaching staff members are present here. Their teaching quality is also very good. The course curriculum is relevant. Students become industry-ready as the course curriculum is designed by industry experts. Semester examinations are moderate. Around 90% of students pass exams.

reviews.review_title: My review about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Amazon, Microsoft, and many more companies offer jobs to IIT Delhi students. For M.Sc. Chemistry, Alien offered jobs to 15 students with a good stipend. We can do projects under well-qualified professors, which enhances your capabilities to do something better. Our college is one of the top colleges in India in terms of placements. Eligibility for campus placements depends on the course you enrolled in. The highest packages are in crores sometimes, and the average is about 10–12 LPA. Depending on the number of companies visiting, it decides the number of students getting placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In this course, we study higher Chemistry and its applications in the fields of industries, research, material synthesis, medical sciences, etc. Every aspect of this course should not be linked to the grades. Course load is more in the first year. Hostel rooms are very neat and clean. Each student has a separate room. There are 6 rooms in a unit. Each unit has a common drawing room and a kitchen. There is a mini refrigerator in the kitchen of each unit. There is a common balcony in each unit. Every unit has 4 bathrooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and have many years of experience. The professors have graduated from very prestigious colleges. They are highly respected in the industry and have many contacts. Most of them here have advanced degrees in their respective departments. They have a lot of knowledge and teach well. Well, you come to an IIT to be a know-it-all. So, it is about how much time and effort you can put in to improve and expand your skill set. Most of the students here hang out in labs where they enjoy working and learning.

reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Our IIT is a newly established IIT. There is no pass-out batch yet. So we can't tell about placements yet but colleges provide internships. Many participate in this. I hope we get good placements due to the curriculum. 2nd year students are eligible for placements. I didn't apply for any placement. The highest package is 17 LPA and a minimum of 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This two-year postgraduate program offers a deeper knowledge of advanced mathematics through subjects like geometry, calculus, algebra, number theory, differential equations, etc. The students become more skilled and specialized in a particular subject and are encouraged to carry out research in various fields of mathematics. The hostels are not that good as it is a temporary campus, but we have coolers two badminton courts, and good nature around us. But it is not cement construction it is steel construction. We have sufficient bed and room space.
detailed_review.Faculty: It's a semester exam. M.Sc. was a 2-year program and exam held at the University Math Department. Exams are a little hard due to big theorems and theories. I passed with good marks in every term. In the first semester, there is a paper on field theory it is so hard but I got maximum marks in that subject. All are excellent but few of them have excellent conveying skills. They are friendly and they play games with us like badminton. They also participate in extracurricular activities. They encourage us. But few of them are not that good.

reviews.review_title: Placements are very good.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement department works well and makes a target to place more than 90% of students. The highest package is 40 LPA. The average package is 15 LPA. Companies that are recruiting are Google, Amazon, Intuit, and L&T.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college campus is gorgeous and well-maintained. We have classrooms with good space, projectors, and smart boards. Labs have high-speed Wi-Fi connections. The library is well-stocked with books and journals. The hostel is very clean and we have attached washroom facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are the best thing about the college. They are highly qualified professionals and have good years of experience. The teaching quality is very good. The curriculum is well-defined and gets regularly updated with additional webinars and seminars that take place from time to time. Exams are a bit challenging and the pass rate is around 80%.

reviews.review_title: The institute is fine at its infrastructure with good academics.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements at IIT Bhilai are quite good. In the 2022–23 academic year, 86.23% of students were placed. The highest package offered was 48 LPA, and the average package was 14 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Amazon, PayTM, TCS, Jio, and Accenture. A total of 131 offers were made.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The buildings were constructed with perfection, and they looked great. Wi-Fi was available everywhere on campus, and the classrooms were fully air-conditioned. The library was quiet and a good place to study. The academic block was really beautiful. Laundry facilities were available at the hostel, along with Wi-Fi. The food quality was above average. For medical facilities, there was a health center on campus. For sports, there was a cricket ground, a basketball court, a football ground, badminton courts, and table tennis tables in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members at IIT Bhilai are great. They are always available to answer our questions during the day. They explain concepts well and clear our doubts. The curriculum is similar to other IITs. Exams are conducted smoothly, and each professor has their own way of conducting them. Semester exams are quite easy, and the pass percentage is 95%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a great college I can say but it is just in its initial phase of achieving excellence.

detailed_review.Placements: If we neglect the recession years, then I can say placements are pretty good in my branch at least. Maximum students are placed in good companies, with top companies being like Google, Accenture, etc. Whereas only a small group of people remains unplaced or don't have good post-graduation options. Internships are not that good, but as an insider, I can say the top 50 percent of the batch at least get the good internship with an above-average stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our institute is in a growing phase, so some facilities are not available here, like Olympic playgrounds and student activity centers, etc. But those facilities that are built till now are up to the mark, like all hostel rooms having air conditioners installed, washing machine facilities inside the hostel, and good Wi-Fi connection with unlimited internet. So I can say those facilities that are built are very the latest and cutting edge.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good enough and helpful; all teachers are Ph.D. graduates from different IITs or foreign universities. Teaching quality depends on course to course and teacher to teacher. Some are really great teachers, but some are not. The course curriculum is similar to that of other IITs, which is decent. Semester exams depend on professors, and their difficulties depend on the course; some courses are easy to do, and some courses are actually very difficult to pass. Pass percentage depends on professors; in most cases, it is 30 percent, but it can be easily changeable.
detailed_review.Other:
My batch strength for B.Tech 2027 is 225 students, including all branches, with 55 in my Computer Science branch. These guys teach biology, digital fabrication, electrical, electronics, etc. In 1st years, which I think is very bad, I think if I get a chance to change that, I will definitely do that. 
Events and fests are pretty decent; the campus has a very small crowd as compared to other institutions. The surrounding area was a village when we were not here, but now it has started developing, and the main city is just 2 to 3 km apart from our main campus. Scholarships are so much available here that many students got scholarships here; scholarship notifications come every week. Extracurricular activities are decent, but I can say that due to the smaller crowd, the chance to do better in extracurriculars is very much higher here as compared to other institutions.

reviews.review_title: A growing college with lots of developments in the future.

detailed_review.Placements: Campus Placements 2023-24: 50% placed on campus for mechanical engineering roles in consulting, IT, core (technical), finance, analytics, management, teaching, and research. Avg (overall) - 13.02 LPA. Companies - Mahindra, Tata Autocomp, TCS, HCL, Accenture, NVIDIA, Winjit, L&T, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a state-of-the-art campus with beautiful buildings, lakes, and greenery all around. The campus has centralized Wi-Fi with good speed. Hostels are good, with AC in each room. Currently, there are 3 hostels. Labs, classrooms, and the library are all well-equipped with the latest technologies. Mess food is good here. There is a common health center. Sports and games are in the development phase, as the campus is new. It will improve over time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are highly qualified. All are Masters in their fields and are busy with their research work. For the first year, the course is common for all. From the second year onwards, we are taught our core courses. Exams here are not very tough compared to JEE, but you will hardly get time to study because of the extracurricular activities. This makes it a difficult job for many students to manage academics. Saturdays and Sundays are off. Classes are from 8:30 to 12:30 (not always, we get breaks too if there isn't a lecture scheduled) and then labs are from 2:30 to 5:30. For the first year, it is two times a week.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty, amazing infrastructure, best 3rd gen IIT, good for startups.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate is 94%, which is quite high. We have a lot of internships, and the placement cell looks after placements. They conduct mock interviews and make us ready for the interviews. The top companies who come for placements are Google, NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft. The highest placement on campus was INR 48,00,000 and INR 82,00,000 off campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our annual festival is called MERAZ, which is central India's biggest techno-cultural festival. It's held in November. In addition, we have over 100 events throughout the year, not counting festivals and celebrations. We're always tinkering with the labs and finding new things. The sports complex isn't ready yet, but we have a decent temporary sports facility and a partnership with nearby sports clubs for professional training. We have 19 clubs on campus, which is a lot, and it's really fun to take part in club events.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum at IIT Bhilai is up-to-date and covers all the important topics that we need to know. We also have elective courses, so we can customize our curriculum to fit our interests. This is especially helpful for those who want to think outside the box. The curriculum is designed to make us corporate-ready, and all the necessary details are taught in college. We have midsemester and end-of-semester exams, as well as surprise quizzes in between. The semester exams are moderately difficult, but they are relatively graded, so the pass percentage is high, about 93-95%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechatronics because I want to start my own robotics company. I like that the course allows me to explore a wide range of topics and think outside the box. However, I would like more lab classes, because hands-on experience is the best way to learn. The faculty are very knowledgeable and approachable, but I'm not happy with the syllabus, especially math, because they don't follow a particular book.

reviews.review_title: Emerging Technical Institute in India with a lot of scope in professional development.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in our institute are good and balanced every year. Many EE students pursue higher education like Masters and PhD in foreign universities. Some students from EE appear for placements in the software and electronics domain and successfully get good packages. The highest package for last year's placement was 42 Lakhs CTC. Companies like NVIDIA, Intel, CDAC, Paytm, and Deloitte bring regular placement and internship opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Full campus coverage of Wi-Fi has been established with 5G services also available. Separate and systematic labs are present for all departments. We have multiple capacity classrooms with AC. The library is also available.
Sports facilities are still under development.
Medical facilities are good and open 24x7.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Teachers here are highly qualified and involved in national-level projects. Teachers provide comprehensive study material to students.
New course curriculum has been implemented under NEP 2020, which makes students industry-ready.
Exams are moderate to tough which judge our skills and knowledge.

reviews.review_title: Strong faculty and practical learning at IIT Bhilai with great campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: At IIT Bhilai, around 75% of students from my course got placed. Top recruiters included companies like Amazon, L&T, and Tata Steel. The highest salary package offered is 40 LPA. The average salary package offered is 12 LPA. Common roles offered are electrical design engineer, control system engineer, and power systems analyst. Around 70% of students secured internships in companies like Bajaj Electrical and Siemens.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped and involve solving real-world problems. The infrastructure of IIT Bhilai is energetic and strong. The campus provides high-speed Wi-Fi and modern classrooms. There is also a central library in IIT Bhilai. Hostel facilities are decent with clean room quality, and the mess provides very delicious and tasty food. Medical facilities are also well-maintained and punctual for emergencies or casual conditions. A sports complex will be made in phase 2 of the construction of IIT Bhilai.
detailed_review.Faculty: At IIT Bhilai, the electrical engineering faculty members are highly skilled and encourage a research-based approach to teaching. The curriculum combines solid theory with hands-on experience, preparing students for the industry. While exams are tough, regular assessments help. Around 85-90% of students pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose electrical engineering at IIT Bhilai because of my JEE advanced rank. One of the best things about the course is its balance between theoretical knowledge and practical application. To improve, I wish there were more industry-focused workshops and internship opportunities. Campus life is lively with events like Meraz and the cultural fest. The campus has good connectivity to Durg and is surrounded by peaceful nature. The campus is surrounded by greenery, and there is zero pollution. The college provides many scholarships for students who do not have good financial conditions.

reviews.review_title: IIT Bhilai - More than expectations.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in Chemistry are mainly for teaching. This year pharma companies will also come and the placement package is around 7 LPA minimum to 12 LPA on campus and off campus 14-15 LPA. In my batch, I got an internship with my 2 other classmates at iiser, barc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Library and Wi-Fi is 24*7. Labs particularly thesis lab is good but M.Sc.  practical lab for first year is okay from Next year it will be better. Hostel rooms are provided with AC and full cleanliness like a dream place. Hostels are better than anyone's expectations.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful as they are from IITs so they are highly qualified, you can check from the Chemistry department and other department official websites. The course is made more academically oriented but industry-based courses are also there like battery, solid state etc.
detailed_review.Other: Fest name Meraz. I chose M.Sc. Chemistry because I am planning to pursue further studies in this field.

reviews.review_title: Good placements in 2021-2022.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 50-60 percent of students were placed. The highest package was  20 LPA and the lowest package was around 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include HCL, Deloitte, Mahindra and Mahindra. Most of them got SDE roles. Overall, the placement was average.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the campus. Sufficient labs and classrooms are present. A decent library is present. The mess food is below average but cafes and canteens serve decent food. There is no proper ground for games like cricket and football, but each hostel has table tennis, badminton and volleyball courts. Campus has a health centre for medical facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is good. Course curricula more consist of core electrical engineering and a small amount of electronics. Semester exams are not much difficult and the majority of the students pass the exam. So the passing percentage is above 90 percent.

reviews.review_title: You can't expect 80 LPA to 1CR packages but you can expect 20–30 LPA.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in my second year of B.Tech. EE. I will graduate from this college in 2027. Till now, what I have experienced is that this college has good infrastructure. The placement cell is average from my point of view, as the highest package last year was 48 LPA, and that was also international, not domestic. If you have skills and are good at academics, you can grab a 20+ LPA easily.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
The course curriculum is well maintained; we have to do almost 144 credits in B.Tech. in 4 years. We have to take the midterm and endterm twice a year; there are two seems in a year. hostel is very good, as each room is provided with AC 24/7. There are 2 hostels for boys and one for girls. Wi-fi is also available but sometimes it is not that properly working but almost everytime it gives a speed of 250mbps. The library is also good for studying as there is no disturbance. It have sufficient books for everyone. Mess food is average and you get 4 meals (breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner)
.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams conducted here are organized. The difficulty of the exam is decided by the respective professor. On an exam, papers are doable if you study one or two days prior to the exam. But I will suggest that you attend classes. You can change your branch in your first year but you have to get a 9+ CGPA in your first year to go into CSE or DSAI. Teachers have TA's that assist you with any problem and you can personally go to professors and meet them in person. Yes, if you work with professors on projects, you will get an idea of how industry works and can have internships through them.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is a core branch. I didn't want to go into mechatronics or the lower branches, as in electrical engineering, communication and digital electronics, which have high potential in the future. I will suggest that if you are going to come to IIT Bhilai, you can expect packages of 20–30 LPA if you are good in academics and have skills.

reviews.review_title: As of now, it is not worth coming to this college because of the below-average placements .

detailed_review.Placements: My name is Aayush, and I am a student in my 2nd year pursuing a B.Tech in Mechatronics Engineering. Since this branch was introduced in our college only 2 years ago and my batch is only the 2nd batch, we have to wait till our seniors get placed before giving an opinion about the placements in this course. But considering the placement rates in already established courses like CSE, DSAI, ME, and EE for IIT standards, it is not going great as of now. Certainly the expectations for our course are high since the demand in robotics and industry 4.0 is increasing so by the time our seniors pass out, companies offering decent packages will start hiring.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since IIT Bhilai is one of the newly established 3rd generation IITs, the facilities and infrastructure are great, and our permanent campus has just been built. There are various departments for the courses equipped with all the new equipment, and the infrastructure is unique with some cultural influences from Chhattisgarh. We also have a common engineering department that has labs for all the departments and each of the classrooms is well equipped with Wi-Fi. We also have a 4-floor library with all the facilities. So, yes, the infrastructure will not disappoint. Talking about hostels, we have a total of 4 hostels on our campus: 2 hostels for boys, 1 hostel for girls and 1 more for Ph.D. research scholars and married students. The hostels are also nice; I'd say better than some old IITs, obviously. And there is one common mess for all the students. The quality of the food is okay. The facilities for sports and games are nowhere near the quality as compared to holder IITs. Still, there is work to be done, like we don't have separate grounds for cricket and football, and for badminton, the courts have been built recently, but we have recreational rooms in each hostel for basic indoor games like TT, foosball, and carrom. In terms of medical facilities, we have a medical center on our campus that runs 24 hours a day.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course syllabus for each course is relevant and the faculty members are also helpful and have done research in their particular field. The quality of teaching is good. There are 2 exams in each semester: one is midterm, and the second is end semester. And the pass percentage for each course depends on the course and the faculty. There is a credit system; each course offers specific credit and to graduate, we need a minimum 144 credits.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the mechatronics course since I have a keen interest in robotics and AI/ML, and seeing the scope of this course in the near future is great. Since this branch was just introduced in our college and also because this branch is niche since we are the first IIT to introduce this branch for B.Tech. So the alumni network is not that strong and the crowd is also very small, so it would be better if we had a good alumni network to guide this branch. The college fest also takes place every year, named 'Meraz', which is great with many events taking place.

reviews.review_title: This college is good but if you are eligible for any 2nd or 1st grade IIT, don't come here.

detailed_review.Placements:
33% placements were offered this year because of recession. The average package is 14 to 16 LPA.
Deloitte is the top recruiter. The thing I don't like is that Google doesn't come here but yes, Microsoft and Amazon do come here. People mostly try off-campus and they get very good packages like 60 LPA, 80 LPA and even 1 CRPA.
There is less competition because of the smaller population, as this is a third-generation IIT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is very good. They provide AC in every room. Decent Wi-Fi is there. Mess food is below average. It was good last year. But this time, they messed it up. Also, COSAA, whose overview of everyone's problems is not so good as students are less likely to be found, is only 50 to 45 Lacs for the whole year. Fest is also not that good. It's like some small private colleges, really.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, and especially electrical faculty members are very good. Teacher assistance is also nice to students, as they are also M.Tech or PhD students. The course of study or plan of study is well maintained and there are 2 semesters in a year, with 2 midterms and 2 end terms.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as this is a core branch.

reviews.review_title: B.Tech in electrical engineering from the IIT Bhilai.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Bhilai is one of the best colleges for placements in electrical engineering. Almost 100% of the students get placements in our college. The average package offered at our college was between 4-9 LPA. Top recruiters at the college were Tata Motors, Hero, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, etc. for our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for the students in our course are good enough. Students receive the best quality facilities, including labs, library, Wi-Fi, canteen, hostel, etc. Modern facilities are available to improve their learning. Sports facilities are also available for the students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of the college is helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable for our course. All the teachers are highly experienced and provide the best quality teaching to the students. Teachers offer both theoretical and experiential knowledge to the students. The course curriculum of the college is relevant and prepares the students to be industry-ready. Exams are not that easy to pass.

reviews.review_title: Review of M.Tech (Electronics and Communication Engineering).

detailed_review.Placements: As the ECE Branch is a new department, right now there are no B.Tech. students currently enrolled in the course, and only 2 M.Tech. and 3 Ph.D. students are enrolled in the ECE program as of now. So placement data can't be provided, as we are the first batch enrolled here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good regarding Wi-Fi and water, and every room has an AC installed. Mess food is good. As only phase I is completed, the whole campus is still not built, but it does have almost everything needed in college for now and plenty of space to roam around.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members here are highly knowledgeable and helpful to students. Here we have 2 faculty members, of whom 2 are communication faculty members. But as of right now, we don't have a VLSI professor, so for now, we have a guest faculty member from IIT Naya Raipur teaching us VLSI subjects. Exams are up to the mark and we do deal with a lot of practical experiments regarding our courses for any subject being taught here.
detailed_review.Other: Right now, we are studying two communication subjects and two VLSI subjects as of this first semester. There are many workshops happening at the college and clubs are also active so if anyone is interested, they can participate as per their level of interest.

reviews.review_title: A short review of IIT Bhilai for all those who are confused regarding which IIT to choose.

detailed_review.Placements: As IIT Bhilai is a recently developed IIT, the placements in the college are mediocre, with the domestic package being INR 28 LPA and the highest international package being INR 48 LPA given by Accenture Japan. The average will be around INR 14 LPA in 2023. Major recruiters include Deloitte, HCL, Google, Mahindra, ICICI, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Being an IIT, it has state-of-the-art infrastructure. Some of the buildings are being built, they will be completed by mid-2024. The full campus is expected to be built by 2030, by mid-2024, all infrastructure regarding academics, like classes and the library, would be completed, along with some sports fields and a complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers here are experienced and qualified since it is an IIT, and the professors here have experience teaching at other IITs as well. The semester exam is not that hard, provided you pay attention in class, and the IIT curriculum allows you to choose the electives of your choice, giving you flexibility in your course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: IIT Bhilai- on it's way to progress!

detailed_review.Placements: The Data Science and Artificial Intelligence course offers great insight into future possibilities and also uncovers the new horizons that can be reached if proper guided effort is put into certain areas of study. I have learned a lot from my professors and would love to put it to use.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The newly built campus is great. Even though only the first phase is complete as of now, the campus reflects the institute's ideology and doesn't let down when compared to globally leading institutions. The infrastructure provides opportunities to explore every possibility.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the professors were helpful and very knowledgeable. Random grading was never a concept. The curriculum is still being built, but it is quite up-to-date and on par with international standards. We hope to cement it soon. The semester exams are designed to test theoretical and application-based knowledge to prevent written learning.
detailed_review.Other: None.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Bhilai - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college provides good placements. Almost all students are placed. The highest salary package offered is 40 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Recently, a new permanent campus was constructed. The construction work is not entirely done. Our college provides excellent infrastructure. We have top-class labs with a central prototyping facility. A library and data center are available. Hostels are spacious.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are excellent. Some teachers are guest lecturers from the top institutions in the world. The course curriculum is designed for constructive development and better knowledge. It is highly optimised for better skill development.
detailed_review.Other: It is an emerging third-generation IIT.

highlights.summary:
NIT Srinagar is one of the premier Educational institutions in the Northern Regions of the country. In 1960, the institute was formed and is situated on the banks of the world-famous Dal Lake, Srinagar. The National Institute of Technology Srinagar is one of the 18 regional engineering colleges sponsored by the Government of India during the 2nd Five-Year Plan. The institute was recognised by UGC and AICTE. NIRF has ranked NIT Srinagar 73 under the Engineering category in 2025.
NIT Srinagar admission is entrance-based and accepts national entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, CAT, MAT, and others. During NIT Uttarakhand placements 2023, the highest package stood at INR 36.5 LPA. The institute has well-equipped infrastructure, which includes classrooms, a library, a sports complex, healthcare facilities, a hostel, and others. reviews.review_title: Come to NIT Srinagar if this is your last and best option.

detailed_review.Placements: Unfortunately, in my course, placements are very low. The maximum package for this year is 8 LPA, 8–10 students got placed for the same amount, so it can be considered as an average package as well. Most of the students got internships in good companies like DRDO, HPCL, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is fine. Classrooms are good. Wi-Fi is also available. Labs need some maintenance. The library is well maintained but very small and congested. Mess food is just edible, canteen food is far better. For common health issues, medical facilities can help you, but for bigger issues, the college will prefer you go to a government hospital. Most of the sports courts are here. If you are a sportsperson, you will be happy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are a bit strict in their curriculum. If you are genuinely eager to learn, teachers are helpful. All of them are well qualified. Till now, based on my experience, I can say the theory portion is much more than practical, which didn’t sound good to me. The exam level is average. But the copy-checking criteria in my course are strict, due to which many students face backlogs in their exams.
detailed_review.Other: Obviously, this course isn’t my choice. But I got it, and I have to go on with it. At the end, I’ll have some knowledge which will enhance my skills in this field. Many things can be improved in my course, like labs, curriculum, and a few faculty members. You can grab many scholarships; the most common is PM Yashasvi. Every day, many extracurricular activities are held. We have two fests: 1–Techvaganza (Tech Fest), 2–Range-e-Chinar (Fest of Art and Culture).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Improving gradually in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, the placements have been decent. As per the data provided by the placement cell of NIT Srinagar, 67% of students of Computer Science and Engineering are placed this year, up to now, with a median package of approximately 9 LPA, and the average package is around 8.5 LPA. The highest package is 24 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters are Physics Wallah, Oracle, Microsoft, and Make My Trip. This year, from my course, we have plenty of internship programs offered by Microsoft, but only 40% students opted for internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As per the needs of the modern world, I don't think that we have the required facilities and infrastructure available in NIT Srinagar, classrooms are not well maintained, and many tools for doing experiments are outdated, yet we have Wi-Fi facilities and all kinds of labs. Hostels are built according to old standards, but the new mega hostel will be ready this year. Food is good with all sorts of requirements for a balanced diet. There are 2-3 canteens for each station, fast food, daily use items and stalls, they have all the required items you desire. A big playground is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very helpful and good, but there are teachers who are only there for the completion of the syllabus rather than giving you constructive support. All of them are highly qualified. The curriculum is not designed efficiently in accordance with the modern book of AI. We are stuck with the old course, so one has to do their own research in the field of AI. Semester exams are medium hard, and the pass percentage is around 89%.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is the highest preferred course in all engineering institutes, as it gives you a variety of skills and the ability to secure a decent package. You can work from home, no field work is required in your office. I think if it is somehow connected with Artificial Intelligence, then it will be fully nourished, and this combination can lead the students to higher packages and job offers. Not many events were held earlier, but this year we had many fests and events, a less crowded campus, NSP scholarship, beautiful surroundings, lots of extracurricular activities, and good alumni connections.

reviews.review_title: I am in my first year of college. It is very good and one of the most beautiful campuses in India.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Srinagar has good placement records from the past 5 years. It has almost 100 percent placement records in almost every branch, with an average of 9 LPA. MNCs from across India come here to place students in their companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has very good infrastructure. Every hostel has a nice garden in front of it. There is a badminton court in my hostel where we enjoy playing every day. We have a big ground and good sports equipment, so we enjoy ourselves a lot while playing. We also have a nice view of the mountains.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty of the National Institute of Technology Srinagar is very good. Most of the faculty members are Ph.D. holders. They are very friendly and not too strict. The curriculum is good. We have two exams mainly. They are mid-term and end-term, so we don’t have much pressure.
detailed_review.Other: While playing sports or games, we have the best view of the mountains and clouds passing through them from the ground. It has one of the most beautiful campuses in India.

reviews.review_title: An almost good institute with average placements and a beautiful campus.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Srinagar's placement ratio is decent, means average placements. In Civil Engineering, there are the best placements. Computer Science and Electronics and Communication have the best placements, while other courses have average placements. I'm a Mechanical Engineering student, so in my course, approximately 80-85 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 35 LPA, the lowest package is 4 LPA, and the average package is 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, and some courses are NBA-accredited. There are all facilities for our course. It includes good Wi-Fi, classrooms with both smartboards and whiteboards, and good-quality labs. The food is good, and they prepare all Indian foods, both South and North. Sports facilities are also good, with a cricket ground, badminton courts, basketball courts, volleyball courts, etc. There are many canteens, but one problem is that there is no night canteen.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are helpful by nature. All are well-qualified, with most teachers holding M.Tech degrees, etc. The teaching quality is also good. Semester exams are not so difficult, but still, some papers are difficult. Students who have been learning from the start find it easy to clear semester exams. Overall, the semester exams are good.
detailed_review.Other: I don't have a very high percentile, so I got Electronics and Communication as my maximum option, but I am satisfied with Mechanical Engineering, so I am pursuing Mechanical Engineering. There are many events on this campus, including a good fest like Range-e-Chinar. The campus is good, and the food quality is also good.

reviews.review_title: College is good for students in higher branches like CSE and ECE, with a nice campus and location.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good in Computer Science Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and other major branches. The highest package is around 35 LPA, and the average is around 13 LPA for CSE and other major branches. In lower branches, the average is around 8-9 LPA. Many companies, such as BPCL, ONGC, and HPCL, recruit from core branches. Approximately 80-85% of students are placed in major branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mechanical and ECE departments are accredited. Wi-Fi is slow in hostels but good in academic areas. Mess food is manageable but not very good. A new hostel is being built for more convenience. Geysers, 24/7 water, and electricity are available. Cupboards are provided in the rooms, and single rooms are available for 4th-year students. Labs are good, with equipment and support staff.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, though not all. Most are knowledgeable and well qualified, but sometimes there may be gaps in understanding. As a Mechanical student, my course is accredited and is going well. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are little bit tough, but students who study well will get good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I like cars and mechanical work, so I chose Mechanical Engineering. My course is accredited. Labs and staff support are good.

reviews.review_title: Good college. Placement is good, and the facility is also good.

detailed_review.Placements: 80-90 percent of students got placed on campus. The average package is 10 LPA. Recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, IBM, TATA. 90 percent of students get internships. Internship is with the company DRDO. The highest package offered is 30 LPA-40 LPA. Students got placement inside the campus. Everyone is satisfied.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure and all facilities. Wi-Fi is everywhere. Classrooms are good. Library is good and canteen is available. The food is not very good. There are a lot of facilities in sports like badminton, volleyball, cricket, etc. Medical facilities are also good, we get good treatment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is good, helpful, and qualified. The difficulty of the semester is average. The pass percentage is 40 percent of the total, like 40 out of 100. Teachers are so experienced and good at understanding the topics for students. Teachers make students ready for the industry.
detailed_review.Other: I am interested in B.Tech.

reviews.review_title: Average colleges don't take your expectations very high while getting into NIT Srinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Srinagar offers better placements for CS/IT branches and decent placements for core branches. As I talked to my seniors, they told me that companies visit campus (like Nvidia, Microsoft, Oracle), but they offer only 2-3 job letters out of 100 students, which is not a good count. There is still a lack of skills in students to secure good placements on campus. It has around an 80 percent placement rate with a 10 LPA median salary, and the highest is 36 LPA. Roles offered to students are front-end developers & software developers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As a National institute, you expect a good infrastructure but it's not a good campus infrastructure. You may feel a lack of privacy and find it difficult to adjust at first in hostels. The canteen's facilities are not good, and you also get restrictions for visiting outside of campus and the hostel in terms of timing. You have to share a room with 5 students, and the room is not in very good condition. You will get Wi-Fi facilities. Department buildings are decent. Hostel food is not good. As you are also not allowed to not cook in the room yourself.
detailed_review.Faculty: The academic schedule is hectic, as you have to get 75 percent attendance with 9-5 classes. As a 1-year course, the curriculum is very irrelevant. Teachers are helpful, qualified (NIT/IITS), and knowledgeable. Depending on the curriculum, it does not make students industry-ready. The semester exams are tough, and you have to study well, you will get back for sure.
detailed_review.Other: I chose IT as I am interested in the tech field and want to have a good and bright future. A much more practical approach can lead to better courses. There are many events happening in college on a daily basis.

reviews.review_title: NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology .

detailed_review.Placements: In the last placement, Information Technology acquired more placements than the Computer Science branch. Top recruiting companies are Oracle and Big Basket. Around 60–80 percent students got placed. Students need to work on their skills to get a good placement like in any other place. At the end, it’s about skills because no company will hire a person who has no skills, even though he or she is from a reputed college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is beautiful. Dal Lake is right beside the college. The campus is a little small though. In sports, there are basketball, volleyball, cricket, football, tennis, table tennis, chess, and carrom. There is a canteen, a cafeteria, and some stationery shops.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the faculty are good, but some are not that good in teaching but have knowledge. But it’s like this in every college. Faculty in the college have PhD's and degrees from prestigious institutions like IITs and NITs. Some professors are known for being strict about attendance and assignments.

reviews.review_title: My opinion for NIT Srinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: 70 to 75 percent of students get placement. There are many companies like for civil – the top most company is L&T, JSW – for mechanical, Increff, Make My Trip, PayPal, Microsoft, Visa, Fractal, and many more companies. Along with this, there is a project in 4th year of college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Due to the low temperature here, heaters are available in the library and classroom, and Wi-Fi facility is also available. There are all labs available for all branches, like for civil – geotechnical, highway, transportation, structural, concrete lab available.
detailed_review.Faculty: They are really very supportive and apart from the academics they helped me a lot. Due to the projects in the 4th year, we mentally prepare for the industrial work, and also internship helped me a lot. Paper is moderate level and it depends upon the faculty and subject.
detailed_review.Other: Techvaganga and Range Chinar are the two most important fests of college, because I wanted to go in over. Nment exams civil engineering is best for me.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly, around 70% of students get placed. Many companies and startups visit the campus, such as INCREFF, Microsoft, and MakeMyTrip. The top role offered is SDE, but it depends on the skills and performance of students. Most students opt for research internships in 3rd year for exploration, while many students also get paid online internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are very nice due to the cold environment here. Heaters are available in the classrooms. Smart boards are installed in each class, and medical facilities are very good, with a medical unit on campus. There is a big library that is open till 12 at night. Open-air campus Wi-Fi is also provided by the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is highly educated. Their teaching quality is decent. They teach using smart boards, and some teachers use PPTs with visual presentations. The course curriculum is relevant, with coding, computer-related, and networking subjects that provide practical knowledge. The exams are moderate and depend on the subjects.
detailed_review.Other: I got into this college through my selection in JEE Main. The college crowd is good. There are two main fests held every one or two years, namely Rang Chinar and Techvaganza, and other small events are held every month. Each festival is celebrated with the same enthusiasm, which is a plus point. Extracurricular activities are also organized, with huge participation from students.

reviews.review_title: My review of NIT(National Institute of Technology) Srinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: In my first semester, the subjects were computer programming, engineering drawing, engineering mathematics, English communication, Chemistry, etc. The highest package is nearly 40 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, steel companies, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities and infrastructure are relatively nice. There are pretty good Wi-Fi lab facilities, well-maintained classrooms, a library, and nice medical facilities for sports and games. There is scope for improvement that needs to be addressed. Overall, it is a good college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The papers are pretty hard and need to be rationalised. Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The curriculum is relevant to some degree but needs improvement. Exams are overall hard. The passing percentage is nearly 60 percent. Overall, I would recommend this college.
detailed_review.Other: I chose civil engineering as I am from J&K. There is scope for development and improvement in quality.

reviews.review_title: NIT Srinagar: Pros and cons.

detailed_review.Placements: There were close to 70-80 percent of students placed in our course. The highest package was around 23 LPA, and the average was around 10 LPA. Amazon, Infosys, Tata, and DPCL were the lead recruiters. Around 80 percent got internship offers both on campus and off campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi often doesn't work. Although classrooms are spacious. Labs have the required equipment most of the time. The library needs more space. The quality of food is above average. The rooms have 5 occupants each. However, this could change soon since a new hostel is being built.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and dedicated to teaching. However, the time allotted to complete the first semester is less than sufficient. Exams are difficult, varying from subject to subject. Although most of them are manageable. Most of the students pass in most subjects. Around 60-70 percent pass in every exam.
detailed_review.Other: Teachers are well-qualified and dedicated to teaching. However, the time allotted to complete the first semester is less than sufficient. Exams are difficult, varying from subject to subject. Although most of them are manageable. Most of the students pass in most subjects. Around 60-70 percent pass in every exam.

reviews.review_title: Some teachers are good, and some are not.

detailed_review.Placements: Among eligible students, 70 to 80% were placed, with an average package of 9 LPA, and the highest being 22 LPA in our branch. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Microsoft, GAIL, and BPCL. Roles offered include assistant engineer, junior engineer, and executive engineer. Some PSUs directly recruit in college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Excellent infrastructure, beautiful campus life, and sufficient labs and workshops for the mechanical department. In the hostel, there are 5-seater rooms, which are not good, and the mess food is average. Sometimes the hostel Wi-Fi is not working properly. In NIT Srinagar, the best branch is the mechanical department.
detailed_review.Faculty: In NIT Srinagar, most teachers are Ph.D. holders with good experience in teaching. I have no idea if the courses are relevant or not. In semester exams, some teachers make the exams tough and some easy. It totally depends on the teachers' mood. In NIT Srinagar, the passing marks are 41 out of 100.
detailed_review.Other: Mechanical engineering will be an evergreen branch with a good history at this college. Range Chinar is one of the famous cultural events.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Srinagar - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70 to 80% of students among the eligible candidates were placed this year. The highest package offered to our branch was about 24 LPA, with an average of 10.6 LPA and a median of about 9 LPA. Top recruiting firms were MMT, Tata Motors, Amazon, BPCL, Infosys, and GAIL. About 70 to 80% of students have received internships in total, including off-campus. Top roles offered were junior engineer, assistant engineer, and core sectors included design engineer, control engineer, power system engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is excellent, especially in the winter. The campus has all the necessary facilities required for students. Labs are sufficient and equipped with modern tools. The whole campus is Wi-Fi covered. Classrooms are digitalised, and the library is open from 6 AM to 12 AM. The hostel is okay. 5 students are accommodated in a room for the first year. The mess is okay, with differentiated timings for veg and non-veg, providing 4 meals a day.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is excellent here. Most of them are PhD holders, and their behaviour towards students is very generous. Their teaching quality is exceptional. The courses here are up to date and provide more opportunities for lab and practical work. Semester exams are okay, but marking is difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechanical Engineering because I'm interested in the field of mechanics. Moreover, the mechanical course in our institute is reputed as being among the best in the country. However, one thing that could be improved is the overall timing of the semesters. It could be increased to provide more time to completely understand and apply every single thing in the course.

reviews.review_title: Everything needs improvement.

detailed_review.Placements: While I have looked at various passouts of our course and talked to many seniors. The way they described college placements seemed very average. Some students get placed, but no one receives a very high package. I feel a person has to focus entirely on placements to get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are decent, but first-year classrooms are not good. The library has a very limited seating capacity. Wi-Fi is available but limited, with unnecessary website restrictions. The mess and canteen are poor. Sports and games are below average. There is not enough infrastructure for sports, with very few events and tournaments.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are somewhat helpful. Some are qualified and knowledgeable, while others are not. Overall teaching quality is decent. The course does not make students very industry-ready, though the curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are very difficult. Sometimes the marking is uneven or unnecessarily strict. The pass percentage varies by course and mostly depends on faculty. Some faculty members are good, but some subjects need to be studied independently to get decent marks in exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course because it seemed good, it is in my state, and it is in a good location. The campus is not very large. Infrastructure in classrooms and the library can be improved. More focus should be given to practical application, knowledge, and experience from the second semester. Help desks should be available for freshers. Scholarships are not very good, and events are outdated. New events should be introduced properly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Srinagar Metallurgy.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our course is approximately 85–90%. The highest package offered in our course is 24 LPA. The average package is around 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Vedanta, GMDC, SAIL, and Larsen & Toubro. Almost all students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are excellent. Wi-Fi and computer labs are available. A library is also present. Classrooms are modern. Hostel quality is very good. Mess and canteen food are good. Sports and games facilities are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is good. They teach us to think effectively. The course curriculum is relevant to the Production and Processing Industry. Semester exams are a little tough and depend on the students’ preparation.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: College of dreams for students who want to feel their student life.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students who got placed is around 70 percent. The highest package is 35 LPA, the minimum package is 9 LPA, and the average is around 11 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Nvidia, and many more chip-designing companies. The top MNCs of the nation gather during placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are obviously great, while the atmosphere of the campus feels like heaven, the view of the mountains is insane. Facilities are quite good. We can choose our mess timetable, the canteen feels okay, the ground is great, and our branch faculty is very supportive, as they are doing great in teaching.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. Teaching quality is perfect. It makes the students industry-ready while they complete 4 years of study. The difficulty level is at its top, with a pass percentage 80 percent. It is generally considered as a good college for its environment, placement, etc.
detailed_review.Other: Electronics and communication engineering is known as the evergreen course. Generally, people say that we can choose both software engineering and hardware in this course. Where they make mistakes, in the beginning itself, you should fix them for the ambition. Events are great, like range-e-chinar 2.0, etc., is conducted.

reviews.review_title: As NIT Srinagar is a Tier 3 college, then according to that, it is good.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024-25, the IT branch recorded 140.57% placement. And this is among the highest placements in all branches at NIT Srinagar. The highest package offered is Rs. 35.5 LPA, and the average and median are Rs. 10.4-11.6 LPA and Rs 8-10.6 LPA, respectively. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, IBM, Microsoft, Google, etc. The percentage of students securing internships is 70-98% and common companies are Google, Microsoft, Infosys, Samsung, Amazon and other reputed IT firms. Top internship roles are Software Engineer, Developer, Full-Sack Developer, and Data Scientist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The IT department is good in the area, not as big as other NITs have, because the campus of NIT Srinagar is not very big. Wi-fi speed is decent throughout the campus, but in the library, wi-fi is top-notch. Hostels are decent, not top-notch. Food quality is low to medium, medical facilities are good, and sports and games are also very good. NIT Srinagar have a good enough playground, a common hall for indoor sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. But not all the teachers are helpful, only some are. Teaching quality is decent enough. In the 1st year, many subjects were taught that are not needed for us to learn as IT students. I think the curriculum for 1st year is not that relevant. I think that the students should do hard work on their own to get industry-ready. Mid sem exams are not too difficult, not too easy, their difficulty level is decent. The passing percent is nearly 100% with only a few 4-5s getting back.
detailed_review.Other: I chose IT as my course because at this college, IT is one of the top-performing branches. I think for tech branches from the 1st year, they should only be taught those subjects that are necessary for their future. Recently, there was a fest Range-e-Chinar that was conducted in our college, which was good. There are a lot of extracurricular activities in college. And about scholarship, I don't think there is any scholarship for General Students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good faculty and nice sports facilities in this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is kind of average here, 50% students have been placed till now, the highest package was 20 LPA, the lowest was 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Oracle and Nvidia. Only a few students got internships from my course, and the companies were Microsoft, Oracle, etc. Top roles were front-end developed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available is okay. There is a LAN available in the hostel. Labs are under construction, and the library is small and is also under construction. The food quality of the mess is very poor, canteen food is okayish, the medical centre is good with good doctors, and sports and games are also good here.
detailed_review.Faculty: It's very easy to score in the semester exams in this college. The pass percentage is lower in my branch. The teachers are helpful and well-qualified. Teaching quality is also nice. The course curriculum is outdated and not relevant. It doesn't make students industry-ready; students have to study on their own to acquire skills.

reviews.review_title: The beauty of the Dal Lake and Kashmir.

detailed_review.Placements: 60 percent of IT students are placed every year, and placements are increasing year by year as new companies are approaching the campus. Companies like Google, Amazon, and Nvidia offer great packages to the students every year. Students should also struggle on their own.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in hostel as well as in the classrooms. Infrastructure of Labs and classrooms is quite good. Library is average it is small, it should be large so that more students are able to study in it. Quality of food in the hostel, as you know it is not so good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful for any work. Student should study on their own and practice for better results. Semester exams are not too tough that a 1st year student cannot do it. To pass the end term semester exams one has to get 40 marks out of 100.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT - Srinagar?
faqs.answer: For admission to a NIT Srinagar course, aspirants must meet the course-specific eligibility and selection criteria. Admission to all the offered courses is entrance-based. Hence, for admission in the NIT Srinagar BTech CSE course, aspirants need to have a valid score of JEE Main. Candidates who further meet the cutoff become eligible for participation in JoSAA counselling for seat allotment. In case seats are left vacant after the JoSAA counselling, then those are filled through CSAB counselling.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

highlights.summary:
University of Hyderabad is also known as Hyderabad University and UoH Hyderabad. It is a government university and was established in 1974. The university is recognised by the UGC and is a member of Association of Indian Universities (AIU). It has been accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade and has signed MoUs with several national and international universities to provide global exposure to students. Hyderabad University has been ranked in the range of 801-850 in the World University category by the QS World Rankings 2026.
The university has also ranked 26 and 74 in the Management and Engineering categories, respectively by NIRF Ranking 2025. UoH Hyderabad courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels, mainly in the field of Engineering, Business Management, Science, Computer Applications, etc. Some of the popular courses offered at the university are BTech, BSc, BA, MBA, MTech, MSc, etc. The university offers various courses to students, through its 12 schools of study such as School of Chemistry, School of Physics, School of Life Sciences, School of Economics, etc.
University of Hyderabad also offers distance education programmes to students, through its Centre for Distance and Visual Learning. In addition, the university has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with a total of 23 hostels that can accommodate over 5,000 male and female students. The university has three guest houses and one exclusively for participants of the Human Resource Development Centre. For more details, check the table below:

University of Hyderabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: The research scope is great here.

detailed_review.Placements: An optometrist role is offered at the initial average salary package that ranges from 4-5 LPA. Students generally get placed in hospitals. People do internships in a nearby hospital, which is linked to the university. Our university has 100% placements, and many of them opt to study abroad for better opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is top-notch, and we will get free Wi-Fi at every building with high-speed. Classrooms are also quite good with projectors. The library offers approximately 20,000 books 24x7. In hostels, rooms are average with good cleaning services. It also offers quite healthy and tasty food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are PhD holders from other countries. It has many subjects that made the semester quite hard for students, but somehow, students passed exams. Above 90% of students' exams. The course curriculum is relevant, and everything is taught that makes us fit for jobs.
detailed_review.Other: A fest named Sukoon is held every year.

reviews.review_title: My honest review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: We have a good placement cell on our campus. Every year, we use to invite them for the campus selection. We used to go for higher studies rather than going for a job, most of us are pursuing a Ph.D. now. Still, we have some opportunities to get a job. The list of companies includes Velammal Educational Institutions, DuPont, and some renowned IT companies. We can do an internship under a professor.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course is also vast, and the labs are so good. If anyone wants research, this is the best place to be. So, many labs and many research programs happen here. Seminars from international professors are also very frequent. Exams and labs make a hectic schedule. Exams are very frequent. There are 3 minor and 1 major happen for one subject, with lab exams. The hostel is so good here, and the infrastructure is also very good. Everything is good and clean. Each room has only 2 members, so not a problem at all. Playgrounds are available at hostels. The gym is also there for students, which is very nice. For every semester, the hostel fees are so feasible for everyone.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are highly qualified. Some teachers are good and some are average. They are interested only when you are interested. The faculty's recommendation is highly valuable to them. We can go anywhere in the world with their recommendation. Only some teachers teach passionately, and others focus more on the syllabus. They are very good teachers, which makes the subject very interesting. They very much help in research areas. There are good digital classrooms where I can easily understand, and I'm also interested in doing lab work. The organisation of the curriculum plays a critical role in helping students. This helps them transfer their learning to new situations.

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences
reviews.review_title: Overall, it is the best university for the M.Sc. in Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences course.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of students are successfully placed in our Hyderabad University. Our course has the highest package of 37 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3-7 LPA. Recruitment agencies include IMD, IIRS, MoES, and many others. Opportunities for internships are great, with more than 85% of students placed in good companies. The top roles offered are oceanographer, climate modeler, and more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has very fast internet and the best library compared to all the colleges in India. Indira Gandhi Library is one of the best libraries with a lot of books and papers. The hotel quality and facilities are excellent. There are some of the best medical emergency centers on campus, and we also have excellent sports and games facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: I personally feel that the professors are too qualified. They are well-known people in Communication with wonderful stories, which gives you the chance to expose yourself more and network with some well-known people. Teachers are very supportive and will do everything they can to help you grow. Semester exams are easy, and the pass rate is 90%.

reviews.review_title: I am fully satisfied with the course and dissatisfied with hostels.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage is 12% - 15%. The highest package is 14 LPA. The lowest package is 5 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Recruiting companies are Federal Bank and Synchrony. Internship percentage is 20%. Roles and companies are research assistant in IITs, research institutes, RBI, and NABARD. Roles offered are research and data analysis.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good in the classroom. Toilets are neat and clean. Facilities available for PWD students. Wi-Fi is available. We don't have a library but a reading room. Hostel facility is not good. Food is not good and insects can be found in the food. We have many canteens on our campus and they are subsidized as well. Medical facilities are available all the time. Sports facilities are also provided.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable also. Their teaching style is good. They provide the lecture slides also. Course curriculum is relevant to the industry needs. The course is rigorous. Semester exams are not very difficult. But one has to study a lot to score good marks. Pass percentage is 80 - 85%.
detailed_review.Other: Course will help me to prepare for CFA. The best thing about this course is its industry-specific. Fest is held once a year. It is a three day event. Scholarships are provided to few students on a merit basis.

reviews.review_title: Best affordable university with great amenities.

detailed_review.Placements: As far as I know, you will have a good placement percentage but don't expect a package like 20LPA. If you are well talented, you can surely get placements as many companies will come for placements. The eligibility criteria depend upon the company, and some companies have minimum CGPA but some consider an interview irrespective of your CGPA. As I am still in 2nd semester this much only I can provide information about this section.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is another thing I personally like about this university as everywhere can get ramps for disabled students. Well maintained hostels and different blocks for different branches are there. There is an open theatre for events and a beautiful auditorium for seminars. There will be 24/7 library. Wi-Fi facility is there everywhere. Hostels are also nice and spacious. The food is a bit average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is not like I don't like them but as they are from different parts of the country everybody has a different style of teaching and slang. For every student, it will be quite difficult to understand their language, especially if the teachers are from North East states. But the curriculum is very helpful for your future. The exams are bit difficult but if you study well you can score easily.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is one of the best things about this university. There will be many facilities and more greenery where you can feel fresh. Students can make friends all over the country which is one of the best things. You will get scholarship of approximately 1000 rupees for a month. For that, we have to reach certain points to get eligible. The points will be based on your previous semester CGPA and for first semester your 12 marks will be considered, other than this your income and your category points will be allocated. For semester, you will get approximately 4500 to 5000 based on your semester duration. I think everyone has to pay the same amount Rs 7500 in odd semester, and Rs 2500 in even semester. At the time of registration, you have to pay Rs 2500 for hostel and 1500 is refundable.

reviews.review_title: If you're planning to come here for studying M.A. Economics, please don't.

detailed_review.Placements: There are around 130 students in the M.A. Economics and Financial Economics, and hardly 25 students get any placement. The recruiters are mostly small companies, and the average package is very low. The placement cell is nothing more than an independent students' organisation. Basically, you shouldn't consider this university if you want placement. The same with the internships too, you have to find on your own.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Infrastructure is very poorly planned and designed. Apart from old and depressing architecture, the locations of different buildings are also not well thought out. Some of the hostels are in the north campus and some are in the south, which are 3-4 km apart. Some departments are in the middle, some are in the east campus (3 km from the north campus), and some are in the south. There aren't enough buses to carry all the students to their respective classes. But, the library is in the middle, somewhat nearer to everyone and it's open 24*7.
detailed_review.Faculty: I must say, for such a highly rated university with a tag of "Institute of Eminence" (which they like to boast about all the time), the professors are pretty mediocre. You'd be lucky if you find one or two good ones. The curriculum is very hectic, especially for Economics students. The exams are also very frequent, you won't get any time to explore what interests you or prepare for a competitive exam. The difficulty level of exams varies, but mostly it's medium.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied as they are very affordable, large campus area, and have a lot of greenery.

detailed_review.Placements: Actually in IMA history, there are almost no placements but available in other social science courses like IMA economics. Last year a student got a placement of 19 LPA in IMA economics. But I haven't heard of someone who got placements in history. In Hyderabad, most of the IT companies came, and also many students got placements in the government as economists.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure is up to the mark especially in south campus whereas it is not as much good in north as they all are so old. South campus hostels are well-equipped with geyser, RO, water cooler, and Wi-Fi both LAN and outer near to rooms. We need not worry about the classrooms as they are best in infrastructure wise with the modern equipment. Labs are also well maintained. Hostels need a little bit of maintenance but academic buildings are well maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. They are also very kind and helpful. We need not worry about them and also the curriculum is good. But we find some obstacles as we get irritated by seeing some courses from different streams. If we are from science then we also have to study social science subjects. But at last, we will enjoy it. Here we hardly will be able to focus on our studies as there are lots of distractions. Exams are good and we will not be able to cheat them also get recourse if found so be careful.
detailed_review.Other: Actually I want to prepare for civil services and this university gives admission based on general tests so science students can easily get admission if they want to change course. We are really going to enjoy the campus as it is more than 3,000 acres of land, full of flora and fauna and different lakes and wildlife. Also, there are so many diversity which leads to many cultural festivals like Sukoon, Milaap, etc.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science
reviews.review_title: It has good infrastructure and facilities. Everyone is friendly.

detailed_review.Placements: Actually, I am not sure about placements as this is my first year. But I know that the highest salary package offered is 44 LPA. Many internships are provided with a good salary. The campus is great and it is ranked among the top 10 by NIRF. Nature and the environment are very good. We have a lot of peace here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a big library where many books are available. We have playgrounds, a gym, and yoga. Many tournaments are held here.
