admission.title: University of Hyderabad Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
University of Hyderabad admission to all the courses is based on the entrance exam. Hyderabad University, also known as the Central University of Hyderabad , presently offers PG, integrated and doctorate courses in the stream of Science, Management, Engineering and Law across its constituent schools or departments. All the PG and doctorate courses at the University campus are offered under its 12 schools and 41 departments. On the other hand, integrated MA and MSc programmes are offered via the College of Integrated Studies.

The University conducts an entrance exam for admission to MSc , MA, MPA, MFA, MPH, Executive MBA, MBA and PhD programmes. However, it also accepts several national-level entrance exams for MTech, MBA and PhD admissions. In addition to this, this University also offers distance learning courses through its Centre for Distance and Virtual Learning.

The University of Hyderabad (UoH) admissions to the five-year integrated UG+PG programs is based on the Common University Entrance Test (CUET) (UG) where one must take the test and subsequently apply to the university counselling portal. In B.Tech and B.Pharma degrees, applications are likely to be made on the basis of the Telangana State Engineering Agriculture Medical Common Entrance Test (TS EAMCET), the application process typically starts in February. The other courses might have other entrance tests or even a merit-based process, and thus, to have a clear direction, it is important to cross-check the related UoH prospectus and admission notifications.

The general admission procedure of UG programmes (Integrated Courses): Appear in CUET (UG): The candidate has to take the Common University Entrance Test (UG) in order to qualify to attend integrated UG+PG programs. Apply at UoH Counselling: Once the CUET result is announced, apply at the University of Hyderabad’s counselling portal . Participate in Counselling: This is the procedure that assists in ensuring one secures a seat in the integrated UG+PG programs. Confirm Admission: Pay the admission fee to book your seat. Students may opt to take an undergraduate degree program in any of the three following streams:

In the case of Engineering Programs (B.Tech and B.Pharma): Take TS EAMCET: B.Tech and B.Pharma programs are anticipated to be subject to the examination of TS EAMCET . Register TS EAMCET: TS EAMCET registration usually starts in February .

faqs.question: What is the procedure for admission to Engineering courses at University of Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: There are no B.Tech programmes available through the University of Hyderabad. It does, however, provide admission to a five-year Integrated M.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, provided that applicants complete the necessary requirements and obtain a passing score in the JEE Main exam. With effect from the academic year 2014-2015, the School of Computer and Information Sciences at UoH launched this five-year Integrated M.Tech degree. After five years, students receive an M.Tech degree; however, there is no way out before that point.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Can I get admission in Hyderabad University for MCA on the basis of TSICET entrance exam score?
faqs.answer: No, you can get admission in the University of Hyderabad for MCA on the basis of your scores obtained in NIMCET (National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test) only. NIMCET scores, in order of merit, will be the basis for admission which is done by the counselling at the University of Hyderabad. Interested candidates need to apply to the University of Hyderabad and separately need to provide their NIMCET scores in the application form.

faqs.question: What happens if I have low attendance in class at University of Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Students must attend 75% of classes held in all courses at the University of Hyderabad. Hence, low attendance can affect their chances of appearing in the semester-end exams. Ever student is bound to follow this and there will be exceptions given for only a few students belonging to special cases.

faqs.question: Is University of Hyderabad entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: The Hyderabad University entrance exam is moderately tough as it requires examination of both subject matter and analytical skills. The level of competition varies on the basis of the number of applicants versus the seats available in a programme. Since most courses today admit students based on CUET, strategies for preparation must be in accordance with that pattern of the exam. Students can cope with the level of difficulty with regular study and practice.

faqs.question: Can I join MBA without entrance in Hyderabad University?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission must at least have completed a three-year bachelor’s degree with first class (or its equivalent with 60% aggregate) in any discipline recognised by UGC/ Association of Indian Universities/ AICTE on or before June of the year of admission. Those completing their final examinations by June can also apply. Additionally, candidates must also have a valid score in CAT exam conducted by the IIMs. IIMs, however, play no role in the selection criteria of UoH for MBA. Online application form has to be submitted online and after filling the online application form, candidates must pay the application fee immediately using the online payment gateway link provided on the form. A list with the names of the short listed candidates is posted on the official website as per the given schedule and none of the shortlisted individuals are sent any communication in this regard.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in University of Hyderabad for MBA?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission must at least have completed a three-year bachelor’s degree with first class (or its equivalent with 60% aggregate) in any discipline recognised by UGC/ Association of Indian Universities/ AICTE on or before June of the year of admission. Those completing their final examinations by June can also apply. Additionally, candidates must also have a valid score in CAT exam conducted by the IIMs. IIMs, however, play no role in the selection criteria of UoH for MBA. Online application form has to be submitted online and after filling the online application form, candidates must pay the application fee immediately using the online payment gateway link provided on the form. faqs.question: What MBA specialisations are offered at University of Hyderabad?

These are curricula that focus on delivering special knowledge as well as core management skills. The course is to equip the student with leadership positions across industries.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The University of Hyderabad (UoH) has a 2300‑acre campus in Gachibowli, Hyderabad, with lush forests, serene lakes, and wildlife, and world‑class academic and residential facilities. The infrastructure comprises state‑of‑the‑art lecture hall complexes, fully equipped labs across disciplines, and the Indira Gandhi Memorial Library—India’s first fully automated university library- housing over four lakh physical volumes alongside extensive digital collections. With modern facilities that include multiple auditoria, seminar halls, cafes, an ATM and post office services, guesthouses, and a robust campus‑wide Wi‑Fi and IT backbone, UoH is designed to foster academic excellence, research innovation, and vibrant campus life.

sections.heading: University of Hyderabad Academic and Research Facilities
text: The University of Hyderabad is exceptionally well-equipped with academic and research facilities, featuring a comprehensive ecosystem of specialised facilities and interdisciplinary centres. At its core, the Central Instruments Laboratory offers high-end tools such as scanning electron microscopy, confocal microscopy, X-ray diffraction, ESR spectrometry, and protein sequencing equipment. The Centre for Nanotechnology supports micro/nano fabrication, advanced spectrometers, TEM, SQUID magnetometers, and nano-biomedical device development.

For life sciences, UoH’s School of Life Sciences houses BSL‑3 containment labs, animal and greenhouse facilities, genomics, proteomics, metabolomics platforms, flow cytometry, confocal imaging, and in vivo imaging . Overarching these setups is the Research & Development Centre, which manages funding, grants, patents, consultancy, and extensive national/international collaborations

sections.heading: University of Hyderabad Library
text: Indira Gandhi Memorial Library is one of the major facilities being offered at the university. The library has all the resources for students related to the Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Management, Sciences and Engineering. The total area of the library is 57000 Sft, with a total seating capacity of 400. The library also has 30 Individual Reading Carrels. There is a 2000 square foot lounge for browsing and relaxed reading. The library also has a separate air-conditioned annexe building with 2 reading halls on 2 floors with 200+ seating capacity, which is kept open round the clock (365 days, 24 hrs).

The library has taken visible measures to make use of the ICT advancements for improving library services. The library has a 1 GB national knowledge network for accessing online databases. There is a wifi connection with 11 instruments.

sections.heading: University of Hyderabad Sports Facilities
text: The University of Hyderabad (UoH) offers a comprehensive sports infrastructure designed to cater to diverse athletic interests and promote holistic wellness. Its main sports complex features a full-size cricket pavilion, a 400 m running track, an open Karate dojo, a volleyball court, and an indoor stadium equipped with four LED-lit Yonex badminton courts, a 4,000 sq ft fitness centre, and a multi-purpose indoor hall for table tennis, carrom, and chess. facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
University Library has rich collection of 4.53 lakh books, e-journals, e-books, reference books, serials, theses & dissertations, back volumes of journals, maps etc. The Library has a separate book bank for SC/ST students and 2500 braille books for visually challenged students. Apart from this, the Library has
received 642 books as gift from various sources worth approximately Rs.3.4 lakhs. The Library had renewed subscriptions to 230 plus print journals and 48 plus databases covering more than 40,000 e-journals.
The Library is also a member of Universal digital project of Carnegie-Melon University, Pittsburg, USA(Million books to the Web). Under this project, a scanning center was established in the Library to digitize rare books. The Library has signed MoU with UGC-INFLIBNET Centre, Ahmedabad, to digitize and upload full text Ph.D. theses submitted to University of Hyderabad.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description:
There are altogether 21 hostels on the University campus, of which 13 hostels are for men and 8 are for women. Foreign students, unless they opt not to, are accommodated at the Tagore International House.

The University also provides reservation of the total number of seats in the hostels, 22.5% are reserved for candidates belonging to SC/ST and 3% for physically challenged students.

detailed_review.Placements: Presently, I am in my second year, so I am not yet placed, but when I started my second year, our HOD informed us that almost 50 to 70 students who were entering for the year were placed, and they had good starting packages. The highest package went up to 40 LPA during that time.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not as great as that of the newly built college, as MSRIT has been around for many years, but the labs are well maintained. The classrooms are neat and clean. But as the rumour says, the campus is under construction every time, and some classrooms need maintenance.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty in our branch is helpful and supportive. They encourage us to participate in various events taking place around the college campus, but some of them are less encouraging, and they also avoid the announcements of events during class hours.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: MSRIT-College is innovative and makes you industry-ready.

detailed_review.Placements: Top roles are AI and ML engineer, and 80 percent are placed by the end of the placement season. The highest package is more than 50 LPA, and many students got an internship. Top recruitment companies include Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle and many other companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure and hostel facilities. Decent mess food and timely preparation if asked, and the canteen is also good, all kinds of snacks are available. Good place to hang out during break. Wi-Fi is good in the hostel and college, too and good connectivity in labs and working labs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty and curriculum are good according to what the course is about, but some subjects are not. Well, the exams are according to what is taught, and you can ace them if you study properly, and you have to learn yourself for being industry-ready and not everything is done by the course.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has good placements and a nice infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: 75-80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 60 LPA. The average package ranges from 10-12 LPA. In my cybersecurity branch, the average package offered is 14 LPA, as it has less intake. The major companies are JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley, Hewlett Packard, and Oracle.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available here. The speed is not good across the campus, but good in labs. There are a lot of labs and libraries with a lot of systems and proper internet in that area. There are at least 60-70 systems in labs. Digital libraries are also there. Sports ground and facilities are also there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is good. Semester exams are at a good level. The college does everything to make us industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it's unique and always relevant to CSE cybersecurity. It is the best option I have in Bangalore city. It has numerous coding and AI-related clubs. It also has a lot of personality development clubs.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, a good experience.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements in the college are just above average. Around 10 LPA for CSE and about 7 LPA-8 LPA for other branches packages are offered, though the placement percentage is around 95 percent for CSE and 80 percent around for other branches. Major students got internships here. Around 90 percent of students got internships in companies like Samsung, De Shaw, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is a bit old compared to BMSCE and other colleges. Although the labs are fine, but the classrooms, etc., are a bit old and there are no digital classrooms. The Wi-Fi is provided to every student, but the speed is very low. The sports facilities are also a bit average. The mess and canteen are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in colleges is good. Talking about the 1st year, they are helpful. Also, they take doubts in Hindi if someone does not understand. They provide you with material to ace exams. The semester exams are at a pretty good level. The pass percentage is around 85 percent, and the maximum is good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I had an interest in CSE, got cybersecurity as per my rank and cutoff of COMEDK.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the teaching of the college, as it's average to good.

detailed_review.Placements: Core companies like Texas Instruments, Samsung Semiconductor, Schneider, and many more have come for placements, and they are regular as far as I know. According to placement data, 80-85 were placed in 2025, and the process is still going on. Roles like embedded systems engineer and VLSI roles are also offered by some companies. But CSE-related companies are more here, and most of the ECE students who get placements get them in IT roles. Apart from that, the clubs here are in abundance and active, too, as far as I know.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but it feels like more school than college. Labs are well-maintained. College is hygienic and clean. Modern labs are also there. Hostels are mid, it's affordable too, it mainly depends on the money you can get, an Rs. 80,000 hostel or a 1.3 lacs hostel. The facilities are different, with an overall average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Curriculum is good and up-to-date and relevant. Teachers are good. Some are good, and some are average, like in every other college. Exams have average to high-level of difficulty, but you will be able to pass. The percentage is approximatly 80% for a class, but most students pass the exam.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Placements and faculty are good, but few extracurricular activities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95 percent of students get placed here in companies with average CTC of 9LPA. MSRIT has strong placements with many top companies visiting the campus. Students receive good training in aptitude and interviews. CSE, ISE, and ECE SEE high packages, while other branches also get solid opportunities. Overall, placement support is reliable.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: MSRIT offers a well maintained campus with modern classrooms, advanced labs, and strong Wi-Fi coverage. The library is spacious and resource rich. Sports facilities and common areas are clean and organized, creating a productive academic environment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at MSRIT is knowledgeable and approachable with many professors having strong industry and research backgrounds. They explain concepts clearly and support students through projects and doubt sessions ensuring solid academic guidance and mentorship.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: Good placements in 2025, decent faculty for the first year, and a decent college.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, the highest package is 60 LPA, which is good. The average is around 14–15 LPA for Cyber. There are many chances to secure an internship, as the college is near the Silicon Valley of India, Bangalore. On-campus opportunities are also good. Top recruiting companies are Morgan Stanley, Amazon, Google, Swiggy, and PhonePe.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The average infrastructure is not very modern, but it is okay. Wi-Fi is mediocre. Hostel quality varies based on the course fees. The luxury one, which is 1.3 LPA, is much better compared to the Rs. 80,000 per year one. Food is good. There are multiple sports clubs you can join. Labs are okay, and classrooms are like coaching ones, which is the only downside.
detailed_review.Faculty: I have not given the first semester exam yet, so I don’t know when I will give it. I will share later, but I heard it is moderate to difficult for first-year students. The course curriculum is good and relevant. Teachers are helpful. Some teachers are very good, but some are average, like in every other college. Faculty is helpful.
detailed_review.Other: I hope they provide merit scholarships.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with placement, facilities, and teaching.

detailed_review.Placements: Highest package offered in my Computer Science (cybersecurity) course recently has been 38 LPA in the 4th year. Top recruiting companies include renowned companies like Accenture, Swiggy, etc. The top roles offered in my course are as a cybersecurity analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As for course and classrooms, the facilities provided are excellent. They have a working Wi-Fi all over the campus, free for students, and a very wide range of study materials available in the library, along with the facility to read silently during exams. As for the hostel, the quality of mess is not that good. Also, the fixes needed with the hostel infrastructure can be ignored or done a whole while later, which makes living really difficult. Canteen outside the hostel, i.e, inside the college, is good. Other facilities are good too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in MSRIT are knowledgeable and helpful. They are ready to reach outside classroom and teach you about more application-based topics. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are not hard if you study well throughout the year. The pass percentage is around 80% as of this year.
detailed_review.Other: Well, the college doesn't have any huge fests other than tech fests, which also don't even seem like fests in the first place. The only big fest is the Udhbhav fest, and it's not very engaging like other fests seen in other colleges. One thing, if you had to give up when you enter MSRIT, is to give up on the idea of having fun. Because you won't have proper fests, and even during fests, sometimes classes will be taking place. So, it's not really recommended in that aspect. But otherwise, placement, studies, and facilities are all good.

reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
reviews.review_title: The infrastructure and campus life are really good.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 90% of students get placed in 2025. The highest package is 58.3 LPA, the average package is 18 LPA, and the lowest package is 10 LPA. The highest package is increasing year by year. The college provides placement training and has a separate placement cell. Top companies like HP, JP Morgan, Dell, Microsoft, and Amazon visit for on-campus placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped. The library is informative and includes a digital library. Hostel, mess, and canteen facilities are clean and good. Lab instructors and faculty members are supportive. Medical facilities are available, along with a gym, sports, and game areas.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant to the industry. The passing percentage is above 90%. Assignments are project-oriented. Evaluation is based on the project and presentation skills, which help to overcome stage fear. More importance is given to practical experience.
detailed_review.Other: AI is a trending and valuable course for the future.

reviews.review_title: Review about RIT and college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has good placements for undergraduate and postgraduate courses. For B.Tech and M.Tech students who are pass out this year, i.e., 2025. The highest placement is 48 LPA. There is one abroad placement from Dubai with a salary of Rs.5,000 AED per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college is a well-reputed one in all of Karnataka. It has good infrastructure with well-maintained canteens and dedicated labs for each department. The computers are also high-end, so the systems do not hang or slow down with the software we run. The library is well-equipped with all books, and each student has dedicated Wi-Fi access.
detailed_review.Faculty: As our college is autonomous, most of our exams happen on our campus itself. The question paper is set by every student's level of understanding of the subject. Our college has a strict rule of maintaining 85% attendance for the entire semester to be eligible to write internals and semester exams.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average placement as well as college life.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package this year's placement drive reached around 58 LPA, awarded to a CS AIML student. The average package is about 8-9 LPA. Nearly 80-85 percent of students securing placements. Top recruiting companies include Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Adobe, Deloitte, JP Morgan, Nvidia, Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Bosch, and Qualcomm.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library facilities are very good. There are a total of 3-4 libraries, with a seating capacity of 250-300 and above, not less than that. Wi-Fi is provided by the college. Labs are good, but don't think the same about the lab teachers. The hostel available on the campus is not sufficient; only 30 percent of the students will get the hostel inside the campus, but hostels are available in the locality. However, the food served is too bad. You won't be able to consume the mess food regularly.
detailed_review.Faculty: I am currently in my second semester. The internal exams are not very difficult; you can prepare easily by studying 4-5 days before the exams and 10-12 days before the semester ends. The teachers are somewhat okay, depending on which one you get—some are very helpful.
detailed_review.Other: There are three main festivals on campus: Kannada Rajyotsava, Teach Fest, and Udbhav. Generally, Udbhav is good, but most of the performers are Kannada.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: This college is amazing because I am getting placed in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: I am stream electronics at this college. In our course, placements are very well. Total 600 students in this course have been placed, and get placements 380 members. I also get a placement job in a hardware company. In placements top company is BYD Electronics Chennai hub. All joined internships in 3-2 semesters via online or offline. I joined an online internship Hirist tech company in an online 6-month course join in python programming language.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is good. I have stayed hostel for 2 years, which is good. Wi-Fi, library, and sports are available. Study hours are also available. The food is of very high quality, and I have never seen it taste and quality. Every day have study hours in the evening. Hostel food is super.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers knowledge is amazing. All are good and knowledgeable, of course knowledge and teaching skills are good. Teachers teaching is as per the curriculum. Also available in digital classrooms, and teachers are also good in my course. Semester exams are conducted very strictly and in the hostel, students are available for study hours in the evening.
detailed_review.Other: My course is electronics and communication engineering. This is used with future jobs like embedded systems and VISI is also used in software development side and hardware testing side that's why I am choosing my career with the ECE department. This college also conducts events, fests, and cultural activities. This is an amazing place.

reviews.review_title: Genuine reaction about studying MCA in MSRIT.

detailed_review.Placements: MSRIT has a total of 120 students per year for MCA, and MCA is for two years. From my seniors, who are currently passing out in 2025, only 30-40% of students get placed. A majority of them are placed in low tired companies and the remaining are waiting for placements. Some of my seniors have got internships and PPOs of 9 LPA in Fedility, Bangalore. The highest package is 17 LPA for my seniors, and the lowest package is unknown to us. A majority of roles offered are SDE and analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a great infrastructure in MSRIT for students. The college provides supervised Wi-Fi access to students with a maximum of 2 devices per student. We also have a great library and also have access to a digital archive of those books. The library has all the prescribed books covered in our syllabus. I don't know much about hostel facilities as I stay outside the college hostel. I do have a rough idea about the price of the college hostel. It costs approximately 1 lakh per academic year. Hostel rooms are not so great, but the food is great.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum of MCA is very cleverly designed and impacts a lot on students as it gives exposure to the latest technology available in the industry. Some teaching staff members do not possess the sufficient amount of knowledge required to teach students. I expect, at least next year, RIT hire good staff members.

reviews.review_title: The campus has many blocks making to recognised to identify which department is there to access.

detailed_review.Placements: I have seen that our college placements are based on skills. Many companies visit the college. Students between 25-40 get placed. I am a student of the civil engineering department and I got placed with a package of 17 LPA which was the highest package offered by Amazon. I do not have any knowledge of the lowest package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All lab equipment is available with the latest tech. It provides 10 GB of data every day. The hostel is the worst, but we can stay outside. The college charges students if they break equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: In the civil engineering department, most of the faculty are PhD holders, which gives them more knowledge to transfers or to gain more from them. While giving marks, they are too poor to provide and they would reduce most of the time instead. They would pass if we had 2 or 3 marks less also to push. They provide leadership qualities.
detailed_review.Other: A minimum of 20 to 30 events are organised in a year.

reviews.review_title: About MSRIT you need to know before joining.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed every year. The highest package offered is 52 LPA. Google, Microsoft, and construction companies visit colleges every year. Around 80% of students get internships every year. The lowest package offered is around 6 LPA. The average package offered is around 10 LPA - 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is quiet and silent all the time. Wi-Fi is installed in every corner of the college. The library is good and completely quiet. It is highly equipped with all the books and stuff. The hostel food is good and completely veg. There is good scope for sports and extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors are friendly and supportive with high level of teaching experience. Semester exams are quite hard but everyone can pass it with minimum amount of study. The pass percentage of college is around 80%. The attendance maintained in college is 75%.
detailed_review.Other:
I wanted to become a civil engineer since my childhood and it's my dream 
practical-based education can be improved in our college.

reviews.review_title: The college is worth it if you are interested.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of people who got placed at MSRIT in 2023 was 183 offers from CSE students. The highest package was 50 LPA in 2023. The average package was 7.66 LPA in 2023. Top recruiting companies are Adobe, Google, and JP Morgan. Every branch got internship opportunities. The top role is a developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good compared to other colleges. They have Wi-Fi, labs, and clean classrooms. Facilities in the hostel are good. The hostel is clean and decent. They have medical facilities. We have sports grounds and both indoor and outdoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: At MSRIT, CSE and civil teachers are highly qualified. They are supportive. The curriculum is industry-focused, covering AI, ML, and cyber security, ensuring job readiness. Exams are challenging but manageable, with a high passing rate.
detailed_review.Other: There are no fests here.

reviews.review_title: Bachelor of Architecture at MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore.

detailed_review.Placements: The college has a 96% placement rate. The average package is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Infosys, Birla, and many more. Internships are provided to some of the students who hold a good academic record. Top roles provided are of a college representative.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire college is Wi-Fi enabled. Labs have all the equipment for any practical workshop. Classrooms are big in size, with cameras and projectors for digital presentations. The college library is huge, with more than 5,000 books for each course. Hostel food is consumable, the canteen has around 5 different shops. Medical facilities are not available. Sports are very active as we participate in inter-college sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly educated and qualified. They have experience in their respective fields. In architecture, the course curriculum is good, as we get to go to site visits often, and is dependent on more practical knowledge. Semester-end exams are quite difficult, but teachers are available for help. A minimum of 50% is required to pass.
detailed_review.Other: The architecture is good here, as it is in the 30 best colleges in India. Events like Udbhav, inter-branch competitions, cultural events, and clubs are organized often.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely good college.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college, aerospace engineering opened for the first time in [2024], so our is the first batch. The average package is 6 LPA, and the highest is 18 LPA as our lecturer said. Students are not yet placed and didn't get any internships for this course because I have mentioned earlier that it is the first batch. So, we will get to know how the internships and placements after we go to that place.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am not a hosteler, I am a day scholar so I don't know about the hostel facilities. In our college, Wi-Fi facility is very much good. We can use 11GB per day free for one year. We have to the chemistry lab, computer-aided engineering drawing lab, and computer lab up to today because we are still in 1st semester. We haven't seen the workshops or aerospace labs, they will show us after the 1st semester. Classrooms and library facilities are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. All are Ph.D. qualified teachers and they have good knowledge and experience. Curriculum is relevant to the students and makes students industry-ready. Exams are not that difficult. If we gain depth and concentrate on the studies, it will be easy. Pass percentage is 40%.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college in Bengaluru which is at the center of the town and also the faculty is good.

detailed_review.Placements: I joined this through a Diploma CET. The ranking should be below 1000 for diploma lateral entry students. The average package for civil engineers is 5 LPA. The campus recruitment is also there. Top companies like Sobha Construction,  L&T, etc., also come to recruitment.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is near the college and within the campus. Wi-Fi is also provided. The library is good. Cultural activities are there. They give a preference for sports and games. The quality of the mess is good. It is a veg mess. For washing clothes, the washing machines are provided.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have highly qualified lecturers with Dr. degrees. The industrial visit is also there. For civil engineers, the course provides survey camps for 1 week. The minimum passing mark is 22 for 50 in total for the internal test. The faculty is well-educated.
detailed_review.Other: The extra scholarship is provided to students by Ramaiah Institute.

reviews.review_title: I had so much fun till now.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements have been started recently from 2023. Students are getting good money in internships themselves. Most students are working in NASA (Architecture Association of Students) and out of the country getting better salaries than expected. But it's bad luck for CET students because they have topped CET students to enter college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is soo good most of the events happened in my first year. And about student encouragement towards sports activities, workshops, events, club activities is sooo good compared to other colleges in Bengaluru. I wish is happens every year same as now. Hostel fee depends on what we choose. Infrastructure is so good. Hostel fee depends on what we choose.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are conducted strictly and they have rules that every student follows such as strict attendance of 85%. And about faculty members, they are so good at teaching. They are skilled people working out for students they help in all things for students.
detailed_review.Other: Most of the events happened in my first year. Student encouragement towards sports activities, workshops, events, and club activities is so good compared to other colleges in Bengaluru. I wish it happened every year, the same as now.

admission.overview_text:
Ramaiah Institute of Technology admissions 2026 are entrance-based mainly. The institute is also known as MSRIT offers programmes at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in the fields of Technology and Architecture . Students seeking admission to Ramaiah Institute of Technology must fulfill the admission criteria to be eligible for applying to the desired course. Students can read the following article to know detailed information about the admission procedure of the institute.

Download MSRIT Brochure

faqs.question: Does Ramaiah have direct admission to the MCA course?
faqs.answer: Ramaiah Institute of Technology MCA admission is entirely based on the entrance exam. Candidates willing to apply to the MCA course, must qualify in any one of the entrance exam KMAT or PGCET. Further, candidates must participate in the counselling process for seat allocations. Therefore, direct admission to the MCA course is not possible at Ramaiah Institute of Technology.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for B.Arch at MSRIT?
faqs.answer: MSRIT B.Arch fees are INR 4.8 lakh. MSRIT fees may include other components such as tuition fee, hostel fee, medical insurance, mess and other security deposits, etc. It must be noted that the mentioned fee has been sourced from the official website of the institute/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for MBA at MSRIT?
faqs.answer: Ramaiah Institute of Technology MBA tuition fee is INR 6 lakh for two years. The MSRIT MBA fee structure may include components other than the tuition fee. These components are hostel fees, medical insurance, mess and other security deposits, etc. Further, the tuition fee differs for the Karnataka and Non-Karnataka candidates. The mentioned fee has been sourced from the official website of the institute/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the total fee of the M.Tech programme at Ramaiah Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: The total fee of the four-year M.Tech programme offered at Ramaiah Institute of Technology is INR 2L - INR 2.2 lakh .

faqs.question: How much does BTech at MSRIT Bangalore cost?
faqs.answer: MSRIT Bangalore offers a four-year Bachelor of Engineering (BE). The MSRIT BE fee structure includes various components, such as tuition fees, hostel fees, medical insurance, mess and other security deposits, etc. Further, the tuition fee differs for the Karnataka and non-Karnataka candidates. MSRIT BE tuition fee ranges between INR 2.6 and INR 10.5 lakh . The fee is based on official website of the institute/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the last date to fill KCET application form?
faqs.answer: Last date to apply is February 17, 2026 and candidates can fill out the KCET application form at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in MSRIT?
faqs.answer: At the undergraduate level, MSRIT offers four-year BTech and five-year MTech , to students. BTech is provided in 12 pecialisations such as Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and others. At the postgraduate level, the college offers MBA , MCA, MTech , and other courses to students. The accepted entrance exams are COMEDK UGET , KCET, and others. Students must clear the entrance exams for successful admissions.

faqs.question: How to get seat in Ramaiah Institute of Technology BTech?
faqs.answer: Ramaiah Institute of Technology offers a full-time Bachelor of Engineering (BE) in various streams. To get seat in Ramaiah Institute of Technology BE course, students need to fulfill the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. The next step is to qualify for the state-level entrance exams, such as KCET/ COMED UGET with a valid score. The selected candidates are given seats based on the respective counselling session.

faqs.question: Can I take admission in MSRIT MBA without KMAT?
faqs.answer: MSRIT MBA admission is based on the candidate's scores in the accepted entrance exams. KMAT is one of the accepted entrance exams for MBA admission at the institute. However, candidates who have not appeared for KMAT can still apply for MBA at MSRIT, provided they have a valid score in CMAT/ PGCET/ MAT. Appearing for any one of these exams is mandatory.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to Ramaiah Institute of Technology MBA course?
faqs.answer: Ramaiah Institute of Technology's MBA programme requires applicants to have a bachelor's degree with a minimum cumulative GPA of 50%. In order to be eligible for the program, SC/ST and Category-1 students from Karnataka must have a 45% overall average.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MBA course at Ramaiah Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Ramaiah Institute of Technology eligibility criteria are a condition to apply for admission. Graduated with a minimum of 50% (45% for the reserved category) from a recognised university are eligible.

faqs.question: How to register for COMEDK Counselling?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to BTech course through COMEDK 2024 scores must follow the below-mentioned steps to register for COMEDK Counselling 2024: Step 1 : Visit the official website of COMEDK at comedk.org. Step 2 : Login to Applicant Login ID using the application number and password. Step 3 :  On the next page, click on the 'Counselling Registration' Tab Step 4 : Verify the mentioned details and pay the registration fee to participate in COMEDK Counselling 2023 Step 5 : On the successful payment message, close the tab and go back to your application form. Step 6 : Click on the ‘Document Upload' Tab and upload all the required documents. Step 7 : Frequently check the application form and email to keep a track of the verification status of uploaded document.

highlights.summary:
Christ Kengari Campus is a constituent of Christ deemed-to-be University which is referred to as the School of Engineering across all Christ campuses. Situated about 25 kilometers away from the central Bangalore campus, the Kengeri campus of Christ has two schools under it, namely School of Engineering & Technology and School of Architecture that offers UG, PG and doctoral programmes, such as BTech, BArch, MTech and PhD. Accredited with Grade ‘A’ by NAAC, the main campus of Christ University is also located in Bangalore (Hosur) along with Bannerghatta and Kengari campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: This university is best in Bangalore.

detailed_review.Placements: Christ University is situated in Bangalore and offers high placement opportunities for the students. The highest package of this college is 50 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Companies like HCL and TCS visit this college every year for placements. At least 60% is required for placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this course is very good for the students. This university offers many opportunities like all-time Wi-Fi facilities for the students and faculty, and the classrooms of this college are fully air-conditioned. This college has a big library for the students. The hostel of this college is very big for the students, and the food in both the canteen and mess hall is very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of this university is very supportive of the students. They teach in a very good manner. The course provided by this university is relevant for the students, and in one semester, it makes the students industry-ready. There are many exams organized in this university for the students so they perform well in their sessional examinations.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests and events organized in this university. This university also provides scholarships for the students.

reviews.review_title: Best college life that I have seen.

detailed_review.Placements: In my experience with B.Sc. Psychology at Christ. Around 40 to 50% of my classmates opted for placements, and the average package offered is about 4 to 5 LPA, with the highest reaching 6 to 7 LPA for a few roles related to HR, market research, and sales. Psychology graduates are often encouraged to pursue a master's degree for better career prospects. Major recruiters included consulting firms, startups, and organizations looking for HR interns or research assistants. Many students completed internships in organizations like NGOs, mental health startups, hospitals, and corporate HR departments as part of the curriculum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure available is very useful. We have neuroanatomy labs where we cut the brain of a rat and try to understand the functions of the brain. The hostels and food available are also really good. The medical room is present in the 3rd block, which is in the middle of the entire campus. Sports and games we have two huge football grounds, two basketball courts, and various other places.
detailed_review.Faculty: Psychology, at least the faculty is very knowledgeable. The course curriculum makes sure that you have knowledge about everything in your field, which makes you the most eligible while sitting for placements. The semester exams are hard, they come at the right times however, you learn to have a life and work balance where you make sure you score good but also participate in extracurricular activities. Passing marks are 40%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because you finally get to do a B.Sc. even though you have not pursued Science in 11th and 12th. Every subject is carefully designed for the needs of industry. The one thing I hope they improve is more student feedback and taking them seriously. Christ is, was, and will always be famous for its extracurricular life and fests. Every other day, there will be fests happening, which will make you tired, but you will have an amazing college life. Scholarships are also offered, which can be checked on the website.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: A little note about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% of people were placed in my course. The highest package was 8LPA, the lowest 3.5 LPA, and the average was around 4-4.5 LPA. The top recruiters were EY, KPMG, and SAP. We had to search for internships on our own, so people went for government internships and some local companies in their hometowns. I went to TCS. Most people got into Analyst/Developer roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department has good facilities: labs, Wi-Fi, and projector classrooms. Teachers prefer writing with chalk on the blackboard. The library has a good number of useful books. There’s only a boys' hostel inside the campus for undergraduates. There is no girls' hostel; it is private and located outside the campus. There are 3-4 canteens, and the food is average in the canteens. There is a medical room for emergencies. The doc is a nursing student, and she treats well. There are a lot of tournaments being held now and then for all the sports, mainly the Devadan Cup and Tiger 5. Fests will be conducted, and students will have a good chance to participate, volunteer, and enjoy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified, but I didn’t find their method of teaching effective. They just come and read out the presentations, and only some teachers will care to explain what the content is about. They say that it is relevant, but I don’t think so because getting knowledge from 10-year-old books doesn’t make you industry-ready. We need to work on some practical things and inculcate skills from the outside world, but that didn’t happen. So that was lacking in the course curriculum.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted to gain exposure to AI and ML. I thought it would be a good start to build my career, but I am not very satisfied. There is a need to improve the lab facilities and lab equipment because they stop working right before the main lab exams, and we lose marks for not getting the results. The campus crowd is good. This year, a lot of first years came in, and they are starting to conduct good events and come up with new ideas. There will be a lot of teaching and non-teaching events coming up each month.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (IoT)
reviews.review_title: Satisfied and proud to be Christian. Service and teachers are top-notch. Beautiful campus ever.

detailed_review.Placements: Every student passes out of the college with a medium package of atleast 6 LPA during their first placement. But some students with their outstanding skills got placed in companies like JP Morgan for an annual package of 30 LPA at their final year. Placements are good at Christ. During your 2nd and 3rd year, you will be enrolling in various skill development courses and you will learn some subjects under the category LCA which stands for learner's centric approach. As I know, the highest package in CSE department of Christ is 36 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped and maintained. There is personalized Wi-Fi connection for students that students can access whenever they need within the campus. Hostel rooms are clean and washrooms are good, water facilities for both drinking and washrooms are available always. There are various canteens and shops that sell different types of food that are so good in taste. Stationery is available with ATM facility too. Medical room with a doctor is available. Christ gives importance to both academics and sports. There are basketball courts, a huge ground surrounded by lush greenery. There are various clubs and associations to showcase your talents.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-experienced and have wide knowledge in their respective fields. They teach students with nearly prepared presentations and through interactive classes. The subjects are relevant to the courses and are mainly focused on the skill development of students. Semester exams are of moderate toughness, and the questions asked are of real world problems related to make students learn and understand more. One should study good to get a higher CGPA.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
reviews.review_title: No regret, absolutely satisfied.

detailed_review.Placements: 35% are placed. The highest package - 22 LPA, the lowest package - 3 LPA. Accenture, Apple, Netflix, Amazon, Deloitte. AI engineer, IT manager, Software developer. Students can look for their own intern or intern in the college as well, e.g., doing research with faculty.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The faculty members are highly educated and approachable. They also encourage interdisciplinary research and studies. There are almost 7 canteens on our campus that serve good food. Students interested in sports are also encouraged to pursue the same.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful. The teaching quality is excellent. Yes, the campus also provides placement training, which makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are not that difficult with proper preparation. Yes, the course curriculum is relevant.
detailed_review.Other: We have tons of fests! One can enjoy their college life whilst studying.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Love the infrastructure and crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package for computer science is about 6 LPA. The highest salary is 32 LPA. I received this information from one of my faculty members. Companies such as Infosys, TCS, Cisco, and Trevista are some of the highest recruiters on our campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Kengeri Campus is known for its excellent infrastructure. It stretches about 80 acres and is well-maintained. It's lush green everywhere you look. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the campus. Library consists of two floors and offers a vast collection of materials. Hostel life is very disciplined. The food is diverse as there is a huge north and south canteen present. About 3-4 more stalls offering various food and drinks. A cafe coffee day is also present. The grounds are excellent. Football, cricket, and two basketball grounds are present as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here on Kengeri Campus are very chill and understanding. The course curriculum is relevant to today's standards. Holistic education is a course Christ endorses and placement training sessions every week are really helpful as well. We have 3 internals called CIA-1, CIA-2, CIA-3, and an end-semester exam at the end. The CIAs make up 70% of the final result and end-semester marks make up about 30% of the end result. So, if you do well in your internal CIA, you are set for the semester.
detailed_review.Other: Christ University is known for its events and fests. There is at least one event in a month by any department. The fests are huge and we have fun during DJ night and concerts. The crowd is really fun and easy to talk to. People from all over India come to this college so you will have plenty of options to choose your mates. Campus surroundings are a little boring.

reviews.review_title: Christ University- Yay or Nay.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of placements at Christ University has relatively increased in the past few years, making it about 75% overall. The highest package offered in my course is about 6 LPA and the lowest is 2 LPA, with the average being 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Accenture, Adobe, etc. Internship is made a compulsory requirement in the third year, hence there is 100% internship placement in companies like Amazon, Corizon, etc. The top roles offered in my course include Data Scientist, Software Developer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at Christ University is top-notch, with multiple libraries on the same campus. Wi-Fi access, access to more than 45 thousand books, and classrooms are all equipped with both projectors and blackboards for convenient teaching. The hostels on campus for engineering students are available for boys, and the girls' accommodation is off-campus, but students are offered transport at multiple times during the day. The hostels are well-equipped with water systems, common rooms, elevators, desks for every student, and vending machines. The students, however, have a strict curfew of 8:30 PM every night.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is well-versed and prepared before every class and comes into class with ready PowerPoint presentations (PPTs) and an agenda for discussion. The PPTs are later uploaded for students' access. The curriculum is very relevant and includes both extracurricular and curricular activities. The teaching quality is very good, provided that the student pays attention in class and follows the faculty. The students are definitely industry-ready with the hands-on work experience offered at Christ University. The semester exams are of average level, aiming to provide a proper mode of assessment for a student. The pass percentage is about 86%.
detailed_review.Other: I personally chose this course as I was intrigued by the subjects taught and the curriculum. The best thing about the course is the versatility that allows us to learn multiple areas of the software field. One thing I wish were better in my course is the number of working hours given to certain high-credit subjects. If more hours are given to these subjects, finishing the syllabus would be more comfortable. Events at Christ University are no small talk. We have our major flagship event, MAGNOVITE, where students from other colleges are invited to participate in various streams of activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Genuine review of the Christ University.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in our campus are very good. The lowest package is 5 lacs, and the highest package is 20 lacs. The top recruiters are many, like Amadeus, Amazon, etc. A maximum of 95% of students will get placed from all the courses. Many companies will be coming to take interns for the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our ECE department, as many labs regarding VSI signal, magnetic fields, and many more. All the classrooms are installed with Wi-Fi. Campus infrastructure is very good. There are mess, and the canteen is for all the students, including those in the hostel. Students also need to eat in canteens by paying.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are very well professional. They are knowledgeable, and the quality of teaching is very good. The curriculum prepared by the departments is advanced in the industry; the semester examinations in the college are somewhat difficult in the past, and the percentage will be more itself.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because there are the best things in our department, like labs and research. The campus is full of greenery, and the extracurricular activities will be going on daily by various departments.

reviews.review_title: The infrastructure was good overall.

detailed_review.Placements: Good placements took place. Various companies from all over the country came. Rigor grounds were conducted. The negative points were that students had to travel to the central campus for everything. That was a disappointing thing. Also, the average package was 4 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Average infrastructure. Wi-Fi had limited access to everything. There was a time restriction for going out, and no food or eatables were allowed in the hostel premises. Bathrooms were dirty, no soaps were provided, and the water was also not good. Cleaning was good overall.
detailed_review.Faculty: The syllabus was not up to the mark. Teachers were Ph.D. holders but lacked the knowledge of teaching for grooming. Also, it was too strict, and discipline wasn't like a college, more like a school. The teachers lacked professional teaching skills and were more casual, leaving everything to the students.

reviews.review_title: Great Placements, Great Peers, Strict Rules.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly, all students who sat for placements got placed. Top companies like ICICI BANK, Zomato, Deloitte, Goldman Sachs, Godrej, etc., came. Roles in both finance and marketing domains were offered, with an average salary of about 6-7 Lacs. Overall, placements were great.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good. Rooms are cleaned every day, with CCTVs, operational lifts, and a good amount of sunshine. An issue could be the strict timings; you have to be on time every day, and you can't miss out on even a single day. Within hostels, you also have to follow a set of rules.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are mostly PhDs and are qualified enough. Though teaching style varies, the curriculum is decent. There are continuous assignments and tests. Rarely will you find a time when you don't have any assignments or exams upcoming or ongoing.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: College with great infrastructure and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students sitting for placements get placed. The highest package was around 30 LPA at Morgan Stanley, and the average package is around 7-8 LPA. The lowest is 4.5 LPA from mass recruitment companies. Top recruiting companies include Morgan Stanley, Wipro, Siemens, and many others. Internship roles are offered by Dell, Barclays, Epsilon, and many others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is top-notch. They are currently upgrading some of the labs. All the infrastructure is very good. The hostel doesn't provide food but is well-maintained, with clean rooms and washrooms that are cleaned every day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and guide you properly throughout the course. You can learn a lot from most of the teachers, except for one or two. The way the teachers teach and their approach is very good. The course curriculum is updated every year, bringing the latest and in-demand skills to the subjects. Exams are of moderate level. The pass percentage is around 80.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied with the unnecessary rules and regulations.

detailed_review.Placements: There was no one last year who got placed, hardly 1 student, and this year also the situation is similar. Students are struggling to get placed. The average is 4 Lacs and the highest may be 7 Lacs for ECE. There are no such top recruiting companies, but yes, there are startup companies. Some of them got internships from the college itself, some from private offices, and others from government organizations. Employees, but not sure about the exact roles, but engineering posts.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too good; I think it is the best in whole Bangalore. Hostel facilities are also good, but only food and water have some issues from time to time. Labs, classrooms, and the library are perfect. The canteen food was found spoiled and was not clean sometimes. Medical and sports are the best. Playgrounds, basketball courts, and all of them are clean and good for use.
detailed_review.Faculty: For some subjects, teachers were not useful at all. Once, we got a fresher who was a student as our course subject teacher, and he didn't teach us properly, and what he taught wasn't considered properly by examination evaluators, which affected the marks of students. The course in this college, of course, is not relevant as compared to other colleges. Very difficult semester exams, and almost 40% of students fail one or the other subject. And 15-20 detentions per department per year is constant. Recently, they detained more than 100 students for not clearing first-year papers before getting into the 3rd year. There were a few students who had only 1 backlog but still got a year’s detention. Their life is ruined.
detailed_review.Other: I would not suggest students join this college. If you want to live a spoiled life and not study, then it's okay to join, but for people who really want to study, this place is not for them. Too much politics and too many favors are done for one community. Partiality is seen both from the teachers and the students, plus from the management office also.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (IoT)
reviews.review_title: My thoughts about Kengeri campus.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90 percentage of students are getting placed in very good companies. The highest is 36 Lacs, and the least is 7 Lacs per annum. Top recruiting companies are Cognizant, Bharat Benz, L and T. More than 85 to 90 percentage of students are getting internship opportunities in top companies like Cognizant, etc. The roles that my course is offered are applications of the internet in the modern era of the world.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, drinking water purifiers, toilets, bathrooms, etc. A nice garden area is there with full-time security watch. The facilities in the hostel provided are very good, but the cleanliness is not that appropriate. Security attitude is good, and also vending machines are there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very friendly. All the teachers have Ph.D. in the specific fields and have many patents in their name. The current curriculum has many problem-solving attributes, so it makes them ready for the industry. The semester exams are very easy, and the passing percentage is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: Many fests are there in this college like Basha Uthasa, dance programs, and all are there. Many communities are there for enhancing our confidence.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My overview of Christ University.

detailed_review.Placements: A minimum of 75% of students who opted for placements have been placed in top companies like Amazon, Siemens, Cognizant, etc. The highest package received by a student is 32 Lacs per annum, and the average package is 8 Lacs per annum. About 80% of students got internships in my course. Data analysts are some of the roles offered in my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My university is very vast; it has unique infrastructures and buildings. The entire campus is around 82 hectares and is filled with a green lush environment with trees. The hostel facility is average; it has 3-sharing rooms, and each student has a personal desk and cupboard. The hostel does not provide food for the students. The campus supports many sports and arts activities like football and basketball.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers and faculty members support all the students and treat them equally. They help them in their research. Yes, the current curriculum is relevant as it trains the students on how to face the real world and solve problems. It also teaches holistic education. The difficulty level of the examination is moderate, with 40% being the passing grade.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it has many job opportunities, and I also chose it because I am interested in Computer Science. The major events in our campus are Magnovite, Ethnic Day, and Sports Day. It also provides many scholarships.

reviews.review_title: Good facilities and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: First of all, as I know, not much students were placed from my department this year. The highest package is 10 Lacs per annum and average is 5 Lacs per annum. College won’t provide internship, we should find it by ourselves and no paid internships are accepted.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Labs are easily accessible, classrooms are always clean and there are two libraries which contain books from every department. Coming to hostel, there are two separate hostels for girls and boys. There are 5 canteens with average food provided and I think the hostel fee is actually high.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality depends on each teacher, but students can work with faculty members for any innovation. Extracurricular activities are given importance here, often programs take place in our college. Coming to exams, there are three CIAs and final exam. One day reading before exams doesn’t work.
detailed_review.Other: I’m interested in mechanical stuff, so I chose the department of Mechanical Engineering. Placements and Internships for our department should be improved. No scholarships and our campus is no less than a garden and maintained well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: In the case of internship, reference letter will be provided, no paid internships are allowed, in total, 60 days internship should be completed with certificate. College rarely provides the internship opportunity; if provided, a test will be conducted and only selected students are provided with the opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and lab facilities are available and well maintained; there are two libraries and plenty of options in different types of books. But hostel fees are little high and food is average with respect to the price. There are five canteens in total.

detailed_review.Other: Extracurricular activities are encouraged and there is a garden/park that is very well maintained.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A College Guide To Balance Everything .

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package offered was of 25LPA while the average package is around 7-8LPA offered. The top on-campus recruiting companies include L&T EduTech, Goldman Sachs, and Wipro. The percentage of students who got placed is around 60-70% and the top roles offered include those of Software develops, Testers, Solutions Engineer and so on.

There are tons of fests happening almost every month that help students network with various people and build their portfolio. The connectivity is a little poor as the campus is located on the outskirts of the city but this also comes as an advantage as the campus hosts a lush green environment which is a perfect setting for academic endeavors.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Beautiful campus, far from city, strict environment .

detailed_review.Placements: At the end of the first year, internship opportunities and time to do internships are provided. One should have completed some certified courses in order to secure an internship, which typically lasts around 45 days. Placement training is provided from the first year itself, with two hours a week dedicated to soft skill development and coding skills.

Sports facilities are great, along with trainers. Classrooms can accommodate 60-70 students. Auditoriums are used for events, and canteens are located around almost every block.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors are at least 2-degree holders and are knowledgeable, but some are too strict. The Computer Programming course is not updated; they’re teaching C language in the first semester. There are too many tests other than mid-sems and end-sems. Also, the attendance policy is super strict.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is very beautiful and peaceful. Darpan and Basha Utsav are some of the main events. The campus is really beautiful at Christmas time also. Club activities are very active, but the selection process is long and tiring.

reviews.review_title: A genuine review from a christite.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 7% of students were placed last year. No internship offers are available through the college. HR, sports, clinical, and counseling psychology positions are available. There aren't any specific recruiters for this course. Every student has to work on an internship to satisfy the degree criteria.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classes are provided with projectors and boards that work, and lab facilities for neurology and experiential psychology. There are 7 canteens in the college, which provide hygienic food and a lot of variety. Health centre and sports opportunities are abundant as well. No hostel for girls.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are Ph.D. holders with several years of experience and expertise. The course plan provided contains elaborate topics and regular CIAs to keep track of the learning. Various extra courses related to the subject are also provided. Pass percentage is 40% for mid-semester and end-semester exams. The exams are reasonably difficult.
detailed_review.Other: The course is interesting by itself; good exposure is one of the main best things in the course. We also get practical and hands-on experience. Hours provided to teach can be burdening, but it takes hours to complete the syllabus, so it is valid. Major events like Darpan for freshers, Magnovite, Magnificat, Kaleido, and Anvesha are events that happen throughout the year, making campus life fun.

reviews.review_title: Honest review of Christ.

detailed_review.Placements: Only 20 percent of the students were placed. The highest package went to 19 lakhs per year and the lowest came to 2 lakhs. Placements are good in other IT departments. The minimum eligibility criteria depends on the company that comes to recruit. Other than that, students should have a minimum of a 60 percent CGPA and should not have backlogs. Students with backlogs are allowed but obviously there won't be any interest from companies in those students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has a good infrastructure. They have 2 good libraries that have a great collection of books. The quality of the food is not bad. The hostel facility is good enough. Not that great, by the way. The hostel does not have its own food facilities. Students have to reach out for the college canteen or they can have food outside the campus. There are many good mess facilities outside the campus, which are good and affordable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is not that great. The faculty are well qualified and very nice. Most of them are very nice but there are some people from the management who are not nice. The semester exams are pretty tough and they are prepared by the faculty itself.
detailed_review.Other: There are many cultural activities at the college. There are many programs for students where they can engage apart from their studies. Many programs take place in a year at the college. Sports activities take place. Students can engage in athletics and many other activities. The college has its own team in football, cricket and many other sports. Especially the football team is good, as it has a proper coach and other activities.

faqs.answer: Christ University Kengeri offers BTech in Computer Science and Engineering. The eligibility criteria for the CSE course should have studied Physics, Mathematics and any one of the following 14 subjects. Candidates must have obtained a minimum aggregate of 50% in Physics, Mathematics & any one of the 14 subjects and 50% in Mathematics.

faqs.question: What is the application process for BSc at Christ University Kengeri Campus?
faqs.answer: Christ University Kengeri Campus BSc application process for all courses will close approximately a week before the scheduled selection process. Students can fill out the Christ University Kengeri Campus application form on the official website. The admission registration fee is INR 5,000 for all programmes. Candidates must follow the following steps for online application: Step 1: Visit the official website and click on 'Admission' followed by clicking on the level of the course students' wish to get into. Step 2: Select the school under Christ where the desired course is offered. Step 3: Select the desired course and click on 'Apply Now' written against it. Step 4: Register as a new user by entering the name, contact number, email-id and create a password. Log in again and fill out the complete application form. Pay the application fee and submit the form.

faqs.question: Can students join Christ Kengeri Campus M.Tech course directly without any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can join Christ Kengeri Campus M.Tech course without any entrance exam. However, candidates must participate in the selection process. The Christ University Kengeri Campus M.Tech selection process is inclusive of Skill Assessment (SA), Micro Presentation (MP), and Personal interview (PI). For the SA, the applicants will be given a topic to write. Further, for the MP round candidate should be able to talk for 90 seconds, on a topic given by the panel. Finally, for the PI rounds, the candidate will be interviewed for ten minutes. The selection process (SA_MP_PI) will be held in person at the venue selected while submitting the application form online

placement_faqs.question: What is the highest package for B.Tech students at Christ - Kengeri Campus?
placement_faqs.answer: The highest salary package offered to students at Christ-Kengeri Campus is 21.5 Lacs per annum. The median package offered to students is estimated at 4.8 Lakhs per annum. Many companies come to this University for placements. Some of the examples are Tech Mahindra, Cisco, Newtronics, Epsilon, TCS. All specialisations have good placement opportunities and there are openings for students from all specifications that they can attend. The University has a well organised and proactive placement support. One disadvantage is that the University offers very less placements for B.Tech in civil engineering.

placement_faqs.question: Are there any government job opportunity for BSc form Christ University Kengeri Campus?
placement_faqs.answer: Yes, there are plenty of government job opportunities for BSc graduates form Christ University Kengeri Campus. After graduating in Psychology one can either work for a company or practice as a professional. One can easily get a job in industries like NGOs, schools, colleges, and companies. The prominent roles offered by these industries are career counsellors, juvenile counsellors, and trainers in rehabilitation centres.

placement_faqs.question: Can HCL and Infosys be considered as some of the top recruiters of Christ - Kengeri Campus?
placement_faqs.answer: Yes, HCL and Infosys are regarded as two of the best employers at Christ University's Kengeri Campus for recruitment. It's these well-known IT firms who engage in the university's placement drives year after year and hire an enormous amount of graduates.Offering roles in a variety of fields, including software development, IT infrastructure, data analytics, and consulting, HCL has long been a significant employer at Christ University.Students are prepared for the recruitment process through workshops and pre-placement sessions held on campus. Christ University alumni are frequently hired by Infosys, another well-known employer, for positions in project management, business analysis, software development, and testing.Students have plenty of opportunity to get placements since they actively participate in the university's employment fairs and placement campaigns.
