highlights.summary:
Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad is a third generation IIT, which was established in 2016. The Ministry of Education, Government of India, and IIT Bombay are mentors to IIT Dharwad, which was started by the government. The Dharwad IIT is also able to set up the Global Centre of Excellence in Affordable and Clean Energy to aid in the development of Affordable and Clean Energy in India. It was also rated 5-star under the Green Rating on Integrated Habitat Assessment, Large Development Master Plan.
Indian Institute of Information Technology Dharwad is an institute of National Importance and a government institute offering various UG, PG, and doctoral programs. IIT Dharwad has over 10 departments including the Department of Chemical Engineering, Department of Civil and Infrastructure engineering, etc. It offers various courses such as BTech, MTech, MS, Integrated BS-MS, etc. It has signed various national and international MoUs with companies and universities such as The University of New Brunswick, Canada, National Cheng Kung University, Taiwan, Deshpande Startups, and the University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad among others, through these departments.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Inside the best 3rd gen IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost every student got placed, while the others opted for start-up or higher studies. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Infosys, Paytm, AIR Asian, Oracle, Zepto, Mathworks, Texas Instruments, etc. They offer placements. The average package is around 16-20 LPA. The highest package has been 52 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. Internships are available in companies like Amazon, Texas Instruments, JIO, Arista Network, etc. Top roles offered are SDE and product manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has an amazing hostel with a fully air-conditioned mess, Wi-Fi, and power backup. The college has facilities like basketball, badminton, table tennis, fuss ball and 3 common rooms with a capacity of 100 students in each hostel. Every wing has 3 washing machines. The indoor facility has badminton, squash, volleyball, and a gym. Temporary grounds for cricket and football and a helipad. The medical facilities are very efficient with 24/7 working and an ambulance just a call away.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college has an amazing academic structure. Teacher-student ratio of 1:10 and maintains a good balance between studies and extracurricular activities. Professors with impeccable academic records. Sports coaches here are not just skilled but highly supportive. Whether a student is a beginner or a pro, the coaches have them covered.
detailed_review.Other: The college provides a bus service for students traveling to the city or railway station. Our annual tech fest, PARSEC, has been a highly successful event and is eagerly anticipated by students. Multiple workshops and technical competitions are held, featuring a significant prize pool. We receive participants from various colleges across the state.  The annual cultural fest, HarshtaaL, takes place at the end of March. Yearly events, including sports, tech, and cultural competitions such as the general championship (inter-hostel and inter-branch), are organized to allow students to showcase their hidden talents.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great things take time, and IIT Dharwad will shine.

detailed_review.Placements: Chemical, biochemical, civil, maths, and computing are the branches introduced in 2022. There is no data present for placements. But branches like CS, mechanical, and electrical have average placements. The average salary package offered is 15 LPA. The percentage of students who got placed from those branches is around 70-80%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As the college is in the developing phase, it is not the appropriate time to conclude about infrastructure, but till now the buildings are class, big, and enough to meet the requirements of an IIT. All the basic facilities are available to the students and staff members. We have a mess, a gymkhana, 2 hostels, one wellness center, etc. There is a lack of sports grounds, so we used it from the Walmi campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is good like the other IITs. Teachers are highly qualified. Their teaching quality is very good. There are 2 short exams like quizzes along with mid-semester and end-semester. The course curriculum mainly focused on subjects like physics, chemistry maths, and biology in the first year, and then onwards to the specific industry.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is overall good. Due to the lack of the infrastructure, it is incomplete.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I think, as a 3rd Gen IIT student, the placements are improving from year to year.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, CSE, 60 students are there in total for 1st-year students, with two sections, S1 and S2, 160 students in each section. As a first-year student, I did not know much about placements, but as a 3rd-generation IIT student, it is the best of all. The average package is 21 LPA for CSE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Nice buildings, nice hostel, nice mess, nice roads, nice gym, nice indoor stadium, nice people, nice staff, good atmosphere, environment, nice college, nice people, nice atmosphere for the library, and a very good library, nice chairs in the library, very high-class library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Good faculty, nice qualified teachers, and Ph.D. teachers from prospective IITs. The courses for the first year are very relevant, and the exams are quite difficult, but you can do with minimum preparation day by day. Exams are quizzes, midsem, and endsem exams.
detailed_review.Other: As a first-year student, the fresher's party is the only event conducted till now, but there are other courses and activities as told by seniors.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure but come mentally prepared.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 12 students from the chemical engineering branch. The highest package is 54 lakhs in the CS branch. Very few students get internships in any branch. As ours is the third batch, since this is a new IIT, we still don't know about chemical engineering placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good, but hostel food is not. The classrooms and library are really nice. But, there are frequent power cuts. The Wi-Fi offers fast internet. There is a wellness center if you are sick, a sports complex to play games and a gym. Canteen food is affordable and tasty.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are difficult. Students have to prepare from the start of the semester itself. Yes, the chemical engineering branch is really helpful in the core side. Almost all the professors are highly qualified, but a few don't have proper ability to teach.
detailed_review.Other: There will be 2 or 3 DJ nights in each semester and many teach meetups. There will be an inter-IIT sports once a year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil and Infrastructure Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college has good faculty members who happily clear students' doubts.

detailed_review.Placements: This year placements are going on because our branch started three years ago. We hope that this year will get better placements. There is a career development cell (CDC) that helps to join internships. There are advanced research facilities that help more to qualify.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: They provide labs, equipment, materials, and everything. I'm still in my first year in this college, so I don't know about the engineering lab. Our seniors say that they are better than mechanical. Everything is good. Our college provides all facilities like a medical lab, hostel, canteen, and mess. The ground for cricket and football is under construction and will be available in the next year. There is a wellness center here for medical issues. We have a common indoor facility for indoor sports. There is a gym.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: IITs with best buildings, the latest IITs.

detailed_review.Placements: Mine is B. Tech Chemical and Biochemical Engineering. It is a 4-year course containing Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics, and Biology. There are around 50 members in our batch. Many seniors got internship offers, and they were placed in different industries, and a few started their own labs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The buildings and infrastructure are quite amazing. As ours is a new generation IIT, everything was built recently, and everything is amazing. It feels good to experience things here, though there may be a little discomfort with Wi-Fi, but it’s okay. Everything provided is of fine quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is super good. Exams are not so tough, but they are okay. Paper standards are set by the professors who teach us, and attempting those papers will be thrilling and exciting. Yes, of course, our course curriculum is relevant to our daily lives and makes us ready for the industry.
detailed_review.Other: Of course, IITs are super cool, and fests don’t happen often, but they are amazing. Sports and cultural competitions will also be held.

reviews.review_title: Campus has good infrastructure and food but placements are absolutely bad.

detailed_review.Placements: I would say placements are quite poor here. Only students with the highest CPI get placed or are offered internships. As of placements, one might probably regret joining here. Last year, only 30% of students were placed while some opted for higher studies, whereas others were left without any option.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite good, as it’s a newly built college. It’s clean, and the buildings and hostels are kept cool. While there is no air-conditioner facility in the hostels, the classrooms are equipped with air-conditioners. However, the buildings are a bit far from each other, so you may prefer to cycle rather than walk.
detailed_review.Faculty: I would say it’s okay. Faculty members don’t personally care about your grades. However, teachers have at least 7–8 years of experience in teaching and are graduates from IITs or NITs. Curriculum is well-organised. You get a total of 4 months of holidays per year, with 3 months for summer holidays and 1 month for winter holidays.
detailed_review.Other: Total campus strength is 1,200, so it can get crowded in the libraries and canteens. However, campus is expected to expand in the next 5 years, which should alleviate this issue. As for fests and events, the audience turnout is great, and the organization is pretty good. It might be slightly below your expectations, but overall, it’s decent.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Sc.+ M.Sc. in Interdisciplinary Sciences
reviews.review_title: The basic idea about IIT Dharwad.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, there are no placement data of my course as it started in 2022 and this course is very different, as the course starts in the 4th semester. We have to take our major subjects like Maths, Physics, Bio, and Chemistry, as it is a (4+1) year course. You can exit after the 4th year. This course is very relevant for those who are good in research. By taking Math, you can pursue studies in AIML, which has very good scope, and in Physics, there is Quantum AI and Computing, which is key for placements. As it is an IIT, you have an advantage there. The curriculum is very good and tough, so it can blow your mind.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Talking about our facilities, we have access to 24/7 Wi-Fi and the library. As it is a 3rd-gen IIT, the infrastructure is not completed yet, so it can take 10 years to be fully developed. The food in the mess is average. The canteen is open till 3:00, so you can go there and enjoy. There is no restriction on roaming; you can roam around the campus. The medical facility here is available 24/7. We have a nurse, and the doctors visit daily, but in restricted time.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty here is good, as there are professors who have done their Ph.D. from MIT and other foreign institutes. There are timings for meeting the professors, so you can take your doubts there. About the course, we have to take a major in the 4th semester. You can take Math, Physics, Chemistry, or Bio. The curriculum is very good, as in Physics and Math, we have AIML in our program electives, so you can define your career. There are visiting professors from IIT Bombay and Delhi who take our courses. The semester exam is tough, as it is an IIT. The pass percentage depends on the average of the class. There are labs every week, and credits are also there. If you want to pursue a Master's from other IITs, you can do it without qualifying GATE, just by scoring 8 CPI.
detailed_review.Other: We have a tech fest, cultural fest, etc. As there are approximately 350 seats, the crowd is less, so the professors focus more on us.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Campus life at IIT Dharwad.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75–80% of students were placed; the highest package offered was 55 LPA, which was offcampus. The highest on-campus package offered was 40 LPA, with an average package of around 12–14 LPA. The major recruiting companies were CRED, Google, Intel and Wipro. Many of the remaining students go for higher studies. The placements are pretty much on a decent level and are getting better year after year. As it's a new IIT, it will require some time to get at par with the level of holder IITs in terms of placement and reputation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
The infrastructure here is amazing. As it's a new IIT, it's hostels are far better than the holder IITs. The hostels are equipped with good Wi-Fi but sometimes there may be temporary network issues. The classrooms here are well furnished and equipped with all the necessities required.
Mess food is above average, and there is also a night canteen that remains open till 3:00 am. 
Our campus's main motto is to make it a " Net Zero Campus," which will be self-sufficient for water and electricity and waste management for which it is termed "GREEN IIT.". The only thing missing on this campus is playgrounds, for which we need to go to the temporary campus, for which buses are scheduled by the institute. The sports that are available in the sports complex are badminton, squash, table tennis, and of course indoor games like carrom, ludo and chess.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are amazing and highly qualified, with many years of teaching experience in other IITs, and the curriculum here is relevant. But there is a strict attendance policy of 80% mandatory attendance; failure to achieve this results in a DX grade and the student has to repeat this course again. The level of exams here is on a bit tougher side, but can be handled if someone attends classes regularly and attentively.

faqs.question: How much percentile is required for IIT Dharwad?
faqs.answer: IIT Dharwad accepts students for admission based on their percentile in the last qualifying exams. The institute releases a specific percentage that students must secure for admission to the programme.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Dharwad?
faqs.answer: To get admission in IIT Dharwad candidates must follow the admission process as per the institution admission guidelines. IIT Dharwad admission is completely entrance-based for all the courses offered by the institute. IIT Dharwad offers BTech and BS-MS (integrated course) at the undergraduate level. At the postgraduate level, the institute offers M.Tech and MSc. Further, IIT Dharwad offers a doctoral-level programme as well. Candidate can follow IIT Dharwad's admissipon procedure as follows: Step 1: IIT Dharwad Application Programme IIT Dharwad conducts the application process for admission to its offered courses. However, for a few course candidates are required to complete the entrance exam's registration/application process. Step 2: IIT Dharwad Selection Process Candidates are shortlisted based on their qualifications. Next candidates are required to go through the selection process which requires candidates to go through the course-based entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). After the selection rounds are completed, they are required to go through the course-wise counselling process for final seat allocation. For PhD and MS, IIT Dharwad conducts its own written test and personal interview for selection. Step 3: IIT Dharwad seat allocation Seat allocation for BTech is conducted by the JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority) counseling plays a crucial role in the final selection process, as it facilitates the allocation of seats in the BTech programme at IIT Dharwad. For M.Tech candidates must participate in the Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP) for seat allocation. sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Dharwad is one of the third-generation IITs, established by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The institute is spread across an area of 470 acres and is located at Chikkamalligawad, Karnataka. The institute has established the Global Centre of Excellence for Affordable and Clean Energy (GCoE ACE). This has been done with the help of the mission of the centre to make affordable and clean energy a backbone of India's development. The institute features well-equipped infrastructure with amenities like a gym, library, hostels and cafeteria. Read further to get to know more about the infrastructure facilities at the campus:

reviews.review_title: Fairly satisfied, hoping for companies to visit the campus for Tech Branches.

detailed_review.Placements: Tech Branches are new here, so placement stats are low. The highest package was given by Flipkart at 33 LPA. More companies are coming, such as Analog Devices, Grow, and PhonePe. Many more companies came to the campus, and sessions are ongoing too (2026 batch). The Teach Branches have shifted to the Bangalore campus for their final year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Here at the Bangalore Campus, the facilities are worse and still under construction. Jais campus is good. All facilities are there. Labs are good and classrooms too. The library is very small. The mess and canteen are decent enough. Medical facilities are available, and sports events are also conducted too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, but the course structure is worse. They teach only the book concepts and focus on exams, not on real-life job skills. Semester exams are not that difficult; the pass percentage is great. They conduct labs and workshops, but they are not useful as they are quite outdated.

reviews.review_title: Not very satisfied, but I did not have any other option, so it's okay to study here.

detailed_review.Placements: So, talking about placements, the Petroleum and Chemical branches are way better here. We can see PSUs for them, and for CSE, ECE, EV, MNC, and IT, we have quite low numbers. The teaching branches are shifted to the Bangalore Campus for their final year. A few companies visited the campus in Bangalore. Now, for my batch, companies are coming, and hopes are high. The highest till now from our year is Flipkart for 33 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is new, and the facilities are great at the Amethi campus. Food is decent, and labs are fully equipped, but the library is small for the crowd. Now, talking about the Bangalore Campus, the hostel is very new, but there are no good facilities at all. Wi-Fi is horrible here compared to the Amethi campus. Connectivity is okay at Amethi, but at Bangalore, it's very far from the city.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is not good at all (I am talking with respect to my branch, EV). The faculty focuses mainly on GATE and government job exams, and lastly, Ph.D. exams. No proper guidance or help for placement and job-ready skills; they only want us to attend lectures and score marks, which depend on rote learning.
detailed_review.Other: I chose my course, i.e., Electrical Eng. Major in EV, because I wish to learn a core branch. However, that major in EV is just a gimmick. The campus crowd is good, and events are great. Fests occur at a great level too.

reviews.review_title: College is great, but it has a small campus, and the location is quite far from the city.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement ratio for Chemical and Petroleum is almost 98 to 99%. You need to maintain a decent CPI and get good companies like IOCL, and PSU. Also, you can try for off-campus placements and clear exams like GATE, CAT, etc. The tech branches don’t have good placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are outdoor and indoor games in the college with well and good infrastructure. The campus is clean and tidy. It also has a beautiful garden and a statue. There are two academic blocks, and every kind of lab is available in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty can vary according to your branch, and in the end, it depends on the person to develop skills and create a better version of themselves. There are weekly quizzes and a large library to help the students. The seniors can also be very helpful in academics.
detailed_review.Other: College organizes many fests. The major fests are Urjotsav and Kalarang, etc. These are cultural and sports events that are very fun to attend.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design Engineering
reviews.review_title: Not at all satisfied, poor.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are so poor. We pay more than 12 lakhs in fees, even though it is a central government college still we do not get a 3 LPA job at TCS. College on campus is very poor. Companies don't come here and they send the CS department to Bangalore in 4th year in the name of exposure. But only we know what the reality is. Recently, a 3rd-year student did suicide but this college is shameless enough to even hold some sympathy.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Construction is still ongoing on and only two academic blocks are there. Wi-Fi doesn't work properly even after complaining a lot they don't fix it. Library is good and classrooms are good too but still, there's a need for more enhancement. Talking about the hostel even after a hefty amount they clean our room only once in 15 days. Wi-Fi is very poor. Medical facilities are the worst in the name of health center, all they have is bitadine and cotton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Even the HOD for the CS department is from the civil branch. They do not have good faculty members who are specialized enough for particular CS branch. Faculty members are well qualified but they are not as specialized in CS. They don't even know how to teach good. Students have to prepare all on their own to get off-campus placements.
detailed_review.Other: No proper sports facilities are here, we are not provided with a proper coach to train us. College life is the worst even though they get a good amount from the government. Still fest life is bad here, no artists and nothing creative. Good thing we can talk about official sitting here eating all of our money.

reviews.course: Discontinued(Aug 2025)- Integrated B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering + M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: It is a decent college with a good rank, and it is very easy to go foreign with this college's name.

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students placed is less this year due to the recession. The highest package is 24 LPA, given to 2 students. The average package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Wipro, Infosys, PhonePe, and other tech companies. Around 90% of students get internships in the 3rd year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course is a 5-year course with well-maintained infrastructure and a big library with more than 15,000 books available in every field. Newly built hostels for 1st-year students have rooms that are large enough. Wi-Fi, along with LAN and classrooms, are well-maintained (like IITs). The mess food is average, and every semester the menu is changed. Both veg and non-veg food are served. All sports are accepted, except for the swimming pool.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is well-qualified, most are from IITs or foreign universities. They are very helpful. The teaching quality is also very good. It is industry-relevant, and the course is updated according to industry needs. You can get passing marks one night before the exam, but for a good score, you have to work hard.
detailed_review.Other: Having a degree in AI is very good for the future. From the 1st year itself, they should teach AI-related subjects other than P, C, B, and humanities.

reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities .

detailed_review.Placements:
Recruiting companies: ONGC, Rystad Energy, Sunpetro, Selan, Oilmax, HLS Asian.
The highest package: 26 LPA.
Average package: 8-10 LPA.
Roles offered: Assistant Executive Engineer, Junior Data Analyst, Case Whole Engineer, Reservoir Engineer, Drilling Engineer, Production Engineer.
Internships: Halliburton, ONGC, Selan, Telesto Energy, MicroEnergy Credit, HLS Asian, Essar.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Wi-Fi in classrooms and hostels, library (9 AM - 12 AM), and state-of-the-art labs (drilling technology, production engineering, reservoir engineering, geology, well testing, and logging lab).
Sports facilities: volleyball, basketball, football, lawn tennis, badminton, table tennis, carrom, snooker, cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Highly qualified teachers who have done their PhDs from IITs or foreign universities with very good teaching quality.
Relevant course structure, which makes students ready for the industry.
High pass percentage, but getting high grades like A or A+ is difficult.
detailed_review.Other:
Fests: Urjotsav (technical fest), Energia (sports fest), Kaltarang (cultural fest), Pratidhwani (freshers' programme), Intra-mural sports activities.
Extracurricular activities: Student chapters like SPE, EAGER, FIPI, SEG, AAPG, IEEE, ACM, CodeChef, GFG, GSOC.

reviews.review_title: Talented students excel through personal efforts.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 50-60% of students secured internships, with others relying on personal efforts. Around 65-70% of students from the IT branch secured placements, but again, a significant number did so through personal efforts rather than college support.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs, classrooms, and overall infrastructure are decent. Hostels are functional and above average. Mess food is edible, it's repetitive, and sometimes below expectations. The campus is small but sufficient. It lacks recreational space, making student life less dynamic.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are really good. The IT branch curriculum is really good as well. Most professors make efforts to guide students, and the way they teach is decent. They are qualified and know their subject well. CSE department professors are really supportive.

reviews.review_title: The Farzi and average IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are basic, not on top, but the students are placed in PhonePe, TCS, Infosys, etc. The highest package is 20 LPA and the lowest is 3 LPA. Around 50 percent of students get on-campus placement. Around 50 percent of students got internships. Students are placed in senior and junior positions as well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi quality is good, which is available 24 hours, and library access is for 15 hours. Classroom infrastructure is basic. The canteen is not so good, but the mess food is good. Sports facilities are also good, and the college gives free-of-cost medical treatment. Labs are basic, not so advanced. Wi-Fi speed is not so fast.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is good. Teacher assistants are also good, and lab assistants are also good. Professors are not skilled. Semester exams are easy, and the study material provided to students is good. The course content is not industry-ready, and it is very difficult to relate the course content to industry demand.

reviews.review_title: This college is not for teach branches.

detailed_review.Placements: Here, B. Teach in electronic engineering started in 2020. So, the first batch passed out in 2024. There are 30 total students in the electronic branch, out of which 8 students are placed. Two of them were off-campus. The average CTC is 9 LPA and the highest package offered is 17 LPA, which is of course off-campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available. There are 2 or 3 washing machines on each floor. A floor consists of 30-35 rooms. The rooms are quite spacious and in good condition. Food quality is so-so and the canteen is also there. A cafe is also inside the campus. For small injuries, there is a medical center, and of course, it is free of cost. Sports facilities need to be improved.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified, but we all know that qualifications and ways of teaching are different. Some of the faculty members are good at teaching, while you have to compromise with some of them. The course curriculum is relevant, but it doesn't make you ready for the industry, especially for tech branches.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely good college, RGIPT - an evolving institute comparable to IITs.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch has 60 students, and total students in the fresher batch are 550. The average package of my branch is 1,00,000, while the highest and the lowest packages were 35,00,000 and 4,00,000 respectively. Top recruiting companies in my course were Apple, Amazon, Infosys, TCS, etc. Around 20 to 30 students got internships at the end of their 2nd and 3rd years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available are good rooms, good LAN and Wi-Fi connection, and good classrooms with projectors. Two-seater rooms are provided with one table, one chair, one cot, and one almirah to every student. There is a health centre, cafeteria, and canteen inside the college. Mess food is good, with a gala dinner held once in a month.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers and faculty members are good qualified. Most of them are graduates of IITs, top international institutes, or they have done their Ph.D. or postdoc from top-tier research universities. The course curriculum is relevant and inspired by the New Education Policy, streamlined with the job needs of today.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Tech in MnC because mathematics combined with computing is an evolving field. I have interest in quant and fintech, so this field will give me knowledge, and I will pursue it passionate.

reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements:
In the recent batch, 40% of students got placed. 
The highest package is 26 lacs, the lowest is 8 lacs, and the average package is 10 LPA. There is very decent placement in our college, and it is the first time PhonePe takes students with good packages.

60% got internships in companies like IOCL.

Wi-Fi is available across the college.
Labs are well maintained with working equipment, and classroom infrastructure is very nicely designed. 
The library is full of books, and from time to time new books are added.

Teachers were highly qualified and helpful; their teaching quality is very good. 
Yes, the course curriculum is totally relevant. Yes, it makes the students industry-ready.
Semester exams are hard as the teaching is of good level, and there is relatively little marking for students.
detailed_review.Other:
I have chosen chemical engineering because I have an interest in this department. 
Many events and fests are held in college for many industrial projects and industry readiness.

reviews.review_title: A Comprehensive Review on RGIPT, Amethi by Himanshu Saini.

detailed_review.Placements: There is an overall placement cell, coordinating with departmental placement cell at the institute. The placement cell helps the students to get settled in their life after RGIPT. Even a lot of Alumni work in PSUs at very high and good positions. Many of the students study in foreign universities like the University of Houston. Almost eight-five percent of students get placed every year and others opt for higher studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of RGIPT is well-built. The academic blocks are fully air conditioned with electric lecterns and projectors in the class. There are many labs that have great equipment. There is also an incubation center with workshop machines. There is also a night canteen that is open from 10:00 PM to 3:00 AM and a canteen open from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. RGIPT also has a BOB bank with ATM machines, Bakery shop, Post office, and Commercial complex. Best thing about the campus is that it also has a health center and guest hostel with faculty building. The hostels are well built and are very good in shape. A room accommodates two people and it's quite spacious. The C-block has an attached washrooms with rooms and other blocks have public washrooms and those are cleaned daily by janitors. The hostels have basketball, volleyball, lawn tennis, and badminton courts. For indoor games, there is a snooker room, Table tennis, dance room, music room, FMC room, and separate gyms for boys and girls. These hostels also have three messes and accommodate a large number of students at a time.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members of RGIPT are well qualified. Many of the faculty members are educated at reputed foreign universities like the University of Oklahoma. Especially the professors of core branches have a lot of academic experience and many publications and patents under their name. The teaching style is nice as they are quite knowledgeable. Hence, if you pay attention in the classes you will be left with minimal doubts. The course Curriculum is a complete mixture of academia and making students industry-ready. The exams have been divided as mid-sem and end-sem, the mid-sem carries thirty percent weightage and end-sem carries sixty percent weightage, while the remaining ten percent are of quizzes and assignments. The exams are not very hard, if you had paid attention in the classes then exams will be very easy for you. The passing percent if also around ninty-eight percent.
detailed_review.Other: The overall institute life is quite good in RGIPT. One thing for sure is that if you choose RGIPT, it going to provide you with good industrial exposure. The extracurricular life is also good, there are many events that are conducted on a regular basis and many international conferences also take place at RGIPT. RGIPT have its annual fests every year that includes Urjotsav (Teach fest), Energia (Sports fest), and Kaltarang (Cultural fest).

reviews.course: Discontinued(Aug 2025)- Integrated B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering + M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of no exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is not good for tech branches. First batch of CSE passed out last year and very few companies visited our campus. Majority of students get hired off campus. We are also facing issues for internship because companies are not coming for internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is good. Hostel is also well maintained. Every room is two person sharing. Mess food is also decent. But the campus size is very small and located in rural area. Some buildings are under construction. There is not any proper playground.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some faculty members are good and supportive but not all. Curriculum is also good. They just force for attendance. If you want to study you can do by yourself. Majority of students study from YouTube just one day before exam. There are two exams held in a semester. One is mid semester and another is end semester.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen my course as per current demand.

reviews.review_title: Good facilities but not that good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am from the IT branch, our first batch will pass out in 2025 , but in the CSE branch, the placement is going on and many students have secured the job, and the average package is currently 8 LPA for the CSE branch. As it is an energy institute, petroleum and chemical branches are a safer option here, and their average packages are above 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good here; the number of students is increasing significantly, due to which we are facing some problems like library size , playgrounds are limited and all these things. As the college is small for such a number of students, only 47 acres for approximately 2000 students, so obviously limited area. But the hostels are very good and they are new; they provide a washing machine and a water cooler, which are very good .
detailed_review.Faculty: As the number of students in a branch is less, for example, in my branch there are only 59 students, so you can directly contact the faculty if you are facing any problem in your academics or any other things; they will help you for sure . The course curriculum is relevant here; they update the courses according to the trends.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is good here but you can face problems like shopping and all those things as the nearest city is Raebareli, which is 30 km from here .

reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of bad placements in our college for tech branches .

detailed_review.Placements: There are 50–70% students in each branch. The average package for tech branches from this college will be 6–8 LPA for core branches. The average package is 12-20 LPA. The recruiting companies are HPCL, ONGC , BPCL, Reliance, etc. for tech branches and also TCS, Byju's and other private companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Space is very minimal in our college. So infrastructure overall is good. There is 24*7 Wi-Fi available all over campus. Labs are good; fully air-conditioned classroom are also air-conditioned. In the library too, there is air conditioning available for students. The food at the hostel is good compared to other colleges. Medical facilities are okay; every doctor is available in the evening and morning for 2 hours. Sports facilities are okay. There is no cricket ground, but you can play badminton, basketball, volleyball, and tennis. All other ground are there in college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in this college; all are well qualified and knowledgeable too. Their quality is not bad but also not great . The course curriculum is relevant mostly because it fulfills the demand of industry needed. The exams are tough; you really have to read to pass the exam. There is relative marking in this college in CPI.
detailed_review.Other: In our batch, there are 400 students; 320 are boys and the rest 80 are girls . I chose this course because I'm about to learn a tech branch subject. I would like to improve the course by reducing the irrelevant subject that we are reading . The college provides scholarships too and there are too many events and fests organized by the college, like Kaltarang and Tech fest Urjotsav.

reviews.review_title: If you want do research in oil and gas then you can join.

detailed_review.Placements: This college is nice. Their placement is well in petroleum and chemical engineering, but placement of IT branches is not well but studies are very well and I hope all is well in the next 2 years. Most companies come to the college for placement, like ONGC, Hal, Indian oil and other oil and gas industry companies. The highest package of this college is 26 LPA per year and the average is around 10 LPA. This college campus is small but very well because maintenance is very good and facilities are very good . You feel very good and for an internship, you are very well in a top company. As a result, while this college is excellent, it falls short of the best.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are very good the library is very good for students, books straight are good and all labs are on this campus. The hostel and mess food are good, the medical facilities are excellent and all games are here and well. Also, a gym is available on this campus .
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and all teachers are PhDs, and all are very qualified and experienced so academics are well and teachers help all students for academics and not academics, so I do not fear . Semester exams are moderate to hard but if you have done all assignments and tuts, then you perform well in exams .
detailed_review.Other:
I choose petroleum engineering because I think all are choosing it department and mostly not choosing this branch but if you want to do something unique, then you choose because there are many ways in the oil and gas industry. Due to pollution from combustion of oil and gas, you create a technique to minimize because the future is dangerous.
So I want something done for all Indians, so I choose this department. I want to minimize pollution due to the oil and gas industry.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the placement culture.

detailed_review.Placements: The students placed this year, 2024, were around 65%, with the majority in petroleum and chemical branches. The minimum package was 5 LPA and the maximum was 24 LPA. For petroleum and chemical branches, companies like ONGC, HPCL, IOCL, and HLS recruited. For other branches, there are no specific companies as they are all new branches. About 40% of students are doing internships in my branch, but most of them are off-campus; only one company specifically came for our branch, and only 3 were selected. In my course, there is a wide field in both tech and non-tech areas like chip design, communication engineering, VLSI, Verilog engineers, research, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is everything required in a college, but the only disadvantage is that our college is situated in a very remote area, so there isn't much exciting outside. Additionally, they are admitting tons of students, making it hard for survival in terms of area and resources.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are undoubtedly very qualified and teach nicely, but the syllabus is very outdated and not very useful from a competitive point of view. Also, the exam and syllabus pattern is too boring to adopt, and they give relative marking, which makes it tough.

faqs.question: Are admissions in Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology open?
faqs.answer: Yes admission is open at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology. According to the official website of Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT), for BTech courses, candidates need to apply and appear for JEE Main and JEE Advanced and fill the application form on the official website of the university. Last date to apply for MTech and PhD can be checked on the official website of the institute.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for RGIPT BTech?
faqs.answer: Application fee for RGIPT B.Tech is INR 600 + INR 108 (taxes) for SC/ST/PwD and female candidates. For all other candidates, the application fee is INR 1200 + INR 216 (taxes) . This fee is non-refundable.

faqs.question: Am I eligible for BTech admission at RGIPT if I have not qualified JEE (Advanced)?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can still get admission in Round 2 if you meet eligibility criteria to appear in JEE (Advanced) and have a valid JEE (Mains) rank. Also, you must have scored 60% or above in class 12th. For SC/ST/PwD category students,  55% or above is required.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in MBA course at RGIPT without CAT score?
faqs.answer: RGIPT allows admission without CAT/XAT/GMAT/CMAT/MAT/CUET-PG score under two circumstances. First, you should be a company-sponsored candidate. Second, if you belong to part time registration category. You will still have to fulfil the remaining eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for BTech CSE at RGIPT through JEE Mains?
faqs.answer: RGIPT BTech CSE Cutoff is based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced rank and scores obtained by candidates. RGIPT BTech CSE last round closing rank for the year 2022 was 14894 while the last round closing rank for the same in the year 2021 was 23800.

faqs.question: Can I get refund if I withdraw from BTech counselling round at RGIPT?
faqs.answer: Yes, RGIPT allows refunds only after receiving a valid withdrawal request submitted within the deadline. Refunds for seat blocking amount and event full fees can be refunded after certain deductions. After physical registration, you will only get back the security deposit after deducting the mess advance charges based on actual consumption.

faqs.question: What is the criteria for RGIPT MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the MBA core programme offered at Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology must meet the RGIPT MBA eligibility criteria . Candidates who have a valid score in the entrance exams must obtain at least 60% aggregate (55% aggregate for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates) in the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations and must hold a Bachelor’s degree with at least 60% aggregate or 6 CPI on 10 point scale (55% aggregate for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates). Candidates who do not have a score in the entrance exams must obtain at least 65% aggregate (60% aggregate for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates) in the Class 10 and Class 12 examinations and must hold a Bachelor’s degree with at least 65% aggregate or 6.5 CPI on 10 point scale (60% aggregate or 6.0 CPI for SC/ ST/ PwD category candidates).

faqs.question: Which entrance exam scores does RGIPT accept for admission to MBA?
faqs.answer: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology accepts entrance exam scores and percentile obtained by candidates in the CAT/ XAT/ GMAT/ CMAT/ MAT. The admission is offered to eligible candidates based on their performance in these entrance examinations and Personal Interview.

highlights.summary:
Established in 1989 by the Ministry of Human Resource and Development, Government of India, Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology is a AICTE-approved institute that offers courses on the UG, PG, PhD, and other levels. SLIET courses are provided across several streams such as Engineering, Management,Commerce, and more by 12 departments.
SLIET Punjab has a central library and provides sports and several other facilities to students. SLIET University Punjab aim is to provide training and education in modern technology areas. Located in Sangrur, this deemed to be university is ranked 151-200 by NIRF 2023 under the Engineering category and 151-200 by NIRF 2023 under the University (Overall) category.
Longowal SLIET offers B.E. and MBA as flagship courses. Longowal SLIET past students were taught value-added programmes such as the Personality Development Programme, a workshop on Virtual Lab for Antenna and Microwave Engineering using TARANG, and others.
More value-added courses are being added for current and future students of this reputed deemed to be university. SLIET Punjab students can also make use of the placement assistance programme provided by this deemed to be university. Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is the best college for our JEE score. We get decent placements and have a good life.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently I pursue my bachalor's in mechanical engineering from SLIET Longowal. According to last year, about 90% of students are placed from my branch in different companies. In 2025, the highest package of CSE is 55 LPA by Google and others are also placed well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SLIET Longowal has the best infrastructure in GFTIs with good library, many smart classes, well-equipped labs and workshops, a big size swimming pool, student activity center (gym, tycando, sketching, etc). It has a big size playground (badminton court, football court, volleyball, etc).
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are good except for the guest faculty. They show a very helpful nature. In this college, 75% attendance is required, and exams are decent (not very tough). If we study atleast 1 hour per day then we can easily score 8 CGPA and have much time for other things.
detailed_review.Other: The best B.E. branch in SLIET is mechanical engineering.

reviews.review_title: College is good and affordable and it improved its ranking from 176 to 79.

detailed_review.Placements: Regarding placement its good with many companies often visiting this institute. They also offer a variety of packages from as low as 4 LPA to 12 LPA in Mechanical engineering. There is not much academic pressure you can also focus on extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Some hostels are well maintained but a few are not up to standard. BH 6 and BH 5 are not that good. The remaining hostels are good and up to date. Students of different branches are kept separately. CSE and Mechanical branch students are in BH6 while ECE students are kept in BH9. Mess food is good and it costs 3000 per month.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are good and the course curriculum is relevant. Assignments are given with proper guidance. Regular tests are also conducted. Practicals are also held to gain hands on experience. Semester exams are easy to moderate depending on the subject. Good and regular study you can get good grades like 10 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: College is far from the main city Sangrur. The nearest city is Longowal 2 km.

reviews.review_title: College gives NAAC A+ and very good environment.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package is 18 LPA, and the lowest is 7 LPA. This college is really very good. Many companies visit our college like Tech Mahindra and Infosys. All the companies are very good, and my teachers are very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classes are very good, and all the bad branches are good. AC is also available in my class. We have camera, AC facilities, and also a large ground for boys. Projectors are also available for our study.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and also suggest to you how to read the books. Teachers have encouraged you to always study. They have an extra class for those who fail. Teachers also provide 3 hours extra classes for students who fail in their subject. Teachers are very good and they consult and solve your problem immediately.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is very attractive and they are going to apply knowledge to English to my performance in the other subjects.

reviews.review_title: Modern-day gurukul, fully green campus, good vibes, average package.

detailed_review.Placements: So, from my batch, 80% students got placement. The highest package offered was 27 LPA, the lowest package offered was 3.5 LPA, and the average package was around 4-5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Infosys, DEE, Sonalika, Kandhari Beverages Ltd., ISGEC, Jindal, TCS, Mahindra, etc. The top roles offered were GET.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Department infrastructure is the best. If you want to do research work or anything, there are plenty of resources available. The library is the best, all course-related stuff and other literature are easily available, and we have an e-library option. The hostel facility is good, but the mess is managed through a third-party contact, so the food quality is bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are the best in their field. If you're truly willing to grow, they will eventually help you grow. Course curriculum is relevant, but it has to be changed my modern world requirements. Semester examinations are easy. Almost every student passes, but exceptions are everywhere.
detailed_review.Other: I'm a 2025 passout from the mechanical department. My reason for choosing this course was my love for automobile machines. The things I want to improve are firstly that the course should change immediately with aligned to modern world requirements and new technologies. Second, the teacher and student relations should be good, and research work should be promoted. Plenty of extracurricular activities are held, like Tech fest, Cultural fest, Science day, etc.

reviews.course: B.E. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: College for extra passion and dreams.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% placed in this college in batches. Most students prepare for higher studies and other competitive exams based on graduation, like CLAT, UPSC, SSC, and many more exams like this, to update themselves with higher knowledge. They also prepare themselves for better jobs in placement drives and interviews.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good, but you have to compromise with the mess food. Security is also good. They protect you from any misleading activities and work in their surveillance. Please keep your things and life in check around them, and do not forget to thank them occasionally for their kind deeds.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and faculty are good. All the students also follow the guidance of the faculty and professors, studying very hard for good academics and placement. So, please check it out and try it if you want to achieve very big ambitions for other exams and life.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are good, and very regular workshops and events are also held.

reviews.review_title: I'm absolutely amazing because of all the facilities, low fees, good placement, and great faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students who are placed is about 60%. The highest package is 25 LPA, and the lowest is about 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TVS Motors, Mahindra, and Infosys. The percentage of getting an internship is about 80-85%. All the companies have given good reviews about the college students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are all types of facilities available, like digital libraries, a hostel, a sports complex, and grounds. There are different blocks, 12 different hotels, AC classrooms, etc. There is a volleyball court, 2 basketball courts, 1 cricket ground, 1 football ground, and 2 tennis grounds. There is a library and 1 study center.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are GATE-qualified. All the teachers are too good and supportive. They all have good experience in teaching. Semester exams are not that hard, they are easy, and the teacher also helps you with the preparation. The course curriculum is too good, and you have enough time to prepare.
detailed_review.Other: The reason I chose this course is that I want to be a mechanical engineer. The good thing about this is that the jobs are highly available for this branch.

reviews.course: Integrated Diploma in Instrumentation and Process Control (DIN)
reviews.review_title: It is an amazing technical institute in which every student can make a good career.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement at this college was very good. Almost 40-80% of students got placed here. Average placement should be about 4 LPA - 5 LPA. Many companies like L&T, Infosys, Microsoft, and many more companies visited the campus for selection. It provided a nice placement cell here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was suitable. It had a large area of 451 acres of land, and every department had its own building. It had a lake inside the campus, garden, shopping complex, and activity center including gym and stadium for sports as well. There was a swimming pool to enjoy also. It had a central library with a study center in it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors were well qualified here. They always taught you the relevant topics that were helpful for the student's skills. The curriculum was the latest and relevant. Practical knowledge was also given through practical classes. The semester exams were moderate. If you study, you will easily pass every semester.
detailed_review.Other: My course was integrated certificate diploma (ICD), it was a 3-year course after which you could directly give lateral entry exam for admission in the 2nd year of B.Teach course. My course was in instrumentation in which I gained practical knowledge as well as theoretical knowledge. I wish they would add some subjects and eliminate some in that course. Every year, a college fest was organised in this college in which many types of cultural activities were conducted, and provided enjoyment for students. This college was 18 KM from Sangrur district in Punjab, it was situated in Longowal.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of SLIET Punjab College.

detailed_review.Placements: For placements, you should not have any backlog in any exam and should have a CGPA of 7 and above. Top companies like Infosys, TCS, HCL, Cognizant, and many more recruit. The average placement is 5 LPA, and some top students also get 10 to 15 LPA. About 50 to 60% of students get placed each year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The best thing about this college is that its fees are lower compared to other colleges. I got a 91% in JEE Main. I got the Electronics and Communication branch, which is quite good according to my rank. Classrooms are quite good, and most of them are smart classrooms. The campus is beautiful and about 450 acres. The campus has a lot of trees, which makes it very beautiful.
detailed_review.Faculty: The qualifications of some faculty members are B. Tech and M.Tech from some IITs, but not all. But, some faculty members have a unique way of teaching, which is quite good. Some send their assistants to teaching, who are currently doing their Ph.D. at the college. This college also offers a diploma degree. The format for the B. Tech degree is Minor-1, Minor-2, and then Major each semester.
detailed_review.Other: At the time of registration, you have to pay Rs.67,000, which includes the first-semester fee, hostel fee, admission fee, and some other charges. The college's per semester fee is Rs.37,000. It also includes the hostel fee of Rs.4,000 per semester. You have to pay a mess fee, which is nearly Rs.3,000 per month. Various scholarships are available, such as Mahindra, tuition fee waivers for top rankers in JEE Main, and others. Two to three students in each batch are given a tuition fee waiver, which is about Rs.26,000 per month. I chose the Electronics and Communication branch because I love robotics, and it is growing in today's world.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has a very good environment, all you need here is to study hard by yourself.

detailed_review.Placements: I joined the college in 2023 computer science batch through JEE Main. Generally students who scored 90 percentile or more in JEE Main have a chance to get a seat in this college in the computer science stream. In my batch, there are 63 students. Talking about packages, the news we hear every day is that most seniors get placed with an average package, while some of them get good placements too. The highest package offered to date is 33 LPA and average movies are around 4-5 LPA. Top recruiting companies here are TCS, Infosys, and Cognizant offering software-developed roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure facilities are more than good here. All types of departments filled with sufficient equipment are present here. College gives free 1 GB high-speed Wi-Fi availability. The library facilities are also present here and for computer science students. All types of labs are available for them to study and practice. Hostel facilities are also very good. The only drawback is the mess food is not good. The college provides all types of sports and gaming facilities like a cricket stadium, volleyball basketball, and badminton court.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very much qualified. Some of them are Ph.D. from IITs, I feel nothing bad about the teaching quality unless you are interested in understanding. The course curriculum I feel is 4-5 years behind the current development in the CSE field. Talking about the examination there are 2 minor exams of 15 marks each 1 major of 50 and the rest of 20 of personal assessment and assignment which I think is a good way to evaluate students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose my degree here as the feels structure of studying here is very budget friendly and a very big campus of around 500 acres full of greenery and ample space for each activity. The only thing this college needs to improve is to start getting bigger and better placement so that bigger companies like Amazon also think to visit here. Two fests are held in a year Madhuram a cultural fest and Tech Fest a technical fest. Scholarships like a foundation for excellence, Reliance, NSP scholarship, and Siemens scholarship program are some of the scholarships.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with our college infrastructure, facilities, and good placement opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students in our department secured job placements, with the highest package being 11 LPA offered by Hindustan Unilever for the 2024-2025 batch. The lowest package is approximately 3.5 LPA, and the average package is around 4.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course include Hindustan Unilever, WABAG, Infosys, and others. At the end of the third year, every student is provided with an internship opportunity; however, these internships are unpaid, and only a few students manage to secure paid internships through the department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good and especially our Department building is superb and has all the facilities available for students. Labs are equipped with every required equipment. The library of our college contains a variety of books for students from academic to philosophy and motivational books. In 1st and 2nd Years students get a Triple seater room and from 3rd year many students get a single-seater room according to their CGPA till 2nd year the rest students get a triple-sharing room and in the fourth year everyone gets single seater room. The infrastructure of our hostel is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and very supportive and their teaching methodology is impressive. The course curriculum is relevant but, it should be up-to-date according to today's industry needs. Semester exams are moderate and you can easily pass the exam. In this semester, all students get passed from our department.
detailed_review.Other: On a regular basis, events are happening in our college. Each Semester Techfest and a Cultural fest named Madhuram happens apart from this Alumni meet, Teachers Day, Independence Day, and Republic Day are Celebration here.

reviews.review_title: It has good return on investment.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 40 to 50% of students get placed in our college while other goes for higher education or government jobs. Top recruiting companies are Wagah Limited, Khanna Paper, Hindustan Unilever Limited, Jindal Steel, and Infosys. College provides internships to all students in third year. While many students also got internships in 2nd year through their own capabilities and potential.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, there is a library with numerous books. There is also a digital library in our college. College provides 1 GB of internet to every student without any cost. There is also a study room for students. College management also provides hostel to the students at a bare minimum cost. There is a cricket ground, badminton court, volleyball court, and basketball court on our campus. There is also a running ground in our college. There is a health center on our college campus. But the quality of mess food is disappointing. Many students suffered from health issues.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of them behave just like a friend. Faculty members are highly qualified and experienced. Their pedagogy is also good. But there needs to be a little bit of enhancement in labs so the students can connect their knowledge to the industry-based applications. Semester exam papers are not so difficult if someone sticks to teacher's notes then they score good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there is a good scope for electrical engineer in the government sector. On our campus, 2 major events happen one is Techfest Sliet and another is cultural event called Madhuram. College provides tuition fee waivers to students whose family economic condition is not good. College management also helps poor students through national service scheme. Many students acquired private scholarships like Siemens, Mahindra, and Reliance through their own potential. Extracurricular activities happen but in a limited manner.

reviews.review_title: SLIET: The technical gurukul for students.

detailed_review.Placements: There are many companies that come to our campus for placement such as L&T, TCS, Wipro, JSw, and Deltax. For mechanical engineering, companies like Tata Motors, Goderaj Aerospace, JSw, and Tata steel come for placements. The highest package is 11 LPA till now this academic year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi, but it is a limited connection of 1 GB per day. It is a drawback. The college has a gym, stadium, sports activities centre, health centre, and central library. The hostel is quite good and clean. There is a shopping complex where we can shop for our necessary items. Sports activities are not too much in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are supportive of students. The teaching skills are also average. The course is industry-oriented. There are two types of exams. The minor exam is held twice a semester. The major exam is an end-semester exam. They are quite easy to score. An average student can pass the exam with their other activities.
detailed_review.Other: There is a big problem of transportation. The college is situated in a rural area. There are only a few buses to go to the city. There can be difficulty in shopping. There is no major railway station in the city. For train boarding, we have to go to Delhi Ludhiana and Ambala.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: SLIET and Its Beauty By Alok.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90 percent of the students get placement every year, and the rest go for higher education. The highest is 19 LPA, the average is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is around 4 LPA. The top recruiting company for my branch here is Z-Scale. I don't know about the college internships yet.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Almost all the required facilities are available here, but there's a problem with Wi-Fi. Actually, they only give 1 GB of data per day to each student, which is very less. Otherwise, all other things like the library, classrooms, etc. are very good. In the hostel, we are provided with all the facilities, but the mess food is the same as always—not good in taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in all aspects related to the course curriculum or self-projects, etc. All the professors have done Ph.D. in their respective fields. Some teachers have very good teaching methods, and some do not. The course curriculum is a bit old, and I don't think it will make us properly ready for the industry.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of its increasing popularity and demand in the upcoming years. I wish they could teach us about VLSI and how to actually design a circuit from computer to physics design. Hostel event - DJ night. College main event - Tech fest, Madhurima. Connectivity is okay. Extracurricular activities are very good.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college because of the good teaching methods and green, lush environme

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of placement of this engineering college in the mechanical branch is really good. The average placement package goes from 3 Lacs to 13 Lacs per year. The highest package in the mechanical branch is 24 Lacs. The most common recruiting companies are Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, Wipro, Amul, etc. Seventy percent of students got internships from our Mechanical branch at Infosys. Top roles offered in the mechanical branch are research areas, hands-on practice, and programming.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many facilities available in our college, like a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus, different types of labs like a Chemistry lab, a Computer lab, a Physics lab, and also a research lab. There is also a digital library and a normal library. The hostel has very well-tiled rooms with a metal bed and two fans for each room. The quality of the mess is average. There is also a medical center with 24/7 availability of a doctor, a sports complex, and a shopping center.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers of this college are very polite and helpful. The teaching quality of the teachers is excellent, and the professors are well-qualified. Some are award-winning at the national level in many fields. The course curriculum is relevant, and after finishing the course, students immediately join the industry.

reviews.review_title: Pretty average in other aspects, but lot of spare time for self growth.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements in SLIET are pretty average, as big players of the market do not participate in the on-campus placements. Companies like Infosys, TCS, Tech Mahindra, HCL, etc. participate in the placements, but they offer packages as low as 3.5 LPA. Students have to go through aptitude tests, interviews, and a final round, and at the end, they get these little packages. This year (2024), Infosys took 44 students from CSE, ECE, EE, etc. in the IT field at 3.28 LPA. The highest package offered this year was 11.5 LPA to 5 electrical students by Hindustan Unilever.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the institute is pretty good. The college is spread over 453 acres of pretty lush and green area. The college has academic blocks (one for each branch), a central library with all kinds of books, magazines, a study center, a student activity center with a gym and sports facilities, a sports complex, a food complex, stores, restaurants, etc. The classrooms have smart boards installed and Wi-Fi access for every student, but with a limit of 1 GB per day per student. Talking about the hostel, you get a 3-seater room with 3 chairs, 3 almirahs, 3 beds, 2 fans, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members of the college are above average; they are highly qualified and experienced, and pretty supportive. Maximum faculty members understand the problems of students, unlike other non-deemed colleges (for example, they do not detain or fail you if the case is genuine). The curriculum of this college is outdated and totally examination-focused. The syllabus of the course is the same as it was 20 years before. Exams are easy; it is easy to score and get a good grade in this college even if you study 1 day before the exam. There are 3 examinations per semester.
detailed_review.Other: This college has a great ROI (Return on Investment), but the crowd of this college is Punjab-centric and quite orthodox. Connectivity is not good; the nearest town is Sangrur, which is 25 km from the college, and the nearest city is Ludhiana, which is as far as 90 km. There is no source of fun inside the college, and nightlife is the worst. Hostel timing: (10 pm for boys, 7 pm for girls). Scholarships: (Tuition fee waiver, 2 students get it per branch - 1 boy and 1 girl). Fests: Madhuram (cultural fest), Techfest (technical fest). The college lacks in sports infrastructure.

reviews.review_title: Review of Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: In the 2018 batch, the lateral entry candidates from the diploma joined JEE main in the second year. The course is for 4 years. Students got placed in Larsson & Turbo, Mahindra, Maruti Suzuki, Byjus, etc. Students also got placed in core and chemical companies like Khanna Paper Mills and Owen Scoring.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is excellent. The new blocks are under construction. The hostel life is up to the mark with appropriate food and water supply. Hostels are well-maintained. We have digital classrooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and experienced. They have in-depth subject knowledge. Exams are conducted as per the curriculum and follow the guidelines of the Ministry of Education Government of India. The curriculum is well-maintained and changes accordingly. The course includes CRE, PDC PIC, fluid mechanics, engineering, mathematics, thermodynamics, and process calculation.
detailed_review.Other: Placements could be better for core branches. The campus is lush green but connectivity is not good.

reviews.review_title: Best college in a low fee for diploma and degree.

detailed_review.Placements:
Students need 6.5 cgpa for placement. The highest package is 22 lakh, the lowest package is 3 lakh, and the average package is 7 lakh. Top recruiting companies are asking for 8.5 or above cgpa, technical skills, speaking skills, and knowledge about work.
Need 8.5 and above cgpa for internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. The mess food is not too good, but we can adjust, and the mess charge is about 3000 per month. Medical facilities are average, but they take urgent action on everything. Sports facilities are very good and 1 tournament is conducted per month.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The teaching quality of teachers is excellent, and they are very helpful. 
Yes, this course makes students ready for industry, and this course is curriculum-relevant. Exams are easy but need to study daily about 3 hours, and the pass percentage is 4 cgpa.

reviews.review_title: SLIET- A silent way of approach through the nature.

detailed_review.Placements:
The highest package offered is 6 LPA.
The lowest package offered is 3–4 LPA. 
The top recruiting firms are Sonalika International, Mahindra, Godrej, Jindal Steel and Power Ltd., TEXNP Engineering, and Kangaroo.
70% of candidates are being offered internships at IRM Energy, Sonalika, and Kangaroo.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
CAD/CAM and stimulation labs are there.
The food quality is good but non-vegetarian food is not provided in any of the hostels as it's a Jain college. Medical facilities are also good institutes that provide two different ambulances, one for minor health issues and the other for major health issues.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers were well qualified and some of the faculty members also take classes in foreign countries. Yes, students have to do industrial training at the end of the semester. The difficulty level is medium, and students who achieve a pass percentage of more than 85% will pass their academics.
detailed_review.Other: Since my school days, I have been interested in vehicles, so I chose this course. Everything is good, except some of the classrooms need to be renovated and should be converted into smart classrooms. Tech Fest for teaching enthusiasts and Madhuram for cultural events. Campus crowding is also good, as it has a lot of species of trees, reindeer, and a sake-free campus. Scholarships are also provided to those who merit them.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The infrastructure is quite good.

detailed_review.Placements: Due to the recent recession in the placement drive, the placement in the CS branch is not as promising, while the chemical branch has a 99% placement rate. Before the recession, the CS branch had a 100% placement rate, with the highest offer being 68 LPA off-campus. TCS is the top recruiting company. Generally, students get internships in TCS.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For self-study, we have a study center (reading room). The library has 10,000 books of various genres. The food quality in the mess is not great, but with time, you can get used to it. Medical facilities are good. You can access all sports facilities if you ever play at the national, state, or zonal level.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some faculty members are very supportive, while some are not. Only a few teachers may detain you due to your low attendance. Try to attend their classes as much as possible. We have training in the first year to understand the basics of industrial work. All teachers hold Ph.D. degrees. Semester exams are not very difficult; you need one day of study before the exam to pass.
detailed_review.Other: CS had a lot of hype at my time, which is why I chose it, and I'm also good at coding. Placement needs to improve. We have "Madhuram," our cultural fest, and a Techfest where you can apply for many scholarships.

reviews.course: B.E. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
reviews.review_title: The beauty of Sant Longowal Institute.

detailed_review.Placements: Yes, our college provides placements but the graph of placements is going down over the last few years. Many known companies, like Infosys, TCS, JSL and many more, visit every year to give placements. The highest package is 21 LPA, and the average package is 4 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course is very well designed because it is not only designed for theoretical purposes but also to give practical knowledge. Our classes, labs, and library are in very good condition. Our library, the digital library and the reading hall are fully air-conditioned. Our hostel is also very good but it needs to be renovated ASAP. But the mess food is the only thing that I don't like about my college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members of our college are highly qualified. This line not only suits our teachers but also our class counselors, and every branch has its own class counselor. Other than this, every student has their own mentor. Our course curriculum is very relevant to our field because we learn more about real-life applications. Exams are taken 3 times in each semester as minors 1 and 2 and the last major.
detailed_review.Other: I didn't choose this course by my own choice but by my rank in JEE Main. Everything in our college is at its best but transportation is a problem that every student has. So many fests, sports competition and teaching competitions are organized in our college every year.
