reviews.review_title: I'm satisfied with the services that Vignan University offers.

detailed_review.Placements: 80 percent of the students got placed in construction companies. Some got placements in cement production companies as plant engineers and quality control engineers. The highest package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies, I'm not really sure, since I'm yet to graduate.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi connection is top-notch, the Wi-Fi at the classroom, library, and the hostel is good, which means you can do your projects from anywhere on the campus. The mess is still in good structure, even the labs are up to standard, but there is room for improvement.
detailed_review.Faculty: The student-to-teacher ratio is 1:28, which means there are fewer students per teacher. We have the advantage of asking for clarity whenever we want to. Students also have an opportunity to do research and projects with their lecturers. Two students from the last batch published a research paper.
detailed_review.Other: I'm happy about the way this university treats international students. There are still some complaints here and there since we're from different cultures, but overall, I'm satisfied. There is a separate menu for international students.

reviews.review_title: We go on field visits to different companies and also do field projects.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of the last batch got placement in construction companies, Ready-Mix Concrete Companies, and Infosys. Plant Engineer and Control Engineer roles are offered. 50% to 60% of civil students get internships through college, and some do research honours, which are funded by the university, and some participate in local government projects. The highest package is 6PA, the lowest package is 3 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a software skills lab ( Autocad, Staad Pro, Revit, Primavera), a department library which has our books and also some ancient collections on the subject. We have a lab the size of a warehouse, which is divided into many sections to accommodate the equipment used in our practical subjects.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers have been helpful a lot. As an international student, I feared that there would be a language barrier and that the lectures would be tough, especially with the different accents. However, the teachers are patient, taking their time to explain to me every concept and checking if I understood before proceeding.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there are a lot of opportunities in my country, and the skilled force is low, and I wanted to gain experience and leverage technology at Vignan University so that I can go back and implement it back home.

reviews.review_title: Great academics and infra, average placements, supportive faculty, vibrant campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: 90 percent of students are placed. The packages offered are 3.6 LPA, 2.4 LPA, and 1.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Sun Pharma, Dr. Reddy's, Pfizer, Aurobindo, Hetero, and Novartis. It is not an internship but 100 percent placement. Roles offered include direct patient care, industry roles such as R&D scientist, QA/QC officer, medical writers, regulatory affairs, sales/marketing, and government roles like drug inspector and jhospital pharmacist, focusing on drug development, safety, quality, and patient counseling.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Modern, air-conditioned smart classrooms, advanced tech-enabled labs, and a library with digital access are available, supported by 24/7 Wi-Fi and sports facilities. Now, the quality of the hostel facilities is better compared to before. The facilities now serve good food with good-quality mess and canteen. Medical facilities are available 24/7 with an ambulance. All sports are conducted, and all games competitions are held.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers teach and help students at each and every point and clarify every single doubt. The course depends on a focus on practical, hands-on skills and alignment with current market needs like tech and data, along with soft skills. If you study well, the semester exam will be easy; otherwise, it is hard to pass. To pass each subject, 50 percent of marks are required. The passing percentage is 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B. Pharmacy for diverse and stable careers in healthcare, driven by a passion for science, helping people, and industry growth, offering roles from drug research and R&D to clinical practice and entrepreneurship, with opportunities for global careers. Better practical application, real-world projects, clearer structure, and updated content reflecting current tech and society, along with improved career support, are needed. All types of events and fests are conducted here. The campus crowd is more than eight thousand. Campus surroundings include physical spaces like buildings, libraries, and grounds. Scholarships are also provided to students, along with sports, clubs such as debate, tech, and arts, volunteering, internships, research, and part-time jobs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Everything is acceptable.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed in my course. The highest package is 12 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package offered is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Wipro, etc. Around 70% of students get internships in TCS, and the remaining get internships in Wipro. Top roles offered in my course are Web Development, Hackathons, and Coding Competitions.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Wi-Fi is available 24/7. Classrooms are clean, and labs are available for individual subjects. The library is open all seven days of the week. The hostel is clean, with single, double, triple, four, and seven bed rooms available. Canteens are available both in the campus and hostel. Medical facilities are available. Many types of sports are available, such as basketball and volleyball.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified in their subjects and are very helpful. They teach well. Our department modifies the course every year according to company and market demand, so the course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are moderate. We have to go through class notes and PPTs to pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there is more scope for placement compared to other courses. I wish there were more practical subjects compared to theoretical ones. Our college organizes fests like Mahotsav every year. Scholarships are based on board marks. There are many extracurricular activities. Around 90% of students pass the exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied that the college offers a variety of courses.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently pursuing B.Tech in AIML 2nd year at Vignan University. The AIML programme here focuses on practical learning of modern AI tools and industry-oriented skills. The university has strong placements with around 85 to 90 percent of eligible students placed each year. Top recruiters include Cognizant, TCS, Wipro, HCL and Accenture. Many students also secure internships through campus drives, gaining hands-on experience in software and AI-based companies. This course is helping me build strong technical and problem-solving skills for future career opportunities in AI and technology.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The quality of food is good and the wardens are friendly with the students. We can easily get our doubts sorted. The faculty teaches well, and the college infrastructure is very good. The management provides various opportunities to enhance your skills. The events are done by the student bodies.
detailed_review.Faculty: A good faculty plays a very important role in the learning and growth of students. Good faculty members are not only teachers, but also guides, mentors and supporters in the educational journey. They have a deep knowledge of their subjects and are always ready to share it simply and clearly. A good faculty member explains difficult topics with patience and uses examples that make learning easier and more interesting for students. Apart from teaching, good faculty members help students to develop confidence and a positive attitude. They encourage students to ask questions and express their ideas.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is vibrant with regular technical events, cultural fests and student activities. One of the major attractions is Vignan Mahotsav, held every February, which is a grand cultural and technical festival bringing participants from many colleges. The crowd is friendly and supportive. The university provides scholarships and encourages extracurricular participation in sports competitions, clubs and innovation programs. The campus surroundings are peaceful with good connectivity and facilities that support both academics and personal development.

faqs.question: Can I get free seat in Vignan University?
faqs.answer: The scholarship seats are alloted in all programmees on the basis of merit, number of seats and first come first served basis at Vignan University. The scholarship is applicable for four years of study subject to maintaining a minimum of 70% aggregate in the preceding year (s) without any backlogs.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in Vignan University for B.Tech with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can get admission to B.Tech at Vignan University with 60% in Class 12th. The eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at Vignan University require candidates to have scored more than 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA in 10+2 in Telangana and other South Indian States. For candidates in North, North East, and other states of India, the minimum eligibility is 50% marks in the 10+2 exam.Since, you have meeted the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at Vignan University with 60% in Class 12th.

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for admission to B.Pharma at Vignan University?
faqs.answer: Vignan University BPharm admission is entirely entrance-based for the academic year 2024. Candidates seeking admission to the Vignan University BPharm are required to meet the eligibility criteria. The admission will be based on the candidate's performance in the V-SAT/ EAMCET. The merit position of candidates for admission will be based on the rank obtained in V-SAT/ EAMCET, provided that they get a minimum of 60% aggregate in the Class 12/ intermediate examination as per the eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Is GATE score compulsory for M.Tech at Vignans Foundation for Science, Technology and Research?
faqs.answer: No a GATE score is optional. TS PGECET can be also used to secure admission to M.Tech at Vignans Foundation for Science, Technology and Research. The candidates should have requirements of graduation. Both the two entrance tests are enough to apply.
